text: 482 naman ni Gatchalian ang may kaangay man nga panawagan.
english: 482 by Gatchalian also made a similar call.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang 93 anyos nga anay aktor ang may 80 ka mga pelikula halin sang 1950s tubtob sa 2000s antes siya nagsulod sa pulitika.
english: The 93-year-old former actor had 80 films from the 1950s to the 2000s before he entered politics.

text: Napatay si Revilla sang tinalikdan nga Hunyo 26 bangud sa heart failure.
english: Revilla died on June 26 due to heart failure.

text: Ang National Artist Award ang pinakamataas nga pagkilala nga ginahatag sa mga Pinoy sa nagkalain-lain nga patag kaangay sang literature, music, dance, theater, visual arts, film, broadcast arts, fashion design kag architecture and the arts.
english: The National Artist Award is the highest recognition given to Filipinos in various fields such as literature, music, dance, theater, visual arts, film, broadcast arts, fashion design and architecture and the arts.

text: Gin-propose ni Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez III ang bag-o kag mas mataas nga buwis agud nga mabayaran ang utang sang Duterte administration sa luwas sang pungsod.
english: Finance Secretary Carlos Dominguez III proposed a new and higher tax to pay off the Duterte administration's foreign debt.

text: Ang amo nga foreign debts amo ang ginpahayag gingamit sa pagbakal sang bakuna kag pag-address sa COVID-19 pandemic sa Pilipinas.
english: The foreign debts were allegedly used to purchase vaccines and address the COVID-19 pandemic in the Philippines.

text: Suno kay Dominguez, mangin paagi ang mass vaccination sang gobyerno agud nga makabukas liwat ang ekonomiya sang pungsod kag malab-ot sang more productive economic sectors ang 7 percent tubtub sa 9 percent nga gross domestic product (GDP) growth subong nga tuig.
english: According to Dominguez, the government's mass vaccination will be a way for the country's economy to reopen and more productive economic sectors to achieve 7 percent to 9 percent gross domestic product (GDP) growth this year.

text: Apang may masulusobra na lang 100 ka adlaw nga nabilin sa Duterte administration kag ang masunod nga administrasyon amo ang magasolbar sang utang sang gobyerno.
english: But there are only more than 100 days left in the Duterte administration and the next administration will resolve the government's debt.

text: Sa kabug-usan, $2 billion (masobra P102 billion) ang utang sang gobyerno —$1.2 billion para sa vaccines kag $800 million para sa booster kag pediatric shots— halin sa tatlo ka multilateral banks sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: In total, the government owed $2 billion (more than P102 billion) —$1.2 billion for vaccines and $800 million for booster and pediatric shots— from three multilateral banks last year.

text: Nakahulam man ang Pilipinas sa bilateral partners kaangay sang Japan kag South Korea agud nga may pondo para sa rollout, lakip na ang logistics kag equipment kaangay sang cold storage.
english: The Philippines has also borrowed from bilateral partners such as Japan and South Korea to fund the rollout, including logistics and equipment such as cold storage.

text: Sa katapusan sang 2021, ang public debt-to-GDP ratio sang Pilipinas ang nagsaka sa16-year high nga 60.5 percent, nga naglapaw sa 60-percent threshold nga amo ang ginalantaw nga masarangan sang emerging markets.
english: At the end of 2021, the Philippines' public debt-to-GDP ratio rose to a 16-year high of 60.5 percent, exceeding the 60-percent threshold that emerging markets are expected to afford.

text: Apang ang finance secretary ang pahambalon, masarangan pa sang Pilipinas ang amo nga ratio.
english: But the finance secretary will say, the Philippines can still afford that ratio.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dominguez nga diskusyunan pa ang fiscal consolidation package kaupod ang presidential candidates agud mahibaluan nila kun paano madumala ang nagataas nga utang sang Pilipinas.
english: Dominguez said the fiscal consolidation package will be discussed with the presidential candidates so that they know how to manage the Philippines' rising debt.

text: Suno sa iban nga mga opisyal sang Department of Finance (DOF), pwede nga ma-target sang next administration sa “relatively untaxed” sectors.
english: According to some Department of Finance (DOF) officials, the next administration could target “relatively untaxed” sectors.

text: Kun bag-o pa lang ang relasyon, daw cute pa man siling sang iban ang pagselos-selos sa imo nga partner kay pagpakita lang ina kuno kun daw ano mo gid siya ka palangga.
english: When the relationship is new, some people say it's cute to be jealous of your partner because it's just a show of how much you love him.

text: Apang samtang nagadugay, madamo ang nagasiling nga makatalaka na ini ilabi na gid kun indi na makontrol kag nagapangimon na lang sa halos tanan nga tion.
english: But as time goes on, many say that it becomes annoying, especially when it becomes uncontrollable and jealous almost all the time.

text: Isa ka hitabo sa Argentina ang nag-ugat sa simple gid lamang nga selos kag naglab-ot sa isa ka krimen.
english: An incident in Argentina was rooted in simple jealousy and escalated into a crime.

text: Isa ka adlaw, nagalakat-lakat kag naga-uyatay pa sang kamot ang 23-anyos nga lalaki nga si Mariano Grinspun kaupod ang iya 32-anyos nga nobya nga si Natacha Palavecino.
english: One day, 23-year-old Mariano Grinspun was walking around with his 32-year-old girlfriend Natacha Palavecino.

text: Samtang yara sa dalan, nasugata nila ang isa ka babaye kag ginbugno sini si Mariano bagud schoolmate gali niya ini sang una.
english: While on the road, they met a woman and she beat Mariano because she was his schoolmate before.

text: Nangamusta man lang ini, apang nangin bayolente na ang nobya ni Mariano tubtub nga gingabot sini ang iya dala nga kutsilyo kag gin-atake ang babaye nga nagpamugno nga si LC.
english: He just said hello, but Mariano's girlfriend became violent until she pulled out her knife and attacked the woman who claimed to be LC.

text: Natumba si LC sang naigu siya sang kutsilyo sa iya nga ilok, apang nalikawan na sini ang isa pa ka handos sang kutsilyo tubtub nga may nag-abot nga isa ka lalaki nga nagbulig sa iya kag nakaluwas siya sa krimen.
english: LC fell when he was stabbed in the nose, but he managed to avoid another stab until a man came to his aid and he survived the crime.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, malas gid para kay Mariano bangud pagkatapos gin-atake sang nobya ang babaye, siya naman ang ginbalikid sini kag ginbuno sa dughan.
english: On the other hand, it was unfortunate for Mariano because after the girlfriend attacked the woman, he turned around and stabbed her in the chest.

text: Base sa surveillance cameras sa area, nakabaisay pa ang magnobya antes nag-collapse si Mariano, kag sang ulihi, bisan haluson na ini makabangon, gin-atake pa gid ini sang iya nobya gamit lamang ang iya kaugalingon nga mga kamot.
english: Based on surveillance cameras in the area, the couple had an argument before Mariano collapsed, and later, although he almost got up, his girlfriend attacked him with her own hands.

text: Nagtawag man ang mga testigo sang emergency services apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi ang lalaki.
english: Witnesses also called emergency services but the man died.

text: Base sa nagapadayon nga imbestigasyon, nahibaluan nga may history gid man sang pagka-bayolente si Natacha.
english: Based on the ongoing investigation, it was learned that Natacha has a history of violence.

text: Sang 2021, na-convict man ini kag napreso sang isa ka tuig sang ginbuno man sa dughan ang iya ex-boyfriend.
english: In 2021, she was also convicted and jailed for a year when she also stabbed her ex-boyfriend in the chest.

text: Mangin si Mariano ang una naman gali nga naka-report sa pulis bangud sa mga pamahog sang nobya kag physical injuries nga iya naangkon.
english: Mariano was the first to report to the police because of his girlfriend's threats and physical injuries.

text: Sa pagkamatuod, sang Hulyo sang nagligad nga tuig, may restraining order nga gindagdag rason nga indi makapalapit si Natacha kay Mariano apang sang nag-expire ang order, didto man gali kag nagdesisyon si Mariano nga hatagan sang one more chance ang ila relasyon nga amo naman ang ulihi bangud sa trahedya nga natabo bangud lamang sa pagbugnuhanay sa dalan.#
english: In fact, in July last year, a restraining order was added that prevented Natacha from approaching Mariano but when the order expired, Mariano decided to give their relationship one more chance.

text: Nagpabutyag si Presidente Marcos nga luyag man niya kuntani mag-upod sa dako nga protesta batok sa anomaliya sa mga flood control projects sa pungsod kun indi lang siya presidente.
english: President Marcos expressed that he would have liked to join the big protest against anomalies in flood control projects in the country if he were not president.

text: Ini ang iya pahayag sa pamangkot kun basi matabo man sa Pilipinas ang natabo sa Nepal kag Indonesia ang natalana nga protesta sa Septyembre 21 sa Luneta kag People Power Monument.
english: He said this when asked whether the protests scheduled for September 21 at Luneta and People Power Monument might happen in the Philippines as happened in Nepal and Indonesia.

text: Suno sa presidente, nahangpan niya ang mga hublag protesta sang publiko kag kinamatarong sang kada isa nga magpautwas sang sentimyento.
english: The president said he understands the public's protest movements and everyone's right to express their sentiments.

text: PPahanumdom niya nga dapat mangin matawhay ang demonstrasyon kag indi magresulta sa kalakasan.
english: He reminded that the demonstration should be peaceful and not result in violence.

text: Gintu-ad sang Barangay Anti-Drug Abuse Council sang Barangay Balabago, Jaro, Iloilo City nga wala sang malain nga record sa ila ang main subject sa buy-bust operation nga ginpatigayon sang City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) kagab-i sa amo man nga lugar.
english: The Barangay Anti-Drug Abuse Council of Barangay Balabago, Jaro, Iloilo City admitted that the main subject of the buy-bust operation conducted by the City Drug Enforcement Unit (CDEU) last night in the same area has no bad record against them.

text: Ang mga subject amo sanday John Winston Porras, 30-anyos residente sang nasambit nga lugar; Jesus Angelo Martinez, 34-anyos, kag Berna Villarosa, 25-anyos residente sang Bolilao, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: The subjects were identified as John Winston Porras, 30-year-old resident of the said area; Jesus Angelo Martinez, 34, and Berna Villarosa, 25, residents of Bolilao, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Ginakabig man ang tatlo nga HVI ukon High Value Individual.
english: The three are also considered HVI or High Value Individuals.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Antonio Jacoba Jr., iya ginpahayag nga nalamhitan sang iligal nga druga ang pangalan ni Porras kasunod sang buy-bust operation sa banwa sang Leganes sang 2020 kaangot man sa paglapas sini sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Antonio Jacoba Jr. said Porras' name was involved in illegal drugs following a buy-bust operation in Leganes town in 2020 in connection with his violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Suno kay Jacoba, anay nangin Sangguniang Kabataan Chairman man si Porras sa ila barangay.
english: According to Jacoba, Porras was also the Sangguniang Kabataan Chairman in their barangay.

text: Ginlaragway man sang natungdan nga wala nagaguwa sa balay si Porras kag masami nga indi makit-an sa ila komunidad.
english: He also described Porras as not leaving his house and often not being seen in his community.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sang natungdan nga bangud sa nagpangita sang palangabuhian ang iloy ni Porras sa luwas sang pungsod, tiya lang sini ang iya upod sa ila nga balay.
english: He also revealed that because Porras' mother went abroad to earn a living, only her aunt lived with her.

text: Nahibaluan nga nga ang buy-bust operation kagab-i ang nagresulta sa pagbaylohanay sang lupok sa tunga sang subject kag sa mga kapulisan bangud sa ginapahayag pagbato ni Porras sa kapulisan.
english: It was learned that the buy-bust operation last night resulted in an exchange of fire between the suspect and the police due to Porras' alleged resistance to the police.

text: Nagdangat tanan sa P4,080,000 ang balor sang anum ka sachets kag 10 ka dalagko nga pinutos sang ginapasuni nga shabu nga ginabanta nagabug-at sang 600 grams ang nakuha kay Porras kag sa mga kaupdanan sini.
english: Six sachets and 10 large sachets of suspected shabu weighing 600 grams were recovered from Porras and his companions.

text: Magluwas diri, may yara pa sang caliber 45 nga pusil kag magazine nga may isa ka bala.
english: In addition, there was a caliber 45 pistol and a magazine with one round.

text: Nakaboto na ang kapin 1.8 million ka mga registered voters sa Ohio may kaangtanan sa nagahilapit nga Election Day sa Estados Unidos sa Nobyembre 5.
english: More than 1.8 million registered voters in Ohio have already cast their ballots in connection with the upcoming US Election Day on November 5.

text: Suno kay Bombo Mary Drake, international correspondent sa Ohio, bangud ginapahanugutan ang early voting sa mga ordinaryo nga mga residente, ang nasambit nga numero ang halos one-third sang kabilugan nga Ohio ballots nga ginalauman sa eleksyon.
english: According to Bombo Mary Drake, international correspondent in Ohio, because early voting is allowed for ordinary residents, the said number is almost one-third of the total Ohio ballots expected in the election.

text: Ginpahayag ni Drake nga mismo ang mga leaders sang Democratic kag Republican Parties ang nagaengganyo sang early voting bangud mas bentaha ini sa mga partido agud nga masiguro na ang voter turn-out.
english: Drake said the leaders of the Democratic and Republican parties themselves are encouraging early voting because it is more advantageous for the parties to ensure voter turn-out.

text: Ginapanan-aw naman nga magdaug ang Republican nga si former president Donald Trump batok kay Vice President Kamala Harris bangud isa ini ka republican state sa sulod na sang pila ka tuig apisar nga nangin swing state ini sadto.
english: Former Republican President Donald Trump is expected to win against Vice President Kamala Harris because it has been a Republican state for several years despite being a swing state.

text: Ang mga botante sa Ohio ang maga- elect sang isa ka member sang US Senate agud magtiglawas sang estado sa November 5, 2024.
english: Voters in Ohio will elect a member of the US Senate to represent the state on November 5, 2024.

text: Maga-elect man ini sang 15 US representatives halin sa amo nga state.
english: It will also elect 15 US representatives from that state.

text: Sa 2020 presidential elections, nagdaug si Republican Donald Trump sang 53.3 per cent sang boto batok kay Democrat Joe Biden.
english: In the 2020 presidential elections, Republican Donald Trump won 53.3 per cent of the vote against Democrat Joe Biden.

text: Pabakuron pa sang barangay kapitan sang Brgy.
english: The barangay captain of Brgy.

text: Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo nga si Leonardo Tamises, and seguridad sang ila nga barangay pamaagi sang pag pa “roving” ukon pagpalibot sang ila nga mga barangay tanod sa ila lugar.
english: Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo, Leonardo Tamises, and the security of their barangay by roving their barangay tanods in their area.

text: Ini matapos matabo ang krimen sa isa ka dalaga nga si Candie Tabadan, 18 anyos nga gin himuslan kag ginpatay.
english: This is after the crime of a young woman named Candie Tabadan, 18 years old who was raped and killed.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Leonardo Tamise, Barangay Kapitan sang Ingay, Tubungan Iloilo kapitan nga ang tanan nga porsyon sang ila nga barangay pagalibuton sang napulo nga barangay tanod nga maga umpisa alas otso sang gab-i tubtob alas dose sang tungang gab-i .
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Leonardo Tamise, Barangay Kapitan of Ingay, Tubungan Iloilo, said that all portions of their barangay will be surrounded by 10 barangay tanods from 8 pm to 12 midnight.

text: Gin dugang pa sini nga sang adlaw nga natabo ang krimen nangin alerto gid ang ila nga tanod forces para ma tul-id dayon ang suspek sang krimen.
english: He added that on the day of the crime, their tanod forces were very alert to immediately correct the suspect of the crime.

text: Nanumpa na ang mga myembro sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI).
english: Members of the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) have been sworn in.

text: Gin-appoint ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. appointed

text: bilang chairperson si retired Supreme Court Associate Justice Andres Reyes.
english: as chairperson retired Supreme Court Associate Justice Andres Reyes.

text: Ang iban nga myembro amo sanday anay DPWH Secretary Rogelio “Babes” Singson kag si Rossana Fajardo nga country managing partner sang SGV & Co.
english: Other members are former DPWH Secretary Rogelio “Babes” Singson and Rossana Fajardo, country managing partner of SGV & Co.

text: Magaserbe naman ng special adviser si Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong.
english: Baguio City Mayor Benjamin Magalong will serve as special adviser.

text: Sila ang magapatigayon sang maid-id nga imbestigasyon sa mga flood control kag iban pa nga infrastructure projects sang gobyerno sa nakaligad nga 10 ka tuig.
english: They will conduct a thorough investigation into the government's flood control and other infrastructure projects over the past 10 years.

text: MANILA – Wala nagadali nga magpakasal ang aktor nga si Sam Milby sa kahagugma nga si Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray.
english: MANILA – Actor Sam Milby is not in a hurry to marry Miss Universe 2018 Catriona Gray.

text: Suno kay Sam, indi pa subong ang tion agud nga mag-settle down sila ni Catriona ilabi pa nga 10 ka tuig ang ila nga age gap.
english: According to Sam, now is not the time for him and Catriona to settle down especially since they have a 10-year age gap.

text: Ginpahayag ni Sam nga sa edad nga 26 anyos, naga-umpisa pa lang sa showbiz career si Catriona kag kun sila ang gintagna sa isa kag isa, sila gid ang magadayunay sa ulihi.
english: Sam said that at the age of 26, Catriona is just starting her showbiz career and if they are predicted to each other, they will stay together in the end.

text: Nahibalu-an nga nangin sentro sang kontrobersiya ang Miss Universe 2018 matapos ang break-up sa anay nobyo nga si Clint Bondad nga nag-post sang cryptic message sa social media kasunod sang kumpirmasyon nga mag-on na sanday Cartiona kag Sam.
english: Miss Universe 2018 became the center of controversy after her break-up with ex-boyfriend Clint Bondad who posted a cryptic message on social media following the confirmation that Cartiona and Sam are on.

text: Ginakabalak-an nga maglab-ot pa sa kapin 100 ang narekord nga napatay sa lapnagon nga pagbaha sa Espanya.
english: More than 100 people are feared dead in widespread flooding in Spain.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang mabaskog nga pagbubo sang ulan nga nagresulta sa flash flood kag ginakabig nga pinakamalala nga pagbaha sa sulod sa ng pila ka dekada humalin sang 1973 kun sa diin 150 ang patay sa baha.
english: This follows heavy rains that resulted in flash floods and are considered the worst floods in decades since 1973 when 150 people died in the floods.

text: Suno kay Bombo Ma.
english: According to Bombo Ma.

text: Edzel Lamparero Lopez, bombo international correspondent sa Spain, pinakaapektado diri amo ang eastern Valencia kag southern Andalusia regions.
english: Edzel Lamparero Lopez, bombo international correspondent in Spain, the most affected are the eastern Valencia and southern Andalusia regions.

text: Nagkalaguba man ang mga taytay kag mga buildings.
english: Nagkalaguba man ang mga taytay kag mga buildings.

text: Nagdeklarar na si Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez sang three days of mourning matapos ang kalamidad.
english: Prime Minister Pedro Sanchez has declared three days of mourning after the disaster.

text: Nakumpiskar ang masobra P1-million nga balor sang illegal nga droga sa isa ka habal-habal driver sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy-bust operation sa Barangay Tipacla, Ajuy, Iloilo sa pagpanguna ni Police Captain John Michael P. Dalipe, Officer-in-Charge sang Ajuy Municipal Police Station.
english: More than P1-million worth of illegal drugs were seized from a habal-habal driver in a drug buy-bust operation conducted in Barangay Tipacla, Ajuy, Iloilo led by Police Captain John Michael P. Dalipe, Officer-in-Charge of the Ajuy Municipal Police Station.

text: Ang subject amo si Alyas Bagtik, 42-anyos kag is ka newly identified High-Value Individual (HVI) nga naga-operate sa banwa sang Ajuy.
english: The subject is Alyas Bagtik, 42-years-old and a newly identified High-Value Individual (HVI) operating in Ajuy town.

text: Base sa report sang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), naglab-ot sa duha ka bulan ang pag-monitor diri sang kapulisan kag nadiskubrehan nga nagahalin sa malapit nga mga kabanwhanan ang source sang illegal nga droga kag ginabaligya mismo sa iya banwa.
english: According to the report of the Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO), the police monitored the area for two months and discovered that the source of illegal drugs came from nearby towns and was sold in his own town.

text: Na-recover kay bagtik ang 150 grams sang suspected shabu nga may estimated standard drug price (SDP) nga PHP 1,020,000.
english: Recovered from the suspect were 150 grams of suspected shabu with an estimated standard drug price (SDP) of PHP 1,020,000.

text: Sa subong, yara na sa kustodiya sang kapulisan si Bagtik kag nagapangatubang sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.
english: Bagtik is now in police custody and is facing charges of violation of Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002.

text: Target sang Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) ang 6 percent nga nga pagsaka sa investment pledges subong nga tuig.
english: The Philippine Economic Zone Authority (PEZA) targets a 6 percent increase in investment pledges this year.

text: Ini matapos sang 27.36 percent nga pagnubo sang tuig 2021.
english: This comes after a 27.36 percent decline in 2021.

text: Suno kay PEZA Director General Charito B. Plaza , gin-aprubahan na sang ahensya ang P69.301 billion worth sang investments halin sa export-oriented enterprises sa 2021, nga nagpakita sang 27.36 percent nga pagnubo ipaanggid sa P95 billion sang 2020.
english: According to PEZA Director General Charito B. Plaza, the agency has already approved P69.301 billion worth of investments from export-oriented enterprises in 2021, which showed a 27.36 percent decrease compared to P95 billion in 2020.

text: Gin-athag ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. explained that

text: nga wala sang pasin-uhon ang gintukod sini nga Independent Commission for Infras­tructure (ICI).
english: that it established the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) without any hesitation.

text: Suno kay Marcos, wala sang kilalahon nga abyan, himata ukon kaalyado ang ICI sa imbestigasyon sa anomaliya sa flood control projects.
english: Marcos said the ICI has no friends, relatives or allies in the investigation into anomalies in flood control projects.

text: Mangin ang iya pakaisa nga si House Speaker Martin Romualdez ang indi man luwas.
english: Even his cousin House Speaker Martin Romualdez is not safe.

text: Ginhimo sang presidente ang pahayag matapos ginsiling ni Navotas Congressman Toby Tiangco nga sa likod sang anomaliya sanday Romualdez kag anay House Appropriations chair Zaldy Co.
english: The president made the statement after Navotas Congressman Toby Tiangco said that behind the anomaly were Romualdez and former House Appropriations chair Zaldy Co.

text: Paathag sang Presidente, wala sang mapati kun hambalon lamang niya nga wala sang ginaapinan ang ICI gani dapat nga imbestigaran ang tanan nga involved sa anomaliya.
english: The President explained that no one will believe him if he says that the ICI is not protecting anyone and that everyone involved in the anomaly should be investigated.

text: Nag-donar sang $31,000 ukon kapin P1.5 million ang US pop icon nga si Taylor Swift sa isa ka estudyante sa London agud nga maka-eskwela.
english: US pop icon Taylor Swift donated $31,000 or more than P1.5 million to a student in London to study.

text: Suno sa Grammy-winning artist, nangin inspirado siya sa dedikasyon ni Mario nga maka-eskwela sa University of Warsick sa diin may online page nga nagapangayo sang donasyon para sa 18-anyos nga dalaga agud nga makakuha ini sang math degree.
english: The Grammy-winning artist said he was inspired by Mario's dedication to attend the University of Warsick where there is an online page asking for donations for the 18-year-old so she can get a math degree.

text: Ginpahayag ni Mario nga nagsulat siya sa fundraising page sa diin iya ginpakigbahin nga nakakuha siya sang top grades sa iya nga eskwelahan kag gintanyagan nga ma eskwela sa University of Warwick apang indi makasarang ang iya ginikanan sa pagsuporta sang iya mga kinahanglanon.
english: Mario said he wrote on the fundraising page where he shared that he got top grades in his school and was offered to study at the University of Warwick but his parents could not afford to support his needs.

text: Nangin tuman ka malipayon si Mario kag gintawag nga “blessing” nga mismo si Taylor Swift pa ang nagbulig sa iya.
english: Mario was so happy and called it a “blessing” that Taylor Swift herself helped him.

text: Tuman gid ang paghalong nga aton ginahimo para sa mga patay.
english: We take great care of the dead.

text: Ini bilang pagpakita man sang pagtahod sa tawo nga wala na sang kabuhi kag pagpakita man sang pag-unong sa iya pamilya nga puno sang kalisod.
english: This is also a show of respect for the person who has lost his life and also a show of solidarity with his family who is full of suffering.

text: Apang may mga amo man sini nga insidente nga wala gid nagakalikawan kag indi gid dayon madali-dali nga malipatan.
english: But there are also such incidents that are never avoided and are never easily forgotten.

text: Isa ka motorista ang nakibot sang may nakit-an ini nga lawas sang tawo sa tunga sang karsada sa Stalowa Wola nga isa ka syudad sa southeastern Poland.
english: A motorist was shocked when he found a human body in the middle of the road in Stalowa Wola, a city in southeastern Poland.

text: Tuman ang kakulba sini sa pagdumdom nga siya ang nakabunggo sa lalaki kag nadulaan ini sang pangalibutan sa tunga sang dalan.
english: She was shocked to remember that she had hit the man and lost consciousness in the middle of the road.

text: Sang ulihi, naglapta na ang pictures sa social media nga nagahigda ang bangkay sa white striped pedestrian crossing matapos ini nahulog gali sa salakyan sang punerarya!
english: Later, pictures circulated on social media of the body lying on the white striped pedestrian crossing after it fell into the funeral home!

text: Gilayon nga nagpaguwa sang statement ang Hades Funeral Services kun sa diin gin-ako sini ang responsibilidad sa natabo nga insidente.
english: Hades Funeral Services immediately issued a statement claiming responsibility for the incident.

text: Ginbasol man sini ang unexpected technical failure sa electric tailgate lock sa autofunebre rason nga samtang nagabyahe, nahulog ang bangkay samtang pakadto-pakari man ang iban nga mga salakyan.
english: He also blamed an unexpected technical failure in the electric tailgate lock on the autofunebre which caused the body to fall while traveling while other vehicles were also coming and going.

text: Ginsiling sang kumpaniya nga wala ini nakaabot sa high standards sang ila serbisyo kag tuman gid ang ila pag-sorry sa pamilya sang napatay.
english: The company said it did not meet the high standards of its service and they are very sorry to the family of the deceased.

text: Nagpangayo man ini sang pasensya sa tanan nga nakakita sang picture sang bangkay kag sa mga dismayado sa natabo nga insidente.
english: He also apologized to all who saw the picture of the body and to those who were disappointed in the incident.

text: “It is with deep regret that we inform you that as a result of an unexpected technical failure of the electric tailgate lock in the hearse, during the transport of the body of the deceased, an unfortunate event occurred which does not reflect the high standards of our company, our deep empathy towards the families of the deceased, and the respect we always show to the deceased,” kabahin sang statement sang kumpaniya sa ila website.#
english: “It is with deep regret that we inform you that as a result of an unexpected technical failure of the electric tailgate lock in the hearse, during the transport of the body of the deceased, an unfortunate event occurred which does not reflect the high standards of our company, our deep empathy towards the families of the deceased, and we have always shown respect to the deceased,” part of the company’s statement on its website.#

text: Indi ma-depensahan sang Filipino-American sprinter nga si Kristina Knott ang iya nga gold medal sa 31st Southeast Asian Games sa Mayo 12-23 sa Hanoi, Vietnam kasunod sang pag-suprer sini sang foot injury.
english: Filipino-American sprinter Kristina Knott will not defend her gold medal at the 31st Southeast Asian Games on May 12-23 in Hanoi, Vietnam after suffering a foot injury.

text: Gin-anunsyo mismo ni Knott kag sang Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (Patafa) nga maga-isol si Knot sa kumpetisyon.
english: Knott himself and the Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (Patafa) announced that Knot would withdraw from the competition.

text: Suno sa 26-anyos nga Fil-am runner, maga-focus anay siya sa pagpaayo sa iya nga tiil kag ipaiway anay ang SEA Games; kag kun mag-ayo na, preparahan sini ang Asian Games sa Hangzhou, China kag ang World Championships sa Oregon.
english: The 26-year-old Fil-am runner said he will focus on recovering from his leg and postpone the SEA Games; and when it recovers, it will prepare for the Asian Games in Hangzhou, China and the World Championships in Oregon.

text: Na-detect ang injury ni Knott sang nagligad pa nga Enero matapos ini nga nagpaidalom sa MRI test.
english: Knott's injury was detected last January after he underwent an MRI test.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga naghibi man siya bangud dismayado siya nga indi siya makahampang.
english: He also said that he also cried because he was disappointed that he could not play.

text: Nangguba sang SEA Games record si Knott sang 2019 sang nag-clock ini sang 23.01 seconds sa 200-meter dash — mas madasig sa 23.30 seconds nga na-register sa 2001 Games sa Kuala Lumpur.
english: Knott broke the SEA Games record in 2019 when he clocked 23.01 seconds in the 200-meter dash — faster than the 23.30 seconds registered at the 2001 Games in Kuala Lumpur.

text: Ginguba man sini ang national record paagi sa paglapaw sa rekord sang legendary nga si Lydia De Vega Mercado sa hampang sang 1986.
english: She also broke the national record by surpassing the record of the legendary Lydia De Vega Mercado in the 1986 game.

text: Gold medalist man si Knott sa 4×100 mixed relay event upod ang iban nga gold medal winners nga sanday Eric Cray, Anfernee Lopena, kag Eloiza Luzon.
english: Knott was also a gold medalist in the 4×100 mixed relay event along with other gold medal winners Eric Cray, Anfernee Lopena, and Eloiza Luzon.

text: Gin-ako sang Patafa nga daku nga kadulaan sang team si Knott apang kumpyansa man si Patafa president Philip Ella Juico nga mangin formidable kag competitive ang iban pa nga mga atleta sang Pilipinas.
english: Patafa acknowledged that Knott is a big loss to the team but Patafa president Philip Ella Juico is also confident that the other Filipino athletes will be formidable and competitive.

text: Ginahandaan na sang Department of Enery (DOE) ang mga alternatibo nga himuon sa Pilipinas sa tunga sang nagakatabo nga disruptions sa suplay sang gatong sa international market.
english: The Department of Energy (DOE) is preparing alternatives to do in the Philippines amid the ongoing disruptions in the supply of fuel in the international market.

text: Nagtukod ang ahensya sang task force nga amo ang magahimo sang contingency plan agud nga ma-address ang ginapanan-aw nga internal kag/ukon external supply disruptions.
english: The agency has established a task force to develop a contingency plan to address anticipated internal and/or external supply disruptions.

text: Suno kay DOE-Oil Industry Management Bureau assistant director Rodela Romero, nagapakig-angot na ang DOE sa Philippine National Oil Co.
english: DOE-Oil Industry Management Bureau assistant director Rodela Romero said the DOE is already in contact with the Philippine National Oil Co.

text: (PNOC) kag iban pa nga government agencies agud nga matumod kun ano ang lebel sang demand sa pungsod kag ang requirements sang lain-lain nga sector kaangay sang transport sector kag iban pa nga industriya.
english: (PNOC) and other government agencies to determine the level of demand in the country and the requirements of various sectors such as the transport sector and other industries.

text: Nagakabatyagan na subong ang disruption sang oil supply sa international market kag nagasaka man ang global oil price.
english: The disruption of oil supply in the international market is now being felt and global oil prices are also rising.

text: Lakip sa ginatumod rason amo ang gamo sa tunga sang Russia kag Ukraine, explosion sa Nigeria, maintenance disruption kag pipeline leaks sa Libya kag amo man ang oil spills sa Ecuador kag Kazakhstan.
english: Among the reasons cited are the conflict between Russia and Ukraine, explosion in Nigeria, maintenance disruption and pipeline leaks in Libya as well as oil spills in Ecuador and Kazakhstan.

text: Sa local market, pito na ka semana nga nagsaka ang presyo sang gatong.
english: In the local market, fuel prices have been rising for seven weeks.

text: MANILA – Nag-angkon sang pagdayaw ang aktor nga si Eric Fructuoso bangud sa iya sideline subong nga may COVID-19 pandemic.
english: MANILA – Actor Eric Fructuoso has won praise for his sideline during the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Ini matapos nga nag-post sang laragway sa social media ang 44 anyos nga aktor kun sa diin makita nga yara siya sa driver side sang naka-parking nga tricycle.
english: This is after the 44-year-old actor posted a picture on social media where he can be seen on the driver side of a parked tricycle.

text: Suno kay Eric, ang pagmaneho sang tricycle ang iya palangabuhi-an ilabi na subong nga ginpauntat ang production sa entertainment industry.
english: According to Eric, driving a tricycle is his livelihood especially now that production in the entertainment industry has been shut down.

text: Ginpahayag ni Eric nga indi dapat magpili sang trabaho bangud nga mas importante amo nga may yara sang isagod sa pamilya kag ang kwarta ang naghalin sa legal nga paagi.
english: Eric said he should not choose a job because what is more important is to have a family and the money comes from legal means.

text: Nahibalu-an nga magluwas sa pag-arte, si Eric ang isa man ka motorcycle enthusiast kag nakilala bilang miyembro sadto sang teen boy group nga “Gwapings” kaupod sanday Jomari Yllana, Mark Anthony Fernandez kag Jao Mapa.
english: Besides acting, Eric is also a motorcycle enthusiast and was known as a member of the teen boy group “Gwapings” along with Jomari Yllana, Mark Anthony Fernandez and Jao Mapa.

text: Kompiansa si Department of Tourism (DOT) Secretary Bernadette Romulo-Puyat nga makarecover na ang turismo sang pungsod sa impact sang COVID-19 subong nga tuig.
english: Department of Tourism (DOT) Secretary Bernadette Romulo-Puyat is confident that the country's tourism will recover from the impact of COVID-19 this year.

text: Suno kay Puyat, ginahulat na lang sang mga turista nga magbukas ang border sang Pilipinas.
english: According to Puyat, tourists are just waiting for the Philippine border to open.

text: Kabug-usan naman nga 10,676 foreign travelers ang nag abut sa Pilipinas sumugod sang Pebrero 10 tubtub kahapon Pebrero 15.
english: A total of 10,676 foreign travelers arrived in the Philippines from February 10 to February 15.

text: Samtang ginabanta 29% naman ang occupancy rate sang mga hotels sa pungsod.
english: Meanwhile, the occupancy rate of hotels in the country is estimated at 29%.

text: Naghakot sang bulawan nga medalya ang mga produkto sang University of San Agustin—Conservatory of Music sa Borneo International Vocal Arts Festival (BIVAF) 2025 nga ginpatigayon sa Sarawak, Malaysia.
english: The products of the University of San Agustin—Conservatory of Music won gold medals at the Borneo International Vocal Arts Festival (BIVAF) 2025 held in Sarawak, Malaysia.

text: Ini amo sanday Demmie Nicolette Maza nga tumandok sang Antique kag Adrianne Kylle Cortez sang Compania, Molo, Iloilo City kag pareho nga yara na sa 5th year sa Conservatory of Music.
english: They are Demmie Nicolette Maza of Antique and Adrianne Kylle Cortez of Compania, Molo, Iloilo City and both are in their 5th year at the Conservatory of Music.

text: Kaupod man nila ang ila Academic Supervisor nga si Prof.
english: They were also accompanied by their Academic Supervisor, Prof.

text: Gerardo Vicente Muyuela, DMA (Doctor of Musical Arts) nga amo ang nagtukar sang piano sa ila nga performance.
english: Gerardo Vicente Muyuela, DMA (Doctor of Musical Arts) who played the piano in their performance.

text: Sanday Maza kag Cortez ang pareho nga nagdaug sang gold medal sa Classical Open Category Singing Competition para sa ages 19 and above nga category.
english: Maza and Cortez both won gold medals in the Classical Open Category Singing Competition for the ages 19 and above category.

text: Si Maza man ang nakakuha sang title sang Category Winner kag nag- compete sa Absolute Winners Competition, ukon ang Grand Prix.
english: Maza also won the title of Category Winner and competed in the Absolute Winners Competition, or the Grand Prix.

text: Suno naman kay Prof.
english: According to Prof.

text: Gerardo Vicente Muyuela, dako nga dungog ini para sa ila bangud ini ang una nga international competition nga nagpasakop ang University of San Agustin—Conservatory of Music.
english: Gerardo Vicente Muyuela, this is a great honor for them because this is the first international competition that the University of San Agustin—Conservatory of Music has participated in.

text: Ini pa lang ang second edition sang Borneo International Vocal Arts Festival nga nagahatag sang platform para sa mga bokalista nga maka-perform, maka-compete, kag makatuon gikan sa mga professionals.
english: This is only the second edition of the Borneo International Vocal Arts Festival which provides a platform for vocalists to perform, compete, and learn from professionals.

text: Nagpasalamat naman si Muyuela sa tanan nga nagsuporta sa ila agud matiglawas ang Pilipinas kag mapakita ang abilidad sang mga estudyante sang University of San Agustin sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Muyuela thanked everyone who supported them to represent the Philippines and showcase the talents of the students of the University of San Agustin to the world.

text: Nagdepensa si former Philippine National Police (PNP) chief kag subong Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa nga “lahog” lamang ang pila sa ginpahayag ni former President Rodrigo Duterte sa atubang sang mga senador sang ginpatigayon ang drug war hearing sang nagligad nga Lunes.
english: Former Philippine National Police (PNP) chief and current Senator Ronald “Bato” Dela Rosa defended that some of the statements made by former President Rodrigo Duterte in front of senators during the drug war hearing last Monday were “nonsense”.

text: Ini apisar yara man mismo si Bato sang nagtindog si Duterte kag nagsumpa nga kamatuoran lamang ang iya ihambal sa Senado.
english: This is despite the fact that Bato was present when Duterte stood up and swore to tell only the truth in the Senate.

text: Lakip sa ginhambal ni Duterte amo nga nagmandu siya sa mga pulis nga i-encourage ang drug suspects nga magbato para nga may rason ang otoridad nga patyon sila.
english: Duterte said he ordered the police to encourage drug suspects to fight back so that the authorities would have a reason to kill them.

text: Ginmensyonar man sini nga ang anay chiefs sang PNP sa idalom sang iya termino ang nagpamuno mismo sang death squad — lakip na si Bato.
english: He also mentioned that former PNP chiefs under his term led the death squad themselves — including Bato.

text: “Basta, as far as I am concerned, I know 100 percent no’ng sinabi niya na ”Yung mga chief of police ko diyan dati, yung Chief, [Philippine National Police] na ‘yan, nandyan sa kanan ko, mga miyembro o mga leader’ yan ng DDS’.
english: "Basta, as far as I am concerned, I know 100 percent no'ng he said that 'My chief of police there before, the Chief, [Philippine National Police] that 'that, there to my right, members or leaders' that of DDS'.

text: Alam ko nagbibiro siya,” suno kay dela Rosa nga nagpungko man anay bilang Davao City Police chief.
english: I knew he was joking,” said dela Rosa, who also served as Davao City Police chief.

text: Indi ini ang una nga bes nga ginrason sang kampo ni Duterte nga nagalahog lang siya sa iya mga statement.
english: This is not the first time that Duterte's camp has argued that he is just joking in his statements.

text: Sang tion nga siya ang presidente, sa kada kontrobersyal nga statement, nagarason ang iya spokespersons kag officials nga “joke” lamang ini.
english: When he was president, with every controversial statement, his spokespersons and officials argued that it was just a “joke”.

text: Dugang ni Bato, pamahog lamang sa mga kriminal ang statement ni Duterte nga i-encourage sila sang mga pulis nga magbato para sila ang mapatay sa police operations.
english: Bato added that Duterte's statement that the police will encourage them to fight so that they will be killed in police operations is only a threat to criminals.

text: “As I have said, puro panakot niya ‘yan sa kriminal.
english: “As I have said, he is all threatening the criminal.

text: Puro panakot niya ‘yan,” dugang sini.
english: It's all his threat,” he added.

text: Pagkatapos sang appearance ni Duterte sang Lunes, nagpahayag man ang House quad comm nga imbitaran man nila ang former president sa hearing sa Kamara sa Nobyembre 7.#
english: After Duterte's appearance on Monday, the House quad comm also said they will also invite the former president to the hearing in the House on November 7.#

text: Gin-ako sang internet personality nga si Lars Pacheco nga tatlo ka beses siya nga nagluib sa iya anay boyfriend nga si Clyde Vivas.
english: Internet personality Lars Pacheco admitted that he cheated on his ex-boyfriend Clyde Vivas three times.

text: Lakip ini sa five-minute Facebook video ni Pacheco matapos gin-anunsyo sa publiko nga nagbulagay na sila ni Clyde nga pito ka tuig man niya nangin karelasyon.
english: This is part of Pacheco's five-minute Facebook video after she publicly announced that she had broken up with Clyde, whom she had been in a relationship with for seven years.

text: Pahayag sini, ginhimo niya ang confession agud nga matapos na ang mga espekulasyon kag masabat na ang mga pamangkot kaangot sa ila nga breakup.
english: He said he made the confession to end speculation and answer questions about their breakup.

text: Gin-share sini nga ang una niya nga pag-cheat ang natabo sang nahubog siya kag may nakilala nga isa ka Taiwanese national.
english: She shared that her first time cheating happened when she got drunk and met a Taiwanese national.

text: Pagkaaga suno sa iya, nagbugtaw na lang siya nga tupad na niya ang lalaki.
english: The next morning, she said, she woke up with the man next to her.

text: “It happened because, of course, I chose it to happen,” suno kay Pacheco.
english: “It happened because, of course, I chose it to happen,” according to Pacheco.

text: “I acted like nothing happened.
english: “I acted like nothing happened.

text: Sinundo niya (Clyde) pa ako.
english: He (Clyde) even picked me up.

text:
Hinanap niya pa ako.”

Natabo ang ikaduha nga pagluib sini sang nag-trabaho siya “out of town” kag may lalaki siya nga ginhatagan sang iya number.
english:
He even looked for me.”

Her second infidelity occurred when she went to work “out of town” and gave a man his number.

text: Wala sila sang personal ukon intimate nga istoryahanay, apang suno kay Pacheco, nareyalisar niya nga nahulog ang iya buot — bagay nga may gintungdan nga papel sa iya pag-evaluate sang iya relasyon kay Vivas.
english: They didn't have a personal or intimate conversation, but Pacheco said she realized she was in love — something that played a role in her evaluation of her relationship with Vivas.

text: “Out of nowhere, I just gave my number and then I told him na doon siya mag-contact because Clyde has access in my Instagram [account],” pahayag sini.
english: “Out of nowhere, I just gave my number and then I told him to contact me there because Clyde has access in my Instagram [account],” she said.

text: “We don’t exchange intimate conversations.
english: “We don’t exchange intimate conversations.

text: Every day for one month, it’s just, ‘Good morning,’ ‘San ka na?
english: Every day for one month, it’s just, ‘Good morning,’ ‘Where are you?

text: ‘Nakauwi na ako.’ You can just count the conversations that we have.
english: ‘I’m home.’ You can just count the conversations that we have.

text: And I don’t know, I’m falling in love with that man, with that guy,” kabahin pa sang iya gin-share.
english: And I don’t know, I’m falling in love with that man, with that guy,” she shared.

text:
“Hindi ko sinasabi kasi proud ako, hindi ko rin alam kung ano ang nangyari, pero na-miss ko ‘yung pakiramdam na kiligin… Basta, I miss the feeling of being, you know, important to someone.”

Ang ikatlo nga hitabo ang ginakabig ni Pacheco nga “worst” bangud suno sa iya, gindul-ong pa siya ni Vivas sang nagpakigtabo siya sa isa ka lalaki nga halin sa Portugal.
english:
"I'm not saying because I'm proud, I don't know what happened, but I miss the feeling of excitement... Just, I miss the feeling of being, you know, important to someone."

The third incident is considered by Pacheco to be the “worst” because, according to him, Vivas took him when he met a man from Portugal.

text: “He’s from Portugal.
english: “He’s from Portugal.

text: And yeah, it happened.
english: And yeah, it happened.

text: And then that made a decision, if I still love him, I wouldn’t do such things,” share sini.
english: And then that made a decision, if I still love him, I wouldn’t do such things,” shared sini.

text: Suno kay Lars, indi siya proud sa iya nga ginhimo, apang luyag niya nga mangin accountable, kag ginpili na lang sini nga tapuson ang ila nga relasyon.
english: According to Lars, he is not proud of what he did, but he wants to be accountable, and he chose to end their relationship.

text: “I take full accountability.
english: “I take full accountability.

text: I know, I did what I did.
english: I know, I did what I did.

text: I’m not proud of it.
english: I’m not proud of it.

text:
And kung papatagalin ko pa relasyon namin, feeling ko, in the end, we will just be just f**ked up.”

Nagpost man sang video ang ex-boyfriend sini nga nagahingyo sa publiko nga untaton ang pag-bash kay Lars bangud basi kun may yara man ini sang problema.
english:
And if I prolong our relationship, I feel like, in the end, we will just be just f**ked up.”

Her ex-boyfriend also posted a video urging the public to stop bashing Lars because he might have a problem.

text: “Huwag niyo nang i-bash si Lars kasi naaawa ako eh.
english: “Don't bash Lars because I feel sorry for him.

text: Alam niyo ‘yon na, mayroon siguro siya talagang dinadalang problema na hindi ko alam.
english: You know that, maybe he really has a problem that I don't know about.

text: Huwag na natin siyang i-bash,” pahayag sang anay nobyo sa isa ka 10-minute clip.
english: Let's not bash him,” the ex-boyfriend said in a 10-minute clip.

text:
“Guys, mas maganda kung suportahan na lang natin siya kung ano man desisyon niya sa buhay ngayon kasi ganoon na lang din gagawin ko.”

Nahibaluan nga bantog si Pacheco nga may 1.9 million followers sa Facebook kag nagtiglawas pa sa Pilipinas sa 2023 Miss International Queen pageant kun sa diin sulod siya sa Top 6.#
english:
"Guys, it's better if we just support him in whatever decision he makes in life now because that's what I'll do."

Pacheco is famous with 1.9 million followers on Facebook and even represented the Philippines in the 2023 Miss International Queen pageant where she was in the Top 6.#

text: Wala ginadula sang Bureau of Fire Protection Iloilo ang iban pa nga posibilidad nga ginhalinan sang sunog nga nagluntad sa Brgy.
english: The Bureau of Fire Protection Iloilo does not rule out other possibilities of the cause of the fire that broke out in Brgy.

text: Gustilo La Paz, Iloilo City.
english: Gustilo La Paz, Iloilo City.

text: Ini matapos nga nagwa sa initial nga imbestigasyon nga nag-umpisa ang kalayo sa balay ni Leo Estañol.
english: This is after initial investigation revealed that the fire started in the house of Leo Estañol.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay SFO1 Den Mark B. Macoco, Acting Chief Investigation and Intellegence Unit, Iloilo City Fire Station, iya ginpahayag nga nakuhaan na nila sang iya side si Estañol apang wala nila ginadula ang iban pa nga ginhalinan sang nasambit nga sunog.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, SFO1 Den Mark B. Macoco, Acting Chief Investigation and Intelligence Unit, Iloilo City Fire Station, said they have already taken his side of Estañol but they are not ruling out other causes of the fire.

text: Suno kay Macoco nga ila na napadala sa National Office ang ila nga iban pa nga example nga nakuha kag subject for laboratory testing pa ini.
english: Macoco said they have already sent their other samples to the National Office and they are still subject for laboratory testing.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Macoco nga ginroll-out naman nila ang posibilidad nga electrical in nature ang ginhalinan sang sunog bangud ang balay indi man energize.
english: Macoco said they have rolled out the possibility that the fire was electrical in nature because the house was not energized.

text: Suno pa sa iya nga bangud human sa mga light materials ang mga balay sa lugar kag nagatinupaday pa ang mga ini madali nga naglapta ang kalayo.
english: He said that because the houses in the area were made of light materials and they were still on top of each other, the fire spread quickly.

text: Dugang pa niya nga naglab-ot na sa 40 ang totally damage, apat ang partially damage kun sa diin nagabalor ini sang masobra 205, 000 pesos.
english: He added that 40 were totally damaged, four were partially damaged worth more than 205,000 pesos.

text: Ginaduso ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.

text: sa mga mamalidha nga padasigon ang pagpasar sang ginaproponer nga layi para mapondohan ang coco levy sa pungsod.
english: to lawmakers to expedite the passage of the proposed law to fund the coco levy in the country.

text: Nagpaandam man ini nga ang madugay nga pagka-delay sa pagbukas sang pondo pwede nga madulaan sang oppurtunidad ang mga mangunguma sa sektor sang niyog.
english: He also warned that the long delay in the opening of the fund could lose opportunities for farmers in the coconut sector.

text: Tuig 2021 sang ginpirmahan ang layi nga Republic Act 11524 ukon ang Coconut Farmers and Industry Trust Fund Act ni former President Rodrigo Duterte.
english: In 2021, Republic Act 11524 or the Coconut Farmers and Industry Trust Fund Act was signed by former President Rodrigo Duterte.

text: Tinutuyo sini nga pabaskugon kag pasangkaron ang mga benepisyo para sa nagapananom sang niyog.
english: It aims to strengthen and expand the benefits for coconut farmers.

text: Sa ika-20 Kongreso, may ginpreparar na nga amyendayhan ang layi sa coco levy fund bilang paghimakas nga pabaskugon ang pagpatuman sa paggamit sang pondo.
english: In the 20th Congress, an amendment to the coco levy fund law has been prepared in an effort to strengthen enforcement of the use of the fund.

text: Kabahin diri ang paghimo kag pagpalapad sang mga seed farm kag nursery, ang produksyon sang mataas nga ani kag hybrid sang lubi.
english: This includes the creation and expansion of seed farms and nurseries, the production of high yield and hybrid coconuts.

text: Tinutuyo man sini ang paghatag sang technical nga suporta para sa rehabilitasyon sang mga tanuman sang lubi.
english: It also aims to provide technical support for the rehabilitation of palm plantations.

text: Gin-ako ni Iloilo City Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna nga wala wala pa nadiskusyonan sa konseho ang pagtal-os sa mga committee head sang city councilors nga maga-graduate na kasunod sang pagtakop sang ila nga termino.
english: Iloilo City Councilor Sedfrey Cabaluna acknowledged that the council has not yet discussed the replacement of the committee heads of the city councilors who will graduate after the end of their terms.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Cabaluna, chairman sang Committee on Public Safety, iya ginpahayag nga sigurado nga antes ang Hunyo 30 kag mag-assume ang next term, may mga magapungko na sa mabakante nga committee head nga posisyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Cabaluna, chairman of the Committee on Public Safety, said he is sure that before June 30 and the assumption of the next term, there will be those who will sit in the vacant committee head position.

text: Suno sa natungdan, nagadependi sa gihapon sa mayorya ang mangin resulta sang pagsinapol.
english: He said the outcome of the meeting still depends on the majority.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga madamo pa sang balasahon agud nga matumod ang mga masunod nga head sang tagsa ka komitiba bangud may mga yara man nga luyag na buy-an ang amo nga posisyon.
english: He also said that there is still a lot of work to be done to identify the next heads of each committee because there are those who want to leave the position.

text: Bukas naman si Cabaluna nga makatrabaho kaupod ang bag-o nga Bise-alkalde nga si Incoming Iloilo City Vice Mayor Love-love Baronda.
english: Cabaluna is open to working with the new Vice-Mayor, Incoming Iloilo City Vice Mayor Love-love Baronda.

text: ‘SANA ALL’ ang makabaton sang kaayuhan sa pagpanubo sang presyo sang balaklon, labi na gid ang aton makuha sa hapag kalan-an agud mapadayon ang aton pagkabuhi.
english: 'SANA ALL' will benefit from the reduction in the price of goods, especially what we get from the food table to sustain our lives.

text: Segurado nga malipay gid ang aton mga konsumidor sa pagpanubo sang mga balaklon sa merkado.
english: Our consumers are sure to be very happy with the reduction in the price of goods in the market.

text: Katulad na lang sang pagpanubo sang Dept.
english: Just like the reduction of the Dept.

text: of Agriculuture sang bili sang imported nga pula nga sibuyas (red onions), nga paborito sang mga Pinoy sa ila linuto tungod sa makahang-kahang nga damil sini.
english: of Agriculture of the price of imported red onions, which are a favorite of Filipinos in their cooking because of their spicy flavor.

text: Jackpot ini para sa mga bumalakal, hambalon pa.
english: It’s a jackpot for buyers, so to speak.

text: Sunu sa isa ka press release sang DA nagabili lang ang retail price sini sang P125/k, nga daku ang pagnubo halin sa P600/k sadtong Disyembre 2022.
english: According to a press release from the DA, the retail price is only P125/k, a significant decrease from P600/k in December 2022.

text: Pero, ano naman ayhan ang epekto sini sa mga mangunguma?
english: But, what will be the effect on farmers?

text: Natandaan naton nga nalipay na ang mga mangunguma sa farmgate nga P200/k sang sibuyas, nga ginabakal sang isa ka NGO sa ila.
english: We remember that farmers are already happy with the farmgate of P200/k for onions, which an NGO buys from them.

text: Sa tantiya naton magabili ini sing mga P230-P250/k pag-abot sa merkado, nga daku man nga kaginhawaan na sang mga bumalakal kag makahatag man sing maayo-ayo nga ganansya sa manugbaligya ikumparar sa P600/k sadtong Disyembre 2022.
english: We estimate that it will cost about P230-P250/k when it arrives in the market, which is also a big relief for buyers and will also give a good profit to the seller compared to P600/k in December 2022.

text: Daw wala na gani sing nagareklamo – manugbakal kag manugbaligya – parti sini.
english: No one even seems to complain – buyer and seller – about it anymore.

text: Ugaling maproblema kita sa ining P125/k nga retail price sang imported sibuyas sa bahin sang mga mangunguma.
english: But we have a problem with this P125/k retail price of imported onions on the part of farmers.

text: Panubuon sini ang mabaligya sang mga mangunguma sa ila pag-insistir nga ibaligya gihapon ang ila sibuyas sa farmgate price nga P200/k nga amo gid ang “reasonable price” para sa ila.
english: This will reduce the sale price of farmers by insisting that they still sell their onions at the farmgate price of P200/k which is the “reasonable price” for them.

text: Unless, mapatuman ang kasuguan nga ginpasar ni anay Senador Pangilinan nga ma-obligar ang mga upisina sang gobyerno sa pagbakal sang mga produkto halin sa kaumhan.
english: Unless, the law passed by former Senator Pangilinan that obliges government offices to purchase products from the countryside is implemented.

text: Daku ini nga bulig sa ila kon matigayon.
english: This would be a great help to them if available.

text: Sa isa ka bahin, ang “unreasonable” nga pagpanubo sang bili sang mga produkto sang kaumhan makapanubo ini sang produksyon nga supak sa programa agud makaagom kita sing “food sufficiency”.
english: On the one hand, the “unreasonable” reduction in the price of rural products can reduce production contrary to the program to achieve food sufficiency.

text: Kag magasige-sige na gid lang ang aton pag-import sini, kag, bag-o kita mamarasmasan, madamo gid ang magutman kay posible wala na kita mabakal halin sa iban nga pungsod.
english: And we're going to keep importing it, and, before we're ready, many people will go hungry because we may not be able to buy it from other countries.

text: Remember ang theory ni Thomas Malthus, nga isa ka British economist?
english: Remember the theory of Thomas Malthus, who was a British economist?

text: Sunu sa iya, mas madasig ang pagmuad sang tawo sangsa ma-produce nga food supply.
english: According to him, humans are growing faster than the food supply can be produced.

text: Therefore, paathag niya, mangin kabangdanan ini sang gutom sang kadam-an sang katauhan.
english: Therefore, he explained, it would cause starvation for the masses of mankind.

text: Unless, paandam niya, matambagan ini nga indi matabo.
english: Unless, he warned, it is advised not to happen.

text: Mahimo naton ini sa Filipinas sa pagpalapad pa sang kaumhan nga suportado sang sagana nga patubig kag patambok sang duta, pagsuporta sa mga mangunguma sa ila pangabuhi agud mas mangin makugi sila sa pagpangunguma, pag-proteksyon sa ila batok sa indi bagay nga importasyon agud ma-engganyo nga  mapadaku nila ang ila produksyon, pagpauswag kag pagpalantip sang ihibalo sa siyensya sa agricultura , pagtambag sa mga “unscrupulous  traders” kag mga ‘smugglers”, lakip ang pagpatuman sang isa ka madinalag-on nga family planning.
english: We can do this in the Philippines by expanding the countryside supported by abundant irrigation and soil fertility, supporting farmers in their livelihoods so that they become more diligent in farming, protecting them against unsuitable imports to encourage them to increase their production, improving and promoting agricultural knowledge, unscrupulous traders and smugglers, including the implementation of a successful family planning.

text: Pero, kon ang gina-isip naton amo lang nga mapuno ang aton bulsa nga wala pag-ulikid sa kaayuhan sang tanan, ti nada gid ining programa naton nga “food sufficiency”.
english: However, if all we think about is filling our pockets without caring about the welfare of all, then our food sufficiency program is useless.

text:
***

Nakahanda bala kita sa ‘The Big One’?
english:
***

Are we prepared for ‘The Big One’?

text: Wala na seguro sa sobra ka mahaliton nga linog sangsa nagligad nga 7.8 magnitude nga linog nga nag-igu sa Turkey kag Syria sadtong Pebrero 6.
english: There is probably no more devastating earthquake than the previous 7.8 magnitude earthquake that struck Turkey and Syria on February 6.

text: Sa ulihi nga isip, samtang ginasulat naton ini, naglab-ut na sa sobra 20,000 ang nagkalamatay, lakip ang duha naton ka kauturan nga Filipino nga nagaubra sa Turkey.
english: At last count, as we write this, more than 20,000 people have died, including two of our Filipino brothers working in Turkey.

text: Ginatos man nga mga building ang narusdak.
english: Hundreds of buildings were also destroyed.

text: Mamilagpilag lang ang nakaluas, lakip ang isa ka bag-o panganak nga lapsag nga sang masapwan sa idalom sang narusdak nga building nagaangot pa ang iya pusod.
english: Only a few survived, including a newborn baby who was found under the collapsed building with his umbilical cord still attached.

text: Tungod sini, ang pamangkot sang kadam-an: Nakahanda bala kita diri sa Filipinas sa kasubong kabaskug nga linog?
english: Because of this, the question of many: Are we prepared here in the Philippines for such a strong earthquake?

text: Isa sini ang ginatawag nga “The Big One”, nga ang fault line (West Valley Fault) nagalaba sing mga 100 kilometro halin sa Bulacan pakadto sa Metro Manila tubtub sa Cavite kag Laguna.
english: One of these is called “The Big One”, whose fault line (West Valley Fault) stretches about 100 kilometers from Bulacan to Metro Manila to Cavite and Laguna.

text: Diri sa MM nagapuyo ang linibu nga pumuluyo kag nahamtang ang dalagku nga mga building.
english: Here in MM live thousands of residents and are located large buildings.

text: Ginsiling nga madugay na ini nga nagakatulog, mga 40-50 anyos na, kag sandig sa pattern sang iya panghulag posible matabo liwat sa subong nga panahon nga dapat na pangandaman.
english: It is said that it has been dormant for a long time, about 40-50 years old, and based on the pattern of its movement it is possible to happen again in the present time that should be prepared.

text: Ugaling, daw wala pa man sing pihu nga lihok ang aton gobyerno nga mapaatras ang mga puluy-an kag mga building at least 5 ka metros halin sa fault line.
english: However, it seems that our government has not yet taken any definite action to move homes and buildings back at least 5 meters from the fault line.

text: Samtang, ginabantayan man sang Phivolcs ang pila pa ka mabaskug nga linog nga may magnitude 7.0 pataas nga posible magluntad liwat sa Mindanao kag Visayas./PN
english: Meanwhile, the Phivolcs is also monitoring several other strong earthquakes with magnitude 7.0 and above that are likely to occur again in Mindanao and Visayas.

text: Nagpungko si former eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao bilang vice-president sang International Boxing Association (IBA).
english: Former eight-division world champion Manny Pacquiao has taken over as vice-president of the International Boxing Association (IBA).

text: Maga-trabaho ang 46-anyos nga Pinoy boxing legend kaupod sa president nga si Umar Kremlev sang Russia para nga makabalay sang mga programa nga magapasangkad sang mga oportunidad para sa mga atleta.
english: The 46-year-old Filipino boxing legend will work with Russian President Umar Kremlev to develop programs that will expand opportunities for athletes.

text: Suno kay Pacquiao, nagapasalamat siya nga mangin parte sang sini nga asosasyon kun sa diin makabulig siya sa bataon nga mga boksidor, makahimo sang mga kampyon, kag masigurado nga wala sang pungsod nga mabilin sa tabtaban.
english: Pacquiao said he is grateful to be part of this association where he can help young boxers, make champions, and ensure that no country is left behind.

text: Ini nga organisasyon ang kilala anay bilang Amateur International Boxing Association kag amo ang sa likod sang boxing events sa Olympics.
english: This organization was formerly known as the Amateur International Boxing Association and is behind the boxing events in the Olympics.

text: Pila ka beses ini nga ginpaandaman kaangot sa isyu sa pinansyal tubtub nga dalayon nga gin-utod sang International Olympic Committee ang koneksyon sa amo nga organisasyon antes ang Olympics sa Japan sang 2021.
english: It was warned several times about financial issues until the International Olympic Committee immediately cut ties with the organization before the Olympics in Japan in 2021.

text: Sa 2028 sa Los Angeles Olympics, ang maga-uyat sang boxing competitions amo ang bag-o nga organisasyon nga World Boxing.
english: In 2028 at the Los Angeles Olympics, the boxing competitions will be handled by the new organization World Boxing.

text: Natiruhan ang isa ka gwardya matapos nga naghingyo ini nga mag-day-off.
english: A security guard was shot after he asked for a day-off.

text: Ang biktima amo si alyas “Ton”, 30-anyos kag reliever security guard.
english: The victim was identified as “Ton”, 30, a reliever security guard.

text: Ang suspek naman amo si alyas “Sammy”, 56-anyos nga amo ang officer-in-charge (OIC) security guard.
english: The suspect was identified as Sammy, 56, an officer-in-charge (OIC) security guard.

text: Natabo ang insidente sa Brgy.
english: The incident occurred in Brgy.

text: San Miguel, Sto.
english: St. Michael, Sto.

text: Tomas, Batangas.
english: Tomas, Batangas.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon, sang naghingyo ang biktima nga mag-day off, ginhambalan ini sang suspek nga sundon ang schedule sang duty.
english: According to the investigation, when the victim asked for a day off, the suspect told her to follow the schedule of duty.

text: Nangakig ang biktima kag nagkuha sang binangon kag ginhangkat sang inaway ang iya superior.
english: The victim became angry and took a knife and challenged his superior to fight.

text: Wala nagbato ang OIC kag ginhambalan ang biktima nga maghalin na lang agud malikawan nga maglala ang gamo.
english: The OIC did not resist and told the victim to leave to avoid escalation.

text: Sang naglakat ang biktima, may ginhaboy ini nga matig-a nga bagay sa iya superior gani napilitan ang suspek nga tiruhon ini gamit ang shotgun.
english: When the victim left, he threw a hard object at his superior and the suspect was forced to shoot him with a shotgun.

text: Gindala sa ospital ang biktima samtang gin-aresto naman ang suspek nga mangatubang sang panumbungon nga frustrated homicide.
english: The victim was taken to the hospital while the suspect was arrested and will face charges of frustrated homicide.

text: Wala gin-aprubahan sang Senado ang pangabay ni Sen.
english: The Senate did not approve Sen.

text: Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa nga magamit ang iya pamilya sang Senate Mansion sa Baguio City.
english: Ronald “Bato” dela Rosa that his family can use the Senate Mansion in Baguio City.

text: Ini matapos nga nag-request ang senador nga gamiton sang iya pamilya ang Senate Mansion sa palaabuton nga Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (CSAFP) Cup 2026 nga sport competition nga maga-umpisa halin Marso 26 tubtob Marso 29, 2026.
english: This comes after the senator requested that his family use the Senate Mansion for the upcoming Chief of Staff of the Armed Forces of the Philippines (CSAFP) Cup 2026 sport competition that will start from March 26 to March 29, 2026.

text: Marso 12 sang nagpadala si Dela Rosa sang sulat kay Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III agud pasugtan ang iya pamilya nga magtinir sa Mansion samtang patigayunon ang aktibidad.
english: On March 12, Dela Rosa sent a letter to Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III to allow his family to stay at the Mansion while the activity was held.

text: Apang ginpahayag ni Senate Secretary Mark Llandro Mendoza nga indi ini mahimo bangud gina-renovate subong ang mansion, kag may ara man sang polisa nga kinahanglan kaupod ang senador kun gamiton ini.
english: However, Senate Secretary Mark Llandro Mendoza said that this is not possible because the mansion is currently being renovated, and there is also a policy that the senator must be present if it is used.

text: Nahibaluan nga wala na nakapakita ang senador sa publiko humalin Nobyembre 2025.
english: The senator has not appeared in public since November 2025.

text: Wala naman sini gintambungan ang tanan nga aktibidad sa Senado apisar nga nagapadayon sa gihapon ang iya baton sang sweldo bilang senador sang pungsod.
english: He did not attend all activities in the Senate despite continuing to receive his salary as a senator.

text: Nag-umpisa nga nangin missing in action si Dela Rosa sang ginwaragwag ni Ombudsman Boying Remulla nga nag-gwa na ang gina-alegar warrant of arrest halin sa International Criminal Court (ICC) batok sa iya bangud sa iya nangin papel bilang PNP chief sang ginpatuman ang Duterte drug war.
english: Dela Rosa began going missing in action when Ombudsman Boying Remulla announced that an alleged warrant of arrest from the International Criminal Court (ICC) had been issued against him for his role as PNP chief during the implementation of Duterte's drug war.

text: Wala gihapon nakilal-an ang bangkay sang isa ka babaye nga nakit-an sa mga bakhawan sa Brgy.
english: The body of a woman found in the mangroves in Brgy.

text: Tanag, Buenavista, Guimaras.
english: Tanag, Buenavista, Guimaras.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay PCapt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, PCapt.

text: Rene Mercado, hepe sang Buenavista Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga indi pamilyar sa mga residente sa lugar ang babaye.
english: Rene Mercado, chief of the Buenavista Municipal Police Station, said the woman was not familiar to the residents in the area.

text: Suno ka Mercado, may yara sang mga pilas kag gasgas ang lawas sang babaye apang indi ini tuga sang pagkabuno ukon pagkatiro.
english: According to Mercado, the woman had wounds and bruises on her body but they were not caused by stabbing or shooting.

text: Ginabanta nga pila ka adlaw na nga yara sa tubig ang lawas sang biktima nga ginabanta 30+ ang edad, nagataas sang 5’3″ kag tubtob sa abaga ang buhok.
english: The body of the victim, who is estimated to be 30+ years old, is 5’3″ tall and has shoulder-length hair, is believed to have been in the water for several days.

text: Nagpanawagan naman ang hepe sa publiko nga magpakig-angot sa pulis kun may nadula sila nga himata.
english: The chief appealed to the public to contact the police if they have lost a relative.

text: Padayon subong ang pagpakig-angot sang Buenavista Municipal Police Station sa kaiping nga mga barangay para madasig ang makilala ang babaye.
english: The Buenavista Municipal Police Station is now in contact with neighboring barangays to quickly identify the woman.

text: Viral sa social media ang superstar nga si Daniel Padilla matapos mabungguan sang tricycle ang iya nga malahalon nga salakyan.
english: Superstar Daniel Padilla went viral on social media after his expensive car was hit by a tricycle.

text: Sa baylo nga mangakig si Daniel, ginhatagan pa niya sang kwarta ang driver sang tricycle.
english: Instead of getting angry, Daniel gave the tricycle driver some money.

text: Gindayaw naman sang mga netizens nga nakakita sang aksidente nga natabo sa Quezon City si Daniel bangud sa iya tuman ka maalwan kag mabuot.
english: Netizens who witnessed the accident in Quezon City praised Daniel for his generosity and kindness.

text: Sa subong wala pa sang statement nga ginpaguwa ang aktor apang ang iya iloy nga si Karla Estrada ang nagpalab-ot sang mensahe nga yara man sa maayo nga kahimtangan ang iya anak.
english: The actor has not yet released a statement but his mother, Karla Estrada, has conveyed a message that her son is also in good condition.

text: Nakarekober ang Foreign investments sang nagligad nga tuig bangud mas nabuksan ang ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: Foreign investments recovered last year as the country's economy opened up more.

text: Suno sa Philippine Statistics Authority, amat-amat nga nabalik sang foreign firms ang kinahanglanon nga kapital para sa economic recovery sang bilog nga 2021.
english: According to the Philippine Statistics Authority, foreign firms gradually recovered the necessary capital for economic recovery throughout 2021.

text: Nagsaka man ang approved foreign investments sang nagligad nga tuig sa 71.5 percent ukon P192.34 billion — mas mataas sa P112.12 billion nga narekord sang 2020.
english: Approved foreign investments also rose last year to 71.5 percent or P192.34 billion — higher than the P112.12 billion recorded in 2020.

text: Sa fourth quarter sang 2021, nagsaka ang approved investments sa 270 percent tubtob P133.47 billion naggikan sa P36.49 billion sang amo man nga period sang 2020
english: In the fourth quarter of 2021, approved investments increased by 270 percent to P133.47 billion from P36.49 billion in the same period of 2020

text: Ginpaidalom sa kustodiya sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) sa Mabalacat City, Pampanga ang duha ka bata nga mga lalaki matapos ginreklamo sang pagpanghimulos.
english: Two boys were placed under the custody of the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD) in Mabalacat City, Pampanga after they were complained of rape.

text: Ang mga bata nagaedad sang 8 kag 10.
english: The kids are 8 and 10 years old.

text: Ang nagreklamo naman amo ang 6-anyos nga bata nga babaye.
english: The complainant was a 6-year-old girl.

text: Base sa imbestigasyon sang otoridad, nagahampang ang biktima kaupod ang manghod sini sang ginbuton siya sang duha ka bata nga lalaki kag gindala sa kahilamunan.
english: According to police investigation, the victim was playing with his brother when he was grabbed by two boys and taken to the grass.

text: Sang nagpauli ang bata, nagpanugid ini sa iya iloy kag nagpadulong sa mga barangay officials.
english: When the child returned home, he told his mother and went to the barangay officials.

text: Padayon pa nga ginaimbestigaran ang insidente.
english: The incident is still under investigation.

text: MANILA – Kilig ang nabatyagan sang aktres nga si Bela Padilla matapos nalakip sa mga nominado sa 15th Seoul International Drama Awards.
english: MANILA – Actress Bela Padilla was among the nominees for the 15th Seoul International Drama Awards.

text: Sa iya Instagram account, nagpasalamat si Bela sa nasambit nga international award-giving body sa ginhatag nga citation.
english: Taking to her Instagram account, Bela thanked the international award-giving body for the citation.

text: Suno kay Bela, ginakabig niya nga “most kilig part” ang pagkalakip sang iya pangalan para sa Best Actress category kun sa diin kaupod niya si Imelda Staunton sang Great Britain nga isa sa mga nagdala sang character sa sikat nga Harry Potter series.
english: According to Bela, she considers the “most exciting part” of including her name for the Best Actress category where she is with Imelda Staunton of Great Britain who is one of the characters in the popular Harry Potter series.

text: Nalakip man sa Best Actress category sanday Shu-qin Ke sang Taiwan, Zuzana Stivinova sang Czech Republic kag tatlo ka South Korean actress nga sanday Si-Eun Park, Hyo-Jin Kong kag Ji-Eun Kim.
english: Also in the Best Actress category were Shu-qin Ke of Taiwan, Zuzana Stivinova of the Czech Republic and three South Korean actresses Si-Eun Park, Hyo-Jin Kong and Ji-Eun Kim.

text: Ang 15th Seoul International Drama Awards ang patigayunon sa Setyembre 15 kun sa diin ginpahayag sang organizers nga limitado lamang sa local artists ang mahimo nga makatambong kag dumili-an ang pagbaton sang live audience bilang precautionary measure batok sa Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).
english: The 15th Seoul International Drama Awards will be held on September 15 where organizers said only local artists will be allowed to attend and live audiences will be banned as a precautionary measure against Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).

text: Gintawag sang Bagong Alyansang Makabayan (Bayan) Panay nga alibi gid lamang ang Iran-Israel conflict sa pagpasaka na naman sa presyo sang gatong.
english: The New People's Alliance Panay called the Iran-Israel conflict an alibi for the fuel price hike.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Mr. Elmer Forro, Secretary General sang amo nga organisasyon kag nagaserbe man nga lead convenor sang No to PUV Phaseout Coalition Panay, iya ginpahayag nga antes pa man ang mataas nga tension sa Middle East, may sunod-sunod na nga daan nga price hikes sa produktong-petrolyo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Mr. Elmer Forro, Secretary General of the organization and also serving as lead convenor of the No to PUV Phaseout Coalition Panay, said that even before the high tension in the Middle East, there were already a series of price hikes in petroleum products.

text: Dies porsyento lang sang oil supply sang Pilipinas ang nagahalin sa Iran suno kay Forro; kag kun may kaangay sini nga tensyon, madamo pa sang mahimo kuhaan ang pungsod.
english: Only 10 percent of the Philippines' oil supply comes from Iran, Forro said; and if there is such tension, the country has much more to draw from.

text: Suno pa kay Forro, katungdanan kuntani sang gobyerno nga ipasiguro nga indi mabutang sa alang-alang ang interes sang mga pumuluyo sa tunga sang pagsinaka sang oil prices.
english: Forro said it is the government's duty to ensure that the interests of the people are not compromised amid the rise in oil prices.

text: Lakip sa panawagan sang grupo amo nga repasuhon sang gobyerno ang Oil Deregulation Law para mabalik ang regulatory powers ukon control sang gobyerno sa oil industry.
english: Among the group's calls is for the government to review the Oil Deregulation Law to restore the government's regulatory powers or control over the oil industry.

text: Ginapanawagan man sang organisasyon ang pag-suspinde sang excise tax agud mapunggan ang pagtimbuok sang presyo sang gatong.
english: The organization also calls for the suspension of the excise tax to curb the rise in fuel prices.

text: Base sa forecast nga ginpaguwa sang Department of Energy (DOE), posible ang price hike nga P3.30 – P3.50/L sa gasolina; P5.00 – P5.20/L sa diesel; kag P4.50 – P4.70/L sa kerosene.
