english: Based on the forecast released by the Department of Energy (DOE), a price hike of P3.30 – P3.50/L for gasoline is possible; P5.00 – P5.20/L of diesel; and P4.50 – P4.70/L for kerosene.

text: Balantayan ang pag-anunsyo sang final price adjustment buwas, Hunyo 23.
english: Watch for the announcement of the final price adjustment tomorrow, June 23.

text: Ipatuman ini epektibo sa Martes sang aga.#
english: It will be implemented effective Tuesday morning.#

text: Nagapanguna subong sa tatlo ka latest national surveys si Vice President Kamala Harris batok kay former President Donald Trump isa ka semana antes ang US elections.
english: Vice President Kamala Harris is currently leading in the latest three national polls against former President Donald Trump a week before the US elections.

text: Labaw sang three points si Harris batok kay Trump, 50%-47%, sa Morning Consult’s weekly survey nga gin-release kahapon kag may margin of error nga 1 point matapos nga nanguna ini nga may four points nga abanse, 50%-46%, sa nauna nga duha ka polls sang grupo.
english: Harris was more than three points ahead of Trump, 50%-47%, in the Morning Consult’s weekly survey released yesterday and had a margin of error of 1 point after leading with a four-point lead, 50%-46%, in the group’s previous two polls.

text: Nangibabaw gihapon si Harris kay Trump sang four points, 51%-47%, sa ABC/Ipsos poll sang mga posible botante nga gin-release sang Domingo kag mas mataas ini sa 50%-48% nga resulta sang una nga semana sang Oktubre.
english: Harris still leads Trump by four points, 51%-47%, in the ABC/Ipsos poll of likely voters released Sunday and is up from the 50%-48% results from the first week of October.

text: Sa Emerson College Polling survey naman nga gin- release sang Sabado, patas ang duha ka kandidato sa 49% gikan sa 49% ni Harris kag 48% ni Trump sang nagligad nga semana kag pinakauna nga bes nga wala nanguna si Harris umpisa sang Agusto.
english: In the Emerson College Polling survey released Saturday, the two candidates are tied at 49% from Harris' 49% and Trump's 48% last week, the first time Harris has not led since August.

text: Ini nga poll ang nagapakita sang pagnubo sang suporta para kay Harris batok kay Trump.
english: This poll shows a decline in support for Harris against Trump.

text: Kabug-usan nga 7,051 foreign kag Filipino tourists ang nag-abut sa Pilipinas umpisa sang gin-implementar ang no-quarantine policy para sa mga fully vaccinated foreign travelers halin sa visa-free countries sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: A total of 7,051 foreign and Filipino tourists have arrived in the Philippines since the implementation of the no-quarantine policy for fully vaccinated foreign travelers from visa-free countries amid the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Suno kay Department of Tourism (DOT) Secretary Bernadette Romulo-Puyat, 45 percent sa 7,051 amu ang mga balikbayan.
english: According to Department of Tourism (DOT) Secretary Bernadette Romulo-Puyat, 45 percent of the 7,051 are balikbayans.

text: Ang mga balikbayan ang makabig nga turista bangud sila ang may yara sang foreign passports.
english: Balikbayans are considered tourists because they have foreign passports.

text: Suno kay Puyat sa tanan nga international travelers, pinakamadamo ang naghalin sa United States, Canada, United Kingdom, Japan, kag Korea.
english: According to Puyat, among all international travelers, the largest number came from the United States, Canada, the United Kingdom, Japan, and Korea.

text: Madamo sa mga ini ang business travelers, kag ang iban ang nagpauli sa ila mga pamilya.
english: Many of them are business travelers, and some have returned to their families.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginbuksan na ang border sang Pilipinas sang Pebrero 10.
english: The Philippine border was reopened on February 10.

text: Ang fully vaccinated foreign nationals lang ang ginatugutan nga magsulod sa Pilipinas kag kinahanglan nga mapresentar ang mga gin-require nga dokumento sang Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases (IATF).
english: Only fully vaccinated foreign nationals are allowed to enter the Philippines and must present the required documents of the Inter-Agency Task Force for the Management of Emerging Infectious Diseases (IATF).

text: Ginabanta 20,000 ka Returning Overseas Filipinos (ROFs) naman ang nakapauli na sa Pilipinas humalin Pebrero 1 tubtub Pebrero 10.
english: An estimated 20,000 Returning Overseas Filipinos (ROFs) have already returned to the Philippines from February 1 to February 10.

text: Yara na sa 70% ang development sa pagsolbar sa kaso sang pagluthang-patay sa isa ka pastor nga natabo sa Barangay Anilao, Pavia, Iloilo sang Enero 10.
english: The development in solving the shooting death of a pastor in Barangay Anilao, Pavia, Iloilo on January 10 is now at 70%.

text: Ang biktima amo si Douglas Jover, 64, residente sang Quintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City kag nagatrabaho man bilang veterinarian.
english: The victim was identified as Douglas Jover, 64, resident of Quintin Salas, Jaro, Iloilo City and also works as a veterinarian.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Gabriel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police sang Pavia Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga may ginasundan na sila nga persons of interest apang ini pa nila mapangalanan ang mga ini.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Gabriel Manguera, Deputy Chief of Police of the Pavia Municipal Police Station, said they are already following up on persons of interest but they have yet to name them.

text: Suno kay Manguera, may yara naman sila sang natumod nga motibo sa pagpatay sa biktima.
english: Manguera said they have identified a motive for the murder.

text: Ginpahayag man niya nga possible nga magkilalahay lang ang biktima kag ang suspek.
english: He also said it is possible that the victim and the suspect knew each other.

text: Base sa mga nakit-an nga ebidensya, posible nga indi anad sa pagpatay ang suspek bangud nga ginbilin lang sini sa sulod sang salakyan ang armas nga gin-gamit sa pagluthang sa pastor.
english: Based on the evidence found, it is possible that the suspect was not used to killing because he left the weapon used to shoot the pastor inside the vehicle.

text: Naggwa naman sa dugang nga pagpangusisa sang kapulisan nga may problema sa kwarta ang biktima kag isa man ini sa ginasundan nga anggulo sang otoridad.
english: Further investigation by the police revealed that the victim had a money problem and this is also one of the angles being followed by the authorities.

text: May bag-o na nga lider ang Hezbollah.
english: Hezbollah now has a new leader.

text: Ini amo si Naim Qassem nga nagbulos kay Hassan Nasrallah nga napatay sa Israeli assassinations sang Septyembre sa Lebanon-based nga grupo.
english: This is Naim Qassem who succeeded Hassan Nasrallah who was killed in Israeli assassinations in September in the Lebanon-based group.

text: Sa statement, ginsiling sang Hezbollah nga gin-elihir si Qassem agud magbulos sa posisyon bangud sa pagtuman sini sa mga prinsipyo kag katuyuan sang Hezbollah.
english: In the statement, Hezbollah said Qassem was elected to take over the post because of his adherence to Hezbollah’s principles and objectives.

text: Gindugang man sang grupo nga hingyuon nila sa Diyos nga giyahan si Qassem sa iya misyon nga pamunuan ang Hezbollah kag ang Islamic resistance sini.
english: The group also added that they will ask God to guide Qassem in his mission to lead Hezbollah and its Islamic resistance.

text: Ang 71-anyos nga si Qassem ang ginbansagan nga Hezbollah’s “number two”.
english: The 71-year-old Qassem has been dubbed Hezbollah’s “number two”.

text: Siya isa sa mga religious scholars nga nagtukod sang grupo sang 1980s.
english: He was one of the religious scholars who founded the group in the 1980s.

text: Siya man ang pinakamataas nga senior Hezbollah official nga nagpadayon sa paghimo sang public appearances matapos ang pagpanago ni Nasrallah kasunod sang giyera ang grupo batok sa IsraeI sang 2006.
english: He is also the most senior Hezbollah official to continue making public appearances after Nasrallah went into hiding following the group's war against IsraeI in 2006.

text: Magahatag sang P5 million ang TV host nga si Willie Revillame sa mga jeepney drivers nga nadulaan sang palangabuhian subong nga ginpaidalom liwat sa modified enhanced community quarantine ang Metro Manila kag apat ka mga probinsya sa Luzon.
english: TV host Willie Revillame will donate P5 million to jeepney drivers who lost their livelihoods now that Metro Manila and four provinces in Luzon have been placed under modified enhanced community quarantine.

text: Magluwas sini magahatag man si Willie sang P400,000 sa pamilya sang apat nga Overseas Filipino Workers nga napatay sa natabo nga massive explosion sa Beirut, Lebanon.
english: Willie will also donate P400,000 to the families of four Overseas Filipino Workers who died in the massive explosion in Beirut, Lebanon.

text: Suno kay Willie, naluoy siys sa mga driver sang jeep nga nagapangalimos sa dalan bangud wala sila sadto ginpahanugutan nga makabalik sa pagbyahe.
english: According to Willie, he felt sorry for the jeep drivers who were begging on the streets because they were not allowed to return to travel.

text: Dugang pa sang host, bangud nga may yara man siya sang kwarta nga natipon pinaagi sa iya nga trabaho kag paghimakas, luyag niya nga magbulig sa mga driver kag sa mga OFWs.
english: The host added that since he has money saved through his work and struggle, he wants to help the drivers and the OFWs.

text: Indi lango-lango ang gin-agyan sang beterano nga aktor nga si John Regala sang gindala siya sa ospital bangud sa iya balatian sa atay.
english: Veteran actor John Regala was not drunk when he was taken to the hospital for liver disease.

text: Halin sa government hospitals padulong sa private hospitals, wala sang may nagbaton kay John bangud lunsay puno ang mga emergency rooms.
english: From government hospitals to private hospitals, no one accepted John because the emergency rooms were full.

text: Suno sa anay child actor nga si Chuckie Dreyfus,may yara sang liver cirrhosis kag gout si John.
english: According to former child actor Chuckie Dreyfus,John has liver cirrhosis and gout.

text: Ginbisita naman ni Film Development Council of the Philippines Chairperson Liza Diño ang aktor kag nagalaom ini nga mahatagan na sang kaugalingon nga kwarto.
english: Film Development Council of the Philippines Chairperson Liza Diño visited the actor and hopes to be given his own room.

text: Sa subong, hugot nga gina-monitor sang mga doktor ang kondisyon ni John bangud sa nagalala ang iya nga balatian.
english: Doctors are currently monitoring John's condition as his illness worsens.

text: Una na nga ginbuligan sang isa ka grab driver si John bangud nagalingin ang iya ulo kag ginagutom.
english: Earlier, a grab driver helped John because he was dizzy and hungry.

text: Nadumduman sang driver nga i-post ang pictures ni John sa social media kag bangud sini, madamo sang mga kaupod niya sa showbiz ang nagbulig.
english: The driver remembered to post John's pictures on social media and because of this, many of his showbiz colleagues helped.

text: Nag-file na ang Department of Foreign Affairs sang diplomatic protest kasunod sang plano sang China nga magbutang sang nature reserve sa Scarborough Shoal ukon sa Bajo de Masinloc nga kabahin pa sang teritoryo sang Pilipinas.
english: The Department of Foreign Affairs has filed a diplomatic protest following China's plan to establish a nature reserve in Scarborough Shoal or Bajo de Masinloc, which is still part of Philippine territory.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Foreign Affairs spokesperson Angelica Escalona apang wala pa na-klaro kun gin-summon bala ang Chinese ambassador agud batunon ang note verbale nga ginpaguwa kahapon, Septyembre 12.
english: This was confirmed by Foreign Affairs spokesperson Angelica Escalona but it is not clear whether the Chinese ambassador was summoned to accept the note verbale issued yesterday, September 12.

text: Ginlaragway sang opisyal nga “strong, unequivocal and formal articulation” ang pagpamatok sang Pilipinas sa aktwasyon sang China.
english: The official described the Philippines' opposition to China's action as a “strong, unequivocal and formal articulation”.

text: Sini nga semana, mismo ang State Council sang China ang nagsapubliko sang ila plano nga mag-establisar sang reserve sa Bajo de Masinloc.
english: This week, China's State Council itself made public its plan to establish a reserve in Bajo de Masinloc.

text:
Ginsiling nila nga importante ini para nga mamentenar ang diversity, stability, kag sustainability sang natural ecosystem sang isla nga ila ginatawag nga “Huangyan Island.”

Sabat naman sang DFA, indi lehitimo kag isa ka paglapas sa layi ang ginahimo sang China.
english:
They said this is important to maintain the diversity, stability, and sustainability of the island’s natural ecosystem which they call “Huangyan Island.”

The DFA said China's actions were illegitimate and illegal.

text: Nagpaguwa naman sang statement ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika paagi kay Secretary of State Marco Rubio kun sa diin ginsiling sini nga ang plano sang China ang isa ka pamahog sa regional stability.
english: The United States issued a statement through Secretary of State Marco Rubio saying China's plan is a threat to regional stability.

text: Ginpanawagan man sini sa Beijing nga magtuman sa ruling sang Permanent Court of Arbitration nga nagapabor sa kinamatarong sang Pilipinas sa West Philippine Sea.
english: He also called on Beijing to comply with the ruling of the Permanent Court of Arbitration in favor of the Philippines' rights in the West Philippine Sea.

text: Matandaan nga gindeklarar sang amo nga desisyon nga ilegal ang “nine-dash line” sang China.#
english: The decision declared China's nine-dash line illegal.

text: Nakumpleto na sang Tubungan Municipal Police Station ang mga dokumento sa ipasaka nga panumbungon batok sa suspek nga nagpatay sa 18-anyos nga dalaga nga si Candie Tabanda sa sulod mismo sang iya hulot sa ila balay sa Barangay Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo.
english: The Tubungan Municipal Police Station has completed the documents to file charges against the suspect who killed 18-year-old Candie Tabanda inside her room in her house in Barangay Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Alberto Manguilimotan, Jr., hepe sang Tubungan Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga reklamo nga Rape with Homicide ang atubangon ni Aljohn Jalbuna, 33, residente man sang Barangay Ingay sa amo nga banwa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Alberto Manguilimotan, Jr., chief of Tubungan Municipal Police Station, said Aljohn Jalbuna, 33, also a resident of Barangay Ingay in the same town, will face a complaint of rape with homicide.

text: Natipon na suno sa hepe ang mga ebidensya kag mga pahayag sang mga testigo sa krimen, apang sandig sa ila pagpakig-angot sa piskal, gin-schedule ang pag-file sang reklamo buwas sa aga, Hunyo 23.
english: The chief said evidence and statements of witnesses to the crime have been collected, but based on their communication with the prosecutor, the filing of the complaint is scheduled for tomorrow morning, June 23.

text: Bisan buwas pa ang filing, indi man sini maapektuhan ang pag-detain sa suspek.
english: Even if the filing is tomorrow, it will not affect the detention of the suspect.

text: Suno sa natungdan, base sa dalagan sang imbestigasyon subong, isa lang ang suspek sang ginhimo sini ang krimen.
english: He said that based on the current investigation, there was only one suspect when he committed the crime.

text: Matandaan nga nag-ako ang suspek sa pagsulod sa kuwarto kag pagpatay sa dalaga, apang todo-panindugan ini nga wala niya ginhimuslan ang biktima.
english: The suspect confessed to entering the room and killing the girl, but insisted that he did not rape the victim.

text: Baliskad ini sa nagguwa nga resulta sang autopsy sa lawas sang biktima kun sa diin nakumpirma nga ini ang gin-abuso seksuwal.
english: This is contrary to the results of the autopsy on the victim's body which confirmed that she was sexually abused.

text: Naggwa man sa autopsy nga multiple traumatic injury at the head ang kabangdanan sang kamatayon sang dalaga bangud sa mga nakit-an nga mga lagob sa iya ulo nga posible tuga sang pagsumbag ukon ginbunggo ini sa matig-a nga bagay.
english: The autopsy also revealed that multiple traumatic injury to the head was the cause of death of the girl due to the bruises found on her head that may have been caused by being hit or hit by a hard object.

text: Nagaguwa man sa pagpangusisa sang Bombo Radyo sa barangay nga may record man si Jalbuna sa pagpangawat sang baka sa ila lugar.
english: Bombo Radyo's investigation in the barangay also revealed that Jalbuna also has a record of stealing cows in their area.

text: Ginatudlo man ini nga nagsulod anay sa isa ka balay kun sa diin may yara sang menor de edad, apang sang amo nga tion, wala ini napasakaan sang kaso.#
english: He is also alleged to have entered a house where a minor was present, but at that time, he was not charged.#

text: Gin-extend sang Social Security System (SSS) ang contribution payment deadline sa pila ka binulan sa tuig 2021 tubtub Pebrero 28, 2022 sa mga lugar nga gindeklara ukon ginpaidalom sa state of calamity bangud sa paglaslas sang Bagyo Odette sang Disyembre 2021.
english: The Social Security System (SSS) has extended the contribution payment deadline for several months in 2021 until February 28, 2022 in areas declared or placed under a state of calamity due to the onslaught of Typhoon Odette in December 2021.

text: Ini ang gin-issue sang ahensya sa idalom sang SSS Circular No.
english: This was issued by the agency under SSS Circular No.

text:
Sa amu nga circular nakasaad ang extension sang contribution payments deadline asta sa katapusan sang Pebrero para sa bulan sang Nobyembre kag Disyembre 2021 sa business kag household employers; Oktubre tubtub Disyembre 2021 para sa coverage and collection partners (CCPs), self-employed, voluntary, non-working spouse (SE/V/NWS) members, kag land-based Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) nga mga myembro sa idalom sang mga masunod nga rehiyon:

Region IV-B (MIMAROPA),Region VI (Western Visayas),Region VII (Central Visayas),Region VIII (Eastern Visayas),Region X (Northern Mindanao), kagRegion XIII (CARAGA).
english:
The circular provides for the extension of the contribution payments deadline until the end of February for the months of November and December 2021 to business and household employers; October to December 2021 for coverage and collection partners (CCPs), self-employed, voluntary, non-working spouse (SE/V/NWS) members, and land-based Overseas Filipino Worker (OFW) members under the following regions:

Region IV-B (MIMAROPA), Region VI (Western Visayas), Region VII (Central Visayas), Region VIII (Eastern Visayas), Region X (Northern Mindanao), and Region XIII (CARAGA).

text: Nahibaluan nga ang ahensya ang nagbukas man sang calamity assistance package para sa mga myembro kag pensioners nga naapektuhan sang bagyo odette.
english: Nahibaluan nga ang ahensya ang nagbukas man sang calamity assistance package para sa mga myembro kag pensioners nga naapektuhan sang bagyo odette.

text: Simple apang maunod ang mensahe ni Jinkee Pacquiao matapos ang pagpakamalaot sang aktres nga si Agot Isidro angot sa magarbo sini nga lifestyle.
english: Jinkee Pacquiao's message is simple but meaningful after actress Agot Isidro condemned her lavish lifestyle.

text: Si Jinkee ang tiayon sang boxing champ-senator kag bilyonaryo nga si Manny Pacquiao.
english: Jinkee is the wife of boxing champ-senator and billionaire Manny Pacquiao.

text: Una nga ginpahayag ni Agot nga insensitibo nga sahi sang tawo si Jinkee bangud sa pagpakita sini sang mga pictures sang malahalon nga mga gamit sa social media partikular na ang pictures sang Hermes kag Louis Vuitton bikes.
english: Agot first said that Jinkee is an insensitive person because she showed pictures of expensive items on social media particularly pictures of Hermes and Louis Vuitton bikes.

text: Matapos ang post ni Agot, ginpakigbahin ni Jinkee ang isa ka Bible quote sa iya nga instragram story.
english: After Agot's post, Jinkee shared a Bible quote on her instragram story.

text:
Ginbutangan sini sang highlight kag arrow ang Matthew Chapter 7 Verses 1 kag 6 nga may tigulo: “Do Not Judge Others.”

Wala man sang pangalan nga na mentionar sa post ni Jinkee apang iya ini ginpakigbahin matapos ang nabaton nga kritisismo sa aktres.
english:
It highlighted and arrowed Matthew Chapter 7 Verses 1 and 6 with the title: “Do Not Judge Others.”

No name was mentioned in Jinkee's post but she shared it after receiving criticism from the actress.

text: Ginduso sang Egypt ang duha ka adlaw nga ceasefire sa Gaza agud nga ibaylo ang apat ka Israeli nga ginbihag sang Hamas sa mga Palestinian prisoners nga yara naman sa Israel.
english: Egypt has proposed a two-day ceasefire in Gaza in exchange for four Israelis captured by Hamas for Palestinian prisoners in Israel.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni Egyptian leader Abdel Fattah al-Sisi ang amo nga tikang kaupod si Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune sa Cairo.
english: Egyptian leader Abdel Fattah al-Sisi announced the move alongside Algerian President Abdelmadjid Tebboune in Cairo.

text: Suno kay Sisi, dapat nga mag-resume na ang pag-istoryahanay sa sulod sang 10 ka adlaw nga pagpatuman sang temporary ceasefire bilang kabahin sang paninguha nga makasugtan gid ang permanente na nga pag-untat sang gyera sa Gaza Strip.
english: Sisi said talks should resume within 10 days of the implementation of the temporary ceasefire as part of efforts to agree on a permanent ceasefire in the Gaza Strip.

text: Wala pa sang ginkomento ang Israel ukon ang Hamas militants apang may pila ka Palestinian officials nga nagsiling nga nagalaum nga pamatian sang militante nga grupo ang amo nga offer.
english: Neither Israel nor the Hamas militants have commented but some Palestinian officials have said they hope the militant group will listen to the offer.

text: Una na nga ginpahayag sang Hamas nga indi nila pagpangbuy-an ang nabilin nga mga bihag sa Gaza tubtub nga indi mag-isol ang mga soldado sang Israel.
english: Hamas has previously said it will not release the remaining hostages in Gaza until Israeli troops withdraw.

text: Ginbasura na sang Office of the Ombudsman ang gin-file ni Senator Imee Marcos nga reklamo batok kay Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla kag sa iban pa.
english: The Office of the Ombudsman has dismissed the complaint filed by Senator Imee Marcos against Department of Justice (DOJ) Secretary Jesus Crispin “Boying” Remulla and others.

text: Ini may kaangtanan sa pagdakop kay anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kag pagdala sa iya sa International Criminal Court (ICC) sa The Hague, Netherlands sang Marso 11, 2025.
english: This is in connection with the arrest of former President Rodrigo Duterte and his arraignment before the International Criminal Court (ICC) in The Hague, Netherlands on March 11, 2025.

text: Gin-dismiss man ang complaint batok sa iya utod nga si Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) Secretary Juanito Victor “Jonvic” Remulla.
english: The complaint against his brother, DILG Secretary Juanito Victor “Jonvic” Remulla, was also dismissed.

text: Matandaan nga una naman nga nagpahayag si Senator Marcos nga maga-file ini sang motion for reconsideration sa Ombudsman.
english: Senator Marcos earlier said he would file a motion for reconsideration with the Ombudsman.

text: Lakip sa complaints nga iya ginpasaka amo ang grave misconduct kag conduct prejudicial to the best interest of the service; kag arbitrary detention, usurpation of judicial functions, grave threats, graft, usurpation of authority ukon official functions, false testimony in other cases, kag perjury.
english: Among the complaints he filed were grave misconduct and conduct prejudicial to the best interest of the service; and arbitrary detention, usurpation of judicial functions, grave threats, graft, usurpation of authority or official functions, false testimony in other cases, and perjury.

text: Naga-apply si Justice Secretary Remulla sa pagka-Ombudsman gani importante para sa iya ini nga development.
english: Justice Secretary Remulla is applying for the position of Ombudsman so this development is important to him.

text: Sang Agusto, nagguwa ang mga huring-huring nga posible ini ma-disqualify sa iya aplikasyon bangud sa iya pending nga Ombudsman case.#
english: In August, rumors surfaced that he might be disqualified from his application due to his pending Ombudsman case.#

text: Nagasaka ang numero sang online users sa Southeast Asia nga nagakabiktima sang love scams subong nga may pandemya.
english: The number of online users in Southeast Asia who are victims of love scams is increasing during the pandemic.

text: Suno sa cybersecurity solutions firm nga Kaspersky, isa sa duha ka indibidwal ukon 45% sang respondents sa survey nga gin-conduct sang July sang nagligad nga tuig ang nangin biktima sang romance scams.
english: According to cybersecurity solutions firm Kaspersky, one in two individuals or 45% of respondents to a survey conducted in July last year have been victims of romance scams.

text: Sandig sa graph sang recorded ‘love scams’ sa region, ang most recorded incidents ang nagabalor sang indi magnubo sa $100 ukon masulusobra sa P5,000.
english: According to the graph of recorded love scams in the region, the most recorded incidents are worth at least $100 or more than P5,000.

text: Kalabanan sa mga biktima ang nagikan sa Silent (1918-1945) generations nga naga-comprise sang 33% sang respondents.
english: Most of the victims were from the Silent (1918-1945) generations comprising 33% of the respondents.

text: Eight percent naman sang mga biktima ang nagikan sa Gen Z (1997-2009).
english: Eight percent of the victims were from Gen Z (1997-2009).

text: Ginalantaw nga mas mabiktima sang cybercriminals ang mga tigulang bangud sang ila retirement funds.
english: The elderly are expected to be more vulnerable to cybercriminals because of their retirement funds.

text:
Yari ang pila ka panugyan agud nga indi mabiktima ang imo nga kuwarta kag mangin safe ang imo heart batok sa posible mga moves sang cybercriminals:

Kun maggamit sang social media sites, indi magbaton sang friend requests halin sa tawo nga indi mo kilala.
english:
Here are some tips to keep your money safe and your heart safe against possible moves by cybercriminals:

When using social media sites, do not accept friend requests from people you do not know.

text: Likawi nga magbuyagyag sang personal information sa dating profile ukon sa tawo nga imo ka-chat ukon nakilala mo lang online.
english: Avoid revealing personal information on a dating profile or someone you’re chatting with or just met online.

text: Hinay-hinay lang.
english: Just slowly.

text: Pamangkuta ang imo ka-chat sang certain questions, obserbahi kun may mga inconsistencies ukon wala agud mahibal-an mo kun impostor ini ukon indi.
english: Ask your chat partner certain questions, observe if there are inconsistencies or not so you know if he is an imposter or not.

text: Kag ang importante, indi gid maghatag sang kuwarta sa tawo nga ka-relasyon mo lang online kag wala man kamo sang relasyon offline.
english: And importantly, never give money to someone who is only in a relationship with you online and you have no relationship offline.

text: Ginbulgar sang opisyal sang Barangay Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo nga may record man sang pagpangawat ang lalaki nga suspek sa pagpatay sa 18-anyos nga dalaga.
english: The official of Barangay Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo revealed that the male suspect in the murder of the 18-year-old girl also has a record of robbery.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Punong Barangay Leonardo Tamesis, iya ginpahayag nga ginreklamo anay ang 33-anyos nga si Aljohn Jalbuna nga amo ang nagkawat kag nagbaligya sang baka nga ginapanag-iyahan man sang Lola sang dalaga nga iya ginpatay.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Punong Barangay Leonardo Tamesis said that 33-year-old Aljohn Jalbuna was first complained of stealing and selling a cow belonging to the grandmother of the girl he killed.

text: Suno kay Tamesis, P33,000 ang baligya ni Jalbuna sang baka, kag sang nag-atubangay sila sa barangay, ginpabalik sa iya ang kuwarta kag ginpalab-ot pa sa P50,000 ang sukot sa iya bangud sa ginhimo nga sala.
english: According to Tamesis, Jalbuna sold the cow for P33,000, and when they met in the barangay, the money was returned to him and the fine was increased to P50,000 for the crime.

text: Magluwas diri, ginatudlo man si Jalbuna nga nagsulod sang balay sa amo man nga barangay kun sa diin may isa ka menor de edad sang 2024.
english: Besides, Jalbuna is also alleged to have entered a house in the same barangay where there was a minor in 2024.

text: Sang amo nga tion, wala sang kaso nga napasaka batok sa iya apang ginpaidalom gid sa rehabilitation ang bata sa idalom sang Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).
english: At that time, no case was filed against him but the child was subjected to rehabilitation under the Department of Social Welfare and Development (DSWD).

text: Nahibaluan nga ini nga mga record sa barangay ang isa sa ginsundan sang Tubungan Municipal Police Station kun ngaa ginkabig si Jalbuna nga isa sa persons of interest.
english: It was learned that these records in the barangay were one of the followed by the Tubungan Municipal Police Station why Jalbuna was considered one of the persons of interest.

text: Sang ginkadtuan siya sa iya balay agud dakpon, nag-ako ini sa krimen nga pagpatay, apang hugot nga nagpanginwala nga ginhimuslan niya ang dalaga.
english: When he was taken to his house to be arrested, he confessed to the crime of murder, but vehemently denied raping the girl.

text: Nag-ako man ang suspek sa paggamit sang iligal nga droga halin pa sang bulan sang Mayo.
english: The suspect also admitted to using illegal drugs since May.

text: Natalana nga ipasaka ang kaso nga Rape with Homicide buwas, Hunyo 23.#
english: The rape with homicide case is scheduled to be filed tomorrow, June 23.#

text: Nag-depensa ang Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) nga ang desisyon sini nga pahanugutan ang pag-import sang kabug-usan nga 200,000 metric tons (MT) sang kalamay ang naangot sa ginalantaw nga kakulangan sa suplay kun manughingapos na ang milling season.
english: The Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) defended that its decision to allow the import of a total of 200,000 metric tons (MT) of sugarcane is linked to the expected supply shortage towards the end of the milling season.

text: Sa isa ka statement, ginpahayag ni SRA administrator Hermenegildo Serafica nga nag-desisyon ang board nga pasugtan ang importation bangud ginkonsiderar ang pagnubo sa ending balance sang refined sugar.
english: In a statement, SRA administrator Hermenegildo Serafica said the board decided to allow the importation because it considered the decline in the ending balance of refined sugar.

text: Sa iga-import nga kalamay, 100,000 MT ang standard grade refined sugar kag 100,000 MT ang bottlers’ grade refined sugar.
english: Of the sugar to be imported, 100,000 MT will be standard grade refined sugar and 100,000 MT will be bottlers’ grade refined sugar.

text: Suno kay Serafica, gin-assess man sang SRA ang nangin halit ni Bagyo Odette sa sugarcane crops kag ginlantaw man ang sugar stocks sa warehouses amo man ang facilities kag equipment sang sugar mills kag refineries sa nagapanguna nga sugar milling districts.
english: According to Serafica, the SRA also assessed the damage caused by Typhoon Odette to sugarcane crops and also looked at the sugar stocks in warehouses as well as the facilities and equipment of sugar mills and refineries in the leading sugar milling districts.

text: Kasunod sini, ginbutang sang SRA ang ila nga pre-final crop estimate sang raw sugar production sa 2.072 million MT nga mas manubo ipaanggid sa nauna nga projection nga 2.099 million MT.
english: Subsequently, the SRA put its pre-final crop estimate of raw sugar production at 2.072 million MT which is lower compared to the previous projection of 2.099 million MT.

text: Sandig sa ginpa-guwa nga data sang Department of Agriculture-Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Operations Center, ang halit sang bagyo sa tubo ang naglab-ot sa P1.15 billion ukon 8.6 percent sang kabug-usan nga agricultural damage.
english: According to data released by the Department of Agriculture-Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Operations Center, the typhoon damage to sugarcane reached P1.15 billion or 8.6 percent of the total agricultural damage.

text: Gin-revise man sang Philippine Association of Sugar Refineries ang ila nga refined sugar production forecast para sa current crop year.
english: The Philippine Association of Sugar Refineries also revised its refined sugar production forecast for the current crop year.

text: Ginbutang ini sa 16.748 million 50-kilo bags (LKg), manubo halin sa initial production estimate nga 17.572 million LKg.
english: This was put at 16.748 million 50-kilo bags (LKg), down from the initial production estimate of 17.572 million LKg.

text: Ang crop year ang magaumpisa sa Septyembre 1 kag maga-tapos sa Agusto 31 sa masunod nga tuig.
english: The crop year will start on September 1 and end on August 31 next year.

text: Ginpaathag man sang SRA nga ang sugar mills kag refineries ang naga-untat sang operasyon sa bulan sang Mayo tubtub sa Hunyo, kag maga-umpisa naman sa operasyon para sa next season sa Septyembre tubtub sa Oktubre.
english: The SRA also explained that sugar mills and refineries are suspending operations from May to June, and will resume operations for the next season from September to October.

text: Ang refineries naman ang magaumpisa sang operasyon duha ka semana matapos ang mills.
english: The refineries will start operations two weeks after the mills.

text: Suno sa SRA, ang 200,00 MT sang refined sugar imports amo ang maga-cover sa supply shortfall kag amo ang magahatag sang bastante nga buffer stock sa pungsod nga maka-sustain tubtub sa pag-umpisa naman sang bag-o nga milling season.
english: According to the SRA, the 200,000 MT of refined sugar imports will cover the supply shortfall and provide sufficient buffer stock in the country to sustain until the start of the new milling season.

text: Ang pagpatuman sang sugar import program ang naangot sa direktiba sang Department of Agriculture (DA) agud nga ma-temper ang nagasaka nga presyo sa kalamay sa local market.
english: The implementation of the sugar import program is linked to the directive of the Department of Agriculture (DA) to temper the rising price of sugarcane in the local market.

text: ## –with reports from Philstar
english: ## –with reports from Philstar

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Padayon pa nga ginahibalo ang identity sang iloy nga nagbilin sang iya kapid nga fetus sa compound sang Department of Environment National Resources (DENR) Region 6 sa Barangay Concepcion, City Proper.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – The identity of a mother who left her twin fetus in the compound of the Department of Environment National Resources (DENR) Region 6 in Barangay Concep, Propercion City is still unknown.

text: Ini ang nakit-an sang Lunes, Enero 13 sa plant box sa entrance sang building samtang ang isa naman ang yara sa pulungku-an.
english: It was found on Monday, January 13 in the plant box at the entrance of the building while the other was in the chair.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga wala naga-function ang Closed-circuit television (CCTV) sa lugar nga amo kuntani ang makabulig sa imbestigasyon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of Iloilo City Police Office 6, said the closed-circuit television (CCTV) in the area was not functioning which would have helped in the investigation.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, possible nga sang weekend ginbilin ang mga fetus bangud wala sang tawo nga nagabantay sa lugar.
english: According to Sangrines, it is possible that the fetuses were left over the weekend because there was no one guarding the area.

text: Gin-athag man sang natungdan nga indi empleyado ang ahensya ang iloy nga nagbilin sang kapid nga fetus nga ginabanta naga edad sang apat ka bulan.
english: He also clarified that the mother who left the twin fetus, estimated to be four months old, is not an employee of the agency.

text: Gindala naman sa Regional Forensic Unit 6 ang mga fetus sa diin ginkuhaan ini sang DNA sample antes ginlubong.
english: The fetuses were taken to the Regional Forensic Unit 6 where DNA samples were taken before being buried.

text: Igaplastar sang South Korea sa North Atlantic Council ang ginhimo sang North Korea nga pagpadala sang linibo ka mga soldado sa Russia.
english: South Korea will raise at the North Atlantic Council North Korea's decision to send thousands of soldiers to Russia.

text: Ini nga council amo ang mayor nga decision-making body sang North Atlantic Treaty Organization ukon NATO.
english: This council is the main decision-making body of the North Atlantic Treaty Organization or NATO.

text: Suno sa NATO, ang high-level delegation nga gin-imbitahan nga magtambong sa meeting amo ang Indo Pacific partners sang NATO nga amo ang Australia, Japan, New Zealand, kag Republic of Korea.
english: According to NATO, the high-level delegation invited to attend the meeting are NATO’s Indo Pacific partners namely Australia, Japan, New Zealand, and the Republic of Korea.

text: Base sa Ukrainian military intelligence, ginabanta nga 12,000 North Korean troops lakip na ang 500 ka mga opisyal kag tatlo ka mga heneral ang yara na subong sa Russia kag nagahanas sa lima ka military bases.
english: Based on Ukrainian military intelligence, an estimated 12,000 North Korean troops including 500 officers and three generals are now in Russia and training at five military bases.

text: Wala ginpanginwala ni Russian President Vladimir Putin ang pagpadala sang North Korean troops sa Russia, apang ginsiling sini nga pagusto na ang Moscow kun paano iimplementar ang kasugtanan sini kaupod sa Pyongyang nga nagalakip sang mutual defense clause para nga mabuligan nila ang isa kag isa pananglitan may yara sang external aggression.
english: Russian President Vladimir Putin did not deny the deployment of North Korean troops to Russia, but said Moscow is now deciding how to implement its agreement with Pyongyang that includes a mutual defense clause so they can help each other in the event of external aggression.

text: Matandaan nga ginlunsar sang Russia ang full-scale invasion sa Ukraine sang Pebrero 2022.
english: It can be recalled that Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in February 2022.

text: Ginkakibot sang mga netizens ang slimmer figure sang singing champion nga si Elha Nympha.
english: Netizens were shocked by the slimmer figure of singing champion Elha Nympha.

text: Ginpakigbahin sang 16-anyos nga dalagita ang iya mga pictures sa social media nga nagapakita sang iya fit physique sa diin gin-ulan sang mga komento gikan sa iya upod sa showbiz kag mga fans.
english: The 16-year-old shared her pictures on social media showing off her fit physique where comments were showered from her along with showbiz and fans.

text: Suno kay Elha, ang pila ka bulan nga lockdown ang nagbulig sa iya agud nga maka-diet kag maka-ehersisyo.
english: According to Elha, the months of lockdown helped her to diet and exercise.

text: Nangin kilala si Elha sang 2015 sang nangin kampeon ini sa isa ka singing competition kag naka-perform naman sa mga international shows.
english: Elha became famous in 2015 when she became champion in a singing competition and performed in international shows.

text: Pabor ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nga panubuan ang quarantine status sang pungsod sa Alert Level 1 agud nga mabuksan naman ang madamo pa nga negosyo kag trabaho kadungan man sang pagnubo sang kaso sang COVID-19.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) is in favor of lowering the country's quarantine status to Alert Level 1 so that more businesses and jobs can reopen along with the decline in COVID-19 cases.

text: Suno kay DTI Undersecretary Ruth Castelo, kun plano nga panubuon sa Alert level 1 ang Pilipinas, kinahanglan nga amat-amat ini nga ipatuman bangud man sa pagpamahog sang COVID-19.
english: According to DTI Undersecretary Ruth Castelo, if the Philippines is planned to be raised to Alert level 1, it should be implemented gradually due to the threat of COVID-19.

text: Sa subong, ang National Capital Region (NCR) kag iban pa nga mga probinsya ang yara sa idalom sang Alert Level 2 humalin sang Pebrero 1- Pebrero 15.
english: Currently, the National Capital Region (NCR) and other provinces are under Alert Level 2 from February 1- February 15.

text: Sa Alert Level 2, ang mga establishemento kag mga aktibidad ang yara lang sa 50% indoor capacity para sa fully vaccinated adults kag minors, kag 70% outdoor capacity bisan pa nga unvaccinated.
english: At Alert Level 2, establishments and activities are limited to 50% indoor capacity for fully vaccinated adults and minors, and 70% outdoor capacity even if unvaccinated.

text: Apang, kun sa idalom naman sang Alert Level 1 ang pungsod, tanan nga establishemneto, tawo kag ano man nga mga aktibidad ang tugutan na nga mag-operate kag pahanugutan na ang full-site capacity.
english: However, if the country is under Alert Level 1, all establishments, people and any activities will be allowed to operate and full-site capacity will be allowed.

text: Suno kay Castelo 1.5 million ka mga negosyo ang maka-operate sa full capacity kun mas pahalugan ang quarantine restrictions sa pungsod.
english: According to Castelo, 1.5 million businesses will be able to operate at full capacity if the quarantine restrictions in the country are eased.

text: Gin-anunsyar sang rapper nga si Kanye West nga mapadalagan ini bilang Presidente sang Estados Unidos.
english: Rapper Kanye West has announced that he will run for President of the United States.

text: Pinaagi sa social media account sang rapper, iya gin-hangkat si US President Donald Trump para sa pagka-presidente subong nga 2020.
english: Through the rapper's social media account, he challenged US President Donald Trump for the presidency in 2020.

text: Wala sang iban pa nga detalye nga ginhatag ang rapper sa iya kampanya apat ka bulan antes ang eleksyon saNobyembre.
english: The rapper provided no other details on his campaign four months before the November election.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang tuig 2019, nagpabutyag na sang interes si West sa presidential position.
english: In 2019, West expressed interest in the presidential position.

text: Ginatugyan na lang ni Iloilo 1st District Rep.
english: Iloilo 1st District Rep.

text: Janette Garin kay Uswag Ilonggo party list Representative Jojo Ang ang pagsabat kun may kahilabtanan gid man ini sa korapsyon.
english: Janette Garin to Uswag Ilonggo party list Representative Jojo Ang the answer if it really has anything to do with corruption.

text: Ini matapos nga ginpangalan sang mag-asawa nga Curlee kag Sarah Discaya si Ang bilang isa sa mga opisyal nga nagapangayo sang 10% tubtob 25% nga kickbacks halin sa mga kontrata nga gina-award sang gobyerno sa ila bilang kontraktor.
english: This comes after Curlee and Sarah Discaya named Ang as one of the officials who demand 10% to 25% kickbacks from contracts awarded to them by the government as contractors.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Rep.

text: Garin, iya ginpahayag nga si Ang ang nakahangop sa isyu kag mas maayo nga siya ang magdepensa sang iya kaugalingon kag kinahanglan nga hatagan ini sang benefit of the doubt sa amo nga isyu.
english: Garin, he said that Ang understands the issue and it is better for him to defend himself and he should be given the benefit of the doubt on the issue.

text: Apang suno sa kongresista, sa mga akusasyon sang mga Discaya, may mga red flags ini nga nakit-an angot sa pag-ulamid nila sang mga pangalan sang mga opisyal sang gobyerno.
english: However, the congressman said that in the accusations of the Discaya, there are red flags that were found regarding their involvement in the names of government officials.

text: Suno kay Garin, isa na diri ang pagtudlo sang mga Discaya kay Rep.
english: According to Garin, one of these is the Discaya's appointment of Rep.

text: Roman Romulo nga ginsiling nila nga nagakuha man sang kickback, apang pahayag ni Garin, kwestyonable ini bangud nga magkasumpong sa pulitika sanday Roman kag Discaya.
english: Roman Romulo that they said is also getting kickback, but Garin said, this is questionable because Roman and Discaya are political opponents.

text: Dugang sang kongresista, kaangay nga gin-coach lang ang mga affidavit sang mga Discaya bangud nga may mga porsyon sini nga ginlimitahan lang ang paghatag sang data angot sa mga ginkita nila sa mga nauna nila nga mga transaksyon sa gobyerno.
english: The congressman added that the affidavits of the Discayas seem to have been coached because there are portions of them that are limited to providing data on their income from previous transactions with the government.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Garin nga mas maayo nga itugyan man sa independent body nga tukuron ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Garin also said it would be better to leave it to an independent body to be set up by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: ang pag-imbestigar sa mga myembro sang Kamara nga gin-ulamid sa anomaliya.
english: the investigation of members of the House of Representatives involved in the anomaly.

text: Samtang, inrekomendar naman ni Garin ang paglibot sa tanan nga mga flood control projects kag kun may makit-an nga damage, mahingagaw nga ma-rehabilitate ini samtang active pa ang warranty.
english: Meanwhile, Garin recommended to tour all flood control projects and if any damage is found, it will be rehabilitated while the warranty is still active.

text: Nagpasalig man si Garin nga suportahan niya kun may patigayunon nga inquiry ang Iloilo Province sa mga flood control projects.
english: Garin also assured that he will support if Iloilo Province conducts an inquiry on flood control projects.

text: Magasapol subong nga Lunes ang United Nations Security Council agud nga istoryahan ang pag-atake sang Israel sa Iran pasado alas dos sang kaagahon sang Sabado.
english: The United Nations Security Council will meet on Monday to discuss Israel's attack on Iran around 2 am on Saturday.

text: Suno sa council president nga Switzerland, ang Iran mismo ang nag-request sang meeting kag suportado ini sang Algeria, China kag Russia.
english: According to council president Switzerland, Iran itself requested the meeting and it is supported by Algeria, China and Russia.

text: Sa sulat ni Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi sa 15-member council, ginsiling sini nga ang ginhimo sang Israel ang makabig nga isa ka pamahog sa international peace kag security kag mas ginapagamo sini ang mahuyang na nga daan nga rehiyon sang Middle East.
english: In a letter to the 15-member council, Iranian Foreign Minister Abbas Araqchi said Israel's actions could be considered a threat to international peace and security and further complicate the already fragile Middle East region.

text: Matandaan nga may ginpadala nga mga Israeli jets agud maghimo sang airstrikes sa missile factories kag iban pa nga mga site malapit sa Tehran kag sa western Iran sang weekend.
english: Israeli jets were sent to carry out airstrikes on missile factories and other sites near Tehran and western Iran over the weekend.

text: Base sa Iranian authorities, may gin-atake gid man nga sites sa Tehran, Khuzestan kag Ilam provinces apang na-counter nila ini kag limitado lamang ang damage.
english: According to Iranian authorities, sites in Tehran, Khuzestan and Ilam provinces were attacked but they were able to counter them and the damage was limited.

text: May yara man sang apat ka mga soldado sang Iran nga napatay sa amo nga airstrikes.
english: Four Iranian soldiers were also killed in the airstrikes.

text: Balos ini sang Israel matapos ang natabo sang Oktubre 1 sang nagpalupad man ang Iran sang 200 ballistic missiles sa Jewish state.
english: This is Israel's retaliation after the October 1 incident when Iran also fired 200 ballistic missiles at the Jewish state.

text: Nag-apelar naman si UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres sa tanan nga mga partido nga involved nga untaton na ang military action lakip na sa Gaza kag sa Lebanon kag himuon gid ang tanan nga tikang agud nga malikawan ang all-out regional war.#
english: UN Secretary-General Antonio Guterres has appealed to all parties involved to cease military action including in Gaza and Lebanon and take all measures to avoid an all-out regional war.

text: Ginkakilig sang mga netizens ang nangin reaksyon sang boyfriend sang aktres kag vlogger nga si Alex Gonzaga.
english: Netizens were shocked by the reaction of the boyfriend of the actress and vlogger Alex Gonzaga.

text: Ini ang may kaangtanan sa prank video ni Alex sa iya nobyo sa diin nagpa kuno-kuno ini nga natuslok sang tinidor ang iya nga dila.
english: This is in connection with Alex's prank video with her boyfriend where she pretended to pierce her tongue with a fork.

text: Makit-an sa video nga samtang nagakaon sanday Alex kag nobyo sini nga si Mikee, gilayon nga nag umpisa ang prank.
english: The video shows that while Alex and her boyfriend Mikee were eating, the prank immediately started.

text: Nagsalangisag si Mikee apang gintinguhaan sini nga makuha ang tinidor sa dila sang iya nobya.
english: Mikee hesitated but tried to pull the fork out of his girlfriend's tongue.

text: Bangud sa nangin reaksyon sang nobyo, napamatud-an ni Alex nga “true love” ang nabatyagan ni Mikee sa iya.
english: Because of the boyfriend's reaction, Alex proved that Mikee felt “true love” for him.

text: Samtang sa social media account, gin-ulan sang “kilig” ang mga netizens kag nagpahayag pa ang iban nga “Sana all may Mikee”.
english: Meanwhile, on social media accounts, netizens were showered with “kilig” and others even said, “I hope everyone has Mikee”.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky nga posible nga maga-intra na sa patag-awayan subong nga weekend ang mga soldado sang North Korea nga ginpadala sa Russia.
english: Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelensky has announced that North Korean soldiers sent to Russia are likely to join the battlefield this weekend.

text: Pahayag sini, natumod sang Ukrainian intelligence nga gamiton na sang Moscow ang una nga North Korean military sa combat zones sa tunga-tunga sang Domingo kag Lunes.
english: According to him, Ukrainian intelligence has identified that Moscow will use the first North Korean military in combat zones between Sunday and Monday.

text: Wala na ini sang ginhatag nga dugang nga detalye partikular kun sa diin iga-deploy ang North Korean soldiers apang ginsiling sini nga ang deployment isa ka tikang sang Russia agud nga mas maglala ang gyera sa Ukraine.
english: He gave no further details specifically on where the North Korean soldiers would be deployed but said the deployment was a move by Russia to escalate the war in Ukraine.

text: Nahibaluan nga ini ang labing-una nga large-scale overseas deployment sang North Korean military halin sang Vietnam War.
english: This is the first large-scale overseas deployment of the North Korean military since the Vietnam War.

text: Base sa Main Intelligence Directorate sang Ukraine nga kilala sa acronym nga GUR, na-detect sang nagligad nga Miyerkules ang North Korean units sa Kursk region matapos ang training sa base-militar sa eastern Russia kag nahatagan na sang mga panapton para sa winter.
english: According to Ukraine's Main Intelligence Directorate, known by the acronym GUR, North Korean units were detected last Wednesday in the Kursk region after training at a military base in eastern Russia and have been provided with winter clothes.

text: Base sa estimates sini, yara sa 12,000 ka mga soldado ang ginpadala sang North Korea lakip na ang 500 ka opisyal kag tatlo ka mga heneral.
english: Based on its estimates, North Korea has sent 12,000 troops, including 500 officers and three generals.

text: Kun basehan naman ang kumpirmasyon sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika, 3,000 ka North Korean troops ang gin-deploy sa Russia kag nagahanas na sa nagkalain-lain nga mga lokasyon.
english: Based on the confirmation of the United States of America, 3,000 North Korean troops have been deployed in Russia and are already training in various locations.

text: Tubtub subong, wala ginkumpirma apang wala man ginpanginwala ni Russian President Vladimir Putin kun may mga soldado gid man nga ginpadala sa ila si North Korean leader Kim Jong Un.#
english: So far, Russian President Vladimir Putin has not confirmed but has not denied whether North Korean leader Kim Jong Un has sent troops to them.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Preso ang isa ka Retired Philippine Coast Guard matapos ginluthang-patay ang isa ka barber sa Zone-6, Barangay Calumpang, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – A retired Philippine Coast Guard was arrested after he shot dead a barber in Zone-6, Barangay Calumpang, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang suspek amo si Noel Amboy, 66, kasado samtang ang biktima naman amo si Bryan Gabuelo, 42, kasado, lunsay residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The suspect was identified as Noel Amboy, 66, married while the victim was identified as Bryan Gabuelo, 42, married, both residents of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, hepe sang Molo Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga lunsay hubog ang suspek kag biktima sang natabo ang insidente.
english: Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, chief of Molo Police Station, said the suspect and the victim were both drunk when the incident occurred.

text: Suno kay Inot, samtang naga-inom ang suspek sa ila balay, nagpanuktok ang biktima sa ila gate agud magpangayo sang sumsuman.
english: According to Inot, while the suspect was drinking at their house, the victim knocked on their gate to ask for sumsuman.

text: Sang ginbuksan na ang gate, gintuyo nga atakihon sang biktima ang suspek.
english: When the gate was opened, the victim tried to attack the suspect.

text: Diri na kag ginluthang ini sang suspek sa ulo kag sa lawas gamit ang .45 caliber nga armas nga amo ang gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: The suspect shot her in the head and body with a .45 caliber pistol, which caused her death.

text: Boluntaryo naman nga nagsungka ang suspek sa mga pulis kag gin-surrender sini ang iya armas kag isa ka empty shell sang .45 caliber.
english: The suspect voluntarily surrendered to the police and surrendered his firearm and an empty shell of .45 caliber.

text: Sa subong, preso na ini sa Molo Police Station sa diin magapangatubang ini sang kaso nga paglapas sa gun ban sa idalom sang COMELEC Resolution No.
english: He is currently detained at the Molo Police Station where he will face charges of violating the gun ban under COMELEC Resolution No.

text: Naglab-ut sa P18.9 billion ang nakolekta sang Bureau of Customs halin sa rice imports sang tuig 2021.
english: The Bureau of Customs collected P18.9 billion from rice imports in 2021.

text: Ini ang 22 percent nga mas mataas kun ipaanggid sa P15.5 billion nga collection sang tuig 2020.
english: This is 22 percent higher compared to the P15.5 billion collection in 2020.

text: Suno kay Customs Commissioner Rey Leonardo Guerrero, ang import duties nga nakolekta sa rice imports ang nagakadto sa Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund (RCEF) sa idalom sang Rice Tariffication Law.
english: According to Customs Commissioner Rey Leonardo Guerrero, the import duties collected on rice imports go to the Rice Competitiveness Enhancement Fund (RCEF) under the Rice Tariffication Law.

text: Samtang, ang kabug-usan naman nga collection sa pork imports ang naglab-ut sa P3.75 billion halin sang Abril 2021 tubtub Enero 28, 2022.
english: Meanwhile, the total collection of pork imports reached P3.75 billion from April 2021 to January 28, 2022.

text: May mga reklamo na nga daan batok sa 33-anyos nga si Aljohn Jalbuna antes ini nag-ako nga siya ang nagsulod sa balay sa Barangay Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo kag nagpatay sa 18-anyos nga dalaga.
english: There were already complaints against 33-year-old Aljohn Jalbuna before he confessed that he entered a house in Barangay Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo and killed an 18-year-old girl.

text: Ini man ang rason kun ngaa nalakip ang iya pangalan sa pito ka persons of interest nga ginsundan sang Tubungan Municipal Police Station.
english: This is also the reason why his name was included in the seven persons of interest followed by the Tubungan Municipal Police Station.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Neil Eric Goniabo, deputy commander sang Tubungan PNP, iya ginpahayag nga madamo na sila sang may nabaton nga impormasyon tuhoy sa suspek kun sa diin nangin bantog ini siya nga nagapanulod-sulod sa mga pamalay sang mga pumuluyo sa nasambit nga lugar.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Lieutenant Neil Eric Goniabo, deputy commander of Tubungan PNP, said they have received a lot of information about the suspect where he has become famous for breaking into the houses of residents in the said area.

text: Gilayon nga ginpadulungan sang mga otoridad ang puluy-an sang suspek bangud sang impormasyon nga ila nabaton, upod ang bulig sang Punong Barangay nga si Leonardo Tamises.
english: The authorities immediately rushed to the suspect's house based on the information they received, with the help of Punong Barangay Leonardo Tamises.

text: Pag-abot sa lugar, nadiskubrehan sang mga pulis nga may madamo nga kinarusan ukon pilas sa liog ang suspek.
english: Upon arrival at the scene, police discovered that the suspect had multiple stab wounds to his neck.

text: Ginklaro ni Goniabo nga wala nagsungka ang suspek sa estasyon, kundi ini ang ginkadtuan sang kapulisan mismo sa iya balay agud madakop.
english: Goniabo clarified that the suspect did not surrender at the station, but the police went to his house to arrest him.

text: Wala naman ini nagbato pa kag nag-ako na sa iya nga ginhimo nga pagpatay sa dalaga.
english: He did not resist and confessed to the murder of the girl.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, gin-ako sang suspek nga ini siya ang naga-gamit sang iligal nga droga.
english: On the other hand, the suspect admitted that he is using illegal drugs.

text: Suno kay Jalbuna, duha na siya ka bulan nga naga-gamit sang droga kag ginbuyagyag man sini nga nagakuha sila sang suplay sa Villa kag Mandurriao area sa syudad sang Iloilo.
english: According to Jalbuna, he has been using drugs for two months and he also revealed that they get supplies from Villa and Mandurriao area in Iloilo City.

text: Gintuad sini nga antes niya ginsulod ang kwarto sang 18-anyos nga dalaga, nakagamit na ini sang shabu.
english: He admitted that before he entered the 18-year-old girl's room, she had already used shabu.

text: Hugot nga ginpanginwala sang suspek nga ginhimuslan sini ang dalaga kun sa diin tuyo niya lang kuntani nga kibuton ini.
english: The suspect denied raping the girl with the intention of raping her.

text: Maisog nga gin-kwestyon pinaagi sa sulat sang aktres nga si Angel Locsin ang gobyerno angot sa mga prayoridad subong nga may coronavirus pandemic.
english: Actress Angel Locsin has boldly questioned the government's priorities during the coronavirus pandemic.

text: Sa sulat sang aktres, iya ginpahayag nga kuntani may yara sang plano ang gobyerno sa mga mamumugon kag business owners nga nadulaan sang palangabuhian.
english: In the letter, the actress said that the government should have a plan for the workers and business owners who lost their livelihoods.

text: Suno kay Angel, madamo sang oras ang gobyerno nga kontrahon ang ABS-CBN, pag-ilis sang pangalan sang airport kag anti-terrorism bill apang ang kinahanglan mabatian sang tawo amo ang plano sang gobyerno sa pagpapas sa Coronavirus, palno sa mga frontliners, plano sa edukasyon para sa mga pigado nga wala sang access sa internet, balik-probinsya kag mga na stranded nga Overseas Filipino Workers sa iban nga pungsod.
english: According to Angel, the government has a lot of time to oppose ABS-CBN, changing the name of the airport and the anti-terrorism bill but what people need to hear is the government's plan to eradicate Coronavirus, plan for frontliners, education plan for the poor who do not have access to the internet, returnees and stranded Filipino Overseas Workers in other countries.

text: Sa katapusan sang sulat ni Angel, ginpakilala niya ang iya kaugalingon bilang taxpayer.
english: At the end of Angel’s letter, he introduces himself as the taxpayer.

text: Nahibaluan nga sang nag umpisa pa lang ang pandemya sa pungsod, nakit-an sang tanan nga mga Filipino ang pagka-aktibo ni Angel sa pagbulig sa mga naga-kinahanglan ilabi na ang paghatag sang kinahanglanon sang mga frontliners kag vulnerable sectors.
english: It is known that when the pandemic began in the country, all Filipinos saw Angel's activity in helping those in need especially in providing the needs of frontliners and vulnerable sectors.

text: Paga-updan sang superstar singer nga si Beyoncé si Democratic US presidential candidate Kamala Harris sa rally sa Houston, Texas subong nga adlaw.
english: Superstar singer Beyoncé will join Democratic US presidential candidate Kamala Harris at a rally in Houston, Texas today.

text: Isa ka majority Republican state ang Texas apang magakampanya diri ang vice president kaupod si Democratic Senate candidate Colin Allred kag natalana nga mangin topiko ang abortion rights.
english: Texas is a majority Republican state but the vice president will campaign here alongside Democratic Senate candidate Colin Allred and abortion rights are scheduled to be a topic.

text: Nahibaluan nga may yara sang layi nga gin-implementar sa Texas sang Septyembre 2021 nga naga-ban sang abortion matapos ang anum ka bulan kag ginatugutan man ang bisan sin-o nga kasuhan ang abortion patients kag ang mga nagabulig sa ila.
english: It is known that there is a law implemented in Texas in September 2021 that bans abortion after six months and also allows anyone to sue abortion patients and those who help them.

text: Santo sa reports, kaupod ni Beyonce — tumandok sang Houston — ang iya iloy nga si Tina Knowles kun magkadto na sa kampanya.
english: According to reports, Beyonce — a native of Houston — will be accompanied by her mother, Tina Knowles, when she goes to the campaign.

text: Antes sini, masami nga ginagamit ni Harris ang kanta sang celebrity nga “Freedom” bilang iya nga campaign rally song kag amo man ang ginpatukar sa national Convention sang Agusto.
english: Previously, Harris often used the celebrity song “Freedom” as his campaign rally song and was also played at the national convention in August.

text: Kilala man si Beyonce nga masami naga-endorso sa Democratic presidential candidates.
english: Beyonce is also known to often endorse Democratic presidential candidates.

text: Sang 2016, nag-perform siya kaupod ang iya bana nga si Jay-Z sa rally nga para kay Hillary Clinton.
english: In 2016, she performed with her husband Jay-Z at a rally for Hillary Clinton.

text: Ginsuportahan man sini ang Democratic candidates lakip sanday former President Barack Obama sang 2008 kag 2012, President Joe Biden sang 2020.
english: He also endorsed Democratic candidates including former President Barack Obama in 2008 and 2012, President Joe Biden in 2020.

text: Ang iban pa nga singers nga naga-suporta kay Harris amo sanday Taylor Swift, Bruce Springsteen, Eminem, Cher, Marc Anthony, Lizzo kag Neil Young.
english: Other singers backing Harris include Taylor Swift, Bruce Springsteen, Eminem, Cher, Marc Anthony, Lizzo and Neil Young.

text: Si former President Donald Trump naman ang nakabaton sang endorsements halin sa well-known personalities lakip sanday Tesla founder Elon Musk, former Indycar driver Danica Patrick, actor Jon Voight, celebrity chef Paula Deen, former NFL star Brett Favre, actor Kelsey Grammar kag singers Kid Rock kag Kanye West.
english: Former President Donald Trump has received endorsements from well-known personalities including Tesla founder Elon Musk, former Indycar driver Danica Patrick, actor Jon Voight, celebrity chef Paula Deen, former NFL star Brett Favre, actor Kelsey Grammar and singers Kid Rock and Kanye West.

text: Nagkampanya man subong nga adlaw si Trump sa Austin, Texas kag natalana nga magkadto sa Michigan nga isa ka battleground state.
english: Trump also campaigned today in Austin, Texas and is scheduled to travel to Michigan, a battleground state.

text: Nagpa-guwa sang statement si Uswag Ilonggo Partylist Rep.
english: Uswag Ilonggo Partylist Rep.

text: James “Jojo” Ang, Jr.
english: James “Jojo” Ang, Jr.

text: nga nagapabutyag sang suporta sa patas kag “transparent investigation” sa mga alegasyon sang kurapsyon sa flood control projects kag iban pa nga mga proyekto sang gobyerno.
english: expressing support for a fair and “transparent investigation” into allegations of corruption in flood control projects and other government projects.

text: Pahayag sini, deserved sang mga Pilipino nga mahibaluan kun ano ang kamatuoran.
english: He said Filipinos deserve to know the truth.

text: Sa iya statement, ginklaro man sini nga wala niya gin-invoke ang mga pangalan nanday Speaker Martin Romualdez, Rep.
english: In his statement, he also clarified that he did not invoke the names of Speaker Martin Romualdez, Rep.

text: Zaldy Co, ukon sin-o man nga public official.
english: Zaldy Co, or any public official.

text: Nagpaandam man ini nga magahimo sang legal action sa mga nag-fabricate kag nagpalapta sang gintawag sini nga “unfounded claims.” Gindugang sang kongresista nga maga-sabat siya sa mga alegasyon sa iya sa husto nga tion kag sa husto nga paagi.
english: It also warned of legal action against those who fabricated and spread what it called “unfounded claims.” The congressman added that he will respond to the allegations against him in a timely and appropriate manner.

text:
Yari ang statement:

“I fully support a transparent and impartial investigation of those alleged to have profited from flood control and other government projects.
english:
Here is the statement:

“I fully support a transparent and impartial investigation of those alleged to have profited from flood control and other government projects.

text: The Filipino people deserve nothing less than the truth.
english: The Filipino people deserve nothing less than the truth.

text: I have never invoked the name of Speaker Martin G. Romualdez, Representative Zaldy Co, or any public official.
english: I have never invoked the name of Speaker Martin G. Romualdez, Representative Zaldy Co, or any public official.

text: I will pursue every legal remedy available against those who fabricated and spread these unfounded claims.
english: I will pursue every legal remedy available against those who fabricated and spread these unfounded claims.

text: I owe it to our constituents not to be cowed by anyone seeking to obscure the truth.
english: I owe it to our constituents not to be cowed by anyone seeking to obscure the truth.

text:
I will respond to the allegations against me at the proper time, in the appropriate forum.”

Matandaan nga sang Senate hearing sang Lunes, isa si Ang sa mga miyembro sang Kongreso nga gin-angot sang mag-asawa nga sanday Sarah kag Curlee Discaya sa alleged kickbacks — bagay nga una na gintawag sang mamalidha nga wala sang basehan nga akusasyon.#
english:
I will respond to the allegations against me at the proper time, in the appropriate forum.”

During the Senate hearing on Monday, Ang was one of the members of Congress linked by Sarah and Curlee Discaya to the alleged kickbacks — something the lawmaker had earlier called baseless accusations.

text: Apektado man sang importation sang kalamay ang mga sugarcane famers sa pungsod.
english: Sugarcane famers in the country are also affected by the importation of sugarcane.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor, iya ginpahayag nga mataas ang presyo sag kalamay apang tuman naman kanubo ang baligyaanay sang tubo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo 3rd District Representative Lorenz Defensor said the price of sugarcane is high but the sale of sugarcane is very low.

text: Suno kay Defensor, kinahanglan nga pamati-an sang gobyerno ang panawagan sang mga mangunguma nga untaton na ang importation bangud man gakapatay sini ang aton nga local farmers.
english: According to Defensor, the government should listen to the call of farmers to stop importation because it is killing our local farmers.

text: Indi lang ang presyo sang tubo ang apektado, nahibalu-an nga lakip na ang humay sa may pinakanubo nga presyohanay.
english: Not only the price of sugarcane is affected, it is known that rice is also among the lowest prices.

text: Dako man nga bulig suno sa natungdan ang road to market roads sa mga barangay para sa mas maayo nga produksyon sang mga mangunguma
english: He said the road to market roads in the barangays are also a big help for better production of farmers.

text: Nagdagdag sang penalidad ang Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) sa 10 ka generation companies bangud sa paglapaw sa yearly maximum nga limit para sa pagluntad sang brownout.
english: The Energy Regulatory Commission (ERC) has added penalties to 10 generation companies for exceeding the yearly maximum limit for the occurrence of brownouts.

text: Kabug-usan nga P15.5 million ang multa.
english: The fine totaled P15.5 million.

text: Suno sa pahayag sang ERC, regular nga gina-monitor ang kag gina-review ang semanal nga reports kun masumite na sang gencos in compliance sa directive sang ERC.
english: According to the ERC, the weekly reports are regularly monitored and reviewed once submitted by the gencos in compliance with the ERC directive.

text: Kalabanan sa 10 ka generating units amo ang diesel plants; apat ang coal-fired power plants, samtang duha naman ang hydroelectric units.
english: Most of the 10 generating units are diesel plants; four are coal-fired power plants, while two are hydroelectric units.

text: Ginpahayag man sang ERC nga tatlo sa generating units ang nag-offline sa extended period sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: The ERC also said three of the generating units went offline for an extended period last year.

text: Subong nga tuig labi nga ginasigurado sang ERC nga uninterrupted ang power supply sa bilog nga pungsod sa tion sang summer, ilabi na bangud diri natuon ang kritikal nga election period.
english: This year, the ERC is further ensuring uninterrupted power supply throughout the country during the summer, especially since the critical election period is underway.

text: Nangin matchmaker ang actor kag host nga si Vic Sotto sa tunga sang iya anak nga si Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto kag Tarlac Mayor Donya Tesoro.
english: Actor and host Vic Sotto became a matchmaker between his son, Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto and Tarlac Mayor Donya Tesoro.

text: Ginpamangkot ni Vic si Mayor Donya kun bala may yara sang nagapangaluyag sa iya apang sabat sang alkalde, daw kaangay nga wala sang may naluyag sa iya bangud wala man sang may nagapangaluyag.
english: Vic asked Mayor Donya if anyone was in love with him but the mayor replied that no one was in love with him because no one was in love with him.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginkuha ni Vic ang iya telepono kag nagpakuno-kuno nga ka-istorya niya ang anak nga si Vico.
english: Vic immediately picked up his phone and pretended to be talking to his son Vico.

text: Nag-joke naman ang komedyante nga si Jose Manalo kay Mayor Donya nga dapat alkalde man ang mapamana sini.
english: Comedian Jose Manalo joked to Mayor Donya that she should marry a mayor.

text: Apang sa subong dugang pa ni Mayor Donya, indi pa niya prayoridad ang lovelife.
english: But for now, Mayor Donya said, lovelife is not his priority.

text: Sang tinalikdan nga Abril, ginsunlog man sang mga netizens sanday Vico kag Donya sa online world matapos napa-bilib sa kapasidad sang duha sa pag-dumala sa ila tagsa ka mga lugar.
english: Last April, netizens also criticized Vico and Donya in the online world after being impressed by the capacity of the two to manage their respective areas.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Arestado ang isa ka high value individual sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy bust operation sa Zone 2, Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – A high value individual was arrested in a drug buy bust operation conducted in Zone 2, Barangay Bakhaw, Mandurriao, Iloilo City.

text: Ini amo si alyas Soksok, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: This is alias Soksok, resident of the said place.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, pinuno sang Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit, iya ginpahayag nga nakabaton sila sang impormasyon nga madamo sang mga parokyano nga nagagwa sulod sa balay sang subject.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, head of the Iloilo City Drug Enforcement Unit, said they received information that many parishioners were going in and out of the subject's house.

text: Suno kay Inot, ang balay sang subject ang nahamtang mismo sa balay sang Barangay Kagawad.
english: According to Inot, the subject's house is located right in the house of the Barangay Kagawad.

text: Naglawig naman sang duha ka semana ang pag-monitor sang mga otoridad antes ini nadakpan.
english: It took two weeks for the authorities to monitor him before he was arrested.

text: Nakuha naman sa posisyon sini ang 50 grams sang ginapatihan shabu nga nagabalor sang masobra P300,000.
english: Recovered from his possession were 50 grams of suspected shabu worth more than P300,000.

text: Napreso naman ini sang tuig 2018 bangud sa paglapas sa Republic Act No.
english: He was jailed in 2018 for violating Republic Act No.

text: 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002 kag liwat naman ini nga napreso subong nga tuig sa kaangay nga kaso.
english: 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Drugs Act of 2002 and he was jailed again this year in the same case.

text: ILOILO CITY – Daw kaangay nga nakakita sang “closure” ang Filipino pole vaulter kag Olympian nga si EJ Obiena matapos nga gin-clear sang Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) ang iya pondo nga may Credit Notice nagikan sa Commission on Audit (COA).
english: ILOILO CITY – Filipino pole vaulter and Olympian EJ Obiena seems to have found closure after the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) cleared his funds with a Credit Notice from the Commission on Audit (COA).

text: Sa Facebook post ni Obiena, ginpakigbahin niya ang sulat nga iya nabaton sang Marso 31 nga nagapahayag nga base sa audit sang iya liquidation, nakita sang COA nga “in order” ang iya budget nga gingasto.
english: In a Facebook post, Obiena shared a letter he received on March 31 stating that based on the audit of his liquidation, the COA found his budget spent to be “in order”.

text: Ginpahayag man sa nasambit nga sulat nga ang COA ang wala sang may ginpagwa nga Notice of Suspension kag mangin Notice of Disallowance.
english: The letter also stated that the COA has not issued a Notice of Suspension and will be a Notice of Disallowance.

text: Suno kay Obiena, may yara na sila nga closure kag gusto niya nga magbalik na sa pagtutok sa iya ensayo bilang pagpanghanda sa pagtiglawas niya sa pungsod upod ang iya teammates sa Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA) kag mga opisyal sini.
english: Obiena said they have closure and he wants to return to focus on his training in preparation for representing the country with his teammates in the Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA) and its officials.

text: Target sang grupo nga 100% nga mag-focus sa nagahilapit nga SEA Games kag nagpangako nga himuon nila ang tanan agud nga matiglawas sang maayo ang pungsod.
english: The group targets to focus 100% on the upcoming SEA Games and promised to do everything to represent the country well.

text: Ang problema sa tunga ni Obiena kag sang PATAFA ang nag-ugat sang ginpatu-patuan ang atleta nga wala gingamit sang maayo ang budget nga para kun tani sa iya Ukrainian coach nga si Vitaly Petrov.
english: The problem between Obiena and PATAFA originated when the athlete was accused of misusing the budget that was supposed to be for his Ukrainian coach Vitaly Petrov.

text: Gilayon naman nga ginkumpleto ni Obiena ang iya liquidation papers samtang wala naman gin-endorso sang PATAFA si Obiena sa SEA Games kag subong man sa World Indoor Championships.
english: Obiena immediately completed his liquidation papers while PATAFA did not endorse Obiena for the SEA Games and World Indoor Championships.

text: Diri kag nagpatunga na ang PSC kag sang Marso 31, nahitso na sang duha ka kampo ang problema.
english: The PSC intervened and on March 31, the two camps resolved the problem.

text: Si Obiena ang reigning gold medalist sa SEA Games kag ika-anum sa world rankings.
english: Obiena is the reigning gold medalist at the SEA Games and sixth in the world rankings.

text: Nagpabutyag ang Office of the Vice President sang commitment sini sa transparent kag responsible nga paggamit sang travel budget sini para sa fiscal year 2025.
english: The Office of the Vice President expressed its commitment to the transparent and responsible use of its travel budget for fiscal year 2025.

text: As of July 31, 2025, ang OVP naggasto sang P20.68 million, ukon 33.1% sang P62.5 million allocation para sa domestic kag international travels.
english: As of July 31, 2025, the OVP spent P20.68 million, or 33.1% of the P62.5 million allocation for domestic and international travels.

text: Suno sa OVP, ang mga trips ni Vice President Sara Z. Duterte sa luwas sang pungsod sang damlag lang ang wala ginpondohan sang alokasyon para sa international travels.
english: According to the OVP, Vice President Sara Z. Duterte's recent foreign trips were not funded by the allocation for international travels.

text: Suno sa OVP, ini nga alokasyon ang ginagamit agud suportahan ang mga staff kag security personnel sini samtang ginatungan ang ila opisyal nga responsibilidad.
english: According to the OVP, this allocation is used to support its staff and security personnel while carrying out their official responsibilities.

text: Para sa domestic travel, ang gasto nagsakop sang official engagements sang e Vice President kalakip diri ang community visits, ceremonial functions, kag support services, amo man ang operasyon sang OVP personnel.
