english: For domestic travel, the expenditure covered the official engagements of the e Vice President including community visits, ceremonial functions, and support services, as well as the operation of OVP personnel.

text: Ang tanan nga gasto ang may nagakaigo nga dokumento kag nagasunod sa regulasyon sang gobyerno.
english: All expenses are properly documented and in compliance with government regulations.

text: Nagapati si Department of Public Works and Highways ukon DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon nga dako ang nabulig sang Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) sa pag-imbesitigar sang maanomaliya nga flood control projects sa pungsod.
english: Department of Public Works and Highways or DPWH Secretary Vince Dizon believes that the Independent Commission for Infrastructure (ICI) has been instrumental in investigating anomalous flood control projects in the country.

text: Suno kay Dizon nga nakabulig ang ICI sa pagkay-o sang mga ebidensya nga ginsumiter sa Ombudsman.
english: Dizon said the ICI helped prepare the evidence submitted to the Ombudsman.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-anunsyo kahapon, Marso 13, nga tapuson na ang operasyon sang amo nga komisyon subong nga Marso.
english: It was announced yesterday, March 13, that the operation of the commission will end this March.

text: Nahatag naman sang mga ini ang tanan nga dokumento sa Ombudsman.
english: They have submitted all the documents to the Ombudsman.

text: Madumduman nga gintukod ni President Bongbong Marcos ang ICI sang nagligad nga Setyembre 2025 agud nga imbestigaran ang mga gina-alegar nga korapsyon kag iregularidad sa mga flood control kag infrastructure projects sa Pilipinas.
english: It can be recalled that President Bongbong Marcos established the ICI last September 2025 to investigate alleged corruption and irregularities in flood control and infrastructure projects in the Philippines.

text: Agaw-atensyon ang isa ka idik sa Brgy.
english: Attention-grabbing idik in Brgy.

text: Pal-ew, Tanjay City, Negros Oriental bangud sa tumalagsahon nga itsura sini.
english: Pal-ew, Tanjay City, Negros Oriental because of its unusual appearance.

text: Suno sa uploader sang video nga si AJ Bantaya Cardinas, makit-an nga kaangay sang iya sang tawo ang nawong sang idik.
english: According to the uploader of the video, AJ Bantaya Cardinas, the idik's face looks like a human's.

text: Ginpahayag ni Cardinas nga indi ini ang una nga tion nga nagbun-ag ang ila nga ginasagod nga nayon.
english: Cardinas said this is not the first time that their pet goat has given birth.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno sa iya, nagbun-ag man ang nayon sadto sang idik ng may yara sang parte nga kaangay sang pakpak.
english: In fact, he said, the village also gave birth to a duck with a part like a wing.

text: Sa malain nga palad, napatay ini nga pinasahi nga idik.
english: Unfortunately, this special duck died.

text: Isinugod sa ospital ang Queen of All Media Kris Aquino upang sumailalim sa ilang pagsusuri matapos lumabas ang “alarming” na resulta ng kanyang blood panel.
english: Queen of All Media Kris Aquino was rushed to the hospital for further examination after her blood panel showed “alarming” results.

text: Sa isang post sa Instagram noong Agosto 19, ibinahagi ni Kris na siya ay nasa ospital kasama ang anak na si Bimby para tumanggap ng kanyang ikalawang dose ng gamot.
english: In an Instagram post on August 19, Kris shared that she was in the hospital with her daughter Bimby to receive her second dose of medicine.

text: Ayon kay Aquino, ang kanyang doctor ang nakakita ng kakaibang resulta ng kanyang blood test at agad siyang pinayuhan na sumailalim sa ultrasound at iba pang pagsusuri.
english: According to Aquino, her doctor saw the strange results of her blood test and immediately advised her to undergo an ultrasound and other tests.

text: Ipinaliwanag ng tatlong espesyalista na hindi dapat ipagpaliban ang mga ito dahil maaaring malagay sa panganib ang kanyang kalagayan.
english: The three specialists explained that these should not be postponed because they could put his condition at risk.

text: Matatandaan na si Kris ay may 11 autoimmune diseases at kasalukuyang umiinom ng matatapang na gamot tulad ng immunosuppressants, antihistamines, at iba pang vitamins.
english: Kris has 11 autoimmune diseases and is currently taking strong medications such as immunosuppressants, antihistamines, and other vitamins.

text: Mas pinili niyang magpagamot sa mga Pilipinong doktor kaysa gumamit ng gamot na hindi siya sigurado, lalo na’t allergic siya sa blood thinners.
english: He preferred to be treated by Filipino doctors rather than use medicines that he was not sure about, especially since he was allergic to blood thinners.

text: Humiling siya ng dasal mula sa publiko para sa kanyang patuloy na paggaling at pasasalamat sa kabutihang loob ng mga sumusuporta sa kanya.
english: He asked for prayers from the public for his continued recovery and thanked the generosity of his supporters.

text: Sa ngayon ay naninirahan siya sa compound ng kanyang pamilya sa Tarlac bilang bahagi ng kanyang anim na buwang preventive isolation.
english: He is currently staying at his family's compound in Tarlac as part of his six-month preventive isolation.

text: Gin-anunsyo ni Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr.
english: Agriculture Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr. announced.

text: nga ila pa palaparon ang programa nga P20 kada kilo nga bugas sang gobyerno sini nga tuig 2026.
english: that they will expand the government's P20 per kilo rice program this year 2026.

text: Kabahin ini sang plano sang gobyerno nga malab-ot ang 15 million ka mga kabalayan tubtob nga matapos ang tuig 2026.
english: This is part of the government’s plan to reach 15 million households by the end of 2026.

text: Nag-allocate na ang gobyerno sang P23 billion para sa subsidiya sang P20 rice program subong nga tuig 2026 kag ginatutukan ang mga sector nga nagakinahanglan gid sang bulig.
english: The government has already allocated P23 billion for the subsidy of the P20 rice program this year 2026 and is focusing on sectors that are in dire need of assistance.

text: Ginabulubanta nga maga-abot sa 780,000 ka mga kabalayan ukon indi magkulang sa 3.2 million ka mga Pilipino ang makabenipisyo sa sini nga programa sa bulan sang Enero tubtob Pebrero.
english: It is estimated that 780,000 households or at least 3.2 million Filipinos will benefit from this program from January to February.

text: Magapabilin ang limitasyon sa pagbakal sang bugas agud nga ma-manage sang maayo ang suplay.
english: The limit on rice purchases will remain in order to manage the supply.

text: Dugang pa sang tiglikom sang Department of Agriculture nga pahanugutan sa gihapon nga makabakal ang mga senior citizen tubtob sa 30 ka kilo sa kada bulan.
english: The secretary of the Department of Agriculture added that senior citizens will still be allowed to buy up to 30 kilos per month.

text: Samtang, 10 ka kilo naman ang sa iban pa nga banepisyaryo.
english: Meanwhile, 10 kilos were given to other beneficiaries.

text: Nakakumpiskar ang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) sang masobra P60M nga balor sang iligal nga druga sa una nga bulan sang tuig 2026.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) seized more than P60M worth of illegal drugs in the first month of 2026.

text: Ini matapos ang ginpatigayon nga 109 ka anti-drug operations kun sa diin 137 ka mga indibidwal ang na-aresto nga ginalakipan sang 56 ka mga high-value individual (HVIs) kag 81 naman nga street-level suspects.
english: This follows the conduct of 109 anti-drug operations where 137 individuals were arrested including 56 high-value individuals (HVIs) and 81 street-level suspects.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang pinakadamo nga confiscation amo ang naga balor P8.7M nga narekord sa Batad, Iloilo.
english: The highest number of confiscations was worth P8.7 million recorded in Batad, Iloilo.

text: Isa man ka dako nga operasyon amo ang pag-aresto sa incumbent Barangay Chairman sang San Dionisio kun sa diin narekober sa opisyal ang malapit P6.5M nga illegal drugs.
english: Another major operation was the arrest of the incumbent Barangay Chairman of San Dionisio where nearly P6.5M illegal drugs were recovered from the official.

text: Bangud diri, ginpahayag ni PRO 6 Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan nga padayunon nila nga pagatutukan ang supply and reduction program sa Western Visayas bilang isa sa mga pamaagi agud matapna ang illegal nga droga.
english: PRO 6 Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan said they will continue to focus on the supply and reduction program in Western Visayas as one of the ways to curb illegal drugs.

text: Suno pa kay Ligan, ginaplanohan man ang pagpahamtang sang nga operation center sa mga transit areas para malikawan ang pagsulod sang druga sa rehiyon.
english: Ligan said they are also planning to set up operation centers in transit areas to prevent drugs from entering the region.

text: May yara naman sang ginlunsyar nga narcotics detection dog course nga may ara sang 22 ka mga K9 dogs kag handlers nga ginpaidalom sa training agud nga makabulig man nga mas mapasangkad ang operasyon kontra sa illegal nga mga droga.
english: A narcotics detection dog course was also launched with 22 K9 dogs and handlers who underwent training to help expand the operation against illegal drugs.

text: Dugang pa niya nga pagatutukan man ang law enforcement operations kun sa diin igapaidalom sa mandatory drug test ang mga kapulisan agud masiguro nga wala sa ila ang may naga-gamit sang iligal nga droga.
english: He added that law enforcement operations will also be focused on where police officers will be subjected to mandatory drug tests to ensure that none of them are using illegal drugs.

text: Madumduman nga ginpaidalom sa drug test ang 110 ka mga hepe sa rehiyon sang Pebrero 3 kun sa diin naguwa ang resulta subong kag nakit-an nga negatibo ang mga ini.
english: It can be recalled that 110 chiefs in the region were subjected to drug tests on February 3 where the results came out today and they were found negative.

text: INDI katingalahan kon ngaa mapatupling sa ospital sang gobyerno ang aton kubos nga mga kautoran.
english: IT IS not surprising that our poor brothers and sisters are admitted to government hospitals.

text: Libre diri ang madamo nga serbisyo.
english: Many services are free here.

text: Libre man diri ang madamo nga mga bulong nga indi nila masarangan tanan baklon sa botika.
english: Many medicines that they cannot afford to buy at the pharmacy are also free.

text: Apang sa kalaba sang linya sang nagapa-konsulta diri, ang iban matatapan na lang sa masunod pa nga adlaw kag ginaantos na lang ang paghulat sa sunod nga adlaw tubtub masarangan niya antuson ang iya ginabatyag.
english: But with the long line of consultants here, some can only be treated the next day and suffer the wait for the next day until he can endure his feelings.

text: Malain pa kay kon palahero lang kamo nga kinahanglan dayon sang pagtatap basi gahingalo ka na bag-o makalab-ut sa unahan kay wala gid sing luyag magpaulihi.
english: Worse, if you're just a passenger who needs immediate attention, you might be breathing heavily before you get to the front because no one wants to be left behind.

text: Labi na gid kon senior citizen kag talabangan pa.
english: Especially if you're a senior citizen and you're a helper.

text: Gani ma-obligar ang mga himata mo nga dalhon ka sa pribado nga ospital kon diin, sa masami, may lugar pa sa iban nga mga pasyente.
english: So your relatives will be obliged to take you to a private hospital where, often, there is still room for other patients.

text: Ugaling kay pila man ka pilu ang balayran sang pasyente sa pribado nga ospital, nga indi lubos masabat sang PhilHealth kag mga discount para sa mga senior citizen, nga sa masami diutay man lang.
english: However, the patient's fees in private hospitals are several times higher, which is not fully covered by PhilHealth and discounts for senior citizens, which are often small.

text: Gani, makasiling ka na lang nga “Bahala na ang Diyos…Paligban ta na lang ugaling kon manugwa na.” Kag kon sin-o na lang ang imo mapalapitan nga makabulig.
english: Gani, makasiling ka na lang nga “Bahala na ang Diyos…Paligban ta na lang ugaling kon manugwa na.” Kag kon sin-o na lang ang imo mapalapitan nga makabulig.

text: Sanday mayor ayhan, si cong, si konsehal, si manong kag kon sin-o nga manang nga maka-desponer?
english: Maybe the mayor, cong, councillor, manong and whoever can dispose of it?

text: Kon wala gid, manimahon ka na gid lang sa ospital kay indi makagwa sa ospital ang imo pasyente tubtub nga makabayad.
english: If not, you will have to wait in the hospital because your patient will not be able to leave the hospital until he pays.

text: Ang iban gani ginapalagyuhan na lang ang ospital.
english: Some even run away from the hospital.

text: Malain pa kon bisan sa pribado nga ospital gasulobra man ang pasyente bisan dira sa ER, katulad sang nagahimugasa sadto ang mga pasyente sang Covid-19.
english: It's worse if even in private hospitals there are too many patients even in the ER, like when there were Covid-19 patients.

text: Malain pa gid kay samtang may mga bakante pa nga mga kwarto sa pasyente, indi na magamit ang mga ini tungod kulang ang mga nars kag doctor kay nagpaamulya na sa abroad.
english: Unfortunately, while there are still vacant rooms for patients, they cannot be used because there is a shortage of nurses and doctors who have already gone abroad.

text: Tani may exclusive nga waiting room nga serbe ER man sa mga ospital para sa mga senior citizen agud maakomodar sila dayon kag matagaan sing pauna nga tambal samtang nagahulat sa kon diin nga ward ukon kwarto makasulod.
english: I hope there is an exclusive waiting room that serves as an ER in hospitals for senior citizens so that they can be accommodated immediately and given preliminary treatment while waiting for which ward or room to enter.

text: Kon indi man paagi sa isa ka kasuguan, bisan na lang sa inisyatibo sang ospital nga may konsyensya.
english: If not by a law, at least on the conscientious initiative of the hospital.

text:
***

Gina-imbitar ang tanan nga alumni sang YMCA Rizal Youth Leadership Training Institute (RYLTI) sa isa ka Reconnection/Reunion sang grupo sa palaabuton nga Pebrero 15-17 sa Camp Higher Ground sa Barotac Viejo.
english:
***

All YMCA Rizal Youth Leadership Training Institute (RYLTI) alumni are invited to a group Reconnection/Reunion this coming February 15-17 at Camp Higher Ground in Barotac Viejo.

text: Sunu kay Fluellen Ortigas sang 6th Institute nga ginhiwat sa Cebu, at least 25 na ang naka-confirm sang ila pagtambong diri.
english: According to Fluellen Ortigas of the 6th Institute held in Cebu, at least 25 have already confirmed their attendance.

text: RYLTI alumnus ini siya sang Central Philippine University.
english: He is a RYLTI alumnus of Central Philippine University.

text: Kaupod ko si Flue sa 6th Institute sa Cebu kag isa man ako sa na-qualify sa pagsulod sa RYLTI halin sa University of Iloilo.
english: I was with Flue at the 6th Institute in Cebu and I was also one of those who qualified to enter RYLTI from the University of Iloilo.

text: Lakip sa nakabaton imbitasyon sa sining pagtililipon  si retired RTC 6 Judge Pepito Gellada (5th Institute) kag ang iya asawa nga  si Atty. Lorna Gellada (8th Institute).
english: Among those who received an invitation to the gathering were retired RTC 6 Judge Pepito Gellada (5th Institute) and his wife Atty. Lorna Gellada (8th Institute).

text: Si Pete ang una ng presidente sang RYLTI Alumni-Iloilo.
english: Pete was the first president of RYLTI Alumni-Iloilo.

text: Sa karon, ang holdover nga presidente diri amo si former Iloilo City Councilor Ed Penaredondo (7th Institute) tungod wala pa sang eleksyon nga natabo.
english: Currently, the holdover president here is former Iloilo City Councilor Ed Penaredondo (7th Institute) because no elections have been held.

text:
***

Gintukod sang YMCA Philippines ang month-long RYLTI sadtong 60s.
english:
***

The YMCA Philippines established the month-long RYLTI in the 60s.

text: Natawo ini “to restore honesty and integrity in public service” kay kinahanglan naton ang matarong nga “future leaders” sa gobyerno kag sa katilingban, sa kabug-usan.
english: It was born “to restore honesty and integrity in public service” because we need honest “future leaders” in government and society, in general.

text: Diri sa RYLTI ginatudlo ang mga “virtues of honesty, justice, excellence and love of country” sa ejempo ni Dr. Jose Rizal kag sang iban pa nga mga baganihan naton.
english: Here at RYLTI, the virtues of honesty, justice, excellence and love of country are taught in the example of Dr. Jose Rizal and other heroes of ours.

text: Gintukod ang RYLTI sang YMCA RYLTI Foundation sang 1961 sa ika-100 nga anibersaryo ni Dr. Jose Rizal.
english: RYLTI was established by the YMCA RYLTI Foundation in 1961 on the 100th anniversary of Dr. Jose Rizal.

text: Nagsugod hiwaton ang RYLTI sang 1962 sa Manila sa mga pili nga 15 university students diri.
english: RYLTI began in 1962 in Manila with selected 15 university students here.

text: Ang regular nga RYLTI ginhiwat sadtong 1963 sa Dapitan kon diin nagpuyo si Rizal in exile, nga gintambungan sang 89 ka mga “outstanding students” halin sa nagakalain-lain nga mga unibersidad kag kolehiyo sa pungsod.
english: The regular RYLTI was held in 1963 in Dapitan where Rizal lived in exile, attended by 89 outstanding students from various universities and colleges in the country.

text: Halin sadto ang tuigan nga RYLTI ginahiwat na sa nagakalain-lain nga historic places sa pungsod.
english: Since then, the annual RYLTI has been held at various historical places in the country.

text: Nauntat ang paghiwat sang RYLTI sa katung-anan sang 90s tungod sa financial crisis pagkatapos sang 29th batch sadtong 1995.
english: RYLTI was discontinued in the mid-90s due to the financial crisis after the 29th batch in 1995.

text: Gin-revive ang RYLTI sang 2007.
english: RYLTI was revived in 2007.

text: Kag nangin venue na ini sa pag-training sang mga kabataan agud mangin”transformational leaders” nga indi lang sang pungsod kundi sa bug-os nga global community.
english: And it has become a venue for training children to become “transformational leaders” not only of the country but of the entire global community.

text: Sa nag-gradwet sa RYLTI, madamo sa ila ang yara karon sa importante kag ginataha nga mga pwesto sa gobyerno kag kon diin pa sa sosyedad./PN
english: Of the graduates of RYLTI, many of them are now in important and respected positions in government and elsewhere in society./PN

text: Patay ang siyam ka indibidwal matapos ang maduguon nga mass shooting sa isa ka eskwelahan sa British Columbia sa Canada nga natabo sang Pebrero 10.
english: Nine individuals are dead after a bloody mass shooting at a school in British Columbia in Canada that took place on February 10th.

text: Ginkumpirmar sang Royal Canadian Mounted Police nga siyam ang napatay sa pagpangluthang, samtang ang suspek nga gunman nasapwan man nga patay na kag ginapatihan nga “self-inflicted” ang iya naangkon nga pilas.
english: The Royal Canadian Mounted Police confirmed that nine people were killed in the shooting, while the suspected gunman was also found dead and believed to have sustained self-inflicted wounds.

text: Anom ka bangkay sang mga biktima ang nakit-an sa sulod sang Tumbler Ridge Secondary School samtang duha naman ang narecover malapit sa isa ka residential property, kag isa ang napatay samtang ginadala sa ospital.
english: Six bodies of the victims were found inside Tumbler Ridge Secondary School while two were recovered near a residential property, and one died while being transported to the hospital.

text: Kasunod sang krimen, ginpasirado ang Tumbler Ridge Secondary School kag Tumbler Ridge Elementary School sa sulod sang isa ka semana.
english: Following the crime, Tumbler Ridge Secondary School and Tumbler Ridge Elementary School were closed for a week.

text: Nagpalab-ot naman sang pagpaki-unong ang British of Columbia sa mga pamilya sang biktima kag ginpasigurado ang bulig kag suporta sa mga apektado nga mga komunidad.
english: British Columbia extended its condolences to the families of the victims and assured assistance and support to the affected communities.

text: Nagbaylohanay sang matam-is nga mga tinaga ang magkahagugma nga sanday Andi Eigenmann kag Philmar Alipayo kadungan sang ila anniversary.
english: Andi Eigenmann and Philmar Alipayo exchanged sweet words on the occasion of their anniversary.

text: Sa instagram post sang aktres sa diin hakwat siya sang iya nga boyfriend, iya ginpahayag nga “best decision” sa iya kabuhi nga mangin boyfriend si Philmar.
english: In an Instagram post of the actress where she was picked up by her boyfriend, she said it was the “best decision” in her life to have Philmar as her boyfriend.

text: Nagpromisa naman si Philmar kay Andi nga iya palanggaon ang ila pamilya.
english: Philmar promised Andi that he would love their family.

text: Sanday Andi kag Philmar ang magkaupod nga naga-istar sa Siargao upod man ang ila anak nga si Lilo.
english: Andi and Philmar live together in Siargao with their daughter Lilo.

text: Magluwas kay Lilo, may yara man sang anak si Andi nga amo si Ellie sa iya ex-boyfriend nga si Jake Ejercito.
english: Besides Lilo, Andi also has a daughter, Ellie, with her ex-boyfriend Jake Ejercito.

text: Gintuad sang bugtong nga anak sang bangkay nga nasapwan sa Brgy.
english: The only son of the body found in Brgy.

text: San Antonio, San Enrique kahapon nga adlaw nga madugay na nga mentally unstable ang iya iloy.
english: San Antonio, San Enrique yesterday that his mother has been mentally unstable for a long time.

text: Ang biktima amo si Herra Torrecampo, 54-anyos, kag residente sang Brgy.
english: The victim was identified as Herra Torrecampo, 54, resident of Brgy.

text: Boulevard, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: Boulevard, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Jade Beaniza, 29-anyos nga anak sang biktima, iya ginpahayag nga sang dalaga pa ang iya iloy nagsugod nga nagkaproblema ini sa paminsaron bangud sa nangin live-in partner sini, tubtob sang nagka-edad ini nagapadayon ang iya medikasyon sa mental hospital.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Jade Beaniza, 29-year-old daughter of the victim, said that when her mother was a teenager, she began to have mental problems because of her live-in partner.

text: Pahayag sang natungdan, may bes nga ginaabot ini sang balatian apang sang Disyembre, nabungguan ini sang tricycle sang gindul-ong ang iya apo sa eskwelahan kag nakaagum ini sang injury sa tiil rason nga nagdesider nga indi na magbantay sa iya apo.
english: She said she sometimes gets sick but in December, she was hit by a tricycle while taking her grandson to school and sustained an injury to her leg so she decided not to look after her grandson.

text: Bulan sang Abril sang natukiban naman sang biktima nga nakagwa sa prisohan ang nagpatay sa iya utod kag nagligad ang tatlo ka adlaw, didto na kag naglala ang ginasuprer sini nga balatian.
english: In April, the victim discovered that the killer of his brother was released from jail and three days later, his illness worsened.

text: May maintenance man ang biktima suno sa natungdan apang indi ini sigurado kun gina inom.
english: The victim also has maintenance, he said, but he is not sure if he is drinking.

text: Kahapon nga adlaw, Hunyo 19 sang gab-i lang sini na kompirmar nga iya iloy ang bangkay nga nasapwan pinaagi sa tattoo sang biktima.
english: Yesterday, June 19, he confirmed that the body was found through the victim's tattoo.

text: Ginpabutyag man ni Beaniza nga luyag lang sini subong matapos proseso ang dokumento agud matigayon na nila dala pauli ang bangkay sang iya iloy sa Molo, Iloilo City.
english: Beaniza also expressed that she just wants the documents to be processed so that they can take her mother's body back to Molo, Iloilo City.

text: ILOILO CITY- Kompletuhon sang Department of Agriculture, paagi sa Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (DA-BFAR) ang construction sang 21 multi-species hatcheries kag aquaculture facilities sa una nga anom ka bulan sang tuig.
english: ILOILO CITY – The Department of Agriculture, through the Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (DA-BFAR), will complete the construction of 21 multi-species hatcheries and aquaculture facilities in the first six months of the year.

text: Sa statement, ginpahayag sang BFAR nga nakompleto na sini ang construction sang siyam ka legislated hatcheries sa idalom sang 22 ka Republic Acts nga napasar sang tion sang 16th tubtob 18th Congresses.
english: In a statement, the BFAR said it has completed the construction of nine legislated hatcheries under the 22 Republic Acts passed during the 16th to 18th Congresses.

text: Ginsiling sang ahensya nga may nabilin nga 21 hatcheries ang under construction kag natalana nga makompleto sa first half.
english: The agency said there are still 21 hatcheries under construction and scheduled to be completed in the first half.

text: Nagpain ang BFAR sang P635 million para sa construction sang 21 ka mga proyekto subong nga tuig.
english: The BFAR has allocated P635 million for the construction of 21 projects this year.

text: Ginpahayag man sang ahensya nga katuyuan sang programa nga mapadamo ang variety sang cultivable species sa pungsod, mag- promote sang species diversification, kag mag- provide sang venue para sa fisheries extension services.
english: The agency also said the program aims to increase the variety of cultivable species in the country, promote species diversification, and provide a venue for fisheries extension services.

text: Indi na makadumdom si former President Rodrigo Duterte sa mga hitabo, mga lugar, timing, kag mangin mga miyembro sang iya pamilya.
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte can no longer remember events, places, timing, and become members of his family.

text: Lakip ini sa ginpahayag sang iya abogado nga si Nicholas Kaufman sa International Criminal Court (ICC) kadungan sang iya request sa “indefinite adjournment” sa legal proceedings batok sa 80-anyos nga former chief executive.
english: This is among the statements made by his lawyer Nicholas Kaufman to the International Criminal Court (ICC) in conjunction with his request for an “indefinite adjournment” in the legal proceedings against the 80-year-old former chief executive.

text: Suno sa defense lawyer, kulang na sa kapasidad si Duterte nga ma-apply ang iya nga cognitive skills nga amo ang kinahanglanon kun magdepensa na ini sang iya kaugalingon sa korte.
english: According to the defense lawyer, Duterte lacks the capacity to apply his cognitive skills that are needed when he defends himself in court.

text: “In fact, he is not even able to process the reasons for his detention,” suno kay Kaufman.
english: “In fact, he is not even able to process the reasons for his detention,” according to Kaufman.

text: Bangud sini suno sa iya, indi lubos nga mahangpan ni Duterte ang sahi kag ang implikasyon sang proceedings nga gina-conduct batok sa iya.
english: Because of this, he said, Duterte does not fully understand the nature and implications of the proceedings being conducted against him.

text: “With his impaired memory and concomitant inability to retain new information or to recall events, places, timing or even members of his close family and defence team, Mr Duterte is unable to fully understand the nature and implications of the proceedings conducted against him,” pahayag sang abogado.
english: “With his impaired memory and concomitant inability to retain new information or to recall events, places, timing or even members of his close family and defense team, Mr Duterte is unable to fully understand the nature and implications of the proceedings conducted against him,” the lawyer said.

text: “His deficient memory also entails an inability to follow the litigation and to make informed decisions.
english: “His deficient memory also entails an inability to follow the litigation and to make informed decisions.

text: Consequently, and crucially, Mr Duterte is unable to contribute to his own defence, rendering his participation in the proceedings totally ineffective,” dugang niya.
english: Consequently, and crucially, Mr Duterte is unable to contribute to his own defence, rendering his participation in the proceedings totally ineffective,” he added.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Kaufman nga mahimo nga mangin “static” ukon mag-“deteriorate” pa ang ikaayong-lawas sang anay presidente bisan pa nga may yara sang medical ukon psychiatric intervention nga ginahimo.
english: Kaufman also said that the former president's health may become static or deteriorate even if there is medical or psychiatric intervention.

text: “[REDACTED] Mr Duterte’s pathology clearly suggests that “a trial and continued detention […] would also not serve the interests of justice”.
english: “[REDACTED] Mr Duterte’s pathology clearly suggests that “a trial and continued detention […] would also not serve the interests of justice”.

text: In these circumstances, the pursuit of legal proceedings against a [REDACTED] incapacitated individual must be terminated,” kabahin pa sang pahayag sini.
english: In these circumstances, the pursuit of legal proceedings against a [REDACTED] incapacitated individual must be terminated,” he said in a statement.

text: Septyembre 23 kuntani naka-schedule ang confirmation of charges hearing kay Duterte, apang gin-postpone ini sang ICC bangud sa rason sang defense team nga indi ini “fit” nga makaupod sa trial.
english: Duterte's confirmation of charges hearing was scheduled for September 23, but the ICC postponed it on the grounds that the defense team said he was not “fit” to attend the trial.

text: Wala pa sang ginsapubliko nga petsa kun san-o isaylo ang proceedings.
english: No date has been announced for when the proceedings will be moved.

text: Marso 11 siya sang gindakop diri sa Pilipinas sa gahum sang arrest warrant sang ICC bangud sang ginaalegar nga crimes against humanity nga iya nakomiter kadungan sang implementasyon ang maduguon kag kontrobersyal nga drug war.
english: He was arrested in the Philippines on March 11 under an ICC arrest warrant for alleged crimes against humanity committed during the implementation of the bloody and controversial drug war.

text: Sang amo man nga adlaw, gindala siya sa The Hague, Netherlands.
english: The same day, he was taken to The Hague, Netherlands.

text: May pending request ang defense team para sa iya nga interim release.#
english: The defense team has a pending request for his interim release.

text: 18 ka tawo ang patay sa Beirut, Lebanon matapos ang Israeli strike sa gwa sang pinakadako nga public hospital sa amo nga pungsod.
english: 18 people were killed in Beirut, Lebanon after an Israeli strike outside the country's largest public hospital.

text: Kalakip sa mga napatay amo ang apat ka kabataan, suno sa health ministry sang pungsod.
english: Among the dead were four children, according to the country's health ministry.

text: Ang strike sa Rafik Hariri University Hospital ang indi sa area nga sakop sang evacuation orders nga gin-isyu sang Israeli military.
english: The strike at Rafik Hariri University Hospital is not in the area covered by the evacuation orders issued by the Israeli military.

text: Ginpahayag nga antes ang strike, nagpaandam ang Israeli army sa pumuluyo nga magbiya sa pila ka locations sa southern Beirut apang wala nila namitlang ang Rafic Hariri University Hospital bilang isa sa mga targets.
english: Before the strike, the Israeli army reportedly warned residents to evacuate several locations in southern Beirut but did not mention Rafic Hariri University Hospital as one of the targets.

text: Patas na ang serye (2-2) matapos nga ginpierde sang Barangay Ginebra San Miguel ang Meralco Bolts, 95-84, sa Game 4 sang PBA Governors’ Cup Finals sa Smart Araneta Coliseum.
english: The series is tied (2-2) after Barangay Ginebra San Miguel defeated the Meralco Bolts, 95-84, in Game 4 of the PBA Governors' Cup Finals at the Smart Araneta Coliseum.

text: Ginpangunahan nanday Justin Brownlee kag Scottie Thompson ang kadalag-an sang Barangay Ginebra paagi sa pag-score sang 27 puntos kada isa.
english: Justin Brownlee and Scottie Thompson led Barangay Ginebra’s win by scoring 27 points each.

text: Nakadugang pa si Brownlee sang 18 rebounds kag seven assists.
english: Brownlee added 18 rebounds and seven assists.

text: Sanday LA Tenorio kag Chris Stanhardinger naman ang nagdugang sang 17 kag 11 markers.
english: LA Tenorio and Chris Stanhardinger added 17 and 11 markers respectively.

text: Antes pa man nag-umpisa ang Game 4, sa PBA Governor’s Cup individual awards, ginpangalanan si Brownlee bilang Best Import kag si Thompson bilang Best Player of the Conference.
english: Even before Game 4 began, at the PBA Governor’s Cup individual awards, Brownlee was named the Best Import and Thompson the Best Player of the Conference.

text: May tatlo ka adlaw nga break ang Meralco kag Ginebra antes ang sunod nga hampang.
english: Meralco and Ginebra have a three-day break before the next game.

text: Lauman ang Game 5 sang best-of-seven series sa Easter Sunday sa amo man gihapon nga venue.
english: Game 5 of the best-of-seven series is expected on Easter Sunday at the same venue.

text: Nakatipon sang P5 million si Miss Universe 2108 Catriona Magnayon Gray agud nga ibakal sang bugas sa mga pamilya sa Tondo Manila nga apektado man sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Miss Universe 2108 Catriona Magnayon Gray raised P5 million to buy rice for families in Tondo Manila who are also affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Sa instagram post sang beauty queen iya ginpahayag nga “No Work, No Rice”.
english: In an Instagram post, the beauty queen said, “No Work, No Rice”.

text: Gani bangud sa iya nga adbokasiya kaupod ang Young Focus Philippines, natigayon siya nga makahatag sang 100,000 ka kilo sang bugas sa mga pumuluyo sang Tondo.
english: Through his advocacy with Young Focus Philippines, he was able to distribute 100,000 kilos of rice to the people of Tondo.

text: Tuman naman ang pagpasalamat ni Catriona sa tanan nga nagbulig sa iya nga kampanya.
english: Catriona is very grateful to everyone who helped her campaign.

text: Nahibaluan nga gin-lunsyar ni Catriona sang Marso ang “No Work, No Rice” campaign nga may katuyu-an nga makahatag sang bugas sa mga residente sang Tondo, Manila.
english: Catriona launched the “No Work, No Rice” campaign in March with the aim of providing rice to the residents of Tondo, Manila.

text: Nagapanindugan ang chairman sang Committee on Agriculture sa Iloilo Provincial Board nga indi pa ini sang husto nga tion agud nga mag-import ang Pilipinas sang kalamay.
english: The chairman of the Committee on Agriculture in the Iloilo Provincial Board insists that this is not the right time for the Philippines to import sugarcane.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Iloilo Third District Board Member Matt Palabrica, iya ginpahayag nga milling season pa subong ukon tig-galaling sang tubo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Iloilo Third District Board Member Matt Palabrica said it is still milling season.

text: Kahapon, Pebrero 4, ginsapubliko sang Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) ang Sugar Order Number 3 nga maga-import ang Pilipinas sang 200,000 metric tons sang kalamay sa crop year 2021-2022.
english: Yesterday, February 4, the Sugar Regulatory Administration (SRA) made public Sugar Order Number 3 that the Philippines will import 200,000 metric tons of sugarcane in the crop year 2021-2022.

text: Apisar estable ang suplay sang pungsod, ginpahayag nga katuyuan sini nga ma-stabilize ang pagsaka sa presyo sang kalamay sa Pilipinas.
english: Although the country's supply is stable, it is said that the aim is to stabilize the rise in sugarcane prices in the Philippines.

text: Ginapahayag nag-umpisa saka ang presyo sang kalamay kag nakalab-ot sa record highs matapos nga naglaslas ang Bagyo Odette kag naigu pati ang sugar-producing regions kaangay sang Negros, Panay, kag Eastern Visayas.
english: The price of sugarcane reportedly started rising and reached record highs after Typhoon Odette hit sugar-producing regions such as Negros, Panay, and Eastern Visayas.

text: Suno kay Palabrica, kun madayon na ang importation, maganubo naman sa sini ang presyo sang kalamay kag maapektuhan gid ang mga sugar planters sa rehiyon.
english: According to Palabrica, if the importation continues, the price of sugarcane will decrease and sugar planters in the region will be severely affected.

text: Sa pagkamatuod suno kay Palabrica, nabatyagan na sang sugar associations ang pagnubo sang presyo subong.
english: In fact, Palabrica said, sugar associations have already felt the price drop.

text: “Alarming ni sa amon nga part nga nagpanaog ang presyo sang kalamay, kay buot silingon, madayon gid ang importation.
english: “It is alarming on our part that the price of sugarcane has gone down, because it means that the importation will continue.

text: Ano ni, dulaon na lang nila ang mga mangunguma sa pungsod Pilipinas?,” suno kay Palabrica.
english: What is this, they just eliminate the farmers in the Philippines?,” Palabrica said.

text: Nagapati man si Palabrica nga may ‘malisya’ kun ngaa nga ginduso nga patigayunon ang importation ukon may yara gid sang naga-benepisyo bangud sa transaksyon.
english: Palabrica also believes that there is 'malice' why the importation was proposed or that someone is benefiting from the transaction.

text: “May mga interesado gid nga maka-gain sa importation, kay nakita nila nga wala na sang exportation.” Nagpangayo man sang intervention si Palabrica sa gobyerno.
english: “There are those who are very interested in gaining from imports, because they see that there is no export.” Palabrica also sought government intervention.

text: Suno kay Palabrica, wala pa gani nakapatunga ang gobyerno sa problema sa pagsaka sa presyo sang abono, apang gindugangan pa gid sang importation.
english: According to Palabrica, the government has not even intervened in the problem of rising fertilizer prices, but has increased the importation.

text: “Gapangayo na kita sang intervention.
english: “We are asking for intervention.

text: Wala pa gani naka-intervene sa abono, manaog naman ang presyo sang kalamay kay may importation?
english: Even without intervening in fertilizer, will the price of sugarcane go down because there is import?

text: Mahapdi gid na katama,” suno kay Palabrica.
english: It's very painful,” Palabrica said.

text: Una diri, gin-anunsyo man sang gobyerno nga maga-import ang Pilipinas sang bugas, meet products, kag isda subong nga tuig.
english: Earlier, the government also announced that the Philippines will import rice, meat products, and fish this year.
