text: Gin-athag ni Senate President Pro Tempore kag Blue Ribbon Committee chair Panfilo Lacson nga wala naimbitar si former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) secretary Manuel Bonoan agud magtambong sa hearing sa flood control anomaly.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore and Blue Ribbon Committee chair Panfilo Lacson clarified that former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) secretary Manuel Bonoan was not invited to attend the hearing on the flood control anomaly.

text: Kasunod ini sang pag-angot ni Lacson kay Bonoan sa ginaalegar family business ni Bonoan nga naangot sa kontractor.
english: This follows Lacson's link to Bonoan in Bonoan's alleged family business linked to the contractor.

text: Suno kay Lacson explained, tutukan anay subong sang Senate panel amo ang contractors, pareho nanday Sarah kag Curlee Discaya, kag mga DPWH engineers.
english: Lacson explained that the Senate panel will focus on contractors, such as Sarah and Curlee Discaya, and DPWH engineers.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Lacson nga magapaidalom ng bilog nga staff sang Blue Ribbon Committee sang background check matapos nga gin-alegar nga isa ka employee ang naangot sa maanomaliya nga proyekto.
english: Lacson also said that the entire staff of the Blue Ribbon Committee will undergo a background check after an employee was allegedly involved in the anomalous project.

text: Nag-guwa sa report sang isa ka international marine conservation group nga ang mataas nga demand sang seafood sa Estados Unidos ang naga-resulta sa iligal nga pagpangisda sa lain-lain nga mga pungsod sa kalibutan lakip na sa Pilipinas.
english: A report by an international marine conservation group revealed that the high demand for seafood in the United States is resulting in illegal fishing in various countries around the world including the Philippines.

text: Suno sa grupo nga Oceana, naga-import ang US sang $2.4 billion ukon P122.8 billion nga balor sang seafood paagi sa illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing sang 2019.
english: According to the group Oceana, the US imported $2.4 billion or P122.8 billion worth of seafood through illegal, unreported and unregulated (IUU) fishing in 2019.

text: Ginpahayag sang Oceana nga resulta ini sang ginabanta 60 percent sang seafood products nga gina-import sang US nga indi covered sang Seafood Import Monitoring Program (SIMP), nga amo kuntani ang naga-require sang catch documentation kag traceability requirements para sa imports.
english: Oceana said this is a result of approximately 60 percent of the seafood products imported by the US are not covered by the Seafood Import Monitoring Program (SIMP), which would have required catch documentation and traceability requirements for imports.

text: Suno sa amo nga report, ang blue swimming crabs ukon alimasag halin sa Pilipinas ang accounted sa halos one-fourth sang kabug-usan nga IUU wild-caught products nga gina-import sa US sang 2019.
english: According to the report, blue swimming crabs from the Philippines accounted for nearly one-fourth of the total IUU wild-caught products imported into the US in 2019.

text: Sandig man ini sa data sang International Trade Commission.
english: This is also based on data from the International Trade Commission.

text: Ang Seafood fraud ang common sa blue swimming crab bangud mas barato ang crab nga gina-import sa Estados Unidos ipaanggid sa presyo sang crab nga didto mismo sa ila nga pungsod.
english: Seafood fraud is common in blue swimming crab because the crab imported from the United States is cheaper compared to the price of the crab in their own country.

text: Gin-cite sang Oceana ang banwa sang Concepcion sa Northern Iloilo nga amo ang main sources sang blue swimming crabs sa Pilipinas.
english: Oceana cited the town of Concepcion in Northern Iloilo as the main sources of blue swimming crabs in the Philippines.

text: Diri man nga banwa nahamtang ang isa sa duha ka crabs picking and processing plants sa northern Iloilo.
english: One of the two crabs picking and processing plants in northern Iloilo is located in this town.

text: Ginpahayag sang marine protection group nga ang iligal nga aktibidad sa Concepcion ang naga-contribute sa overexploitation sang blue swimming crab nga amo ang makabig pamahog sa palangabuhian kag food security sang mga Pilipino nga naga-depende lang sa pagpangisda.
english: The marine protection group said the illegal activity in Concepcion is contributing to the overexploitation of the blue swimming crab which is a threat to the livelihood and food security of Filipinos who depend solely on fishing.

text: Wala nagadali nga magpakasal ang young actress nga si Sofia Andres sa iya boyfriend nga si Daniel Miranda apisar nga ginkumpirma sini nga may yara na sila sang anak.
english: Young actress Sofia Andres is not in a hurry to marry her boyfriend Daniel Miranda despite him confirming that they already have a child.

text: Ginbun-ag ni Sofia ang iya baby girl nga si Zoe sang Nobyembre 24, 2019 sa Australia.
english: Sofia gave birth to her baby girl Zoe on November 24, 2019 in Australia.

text: Suno sa aktres, indi niya luyag nga may indi maayo nga matabo bangud lang sa pagdali-dali niya sa pagdesisyon.
english: The actress said she didn’t want anything bad to happen just because she made a hasty decision.

text: Luyag pa ni Sofia nga ma kilala nila ni Daniel ang isa kag isa.
english: Sofia still wants her and Daniel to get to know each other.

text: Apang ginasiguro man sang aktres nga sa kasal man sa gihapon ang padulongan sang ila nga relasyon.
english: But the actress also assures that their relationship will still lead to marriage.

text: Sa subong, luyag ni Sofia nga makatapos sang pag-eskwela ang iya 23-anyos nga boyfriend kag luyag man niya nga makabalik liwat sa showbiz.
english: In the meantime, Sofia wants her 23-year-old boyfriend to finish school and also wants to get back into showbiz again.

text: Pila ka semana na lang ang nabilin antes ang US presidential elections, nagbisita si anay President kag subong Republican presidential candidate Donald Trump sa isa ka popular nga fast food chain sa Pennsylvania bilang kabahin sang iya kampanya.
english: With just weeks to go before the US presidential elections, former President and current Republican presidential candidate Donald Trump visited a popular fast food chain in Pennsylvania as part of his campaign.

text: Nakit-an si Trump nga yara sa drive-thru kag nagkapot man mismo sa fryer samtang nga nagasabat sang mga pamangkot sang reporters.
english: Trump was seen in the drive-thru and holding on to the fryer while answering questions from reporters.

text: Bangud kadungan ini sa ika-60 nga kaadlawan sang iya kasumpong sa eleksyon nga si Vice President Kamala Harris, sarkastiko man sini nga ginpanginbulahan ang Democrat sa iya kaadlawan kag naglahog nga hatagan sang fries.
english: Since it coincided with the 60th birthday of his election opponent, Vice President Kamala Harris, he also sarcastically congratulated the Democrat on his birthday and offered to give him fries.

text: Ini nga campaign visit sa nasambit nga critical battleground state ang ginapahayag nga isa man ka tikang batok kay Harris bangud nakasugid anay ang vice president nga naka-trabaho siya sa isa sa branch sang amo nga fast-food chain.
english: The campaign visit to the critical battleground state is also said to be a move against Harris because the vice president had previously revealed that he worked in one of the branches of the fast-food chain.

text: Natabo ini sa Alameda, California sang summer sang 1983 sang estudyante pa lamang ini sa Howard University kag nakatrabaho ini sa register amo man sa french fry and ice cream machines.
english: It happened in Alameda, California in the summer of 1983 when he was still a student at Howard University and he got a job at the register as well as french fry and ice cream machines.

text: Ginbali ini ni Trump kag nagsiling nga nagabinutig si Harris sa iya eksperyensya para lang nga mapadayaw sa publiko ang iya working-class credibility.
english: Trump broke it down and said Harris was lying about her experience just to publicly impress her working-class credibility.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, ginselebrar naman ni Harris ang iya birthday sa duha ka simbahan sa Georgia bilang paagi sa pagpakig-angot sa Black voters paagi sa religious communities.
english: Harris, on the other hand, celebrated her birthday at two churches in Georgia as a way to connect with Black voters through religious communities.

text: Pareho subong nga ginatutukan sang duha ang battleground states samtang nagapamintana na ang eleksyon.
english: Both are now focusing on battleground states as the election approaches.

text: Indi gid mabaton ni Ferenie Tabanda ang brutal nga kamatayon sang iya manghod, rason sang iya nga kaakig sa nag-ako nga suspetsado nga si Aljohn Jalbuna.
english: Ferenie Tabanda cannot accept the brutal death of her brother, which is why she is angry with the confessed suspect, Aljohn Jalbuna.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ferenie, gin-ako niya nga gusto sini sakiton ang suspetsado agud mapautwas ang iya kaugot.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Ferenie admitted that he wanted to hurt the suspect to express his anger.

text: Ginpaandaman pa gid niya ang suspetsado nga dapat indi na ini makagwa kag dapat man ini maghanda sa mga posible nga konsekwensya sang iya ginhimo.
english: He also warned the suspect not to go out and to be prepared for the possible consequences of his actions.

text: “Hinulsulan gid sang iloy mo nga ginbata ka pa sang iloy mo,”mensahe ni Ferenie sa suspek.
english: “Your mother will regret that she gave birth to you,” Ferenie told the suspect.

text: Nagpasalamat naman si Ferenie sa madasig nga paghulag sang mga otoridad kag nadakpan gilayon ang suspetsado.
english: Ferenie thanked the authorities for their quick action and immediate arrest of the suspect.

text: Si Jalbuna ang nag-ako nga nagpatay sa 18-anyos nga si alyas Jeje sa sulod sang iya kwarto sa ila balay sa Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo.
english: Jalbuna confessed to killing 18-year-old alias Jeje inside his bedroom at his house in Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo.

text: Nagpa-idalom sa training sang Philippine National Police Aviation Security Group ang aktres nga si Beauty Gonzalez.
english: Actress Beauty Gonzalez underwent training by the Philippine National Police Aviation Security Group.

text: Suno kay Beauty, nadesisyonan niya sadto pa lang sang ginpa-idalom sa enhanced community quarantine ang Pilipinas nga magsulod sa Aviation sa tion nga mahimo na makaguwa.
english: According to Beauty, she decided when the Philippines was placed under enhanced community quarantine to enter aviation when she could leave.

text: Gani subong nga yara na sa General Community Quarantine ang Metro Manila, ginhatagan niya ini sang oportunidad agud nga makapa-idalom sa Special Operations Unit training sang PNP Aviation group.
english: So now that Metro Manila is under General Community Quarantine, he gave him the opportunity to undergo Special Operations Unit training of the PNP Aviation group.

text: Pahayag sang aktres, tuman ang iya pagpasalamat sang nabaton siya sa training bangud kwalipikado pa ang iya edad kag height.
english: The actress said she was very grateful when she was accepted into the training because she was still qualified for her age and height.

text: Importante nga i-check gid ang label kag rekisahon sang maayo ang mga Chistmas lights antes baklon kag i-dekorar sa sulod sang balay subong nga Christmas season.
english: It is important to check the label and search the Christmas lights carefully before buying and decorating the interior of the house this Christmas season.

text: Pahanumdom ini sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) sa mga taga-probinsya sang Iloilo agud nga malikawan ang sunog sa holidays kag malikawan man ang anuman nga problema sa kuryente.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) is reminding the residents of Iloilo province to avoid fires during the holidays and to avoid any electricity problems.

text: Suno kay DTI-Iloilo Director Felisa Judith Degala, ang mga Christmas lights nga pwede mabaligya sa merkado amo lamang ang may yara sang Product Standard (PS) mark kag Import Commodity Clearance (ICC) sticker — mga ebidensya nga ini ang safe kag may maayo nga kalidad.
english: According to DTI-Iloilo Director Felisa Judith Degala, the only Christmas lights that can be sold in the market are those with the Product Standard (PS) mark and Import Commodity Clearance (ICC) sticker — evidence that they are safe and of good quality.

text: Pwede man nga ma-verify sang customer kun genuine ukon indi ang PS kag ICC markings.
english: The customer can also verify whether the PS and ICC markings are genuine or not.

text: Pwede nga ma-download sang consumers sa ila nga Android phones ang ICC verification application halin sa Playstore kag amo ini ang magamit agud nga ma-scan ang QR code nga yara sa box sang Christmas lights.
english: Consumers can download the ICC verification application from the Playstore on their Android phones and use it to scan the QR code on the box of Christmas lights.

text: Kun ma-scan na ang QR Code, maga-guwa ang impormasyon may kaangtanan sa lights nga naga-match sa information sa box.
english: Once the QR Code is scanned, information about the lights will appear that matches the information on the box.

text: Kun pekeon sang mga manugbaligya ang pagsulundan sa PS kag ICC markings ukon ibaligya ang indi certified nga Christmas lights, pwede mapasaka ang kaso nga paglapas sa Deceptive Sales Act and Product Standards Law.
english: If vendors fake the PS and ICC markings or sell uncertified Christmas lights, they can be charged with violating the Deceptive Sales Act and Product Standards Law.

text: Duha subong ka mga menor de edad ang ginaimbestigaran sang otoridad sa natabo nga pagpanghimulos sa anom ka tuig nga bata nga babaye sa Bingawan, Iloilo.
english: Two minors are being investigated by the authorities for the rape of a six-year-old girl in Bingawan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lieutenant Stephen Girao, hepe sang Bingawan Municipal Police Station, natabo ang pagpanghimulos sa katubuhan sa barangay Alabidhan.
english: Police Lieutenant Stephen Girao, chief of Bingawan Municipal Police Station, said the incident took place in barangay Alabidhan.

text: Ang suspek amo ang 13-anyos nga solterito kag may upod ini nga isa pa gid ka solterito.
english: The suspect is a 13-year-old boy and was accompanied by another boy.

text: Ginpahayag nga samtang ginahimuslan sang suspek ang biktima, may upod ini nga 16-anyos nga lalaki nga nagakuha man sang video sa ginahimo sang solterito sa bata.
english: It was reported that while the suspect was raping the victim, she was accompanied by a 16-year-old boy who was also taking a video of what the boy was doing to the child.

text: Sa dugang nga pagpangusisa sang Bombo Radyo, madamo na sang malain nga record ang suspek sa eskwelahan kag sa pagkamatuod, gin-kickout na ini bangud sa pagka-agresibo sa iban nga estudyante.
english: According to Bombo Radyo, the suspect has a bad record at the school and in fact, he was kicked out for being aggressive to other students.

text: Samtang ang biktima naman ang may mga utod nga special child kag mangin ang iya ginikanan ang ginapahayag man nga may problema man sa paminsaron.
english: Meanwhile, the victim has siblings who are special children and even his parents are also said to have mental problems.

text: Yara na subong sa paghinakop sang Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office kag Women and Children Protection Desk ang bata kag ang ginatudlo nga suspek.
english: The child and the alleged suspect are now in the custody of the Municipal Social Welfare and Development Office and Women and Children Protection Desk.

text: MANILA– Proud ang aktres nga si Arci Muñoz nga ginpakita ang iya pagpakigbahin sa Basic Citizen Military Training sa idalom sang Philippine Air Force.
english: MANILA – Actress Arci Muñoz is proud to show her participation in the Basic Citizen Military Training under the Philippine Air Force.

text: Sa iya social media post, ginpakita ni Arci ang laragway sa una nga adlaw sang training bilang isa ka reservist.
english: In her social media post, Arci showed a picture of her first day of training as a reservist.

text: Suno kay Arci, siya ang labing una nga babayi nga artista sa iya henerasyon nga nagpaidalom sa nasambit nga training.
english: According to Arci, she is the first female artist of her generation to undergo the training.

text: Dugang pa sang 31 anyos nga aktres, gina-engganyo man niya ang iban pa nga kababainhan nga magpa-enlist bilang reservist.
english: The 31-year-old actress added that she also encourages other women to enlist as reservists.

text: Nagpasalamat man ang natungdan sa Philippine Air Force sa kahigayunan nga ginhatag sa iya.
english: He also thanked the Philippine Air Force for the opportunity given to him.

text: Bastante ang suplay sang Noche Buena items sa probinsya sang Iloilo para sa holiday season.
english: There is enough supply of Noche Buena items in Iloilo province for the holiday season.

text: Sandig sa monitoring sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) kag sa pasalig sang retailers and supermarkets , makalab-ot pa pati sa Enero ang mga suplay sa probinsya.
english: According to the monitoring of the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) and the assurance of retailers and supermarkets, the supplies in the province will reach even in January.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay DTI Iloilo provincial director Felisa Judith Degala, iya ginpahayag nga domestic ukon locally-produced ang kalabanan sa mga produkto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, DTI Iloilo provincial director Felisa Judith Degala said most of the products are domestic or locally-produced.

text: Ginpasigurado man sang DTI nga nagasunod ang mga balaligyaan sa suggested retail price (SRP) nga ginpaguwa sang DTI sang Nobyembre 26.
english: The DTI also ensured that the shops comply with the suggested retail price (SRP) issued by the DTI on November 26.

text: Ang SRP guide ang ginalakipan sang mga produkto kaangay sang ham, keso de bola, cheese, sandwich spread, mayonnaise, pasta—spaghetti noodles, elbow kag salad macaroni— spaghetti sauce, tomato sauce, kag all-purpose cream.
english: The SRP guide covers products such as ham, keso de bola, cheese, sandwich spread, mayonnaise, pasta—spaghetti noodles, elbow and salad macaroni— spaghetti sauce, tomato sauce, and all-purpose cream.

text: Una na nga nag-isyu sang panawagan ang DTI nga indi pagpataasan ang presyo sang mga nasambit nga produkto subong nga Christmas season.##
english: Earlier, the DTI issued an appeal not to increase the prices of these products this Christmas season.##

text: Isa ang Panay-Guimaras-Negros Bridge project sa apektado sang pag-untat sang South Korea sang funding support sa mga bridge projects sa Pilipinas.
english: The Panay-Guimaras-Negros Bridge project is one of those affected by South Korea's suspension of funding support for bridge projects in the Philippines.

text: Kasunod ini sang mando  ni South Korean President Lee Jae-myung sang madasig nga pagpauntat sang 700 billion Korean won ukon kapin P28.7 billion loan support nga ginahatag sang ila gobyerno para sa mga ginatukod ng mga taytay sa Pilipinas kasunod sang paglupok sang isyu sa korapsyon.
english: This follows South Korean President Lee Jae-myung's order to immediately suspend the 700 billion Korean won or more than P28.7 billion loan support provided by his government for the construction of bridges in the Philippines following the outbreak of corruption issues.

text: Nahibaluan nga maga-provide kuntani ang South Korea sang kapin $1 billon para sa pagpatukod sang una nga segment sang proyekto nga amo ang 13 kilometros nga kalabaon sang taytay nga magakonekta sang Panay kag Guimaras.
english: South Korea was supposed to provide more than $1 billion for the construction of the first segment of the project, a 13-kilometer bridge that will connect Panay and Guimaras.

text: May yara man sang $56.6 million nga utang ang Pilipinas halin sa Korean Export-Import Bank para sa engineering nga ginalakipan sang desinyo kag assistance para sa procurement sang kabilugan nga proyekto nga nagalaba sang 32.47 kilometros.
english: The Philippines also has a $56.6 million loan from the Korean Export-Import Bank for engineering that includes design and assistance for procurement of the overall 32.47-kilometer project.

text: Gin-ako sang suspek sa pagpatay sa dalaga sa Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo nga ‘balong’ siya sang ginhimo ang krimen.
english: The suspect in the murder of the girl in Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo admitted that he was a 'balong' when he committed the crime.

text: Ang suspek amo si Aljohn Jalbuna, 33-anyos, residente man sang amo nga barangay samtang ang biktima amo ang 18-anyos nga si alyas Jeje.
english: The suspect was identified as Aljohn Jalbuna, 33, also a resident of the same barangay while the victim was identified as 18-year-old alias Jeje.

text: Suno kay Jalbuna, antes natabo ang pagsulod niya sa kwarto sang biktima, nakainom ini sang makahulubog nga ilimnon.
english: According to Jalbuna, before he entered the victim's room, he was under the influence of alcohol.

text: Pahayag niya, pasado las-dos sang kaagahon sang nagsulod siya sa kwarto sang biktima.
english: He said he entered the victim's room around 2:00 am.

text: MANILA– Gindepensahan sang aktres nga si Alessandra De Rossi si Heart Evangelista gikan sa mga bashers sini sa social media.
english: MANILA – Actress Alessandra De Rossi defended Heart Evangelista from her bashers on social media.

text: Suno kay Alessandra, sa subong nga panahon nga madamo sang bashers, padamo-damo nalang sang hinimuan.
english: According to Alessandra, in today's time when there are many bashers, there are many things to do.

text: Pahayag pa niya, kuntani, untatan nalang sang mga bashers ang ila ginhimo nga pagbash kay Heart kag sa baylo, magpangita nalang sa sang pamaagi, agud makabulig sa mga pumuluyo sining tion sang pandemya.
english: He said he hopes that the bashers will stop bashing Heart and instead, find a way to help the people during this time of pandemic.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakaangkon sang kritisismo si Heart bangud wala nagustuhan sang mga netizens ang fashion sense sini, nga pagsuksok sang fashion personal protective equipment nga gindisenyo mismo sang clothing brand nga iya gina-endorso.
english: Heart received criticism because netizens did not like her fashion sense, wearing fashion personal protective equipment designed by the clothing brand she endorses.

text: Gin-engganyo sang Department of Justice ang mag-asawa nga Curlee kag Sarah Discaya nga ila ibalik ang ano man nga nakuha nga kwarta halin sa maanomaliya nga ‘flood control projects’.
english: The Department of Justice has urged Curlee and Sarah Discaya to return any money obtained from the anomalous flood control projects.

text: Suno kay Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin ‘Boying’ Remulla, ini nga tikang ang una nga kondisyon para makunsiderar bilang ‘state witness’ kaangot sa kontrobersiya.
english: According to Justice Secretary Jesus Crispin 'Boying' Remulla, this step is the first condition to be considered as a 'state witness' in connection with the controversy.

text: Matandaan nga ginhingyo sang mga ini nga ipaidalom sila sa ‘witness protection program’ sa tunga sang ginapatigayon nga imbestigasyon.
english: They requested to be placed under the witness protection program amid the ongoing investigation.

text: Sa subong, suno kay Remulla, wala pa niya naistorya ang mag-asawa nga Discaya.
english: So far, Remulla said, he has not spoken to the Discaya couple.

text: Nagmandu ang National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) sa mga nagapanguna nga telecommunication networks sa pungsod nga paandaman ang ila mga subscribers batok sa mga scam messages nga nagatanyag sang peke nga mga trabaho.
english: The National Telecommunications Commission (NTC) has directed the country’s top telecommunications networks to warn their subscribers against scam messages offering fake jobs.

text: Sa ginpagwa nga memo sang NTC, ginhingyo man sa mga kumpaniya nga magsumite sang ila compliance report sa Office of the Commissioner on or before December 14.
english: In a memo issued by the NTC, companies were also asked to submit their compliance reports to the Office of the Commissioner on or before December 14.

text: Una diri, ginbuyagyag ni National Privacy Commission (NPC) commissioner Mon Liboro nga may yara sang “organized global syndicate” nga naga-operate sa likod sang pag-data sang scam text messages.
english: Earlier, National Privacy Commission (NPC) commissioner Mon Liboro revealed that there is an “organized global syndicate” operating behind the dating of scam text messages.

text: Subong nga adlaw sang Myerkules, makigsapol man si Liboro sa telco networks agud diskusyunan ang amo nga isyu.
english: On Wednesday, Liboro will also meet with telco networks to discuss the issue.

text: Una naman nga nag-apelar si Senator Joel Villanueva sa NPC kag NTC nga tapnaon na ini nga schemes, bangud nagakaintuan ang ila nga mga subscribers nga nagahatag man sang ila nga personal data.
english: Earlier, Senator Joel Villanueva appealed to the NPC and NTC to stop these schemes, as their subscribers are also giving away their personal data.

text: Gin-suspend ang lima ka airport police nga suspek sa extortion scheme sa mga taxi drivers sa NAIA.
english: Five airport police suspects in extortion scheme against taxi drivers in NAIA have been suspended.

text: Ini ang ginkumpirma ni Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Vince Dizon.
english: This was confirmed by Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Vince Dizon.

text: Ginmando ni Dizon sa Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) nga imbestigahan ini.
english: Dizon ordered the Manila International Airport Authority (MIAA) to investigate the matter.

text: Suno sa iya, matapos ang suspension, may immediate proceedings na para sa termination.
english: He said that after the suspension, there will be immediate proceedings for termination.

text: Matandaan nga isa ka taxi driver ang nagreklamo sang sobra nga pagpabayad sa ila kun sa diin gin-alegar sini nga nagakapilitan sila nga ihatag ang 40 porsyento sang ila kita sa airport police.
english: It can be recalled that a taxi driver complained of being overcharged where he alleged that they are forced to give 40 percent of their income to the airport police.

text: Suno sa driver, kon mapaslawan sila maghatag, gina-harasss ang mga ini kag wala ginatugutan nga makasulod sa NAIA.
english: According to the driver, if they fail to deliver, they are harassed and not allowed to enter the NAIA.

text: Isa sa ginabantayan nga hampang sa World Cup 2022 sa Qatar amo ang pag-atubangay sang Estados Unidos kag Iran, duha ka pungsod nga may masobra 40 ka tuig nga may malas-ay nga relasyon.
english: One of the most closely watched matches at the 2022 World Cup in Qatar will be the clash between the United States and Iran, two countries that have had an ugly relationship for more than 40 years.

text: Pareho nga yara sa Group B ang duha ka nasambit nga pungsod.
english: Both countries are in Group B.

text: Sa pagkit-anay sang duha ka team sa soccer field, ginpromisa sang ila tagsa ka coaches nga ipahigad anay ang away — kaangay sang diplomatic kag military confrontation — kag magtutok anay sa tournament.
english: When the two teams met on the soccer field, their respective coaches promised to put the fight aside — like a diplomatic and military confrontation — and focus on the tournament.

text: Nahibaluan nga gina-akusaran sang Estados Unidos ang Iran nga amo ang nagasuporta sang mga pagpang-atake sa Middle East, lakip na sa U.S. forces sa Iraq kag Syria.
english: It is noted that the United States accuses Iran of supporting attacks in the Middle East, including on U.S. forces in Iraq and Syria.

text: Sang 2020, diutayan lang nga magsulod sa gyera ang duha ka pungsod matapos nga ginpatay sang US ang pinakamataas nga Iranian general kag nagbalos naman ang Tehran sang missile strikes sa U.S. forces sa Iraq.
english: In 2020, the two countries almost went to war after the US killed a top Iranian general and Tehran retaliated with missile strikes on U.S. forces in Iraq.

text: Sa ila nga pag-atubangay sa Qatar na Nobyembre, 2022, kaupod nila sa Group B ang England kag ang winners sa European playoff — ang Ukraine, Scotland ukon Wales.
english: When they meet in Qatar in November, 2022, they will be in Group B with England and the winners of the European playoff — Ukraine, Scotland or Wales.

text: Gin-athag sang Land Bank of the Philippines nga ang ATM cards nga ila gina-issue sa mga registrants sang National ID ang indi preloaded sang government subsidy ukon ayuda.
english: The Land Bank of the Philippines clarified that the ATM cards they issue to National ID registrants are not preloaded with government subsidies or assistance.

text: Ang ini nga clarification sang LANDBANK ang kasunod sang pagdumdom sang publiko nga may yara sang financial assistance sa Philippine Identification System (PhilSys) registration centers bangud sa naglapta nga sala nga impormasyon online.
english: This clarification of LANDBANK follows the public's reminder that there is financial assistance at Philippine Identification System (PhilSys) registration centers due to the spread of false information online.

text: Suno sa government-owned bank, gina-issue ang ATM cards sa mga tawo nga nakarehistro sa PhilSys ID nga wala pa sang bank account.
english: According to the government-owned bank, the ATM cards are issued to people registered with the PhilSys ID who do not yet have a bank account.

text: Ini nga LANDBANK cards ang free kag wala sang gina-require nga initial deposit.
english: These LANDBANK cards are free and require no initial deposit.

text: Nagpagwa sang ebidensya si Senate President Pro Tempore Ping Lacson batok sa isa ka opisyal sang Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) nga ginaalegar nga nagtanyag sang early budget insertions para sa 2026 National Expenditure Program (NEP).
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Ping Lacson has released evidence against a Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) official who allegedly offered early budget insertions for the 2026 National Expenditure Program (NEP).

text: Sa iya nga privilege speech, ginpakita ni Lacson ang screenshot sang isa ka mensahe gikan kay DPWH Undersecretary Ma.
english: In his privilege speech, Lacson showed a screenshot of a message from DPWH Undersecretary Ma.

text: Catalina Cabral nga ginpadala kay Senate President Vicente Sotto III pila ka adlaw matapos ini ng magdaug sa senatorial elections sang Mayo.
english: Catalina Cabral sent to Senate President Vicente Sotto III a few days after he won the senatorial elections in May.

text: Suno kay Lacson, ang mensahe ang nagatuyo nga mangayo sang mga proyekto nga mahimo nga malakip sa National Expenditure Program, apang namalibad si Sotto.
english: According to Lacson, the message was intended to ask for projects that could be included in the National Expenditure Program, but Sotto refused.

text: Base sa screenshot, ginpamangkot ni Cabral kun may priority projects si Sotto para sa “vetting” agud malikawan ang redundancy, overlap, kag masiguro nga nagasanto sa national priorities kag local project menu.
english: Based on the screenshot, Cabral asked if Sotto has priority projects for vetting to avoid redundancy, overlap, and ensure that they are in line with national priorities and local project menu.

text: Ginsiling ni Lacson nga ginpagwa niya ang ebidensya matapos ginpanginwala ni Cabral sa bag-o nga tiglikom sang DPWH nga si Vince Dizon ang iya nga papel sa isyu.
english: Lacson said he released the evidence after Cabral denied to new DPWH secretary Vince Dizon his role in the issue.

text: ILOILO CITY – Pila lamang sa mga authentic Filipino dish nga ginakalangkagan sang kadam-an amo ang Binagoongang Baboy kag Sizzling Tofu.
english: ILOILO CITY – Binagoongang Baboy and Sizzling Tofu are just some of the authentic Filipino dishes that many people are looking forward to.

text: Sa Good Morning Philippines program, ginpatpat ni Dina Constantino, chief cook sang Jo’s Chicken Inato sa Plazuela de iloilo, ang pagluto sang nasambit nga mga putahe nga sampat sa sabor nga ginapangita sang mga Filipino kag bisan sang mga dumuluong.
english: In the Good Morning Philippines program, Dina Constantino, chief cook of Jo's Chicken Inato in Plazuela de Iloilo, explained how to cook these dishes that are delicious to the taste that Filipinos and even foreigners are looking for.

text: Para sa Binagoongang Baboy, lakip sa ingredients amo ang oil, baboy, ahos, bombay, kamatis, ginamos kag hot pepper.
english: For Binagoongang Baboy, among the ingredients are oil, pork, garlic, bombay, tomato, ginamos and hot pepper.

text: Una nga step amo ang pagpa-init sang mantika sa kalaha antes ibutang ang karne sang baboy nga ginhiwa kasubong sang cube.
english: The first step is to heat the oil in a pan before adding the pork cut into cubes.

text: Masunod nga ibutang ang gintuktok nga ahos, bombay kag ilakip ang ginamos kag gisahon tubtub nga maluto.
english: Next add the crushed garlic, bombay and add the rice and sauté until cooked.

text: Kun luto na, mahimo na nga ibutang bilang toppings ang hot pepper kag ready to serve na ang Binagoongang Baboy.
english: Once cooked, the hot pepper can be added as toppings and the Binagoongang Baboy is ready to serve.

text: Samtang para naman sa Sizzling Tofu, lakip sa ingredients amo ang mantika, tofu, bell peppers, ahos, bombay, mayonnaise, sauce, butter, kalamay, calamansi kag tubig.
english: Meanwhile, for Sizzling Tofu, the ingredients include oil, tofu, bell peppers, garlic, bombay, mayonnaise, sauce, butter, sugarcane, calamansi and water.

text: Suno kay Constantino, pritohon ang ginhiwa nga tofu gamit ang mantika sa sulod sang lima ka minutos tubtub nga malab-ot ang golden brown nga color.
english: According to Constantino, fry the sliced ​​tofu with oil for five minutes until it reaches a golden brown color.

text: Kun luto na ang tofu, mahimo na ini nga bak-iton kag isunod sa pagluto ang sauce paagi sa pag-mix sang bell peppers, ahos, bombay, mayonnaise, sauce, butter, kalamay, calamansi kag tubig.
english: Once the tofu is cooked, it can be baked and then cooked with the sauce by mixing bell peppers, garlic, bombay, mayonnaise, sauce, butter, sugar, calamansi and water.

text: Kun maglapuyot na ang mayonnaise, mahimo na nga isimpon ang ginprito nga tofu, i-mix tubtub nga maluto sang maayo.
english: When the mayonnaise has thickened, you can add the fried tofu, mix until well cooked.

text: Agud nga mas maka-engganyo, mas maayo nga ang niluto ang ibutang sa sizzling plate.
english: To make it more enticing, it is better to put the cooked on a sizzling plate.

text: Ginkumpirma ni BOC Commissioner Arnel Nepomuceno nga yara subong sa kustodiya nila ang 28 nga luxury cars kag duwa ka ATV/UTV sang mag-asawa nga Discaya.
english: BOC Commissioner Arnel Nepomuceno confirmed that 28 luxury cars and two ATVs/UTVs of the Discaya couple are now in their custody.

text: Pila sa mga ini ang wala sang import entry documents kag proof of payments gani padayon nila ini nga gina- verify.
english: Some of them do not have import entry documents and proof of payments so they are continuing to verify it.

text: Gintumod man ang nangin port of entry sang mga salakyan.
english: The port of entry for vehicles was also identified.

text: Pila sa mga ini amo ang Batangas, Cebu, Port of Manila kag MICP.
english: Some of these are Batangas, Cebu, Port of Manila and MICP.

text: Kritikal subong ang kahimtangan sang isa ka 84-anyos nga lola matapos nga ginbubuan ini sang gasolina kag ginsindihan sang iya umagad nga lalaki sa Carcar, Cebu.
english: An 84-year-old woman is in critical condition after her son-in-law poured gasoline on her and set her on fire in Carcar, Cebu.

text: Sa imbestigasyon, ginsiling nga nagapanglaba ang tigulang sang natabo ang insidente.
english: According to the investigation, the elderly man was doing laundry when the incident occurred.

text: Ginpahayag nga ginpakuhaan pa sang video sang suspek sa iya 11-anyos nga bata ang ginhimo sa tigulang.
english: The suspect reportedly had his 11-year-old son take a video of what he did to the elderly man.

text: Nag-angkon sang third degree burn ang lola.
english: The grandmother suffered third degree burns.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga hubog ang suspek.
english: Investigation revealed that the suspect was drunk.

text: Ginaalegar nga may madugay na nga indi paghangpanay sa tunga sang suspek kag biktima.
english: It is alleged that there was a long-standing misunderstanding between the suspect and the victim.

text: Nadakpan naman ang suspek kag magapangatubang sang panumbungon nga frustrated murder.
english: The suspect was arrested and will face charges of frustrated murder.

text: Nadesisyunan sang Miss Universe Philippines Organization nga halinon ang pagpatigayon sang ika-labing una nga coronation night sang Miss Universe Philippines sa Oktubre 25, 2020 sa baylo nga sa Hunyo 14 bangud sa Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).
english: The Miss Universe Philippines Organization has decided to postpone the first coronation night of Miss Universe Philippines to October 25, 2020 instead of June 14 due to the Coronavirus Disease 2019 (COVID-19).

text: Nagpasalig si Jonas Gaffud, Creative Director sang Miss Universe Philippines Organization nga nagasunod sila sa probisyon sang Modified Enhanced Community Quarantine sa pagpanghanda nga ila ginpatigayon.
english: Jonas Gaffud, Creative Director of the Miss Universe Philippines Organization, assured that they are following the provisions of the Modified Enhanced Community Quarantine in the preparation they have conducted.

text: Dugang sang natungdan, nakig-angot na sila sa St.
english: He added that they have already contacted St.

text: Luke’s Medical Center para sa physical kag mental support sang mga kandidata bangud kalabanan sa ila ang apektado man sang COVID-19.
english: Luke's Medical Center for physical and mental support of the candidates as most of them are also affected by COVID-19.

text: Ginpahayag ni Gaffud nga sa subong wala pa sang kandidata nga nag back out sa competition apang nakahanda sila sa anuman nga pagbag-o kag desisyon sang mga contenders.
english: Gaffud said that so far no candidate has backed out of the competition but they are ready for any changes and decisions of the contenders.

text: Ginhingyo ni Quezon City Representative Alfred Vargas, ang chairman sang committee on social services sa Kamara, ang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) nga istrikto nga i-monitor ang presyo sang noche buena items subong nga holiday season.
english: Quezon City Representative Alfred Vargas, chairman of the committee on social services in the House of Representatives, urged the Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) to strictly monitor the prices of noche buena items this holiday season.

text: Sa iya gin-file nga House Resolution 2348, nag-apelar man si Vargas sa mga manufacturers kag mga manugbaligya nga indi na magpataas sang presyo sang basic goods agud mapahagan-hagan ang galastuhon sang mga Filipino nga apekatdo sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: In his filed House Resolution 2348, Vargas also appealed to manufacturers and sellers not to raise the price of basic goods to ease the expenses of Filipinos affected by the COVID-19 pandemic.

text: Suno kay Vargas, nagakadapat nga ipatuman sang national government ang “just regulation” sa presyo sang balaklon agud mabatyagan ang ispirito sang bayanihan subong nga Paskwa.
english: According to Vargas, the national government should implement “just regulation” in the price of goods to feel the spirit of heroism this Christmas.

text: “As we expect the increase in demand for noche buena goods and basic necessities due to the holiday season, it is imperative that prices of such commodities are regulated under the context the COVID-19 pandemic to help Filipino consumers while also protecting the rights and income of manufacturers and sellers,” pahayag ni Vargas sa iya resolution.
english: “As we expect the increase in demand for noche buena goods and basic necessities due to the holiday season, it is imperative that prices of such commodities are regulated under the context the COVID-19 pandemic to help Filipino consumers while also protecting the rights and income of manufacturers and sellers,” Vargas stated in his resolution.

text: Sini lang nga bulan, una na ginpahayag ni Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez nga nagpasalig ang pila ka mga manufacturers sa pungsod sang ila nga commitment nga indi pagkambyuhon ang presyo sang noche buena items sa holiday season.
english: Earlier this month, Trade Secretary Ramon Lopez said that some manufacturers in the country have pledged their commitment not to change the price of noche buena items during the holiday season.

text: Kumpirmado nga napatay na ang lider sang Hamas nga si Yahya Al-Sinwar nga amo ang mastermind sa pagpang-atake sa southern Israel sang Oktubre 7, 2023 nga amo gid ang nagpa-ibwal sang giyera sa Gaza.
english: Hamas leader Yahya Al-Sinwar who was the mastermind of the attack in southern Israel on October 7, 2023 that actually sparked the war in Gaza is confirmed to be dead.

text: Suno sa militar sang Israel, napatay nila ang 62-anyos nga si Sinwar sa ground operation sa syudad sang Rafah sa southern Gaza Strip sang Miyerkules.
english: The Israeli military said it killed 62-year-old Sinwar in a ground operation in the city of Rafah in the southern Gaza Strip on Wednesday.

text: Nakumpleto naman ang proseso kaangay sang DNA test kag pag-check sang dental records kag nakumpirma nga iya bangkay ang nakit-an sa lugar nga gin-atake sang mga soldado.
english: The process such as DNA test and checking of dental records was completed and it was confirmed that his body was found in the area where the soldiers attacked him.

text: Mismo si Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu ang nagkumpirma sa nahimo sang Israel Defense Forces, apang ginsiling sini nga wala pa gihapon natapos ang ila nga misyon.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu himself confirmed the Israel Defense Forces' actions, but said their mission was not over.

text: Suno sa prime minister, “This is the beginning of the day after Hamas.
english: According to the prime minister, “This is the beginning of the day after Hamas.

text:
Evil has suffered a heavy blow, but the task before us is not yet complete.”

Gintawag sini ang kamatayon ni Sinwar nga “important moment in the war”.Here’s mor

Si Sinwar amo ang ginhingadlan nga overall leader sang Hamas kasunod sang kamatayon sang ila political chief nga si Ismail Haniyeh sa Iran sang Hulyo.
english:
Evil has suffered a heavy blow, but the task before us is not yet complete.”

It called Sinwar’s death an “important moment in the war”.Here’s mor

Sinwar was named overall leader of Hamas following the death of its political chief Ismail Haniyeh in Iran in July.

text: Ginapatihan nga nagpanago siya sa mga tunnel sang Hamas nga gintukod sa Gaza sa sulod na sang duha ka dekada.
english: He is believed to have been hiding in Hamas tunnels built in Gaza for two decades.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang ginplano sini nga pag-atake sa Southern Israel sang Oktubre 7, 2023 ang nagpatay sang 1,200 ka mga tawo lakip ang apat ka mga Pinoy kag may gindala man nga masobra 250 ka bihag sa Gaza.
english: It is known that its planned attack on Southern Israel on October 7, 2023 killed 1,200 people including four Filipinos and also took more than 250 hostages to Gaza.

text: Sang nagbalos ang Israel, 42,000 naman ka mga Palestinian ang nagkalamatay kag wala pa natapos ang giyera tubtub subong.
english: When Israel retaliated, 42,000 Palestinians were killed and the war is still ongoing.

text: Naghatag man sang statement ang Estados Unidos sang Amerika matapos ang kumpirmasyon sang Israel.
english: The United States of America also issued a statement after Israel's confirmation.

text: Suno kay Vice President Kamala Harris, nahatag na ang hustisya pati sa mga biktima nga Amerikado, naguba na ang Hamas kag narumpag ang ila liderato.
english: According to Vice President Kamala Harris, justice has been served including the American victims, Hamas has been destroyed and its leadership has collapsed.

text: Isa ini ka daku nga oportunidad suno sa iya nga tapusyon na ang giyera sa Gaza.
english: It is a great opportunity, he said, to end the war in Gaza.

text: “Hamas is decimated and its leadership is eliminated,” kabahin sang pahayag ni Harris samtang yara sa Wisconsin para sa presidential campaign.
english: “Hamas is decimated and its leadership is eliminated,” Harris said in part while in Wisconsin for the presidential campaign.

text: “This moment gives us an opportunity to finally end the war in Gaza, and it must end such that Israel is secure, the hostages are released, the suffering in Gaza ends, and the Palestinian people can realize their right to dignity, security, freedom and self-determination.
english: “This moment gives us an opportunity to finally end the war in Gaza, and it must end such that Israel is secure, the hostages are released, the suffering in Gaza ends, and the Palestinian people can realize their right to dignity, security, freedom and self-determination.

text:
It is time for the day after to begin, without Hamas in power.”##

(photo credit: Anas-Mohammed/Shutterstock, REUTERS/Ronen Zvulun)
english:
It is time for the day after to begin, without Hamas in power.”##

(photo credit: Anas-Mohammed/Shutterstock, REUTERS/Ronen Zvulun)

text: Gintumod ni Iloilo 1st District Rep.
english: Iloilo 1st District Rep.

text: Janette Garin ang tatlo ka nagapanguna nga mga isyu nga hatagan atensyon sa nagapadayon gna imbestigasyon na duwa ka sangay sang kongreso sa anomaliya sa mga flood control projects sa pungsod.
english: Janette Garin the three main issues to be addressed in the ongoing investigation of the two branches of Congress into anomalies in flood control projects in the country.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Garin nga nagaserbe man nga House Deputy Speaker, iya ginpahayag nga kinahanglan tutukan ang mga masunod: una ang ghost projects; ikaduwa, ang sub-standard nga mga materyales; kag ikatatlo, ang insertions sang mga proyekto.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Garin, who also serves as House Deputy Speaker, said the following should be focused on: ghost projects; second, sub-standard materials; and third, the insertions of projects.

text: Nagapati naman si Garin nga dako ang mabulig sang independent commission nga gintukod ni President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: Garin believes that the independent commission established by President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: Una na nga ginsiling ni Marcos nga ang nasambit nga komisyon ang ginabug-usan sang mga personallidad nga wala sang koneksyon sa gobyerno partikular ang yara sa nanuhay-tuhay nga background pareho sang former justice, isa ka investigator kag forensic accountant.
english: Earlier, Marcos said the commission is composed of personalities who have no connection to the government particularly those with various backgrounds such as former justice, an investigator and forensic accountant.

text: Ginpahayag naman ni Garin nga ang ila nga ginahimo nga imbestigasyon sa kamara ang wala sang biases kag wala sang pagpamahog sa mga resource persons para lang magbuyagyag sang mga pangalan sang mga tawo nga involved sa bilyones pesos nga balor sang mga maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: Garin said their investigation in the chamber is without bias and without intimidation of resource persons just to reveal the names of people involved in billions of pesos worth of anomalous flood control projects.

text: Ginakabig sang Schools Division of Iloilo City nga isa ka ‘eye opener’ ang pagnubo sang functional literacy rate sang mga estudyante.
english: The Schools Division of Iloilo City considers the decline in the functional literacy rate of students as an eye opener.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Ma.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Ma.

text: Luz Delos Reyes, Schools Division Superintendent sang Iloilo City, iya ginpahayag nga nagapakita lamang ang datus sang functional literacy nga kinahanglan nga hatagan sang intervention ang mga lugar nga tuman ka apektado.
english: Luz Delos Reyes, Schools Division Superintendent of Iloilo City, said the functional literacy data only shows that intervention is needed in the most affected areas.

text: Dugang sini nga luwas mahatagan balor ang early stages sang pagtuon kaangay na lamang sang mga kindergarten, grade 1, 2, kag 3, mahatagan man sang igtalupangod ang higher year level antes sila maka-gradwar.
english: He added that besides giving value to the early stages of learning such as kindergarten, grades 1, 2, and 3, attention will also be given to the higher year level before they graduate.

text: Suno kay Delos Reyes, samtang nagahatag sang atensyon ang talatapan sa mga natungdan nga estudyante, kinahanglan man pabaloran ang mga talented kag fast learners.
english: According to Delos Reyes, while the office pays attention to the students concerned, it is also necessary to value the talented and fast learners.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga may mga kabataan nga lain ang ila functional literacy kun ikumparar sa iban.
english: He also said that there are children whose functional literacy is different compared to others.

text: Nagapati man si Delos Reyes nga ang mga maalam mismo ang makabulig sa kapareho nila nga estudyante.
english: Delos Reyes also believes that the wise themselves can help their fellow students.

text: SA IDALOM sang Free Enterprise provision sang Constitution ginakilala ang “indispensable role” sang pribado nga sektor (Phil.
english: UNDER the Free Enterprise provision of the Constitution recognizes the “indispensable role” of the private sector (Phil.

text: Const.
english: Const.

text: Article II, Section 2).
english: Article II, Section 2).

text: However, nagapaandam ang Article XII Section 19 nga “No combinations in restraint of trade or unfair competition shall be allowed”.
english: However, Article XII Section 19 warns that “No combinations in restraint of trade or unfair competition shall be allowed”.

text: Ginpaathag ini sang Price Act (RA 7581) nga nagahatag sing proteksyon sa mga konsumidor sang basic necessities kag prime commodities sa idalom sang “illegal Acts of Price Manipulation” (Section 5-e).
english: This was clarified by the Price Act (RA 7581) which provides protection to consumers of basic necessities and prime commodities under “illegal Acts of Price Manipulation” (Section 5-e).

text: Ginatudlo sini ang Hoarding, Profiteering, kag Cartel angot sa pagbaligya sang basic necessities kag prime commodities.
english: It points out Hoarding, Profiteering, and Cartel in connection with the sale of basic necessities and prime commodities.

text: Ang Hoarding nagatumod sa “undue accumulation”, ukon ang pagtago ukon indi anay pagpagwa sang produkto, agud makapamentaha sa mataas nga presyo nga matuga sang “artificial shortage” sa merkado.
english: Hoarding refers to “undue accumulation”, or the hiding or not releasing products, in order to take advantage of the high prices caused by the “artificial shortage” in the market.

text: Ang Profiteering naman isa ka pagpa-presyo sang produkto lapaw sa matuod nga balor sini.
english: Profiteering is the pricing of a product beyond its true value.

text: Matabo ang Cartel sa paghimbon sang duha ukon sobra sa duha ka tawo ukon grupo agud ma-kontrol ang presyo.
english: Cartel occurs when two or more people or groups combine to control prices.

text: Ang penalidad diri (Price Act, Section 16) amo ang 5 tubtub 15 anyos nga pagkabilanggo kag Fine nga P5,000 tubtub sa  isa ka milyon ka pesos (P1M).
english: The penalty here (Price Act, Section 16) is 5 to 15 years imprisonment and a fine of P5,000 to one million pesos (P1M).

text: May problema ugaling sa kaso sang mga agricultural crops katulad sang sibuyas, nga nangin daku nga isyu tubtub subong.
english: There is a problem, however, in the case of agricultural crops such as onions, which have been a major issue until now.

text: Ina tungod wala naga-apply diri ang prima facie evidence provision (Price Act Section 5-e) batok sa over-stocking sobra sa 50% sang “usual inventory” ukon ang pagpasaka sang presyo lapaw sa 10% sa sulod sang isa ka bulan.
english: That is because the prima facie evidence provision (Price Act Section 5-e) against over-stocking more than 50% of the “usual inventory” or raising prices beyond 10% within one month does not apply here.

text: In other words, indi maakusaran diri ang mga negosyante sang Hoarding, Profiteering kag Carteling sang mga agricultural crops.
english: In other words, the traders cannot be accused of hoarding, profiteering and carteling of agricultural crops.

text: Obviously, pabor ini sa mga “unscrupulous traders” kag “smugglers”!
english: Obviously, this is in favor of “unscrupulous traders” and “smugglers”!

text: Ngaa ayhan wala ini maisipan sang aton Kongreso?
english: Ngaa ayhan wala ini maisipan sang aton Kongreso?

text:
