text: Ginpaguwa sang National Board of Canvassers (NBOC) ang final national canvass report sa percentage nga nakuha sang mga party-list groups.
english: The National Board of Canvassers (NBOC) released the final national canvass report on the percentage obtained by party-list groups.

text:
Ang top 15 nga grupo nga nagpangibabaw sa 2025 elections amo ang masunod:

Ang grupo nga nakakuha sang dos porsyento sang total votes sa party-list ang guaranteed sang isa sa 63 reserved seats sa party-list.
english:
The top 15 groups that prevailed in the 2025 elections are as follows:

The group that gets two percent of the total votes in the party-list is guaranteed one of the 63 reserved seats in the party-list.

text: Suno kay Comelec Chairman George Garcia, magasunod lang ugaling ang distribution and allocation sang seats para sa sini nga mga grupo.
english: According to Comelec Chairman George Garcia, the distribution and allocation of seats for these groups will follow.

text: Sa Mayo 19 naman natalana ang proklamasyon sang mga nagdaog, samtang buwas sa hapon naman ang iya sang winning senators.
english: The proclamation of the winners is scheduled for May 19, while the proclamation of the winning senators will be held tomorrow afternoon.

text: Nahibaluan nga nakumpleto sang NBOC ang canvassing sa 175 COCs sa sulod lamang sang tatlo ka adlaw — 58 COCs sang Martes, 101 COCs sang Myerkules, kag 16 COCs sang Huwebes.
english: The NBOC completed the canvassing of 175 COCs in just three days — 58 COCs on Tuesday, 101 COCs on Wednesday, and 16 COCs on Thursday.

text: Nag-abante na sa semifinals sang Guangzhou Open sanday Alexandra “Alex” Eala sang Pilipinas kag Nadiia Kichenok sang Ukraine.
english: Alexandra “Alex” Eala of the Philippines and Nadiia Kichenok of Ukraine have advanced to the semifinals of the Guangzhou Open.

text: Ini matapos sila nagdaog batok sa Russian duo nga sanday Polina Kudermetova kag Kamilla Rakhimova, sa iskor nga 6-3, 7-5, sa ila quarterfinal match kahapon sa China.
english: This comes after they defeated Russian duo Polina Kudermetova and Kamilla Rakhimova, 6-3, 7-5, in their quarterfinal match yesterday in China.

text: Apisar pa nga naka-reord sang 4-3 nga abanse ang mga Ruso sa ikaduha nga set, gilayon man nakabawi sanday Eala kag Kichenok.
english: Although the Russians reordered a 4-3 lead in the second set, Eala and Kichenok immediately recovered.

text: Antes sini, ginlutos man sang Filipino-Ukrainian duo sanday Emily Appleton sang Great Britain kag Qianhui Tang sang China sa Round of 16, kun sa diin nagdaog sila sa iskor nga 6-4, 6-2.
english: Earlier, the Filipino-Ukrainian duo also defeated Emily Appleton of Great Britain and Qianhui Tang of China in the Round of 16, where they won 6-4, 6-2.

text: Bangud sang ila kadalag-an, isa naman ka importante nga milestone ang nadugang sa international career ni Eala.
english: With their victory, another important milestone was added to Eala's international career.

text: Masunod nila nga makasambuwa amo sanday Katarzyna Piter sang Poland kag Janice Tjen ng Indonesia.
english: They will be followed by Katarzyna Piter of Poland and Janice Tjen of Indonesia.

text: Ginbali ni former Kabataan Partylist Rep.
english: Former Kabataan Partylist Rep.

text: Raoul Manuel ang pahayag ni President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.
english: Raoul Manuel the statement of President Ferdinand “Bongbong” Marcos, Jr.

text: nga “normal” pa man ang tanan subong.
english: that everything is still “normal” now.

text: Kasunod ini sang pahayag sang presidente nga diri sa Pilipinas, normal man ang presyuhanay kag ginasigurado sang gobyerno suno sa iya nga maayo ang suplay sang pagkaon, bugas, kag tanan nga basic goods.
english: This follows the president's statement that here in the Philippines, prices are normal and the government is ensuring that there is a good supply of food, rice, and all basic goods.

text: Suno naman sa former representative nga tumandok sang Iloilo, amo ini ang rason kun ngaa dapat nga magpadayon nga maghulag ang pumuluyo sa baylo nga maghipus-hipos lang kag pabay-an lang ang gobyerno kun ano ang obrahon.
english: According to the former representative who is a native of Iloilo, this is the reason why the people should continue to act instead of remaining silent and letting the government do whatever they want.

text: “Normal pa bala nga nag-doble ang presyo sang gatong?
english: “Is it normal that the price of fuel has doubled?

text: Te ang pamangkot naton, ano ni ya ang aton nga gobyerno man?
english: The question is, what is our government?

text: Nagapabungol-bungol lang bala ini, ukon daw kadamol lang bala sang iya nga guya para maghambal pa nga normal ang tanan?,” suno sa anay kongresista.
english: Is he just being deaf, or is he just pretending to say that everything is normal?,” the former congressman said.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga naandan na lang sang gobyerno nga protektahan ang interes sang dalagku nga mga kumpaniya lakip na ang oil companies.
english: He said the government is used to protecting the interests of big companies including oil companies.

text: Ginpanawagan ni Manuel sa publiko nga dapat saligan ang paghugpong sang isa kag isa kag pagbato sa kinamatarong sang mga driver, operator, kag commuter sa tunga sang ginapangatubang subong nga krisis.
english: Manuel called on the public to rely on each other's unity and fight for the rights of drivers, operators, and commuters in the midst of the current crisis.

text: Nahibaluan nga ginhiwat ang ikaduha nga adlaw sang transport strike subong nga adlaw, Marso 20, malapit sa University of the Philippines Visayas sa Iloilo City nga gin-updan sang mga driver, operator, kag nagkalain-lain nga mga sector.
english: The second day of the transport strike was held today, March 20, near the University of the Philippines Visayas in Iloilo City accompanied by drivers, operators, and various sectors.

text: Isa ka nurse nga bag-o lang nakapasar sa board exam ang nalakip sa duha nga napatay sa pagpang-ambush sang riding-in-tandem sa General Santos City.
english: A nurse who recently passed the board exam was among the two killed in a riding-in-tandem ambush in General Santos City.

text: Ang mga napatay amo ang nurse nga si Nhiezer Rolliene Jane Aguacito kag ang tricycle driver nga si Ivan Conde, 33-anyos, kag amo ang target sa ambush.
english: The dead were identified as nurse Nhiezer Rolliene Jane Aguacito and tricycle driver Ivan Conde, 33, who was the target of the ambush.

text: Suno sa General Santos City Police Station, nagasubay ang tricycle sa Brgy.
english: According to the General Santos City Police Station, the tricycle was traveling in Brgy.

text: City Heights sang ginsundan kag ginbanggaan sang mga armado nga lalaki kag ginpaarakan luthang.
english: City Heights when he was followed and hit by armed men and opened fire.

text: Naigo naman sang bala ang nurse nga nagalakat lang sa lugar kag pauli na kuntani halin sa grocery store.
english: The bullet hit the nurse who was walking in the area and was on her way home from the grocery store.

text: Dead on the spot si Conde samtang sa ospital naman ginbawian sang kabuhi si Aquacito.
english: Conde died on the spot while Aquacito died at the hospital.

text: Naggwa sa imbestigasyon nga bag-o lang nakagwa sa presohan si Conde matapos nakapiyansa sa sampaw-sampaw nga panumbungon.
english: Investigation revealed that Conde was recently released from jail after being released on bail on multiple charges.

text: Padayon pa nga ginapangita ang mga suspek.
english: The suspects are still being sought.

text: Ipatuman ang senintimos nga rollback sa presyo sang produktong petrolyo sa masunod nga semana.
english: Implement a penny rollback in the price of petroleum products next week.

text: Suno sa Department of Energy – Oil Industry Management Bureau subong nga Byernes, Enero 2, ang gina-forecast nga adjustments sa fuel prices ang ginbase sa tatlo ka adlaw nga trading sang Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS).
english: According to the Department of Energy – Oil Industry Management Bureau this Friday, January 2, the forecast adjustments in fuel prices are based on the three-day trading of the Mean of Platts Singapore (MOPS).

text:
Gasolina: posible nga may rollback nga P0.50Diesel: posible nga may rollback nga P0.15Kerosene: posible nga may rollback nga P0.20

Ini nga estimates wala pa nagalakip sang operating cost sang mga kumpaniya sang langis kag iban pa nga mga premium.
english:
Gasoline: possible rollback of P0.50Diesel: possible rollback of P0.15Kerosene: possible rollback of P0.20

These estimates do not yet include the operating cost of oil companies and other premiums.

text: Ang ginalauman nga rollback ang naangot sa paghagan-hagan sang geopolitical risks, possible matabo nga global oversupply, mahina nga demand expectations sa major consumers kaangay sang China, kag amo man ang OPEC+ policy kag market balance.
english: The expected rollback is linked to easing geopolitical risks, possible global oversupply, weak demand expectations from major consumers such as China, as well as OPEC+ policy and market balance.

text: Kinaandan nga gina-anunsyo sang oil companies ang adjustments sa oil prices sa kada Lunes, kag dungan ini nga gina-implementar sa kada Martes sang aga.
english: Oil companies usually announce adjustments to oil prices every Monday, and they are implemented simultaneously every Tuesday morning.

text: May yara man bala ikaw sang hinuptanan nga isda sa imo nga balay?
english: Do you have a pet fish at home?

text: Nakahibalo ka bala nga kaangay sa tawo, nagakasubuan man ang isda kun wala sang nagasapak sa iya kag makabatyag man sang pagpalangluya?
english: Did you know that like humans, fish feel sad when no one cares about them and feel discouraged?

text: Amo ini ang natabo sa isa ka sunfish nga nabutang sa isa ka aquarium sa southwestern Japan.
english: This is what happened to a sunfish kept in an aquarium in southwestern Japan.

text: Nag-abot ang isda sa Shimonoseki City Aquarium Kaikyokan sa Yamaguchi, Japan sang Pebrero 2024 halin sa southern coast sang Kochi sa Pacific Ocean.
english: The fish arrived at Shimonoseki City Aquarium Kaikyokan in Yamaguchi, Japan in February 2024 from the southern coast of Kochi in the Pacific Ocean.

text: Sang yara na siya didto sa aquarium, nangin isa siya sa pinakabantog nga attractions sa pasilidad bangud miyembro siya sang blowfish family nga kilala sa unique shape ang iya daku nga mga mata.
english: Once he was there at the aquarium, he became one of the most famous attractions in the facility because he is a member of the blowfish family known for its unique shape of large eyes.

text: Apang sang Disyembre 1, nagdesisyon ang aquarium nga masirado anay sila para sa anum ka bulan nga renovation rason nga wala anay sang ginpasulod nga mga bisita kag turista.
english: However, on December 1, the aquarium decided to close for six months of renovation, preventing visitors and tourists from entering.

text: Didto man kag nag-umpisa nga nagluya ang isda rason nga nagsuspetsa ang aquarium keepers nga basi kun may yara ini sang digestive problems.
english: The fish began to weaken and the aquarium keepers suspected that it might have digestive problems.

text: Gingamay man ang ginhatag nga pagkaon kag ginbisitahan man nila ang fish tank para mahatagan ini sang comfort sa tion nga maggahod na ang construction — apang amo man gihapon ang sitwasyon sang isda.
english: The food provided was also reduced and they also visited the fish tank to give it comfort once the construction got noisy — but the fish were still in the same situation.

text: Padayon ini nga nadulaan sang gana kag nagpahimuyong lang sa isa ka bahin sang fish tank kag tuman ka subo kun tulukon.
english: He continued to lose his appetite and just rested in one part of the fish tank and looked very sad.

text: Sang ulihi, ginkonsiderar na sang facility ang suhestiyon sa isa ka staff meeting nga basi kun naapektuhan gid ang isda bangud gulpi lang nagkaladula ang mga tawo sa iya palibot.
english: Later, the facility considered the suggestion in a staff meeting that the fish might have been affected because the people around it suddenly disappeared.

text: Apisar may pagpang-duha-duha, nagdesisyon ang aquarium keepers nga tilawan abi nila nga ipakabit ang ila nga mga uniform sa palibot sang fish tank.
english: Despite the hesitation, the aquarium keepers decided to try hanging their uniforms around the fish tank.

text: Nagbutang man sila sang cutouts nga daw tawo amo man ang mga laragway sang nagayuhom nga mga tawo para ma-cheer kuno ang isda.
english: They also put human-like cutouts as well as pictures of smiling people to supposedly cheer the fish.

text: Suno sa aquarist nga si Moe Miyazawa, nakahibalo man siya nga nagalantaw ang isda sang ginpakabit nila ang cutouts apang amo na lang ang ila kakibot nga pagkasunod nga adlaw, nagkaon na ang isda.
english: Aquarist Moe Miyazawa said he knew the fish were watching when they attached the cutouts but to their surprise the next day, the fish ate.

text: Ini ang labing-una nga tion sa sulod sang isa ka semana nga may gana ini sa pagkan kag nangin steady man ang pag-recover sini.
english: This is the first time in a week that he has had an appetite and his recovery has been steady.

text: Bangud sadto, nag-umpisa man ang staff sa masami nga pagbisita sa isda kag naga-wave pa sila sa sunfish.
english: Because of that, the staff started visiting the fish more often and they were still waving at the sunfish.

text: Nagalaum ang aquarium keepers nga magabalik man ang fans agud mabisita liwat ang sunfish kun magbukas na liwat ang aquarium sa summer pagkatapos sang ila nga renovation.
english: The aquarium keepers hope that fans will return to visit the sunfish again when the aquarium reopens in the summer after their renovation.

text: Ginakasubo subong sang aktres nga si Angel Locsin ang pagtaliwan sang iya 13-year old Bichon Frise nga si Pwet-Pwet.
english: Actress Angel Locsin is now grieving the loss of her 13-year-old Bichon Frize, Pwet-Pwet.

text: Paagi sa iya social media account, gindumdom sang aktres ang iya paborito nga hinuptanan sa diin ginpakigbahin niya ang pila ka mga pictures nila sang iya ido kag may caption nga “proud of you my perfect little fighter [heart emoji] you can rest now.
english: Through her social media account, the actress remembered her favorite pet where she shared some pictures of her and her dog with the caption “proud of you my perfect little fighter [heart emoji] you can rest now.

text: Love you ALWAYS”.
english: Love you ALWAYS”.

text: Madumduman nga sang Mayo 7, naghingyo sang pangamuyo ang aktres sa publiko para sa iya ido bangud sa sakit sini sa kidney.
english: On May 7, the actress asked the public for prayers for her dog due to kidney disease.

text: Gin-ulan naman sang pagpakig-unong ang social media account sang aktres gikan sa iya mga fans lakip man sa iya mga abyan sa showbiz.
english: The actress' social media account was showered with condolences from her fans as well as her showbiz friends.

text: Indi kuwalipikado sanday Pacifico “Curlee” kag Sarah Discaya nga mangin state witness sa imbestigasyon sa flood control scandal.
english: Pacifico “Curlee” and Sarah Discaya are not qualified to be state witnesses in the investigation into the flood control scandal.

text: Ini apisar nag-ako ang duha nga nagabayad sila sa public officials agud nga maka-secure sang government contracts para sa ila nga mga kumpaniya.
english: This is despite the two admitting that they paid public officials to secure government contracts for their companies.

text: Suno kay House infrastructure committee co-chairman Rep.
english: According to House infrastructure committee co-chairman Rep.

text: Terry Ridon, una sa tanan, indi man madayon ang baydanay kun wala ang mga Discaya.
english: Terry Ridon, first of all, the payment would not have been possible without the Discaya.

text: “Sa tingin ko, hindi.
english: “I don’t think so.

text: Hindi sila qualified na maging state witness kasi una sa lahat, hindi naman matutuloy ang mga payoffs kung hindi sila kasali,” suno kay Ridon.
english: They are not qualified to be state witnesses because first of all, the payoffs will not continue if they are not involved,” Ridon said.

text: “Tatlong bahagi yan: contractor na kumuha ng cheque, DPWH na talagang nag-aayos ng proyekto at kung meron sangkot ng politiko.
english: “There are three parts: contractor who gets the check, DPWH who actually arranges the project and if there is a politician involved.

text:
Magkakasama sila na principally accused sa kung anumang kaso na isasampa laban sa kanila.”

Ang pahayag nga ini sang kongresista ang kasunod sang paandam ni Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto nga indi accountability ang gusto sang mga Discaya kundi nga ginalagas lang nila nga mangin state witness sa sini nga eskandalo.
english:
They will be principally accused in any case filed against them.”

The congressman's statement follows Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto's warning that the Discayas do not want accountability but that they are just trying to become state witnesses in this scandal.

text:
Sa idalom sang layi, yari ang mga kuwalipikasyon agud mangin state witness:

*Kinahanglan may isa ka absolute necessity para sa testimoniya

“That is their defense, na pinwersa lang sila, but the question they need to address is, when did this start?
english:
Under the law, here are the qualifications to become a state witness:

*There must be an absolute necessity for testimony

“That is their defense, that they were forced, but the question they need to address is, when did this start?

text: They said they were contractors during the Aquino, Duterte and Marcos administration, and Sarah Discaya said it was in 2016 when they started winning flood control project contracts.
english: They said they were contractors during the Aquino, Duterte and Marcos administration, and Sarah Discaya said it was in 2016 when they started winning flood control project contracts.

text: And yet they say 2022 onwards lang sila nagbibigay [ng commission] tapos sa ibang panahon, hindi nagbibigay?,” pahayag ni Rep.
english: And yet they say 2022 onwards they only give [commission] then at other times, not give?,” said Rep.

text: Ridon.
english: Ridon.

text: “Clearly, nagsisinungaling po, or selective [ang Discaya affidavit].
english: “Clearly, [the Discaya affidavit] is lying, or selective.

text: Wasak na wasak iyong affidavit nila [na ipinasa] sa Senado,” dugang sini.
english: Their affidavit [submitted] to the Senate is broken,” he added.

text: Una na nga nagpahayag ang bana nga Discaya nga nag-execute sila sang affidavit bangud sa kahadlok nga patyon sila sang “120-million nga mga Filipino.”
english: Earlier, Discaya's husband said they executed the affidavit for fear of being killed by “120-million Filipinos.”

text: Nagpadayaw ang North Korea nga masobra isa ka milyon ka mga bataon pa nga mga indibidwal ang nagsulod sa ila militar subong nga semana bilang pagpabaskog pa sang ila pwersa batok sa South Korea.
english: North Korea boasted that more than a million young individuals joined its military this week as a further strengthening of its forces against South Korea.

text: Suno sa official Korean Central News Agency, masobra sa1.4 million youth league officials, kabataan, kag mga estudyante sa ila pungsod ang nagboluntaryo nga magsulod — ukon magsulod liwat — sa Korean People’s Army sang Oktubre 14 kag Oktubre 15.
english: According to the official Korean Central News Agency, more than1.4 million youth league officials, children, and students in their country volunteered to join — or re-enlist — in the Korean People’s Army on Oct. 14 and Oct. 15.

text: Nahibaluan nga malawig na ang mandatory military service sang North Korea para sa mga lalaki, kag pila ka beses na sini nga ginasiling nga madamo gihapon ang nagapa-enlist ilabi na kun magtaas ang tension batok sa South Korea kag sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: North Korea has a long history of mandatory military service for men, and has repeatedly said that many will still enlist especially if tensions between South Korea and the United States rise.

text: Sang Martes, matandaan nga ginpasigabong sang North ang symbolic nga mga dalan kag riles nga nagaangot sang South kag North Korea.
english: On Tuesday, it can be recalled that the North set fire to symbolic roads and railways linking South and North Korea.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang ila paandam nga pananglitan makakita sila sang bisan isa lang ka drone nga magsulod sa Pyongyang, kabigon na nila ini nga deklarasyon sa giyera.
english: This follows their warning that if they see even one drone entering Pyongyang, they will consider it a declaration of war.

text: Una na nga nagpanginwala ang South nga sila ang nagpadala sang mga drone sa North, apang ginsiling naman sang Pyongyang nga may klaro sila nga ebidensya nga may official involvement sang Seoul sa amo nga drones kag gina-alegar man sini nga lakip sa ginapadala sang South amo ang anti-regime propaganda leaflets kag ginpalapta sa kapital sang North.
english: The South had previously denied sending the drones to the North, but Pyongyang said it had clear evidence that Seoul had official involvement in the drones and alleged that among those sent by the South were anti-regime propaganda leaflets distributed in the North's capital.

text: Wala gihapon sang kaathagan subong kun sin-o gid man ang sa likod sang pagpalupad sang drones.
english: It is still unclear who is behind the drones.

text: Apang kun balikan ang ini nga istilo, ang South Korean activists ang nagpadala na anay sang anti-Pyongyang regime leaflets sa border sang duha ka pungsod kag nagpaibwal sang kaakig sang North rason nga nagpalupad man ini sang mga balloon pakadto sa South nga may dala nga mga basura.
english: But if we go back to this style, South Korean activists have already sent anti-Pyongyang regime leaflets to the border of the two countries and angered the North so it also flew balloons to the South carrying garbage.

text: Lakip man anay sa ginpadala sang mga aktibista amo ang mga materyales kaangay sang USB drives nga nagaunod sang K-pop tracks kag K-dramas.
english: Among the materials sent by the activists were USB drives containing K-pop tracks and K-dramas.

text: Ginakaugtan gid ini sang North bangud sensitibo sila kaayo kag ginadumilian gid ang ila nga mga pumuluyo nga maka-access sa popular nga kultura sang South Korea.#
english: The North hates this because they are very sensitive and strictly prohibit their citizens from accessing South Korean popular culture.

text: Wala na sang plano si Senator Manny Pacquiao nga magbalik sa boxing ring bisan anuman ang mangin resulta sang presidential race sa Mayo 2022.
english: Senator Manny Pacquiao has no plans to return to the boxing ring regardless of the outcome of the presidential race in May 2022.

text: Sa exclusive interview sang Bombo Radyo sa presidential candidate, ginpahayag sini nga naka-anunsyo na siya sang iya nga retirement sa iya karera sa boksing kag handa na siya nga ihatag ang nabilin nga pwersa sa pagserbisyo sa tawo bilang isa ka public servant.
english: In an exclusive interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, the presidential candidate said he has already announced his retirement from his boxing career and is ready to give his remaining strength to serve the people as a public servant.

text: “Nag-announce na ako ng retirement sa taong bayan.
english: “I have announced my retirement to the people.

text: Hayaan nila na yung natitira kong lakas i-alay ko sa pagseserbisyo sa taong bayan.
english: Let them dedicate the rest of my strength to serving the people.

text: Gusto kong tulungan lahat.
english: I want to help everyone.

text: Hindi ko na kailangang yumaman diyan sa gobyerno.
english: I don't need to get rich from the government.

text: Hindi ko na kailangan pang sumikat.
english: I don't need to be famous.

text: Ang kailangan ko lang ay ang mga kasama kong mahihirap dahil gusto kong matulungan sila na umunlad din sa pamumuhay.
english: I just need my fellow sufferers because I want to help them improve in life.

text: Yan ang misyon ko.
english: That's my mission.

text: Commitment ko yan sa Panginoon at sa tao,” suno kay Pacquiao.
english: It is my commitment to the Lord and to the people,” Pacquiao said.

text: 42 anyos ang nasambit nga Filipino icon sang opisyal sini nga gin-anunsyo ang iya pag-retiro sa boxing.
english: The Filipino icon was 42 years old when he officially announced his retirement from boxing.

text: Siya ang nagaisahanon nga boksidor sa bilog nga kalibutan nga nakadaug sang world titles sa walo ka divisions.
english: He is the only boxer in the world to have won world titles in eight divisions.

text: Agusto sang nagligad nga tuig sang katapusan nga nakahampang si PacMan.
english: It was August last year when PacMan was last played.

text: Ginpierde siya ni WBA world welterweight champion Yordenis Ugas paagi sa unanimous decision sa hampang sa Las Vegas.
english: He was defeated by WBA world welterweight champion Yordenis Ugas via unanimous decision in a match in Las Vegas.

text: Punto por punto nga ginpasigurado sang National Food Authority (NFA) Region 6 nga nakamentenar sang maayo ang ila warehouses kag facilities.
english: Point by point, the National Food Authority (NFA) Region 6 ensured that their warehouses and facilities are well maintained.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Engineer Clark Obja-an, Facility Management Section sang National Food Authority Region 6, iya ginpahayag nga antes paman ma-distribute ang mga program sang talatapan, nagaagi ini sa ila section antes paman ma-implementar sa tagsa ka branches.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Engineer Clark Obja-an, Facility Management Section of the National Food Authority Region 6, said that before the programs of the office are distributed, they go through their section before being implemented in each branch.

text: Suno kay Obja-an, magluwas sa pag-imbak sang mga buffer stock sang bugas, nagahatag man ang NFA sang administrative kag technical assistance sa branches kag offices sa Rehiyon VI.
english: According to Obja-an, besides storing buffer stocks of rice, the NFA also provides administrative and technical assistance to branches and offices in Region VI.

text: Dugang sini nga nagakoordinar man ang talatapan sa tagsa ka Local Government Unit (LGU) sa pagpanagtag sang mga stocks ilabi na emergencies kag disaster relief program.
english: He added that the office is also coordinating with each Local Government Unit (LGU) in the distribution of stocks especially emergencies and disaster relief programs.

text: Nagapatuman naman sang monthly inspection kag monitoring ang NFA sa ila tagsa ka pasilidad agud mapasiguro nga well maintained ini ilabi na sa indi mapaktan nga hitabo.
english: The NFA is conducting monthly inspection and monitoring of their respective facilities to ensure that they are well maintained especially in case of unforeseen events.

text: Matapos ang inspeksyon, ginahimo-an ini sang report kag rekomendasyon kon makitaan man sang guba agud mapadala man sa regional office.
english: After the inspection, a report is made and recommendations are made if any damage is found to be sent to the regional office.

text: Pahayag pa sang natungdan nga on-going ang upgrading sang talatapan sa ila mga equipment lakip na ang pag-repair sang pila ka warehouses sa Capiz, Aklan, Dumalag, kag Sigma agud mapalawig pagid ang extremities sang serbisyo sang NFA.
english: He said the office is on-going with the upgrading of its equipment including the repair of several warehouses in Capiz, Aklan, Dumalag, and Sigma to extend the extremities of the NFA's services.

text: Ginkasubo sang mga fans ang pagtaliwan sang singer-actor nga si Sonny Parson sa edad nga 61.
english: Fans mourned the passing of singer-actor Sonny Parson at the age of 61.

text: Suno sa bata ni Sonny nga si Jeff Parson, gin-atake sa tagipusuon ang iya amay samtang nagapatigayon sang charity drive kaupod ang grupo nga Law Enforcement Riders Association of the Philippines sa Tayabas, Quezon.
english: Sonny's son, Jeff Parson, said his father suffered a heart attack while conducting a charity drive with the Law Enforcement Riders Association of the Philippines in Tayabas, Quezon.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, ginahitso na nila subong ang haya sang iya amay nga ibase sa tradisyon sang mga Muslim.
english: He added that they are now preparing his father's haya based on Muslim tradition.

text: Madumduman nga nangin bantog si Sonny sang dekada ’70 kag ’80 kaupod ang iya grupo nga Hagibis.
english: Sonny became famous in the 1970s and 1980s with his band Hagibis.

text: Sang dekada ’90, nagsulod si Sonny sa showbiz kag nangin konsehal sang Marikina City.
english: In the 1990s, Sonny entered showbiz and became a councilor of Marikina City.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – May tatlo na ka mga kandidato sa Western Visayas nga nag-apply para sa exemption sa election gun ban.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Three candidates in Western Visayas have already applied for exemption from the election gun ban.

text: Ang nationwide gun ban ang maumpisa sa Dominggo, Enero 12, nga amo man ang umpisa sang election period para sa May 12, 2025 elections.
english: The nationwide gun ban will begin on Sunday, January 12, which is also the beginning of the election period for the May 12, 2025 elections.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, director sang Police Regional Office 6, iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga mga kandidato ang naghalin sa Iloilo.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Brigadier General Jack Wanky, director of the Police Regional Office 6, said the candidates are from Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Wanky, gin-endorso na nila sa Philippine National Police (PNP) National Headquarters ang hingyo sang mga kandidato.
english: Wanky said they have already endorsed the request of the candidates to the Philippine National Police (PNP) National Headquarters.

text: Nagapanguna nga rason sang mga ini amo ang nabaton nila nga pamahog sa ila seguridad.
english: The main reason for this is the threat they received to their security.

text: Ang PNP Intelligence Group naman ang magapatigayon sang assessment.
english: The PNP Intelligence Group will conduct the assessment.

text: Ang exemption sa election gun ban ang aprubahan naman sang Committee on Ban on Firearms and Security Concerns sang Commission on Elections (COMELEC).
english: The exemption from the election gun ban will be approved by the Committee on Ban on Firearms and Security Concerns of the Commission on Elections (COMELEC).

text: Sa tion nga mapasugtan nga ma-exempt sa election gun ban, mahimo ang mga ini nga makadala sang armas bilang proteksyon sa ila kaugalingon.
english: Once allowed to be exempted from the election gun ban, they can carry weapons for self-protection.

text: Nahibaluan nga bilang general rule, ang bona fide police, military, kag myembro sang government law enforcement agencies nga may complete uniform kag yara sa official duty ang indi sakop sang election gun ban sa bug-os nga election period.
english: As a general rule, bona fide police, military, and members of government law enforcement agencies in full uniform and on official duty are not covered by the election gun ban for the entire election period.

text: Magapasaka si Senator Jinggoy Estrada sang perjury complaint batok kay former Bulacan assistant district engineer Brice Hernandez bangud sa pag-implicate sa iya sa anomaliya sa flood control.
english: Senator Jinggoy Estrada will file a perjury complaint against former Bulacan assistant district engineer Brice Hernandez for implicating him in flood control anomalies.

text: Ginhangkat man ni Estrada si Hernandez nga magpaidalom sa lie detector test kag mag-presentar sang iya mga ebidensya.
english: Estrada also challenged Hernandez to undergo a lie detector test and present his evidence.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang statement ni Hernandez ang nagatuyo lamang nga palikuon ang imbestigasyon kag i-discredit si Estrada sa iya nga partisipasyon sa hearing.
english: He also said that Hernandez's statement only aims to distort the investigation and discredit Estrada for his participation in the hearing.

text: “I will not allow this brazen attempt to smear my name to go unanswered.
english: “I will not allow this brazen attempt to smear my name to go unanswered.

text: This will not pass quietly.
english: This will not pass quietly.

text: Beyond the administrative and criminal liabilities he may face, I will ensure that Mr. Hernandez is held accountable for perjury and made to answer for his deliberate falsehoods before the proper judicial forum,” pahayag ni Estrada.
english: Beyond the administrative and criminal liabilities he may face, I will ensure that Mr. Hernandez is held accountable for perjury and made to answer for his deliberate falsehoods before the proper judicial forum,” Estrada said.

english: Meanwhile, Sen.

english: Joel Villanueva that he will not tarnish the name given by his parents.

text: Ginpanglawag na sini ang bibliya kag ang iya pagpati sa langit kag impyerno samtang nga ginadepensahan ang iya pangalan.
english: He has searched the bible and his belief in heaven and hell while defending his name.

text: Pahayag sini, “I will never betray my principle.
english: He said, “I will never betray my principle.

text: I will never ever.
english: I will never ever.

text: I will never ever, Mr. President destroy the name that was given to me by my parents because it is priceless.
english: I will never ever, Mr. President destroyed the name that was given to me by my parents because it is priceless.

text: The bible says a good name should be chosen than great richest.
english: The bible says a good name should be chosen than great richest.

english:

Villanueva also called for clarification on who is the real mastermind in the controversy and who he referred to as “Dracula” who he said is sucking the national blood bank of the government coffers.

text: Wala ini sang ginsambit nga pangalan, apang ginbalikan sini ang ginmensyonar ni former Senate President Chiz Escudero sa iya manifestation sa plenaryo sang Lunes.
english: He did not mention any names, but he reiterated what former Senate President Chiz Escudero mentioned in his manifestation in plenary on Monday.

text: Sang amo nga tion, ginpabugal ni Escudero nga sa iya termino bilang senate president, na-mensyonar sa Senate Blue Ribbon Committee si House Speaker Martin Romualdez kag si Zaldy Co nga involved sa eskandalo sa flood control.
english: At the time, Escudero boasted that during his term as senate president, House Speaker Martin Romualdez and Zaldy Co were mentioned in the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee as involved in the flood control scandal.

text:
ALEGASYON NI HERNANDEZ SA KAMARA

Kun balikan ang mga alegasyon ni Hernandez, si Estrada amo ang nagpapanaog sang P355 million nga balor sang proyekto sa Hagonoy kag Malolos, Bulacan sang 2025 nga may 30% “SOP” ukon kickback.
english:
HERNANDEZ'S ALLEGATIONS TO THE HOUSE

According to Hernandez's allegations, Estrada is the one who signed the P355 million worth of projects in Hagonoy and Malolos, Bulacan in 2025 with a 30% “SOP” or kickback.

text: Sanday DPWH drivers Christian Santiago kag Andrei Balatbat amo ang ginatudlo nga point persons ni Estrada sa idalom sang direksyon ni former district engineer Henry Alcantara.
english: DPWH drivers Christian Santiago and Andrei Balatbat are Estrada's alleged point persons under the direction of former district engineer Henry Alcantara.

text: Para naman kay Villanueva, gin-claim ni Hernandez nga sang 2023, nag-release ang senador sang P600 million nga balor sang proyekto sa Balagtas, Bulacan nga may yara man sang pareho nga 30% cut.
english: As for Villanueva, Hernandez claimed that in 2023, the senator released a P600 million worth of projects in Balagtas, Bulacan with the same 30% cut.

text: Ini nga pondo suno kay Hernandez ang gin-deliver sa balay ni Villanueva sa Bocaue paagi kay construction section chief Jaypee Mendoza kag Alcantara.
english: Hernandez said the funds were delivered to Villanueva's house in Bocaue through construction section chief Jaypee Mendoza and Alcantara.

text: Si Alcantara suno kay Hernandez ang nagatindog nga “chief implementor” nga direkta nga naga-koordinar sa mga pulitiko.
english: Alcantara, according to Hernandez, is the chief implementor who directly coordinates with politicians.

text: Gin-alegar nga nagakuha ini sang 3% commission para sa iya kaugalingon kag nagamandu sa engineers nga hambalon ang contractors nga kinahanglan ang dugang nga 2% “finder’s fee” kun luyag nila nga maka-secure sang dugang nga mga project.
english: It was alleged that he takes a 3% commission for himself and directs engineers to tell contractors that an additional 2% “finder’s fee” is required if they want to secure more projects.

text: Antes ginpangbuyagyag ini nga mga rebelasyon, nag-apelar si Hernandez sa Kamara nga indi na siya pag-ibalik sa Senado kun sa diin gin-detain siya matapos gin-cite in contempt sang Lunes.
english: Before the revelations were made, Hernandez appealed to the House not to return him to the Senate where he was detained after being cited in contempt on Monday.

text: Nagsabat naman si Congressman Terry Ridon nga magapakig-angot ang panel sa Senate Blue Ribbon Committee para matugutan si Hernandez nga magpabilin sa kustodiya sang Kamara.#
english: Congressman Terry Ridon said the panel will liaise with the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee to allow Hernandez to remain in the custody of the House.

text: Nakahanda ang militar sang South Korea nga magbalos kasunod sang reports nga nagpadala na ang North Korea sang mga soldado sa border sang duha ka pungsod agud nga magpalupok kag magpasigabong pananglitan maglala pa ang tensyon bangud sang pagsulod sang drones sa Pyongyang.
english: The South Korean military is ready to retaliate following reports that North Korea has already sent troops to the border between the two countries to open fire and arson in case tensions escalate over the entry of drones into Pyongyang.

text: Nag-ugat ini nga kumplikto sa akusasyon sang North nga nagpalupad ang South sang drones sa Pyongyang agud nga maghulog sang mga propaganda leaflets nga may unod nga mga “rumor”.
english: The conflict stemmed from the North's accusation that the South had flown drones into Pyongyang to drop propaganda leaflets containing rumors.

text: Nagpaandam man ang North nga kun maka-detect sila liwat sang bisan isa lang ka drone, igakonsiderar na nila ini nga deklarasyon sang giyera.
english: The North has also warned that if it detects even one drone again, it will consider it a declaration of war.

text: Una naman nanginwala ang South nga sila ang nagpadala sang drones kag may mga espekulasyon nga basi kun ang mga activist groups sa South ang may kahimuan sini.
english: Earlier, the South denied sending the drones and there was speculation that activist groups in the South might have been responsible.

text: Nagapanindugan naman ang North nga ang Seoul gid ang balasulon.
english: The North insists that Seoul is to blame.

text: Nag-anunsyo naman ini nga nagpadala ini sang walo ka artillery brigades sa border kag nagdugang man sang pwersa sa air observation posts sa Pyongyang.
english: It announced that it has sent eight artillery brigades to the border and has also increased forces at air observation posts in Pyongyang.

text: Suno naman sa Joint Chiefs of Staff sang South, hugot naman ang ila monitoring sa sitwasyon.
english: The Joint Chiefs of Staff of the South said they are closely monitoring the situation.

text: Ginpahayag man sang unification ministry sang South nga ang mga drone ang possible ginpadala man mismo sang North agud nga mahimo nga excuse sa ila himuon nga mga pagpanggarit-garit.
english: The South's unification ministry also said the drones were possibly sent by the North itself as an excuse for their provocations.

text: Aminado ang Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) nga may mga overweight nga police personnel sa ila talatapan nga kinanlan na mag-ehersisyo.
english: The Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) has admitted that there are overweight police personnel in their office who need to exercise.

text: Ini kasunod man sang hugot nga mandu sang hepe sang Philippine National Police (PNP) nga si Police General Nicolas Torre III nga iya kakason sa serbisyo ang mga police officers nga wala nagapaniwang.
english: This follows the strict order of Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Police General Nicolas Torre III to dismiss police officers who do not lose weight.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga may mga pulis nga nagakalipat na sang ila nga calorie intake.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said there are policemen who are forgetting their calorie intake.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, ipaidalom sa weigh in ang mga pulis antes magpatuman sang programa nga mahimo makabulig sa ila wait loss.
english: According to Sangrines, the policemen will be weighed in before implementing the program that may help their wait loss.

text: Prayoridad man sang talatapan ang 98 ka mga kapulisan nga ipaidalom sa weight loss program sang Philippine National Police (PNP).
english: The office also prioritizes the 98 policemen who will undergo the weight loss program of the Philippine National Police (PNP).

text: Ginpahayag man ni Sangrines nga mahimo i-weigh in ang tanan nga katapo sang kapulisan bangud may mga yara nga pulis ang nagnubo na ang ila kabug-aton.
english: Sangrines also said that all police officers can be weighed in because some of the policemen have already lost weight.

text: Nahibaluan nga lakip sang kaundan sang Section 30 sang Republic Act No.
english: It is known that among the contents of Section 30 of Republic Act No.

text: 6975 ukon sang Department of Interior and Local Government Act sang 1990 nga ang kabug-aton indi dapat magsobra sa lima ka kilo para sa iya kataason.
english: 6975 or the Department of Interior and Local Government Act of 1990 that the weight shall not exceed five kilograms for its height.

text: Sa idalom sang pagsulundan, ang mga pulis nga magsobra sa standard weight pagahatagan sang anum tubtub isa ka tuig agud ma-normalize ang ila kabug-aton.
english: Under the rules, police officers who exceed the standard weight will be given six to one years to normalize their weight.

text: 84 pa ka mga airport projects ang matapos antes magtakop ang termino ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte sa 2022.
english: 84 more airport projects will be completed before the end of President Rodrigo Duterte's term in 2022.

text: Suno kay Transportation Sec.
english: According to Transportation Sec.

text: Arthur Tugade, ini nga mga proyekto ang nagalakip sang facilities sa Biliran Airport, Hilongos Airport sa Leyte, Cuyo Airport kag Puerto Princesa Airport sa Palawan, Lingayen Airport sa Pangasinan, Tacloban Airport, kag Tuguegarao Airport.
english: Arthur Tugade, these projects include facilities at Biliran Airport, Hilongos Airport in Leyte, Cuyo Airport and Puerto Princesa Airport in Palawan, Lingayen Airport in Pangasinan, Tacloban Airport, and Tuguegarao Airport.

text: As of November subong nga tuig, yara na sa 233 ka airport projects ang nakumpleto suno sa tiglikom.
english: As of November this year, 233 airport projects have been completed, the secretary said.

text: Lakip diri ang pagtukod sang Bicol International Airport kag renovation sang airports sa Butuan, Siquijor, Catarman, kag General Santos City.
english: These include the construction of the Bicol International Airport and renovation of airports in Butuan, Siquijor, Catarman, and General Santos City.

text: Sulod na sa finals sang PBA Governors’ Cup ang Barangay Ginebra Gin Kings matapos nga ginlutos sini ang NLEX Road warriors sa score nga 112-93 sa Game 4 sang best-of-5 semifinals series.
english: The Barangay Ginebra Gin Kings are now in the finals of the PBA Governors' Cup after they defeated the NLEX Road warriors 112-93 in Game 4 of the best-of-5 semifinals series.

text: Ang explosive performance ni Justin Brownlee nga naka-score sang conference-high 47 points ang may dako ang kontribusyon sa kadalag-an sang Gin Kings.
english: The explosive performance of Justin Brownlee, who scored a conference-high 47 points, contributed greatly to the success of the Gin Kings.

text: Nagpakita man ang Ginebra sang pila ka vintage performance naghalin kay Jeff Chan, nga may 20 points sa 7-of-11 shooting.
english: Ginebra also showed some vintage performance from Jeff Chan, who had 20 points on 7-of-11 shooting.

text: Nard Pinto nga may yara sang 12 points, kag LA Tenorio nga may 14 points.
english: Nard Pinto had 12 points, and LA Tenorio had 14 points.

english: This is the fourth time in five editions that Ginebra has reached the finals of the PBA Governor's Cup.

text: Ang masunod nga kasumpong sang Ginebra amo ang winner sa hampang sang Magnolia-Meralco semis series sa best-of-7 finals.
english: Ginebra’s next opponent is the winner in the Magnolia-Meralco semis series game in the best-of-7 finals.

english: The accusation was made by former DPWH Bulacan assistant district engineer Brice Ericson Hernandez during the hearing of the infrastructure committee of the House of Representatives yesterday, September 9.

According to Hernandez's allegations, Estrada is the one who signed the P355 million worth of projects in Hagonoy and Malolos, Bulacan in 2025 with a 30% “SOP” or kickback.

text: Sanday DPWH drivers Christian Santiago kag Andrei Balatbat amo ang ginatudlo nga point persons ni Estrada sa idalom sang direksyon ni former district engineer Henry Alcantara.
english: DPWH drivers Christian Santiago and Andrei Balatbat are Estrada's alleged point persons under the direction of former district engineer Henry Alcantara.

text: Para naman kay Villanueva, gin-claim ni Hernandez nga sang 2023, nag-release ang senador sang P600 million nga balor sang proyekto sa Balagtas, Bulacan nga may yara man sang pareho nga 30% cut.
english: As for Villanueva, Hernandez claimed that in 2023, the senator released a P600 million worth of projects in Balagtas, Bulacan with the same 30% cut.

text: Ini nga pondo suno kay Hernandez ang gin-deliver sa balay ni Villanueva sa Bocaue paagi kay construction section chief Jaypee Mendoza kag Alcantara.
english: Hernandez said the funds were delivered to Villanueva's house in Bocaue through construction section chief Jaypee Mendoza and Alcantara.

text: Si Alcantara suno kay Hernandez ang nagatindog nga “chief implementor” nga direkta nga naga-koordinar sa mga pulitiko.
english: Alcantara, according to Hernandez, is the chief implementor who directly coordinates with politicians.

text: Gin-alegar nga nagakuha ini sang 3% commission para sa iya kaugalingon kag nagamandu sa engineers nga hambalon ang contractors nga kinahanglan ang dugang nga 2% “finder’s fee” kun luyag nila nga maka-secure sang dugang nga mga project.
english: It was alleged that he takes a 3% commission for himself and directs engineers to tell contractors that an additional 2% “finder’s fee” is required if they want to secure more projects.

text: Antes ginpangbuyagyag ini nga mga rebelasyon, nag-apelar si Hernandez sa Kamara nga indi na siya pag-ibalik sa Senado kun sa diin gin-detain siya matapos gin-cite in contempt sang Lunes.
english: Before the revelations were made, Hernandez appealed to the House not to return him to the Senate where he was detained after being cited in contempt on Monday.

text: Nagsabat naman si Congressman Terry Ridon nga magapakig-angot ang panel sa Senate Blue Ribbon Committee para matugutan si Hernandez nga magpabilin sa kustodiya sang Kamara.#
english: Congressman Terry Ridon said the panel will liaise with the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee to allow Hernandez to remain in the custody of the House.

text: Indi lamang mga armas ang ginapadala sang North Korea sa Russia kundi pati mga soldado agud nga mabuligan ang Moscow sa giyera sini batok sa Ukraine.
english: North Korea is not only sending weapons to Russia but also soldiers to help Moscow in its war against Ukraine.

text: Suno kay Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, mas nagadaku ang alyansa sang duha ka pungsod kag naglab-ot na sa punto nga nagpadala ini sang tropa para nga may dugang sa pwersa sang Russians nga amo ang nagasalakay sa teritoryo sang Kyiv.
english: According to Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskyy, the alliance between the two countries is growing and has reached the point where it has sent troops to reinforce the Russian forces that are attacking the territory of Kyiv.

text: Pahayag sang Ukrainian president, kinahanglan nga magdaku man ang hulag ang Ukraine kag mga kaalyado ini para mabatuan ang mga nagadalom nga alyansa sang Russia sa iban nga nasyon.
english: The Ukrainian president said Ukraine and its allies must also grow in action to counter Russia's deepening alliances with other countries.

text: Nagpanawagan man liwat si Zelenskyy sang dugang nga military support, indi lamang sa military equipment, kundi mas daku nga pressure nga indi na masarangan sang Russia para indi na magdaku ang giyera sa Europa.
english: Zelenskyy also again called for more military support, not just in terms of military equipment, but greater pressure that Russia can no longer afford to keep the war from escalating in Europe.

text: Una na diri, matandaan nga wala nagmadinalag-on si Zelenskyy sa hingyo sini sa ila mga kaalyado nga tugutan sila nga maggamit sang longer-range missiles para nga atakehon ang military targets sang Russia agud nga mabuhinan ang ila kapasidad sa giyera.
english: Earlier, Zelenskyy failed to ask his allies to allow them to use longer-range missiles to attack Russian military targets in order to reduce their war capacity.

text: Magakitaay kuntani ang Western leaders sa Germany sang nagligad nga semana agud nga diskusyunan ini nga problema, apang naatrasar ang pagsinapol bangud wala nakabyahe si United States President Joe Biden agud pasulabihon anay ang sitwasyon sa Florida nga ginlaslasan sang Hurricane Milton.
english: Western leaders were scheduled to meet in Germany last week to discuss the problem, but the meeting was delayed because US President Joe Biden was unable to travel to address the situation in Florida, which was hit by Hurricane Milton.

text: Subong nga semana ginalauman nga magakadto ini sa Germany para madayon na ang meeting kun sa diin ang Ukraine-Russia war ang nagapanguna sa agenda.#
english: This week he is expected to travel to Germany for the meeting where the Ukraine-Russia war is at the top of the agenda.

text: LEGANES, ILOILO – Madamo sang food trends ang naimbento subong nga quarantine period kag isa na diri ang Lockdown burger sang pamilya Escopel sang Leganes, Iloilo.
english: LEGANES, ILOILO – Many food trends have been invented during this quarantine period and one of them is the Lockdown burger of the Escopel family of Leganes, Iloilo.

text: Sa Good Morning Philippines program, ginpahayag ni Kevin Escopel, isa sa mga founder sang Lockdown burger, nga ang nasambit nga food trend ang inisyatibo nila nga mag-utod para ma solbar ang ‘craving’ sang customer ilabi na nga sirado ang kalabanan nga negosyo subong nga quarantine period.
english: In the Good Morning Philippines program, Kevin Escopel, one of the founders of the Lockdown burger, said that the food trend is their initiative to solve the craving of customers especially since most businesses are closed during the quarantine period.

text: Suno kay Escopel, wala niya ginhuna-huna nga maluyagan sang ila customer ang Lockdown burger tubtub nga sa kada semana, nagadoble ang numero sang mga naga order.
english: According to Escopel, he did not think that their customers would like the Lockdown burger until every week, the number of orders doubled.

text: Ginpahayag ni Escopel nga daku nga factor sa manamit nga burger amo ang manami nga bun, patty, preska nga raw ingredients, sauce kag mas makapaayo man kun may yara sang ibutang nga secret ingredients.
english: Escopel said that a big factor in a delicious burger is a good bun, patty, fresh raw ingredients, sauce and it is also better if there are secret ingredients.

text: Magluwas sa burger buns, patty kag sauce, kabahin sang ingridients sang Lockdown burger amo ang pipino, kamatis, lettuce, caramelized onions cheddar cheeze kag may yara man sang sekreto nga ingridients nga nagahatag sang pinasahi nga sabor sa nasambit nga burger.
english: In addition to the burger buns, patty and sauce, part of the ingredients of the Lockdown burger are cucumber, tomato, lettuce, caramelized onions cheddar cheeze and there are also secret ingredients that give the said burger a unique taste.

text: Agud nga wala sang usik suno sa natungdan, kinahanglan anay nga magpa book sang order paagi sa pag contact sa 09563610949.
english: In order to avoid waste, he said, it is necessary to book an order by contacting 09563610949.

text: Kritikal ang mangin suporta sang multilateral institutions agud nga ma-engganyo man ang pribado nga mga sektor nga magsuporta sa clean energy transition projects sa Pilipinas.
english: The support of multilateral institutions will be critical to encourage the private sector to support clean energy transition projects in the Philippines.

text: Pahayag ini Finance Secretary Carlos G. Dominguez III kasunod sang pagkomiter sang Pilipinas nga maggamit na sang clean energy kag dulaon na ang coal sa electricity generation sa bug-os nga kalibutan.
english: Finance Secretary Carlos G. Dominguez III's statement follows the Philippines' commitment to use clean energy and eliminate coal from electricity generation worldwide.

text: Sa ginapatigayon nga COP26 ukon ang latest UN climate change summit sa Glasgow, Scottland, masobra 190 ka mga pungsod kag organisasyon ang nagkasugot nga i-phase out na ang coal sa dalagku kag gamhanan nga mga pungsod sa 2030s, kag sa nabilin nga bahin sang kalibutan sa 2040s.
english: At the ongoing COP26 or the latest UN climate change summit in Glasgow, Scotland, more than 190 countries and organizations agreed to phase out coal in large and powerful countries by the 2030s, and in the rest of the world by the 2040s.

text: Suno naman kay Dominguez, kun magbuligay ang multilateral agencies, mahatagan sang kumpyansa ang private investors nga maglikop sang pondo para sa programa sang pungsod agud nga maka-shift na sa clean energy.
english: Dominguez said that if multilateral agencies work together, private investors will be given confidence to raise funds for the country's program to shift to clean energy.

text: Ginpahayag ni Dominguez nga crucial ang papel sang mga institusyon kaangay sang World Bank, Asian Development Bank (ADB), kag Asian Investment Infrastructure Bank (AIIB) agud mabuksan ang ganhaan para sa pribado nga sektor nga mag-amot man para sa himuon nga actual projects.
english: Dominguez said the role of institutions such as the World Bank, Asian Development Bank (ADB), and Asian Investment Infrastructure Bank (AIIB) is crucial to open the door for the private sector to contribute for the actual projects.

text: USA– Nagtaliwan na sa edad nga 87 anyos ang ginakabig amay sang ‘rock ‘n’roll’ music nga si Little Richard.
english: USA – Little Richard, considered the father of rock 'n' roll music, has died at the age of

text: Ini mismo ang ginkumpirma sang iya anak nga si Danny Penniman pinaagi sa isa ka American Monthly magazine.
english: This was confirmed by his son Danny Penniman through an American Monthly magazine.

text: Indi pa subong mapat-od ang pamilya kun ano gid ang matuod nga rason sang kamatayon sang singer.
english: The family is yet to determine the true cause of the singer's death.

text: Lakip sa mga ambahanon ni Little Richard ukon Richard Wayne Penniman sa matuod nga kabuhi, amo ang Tutti Frutti, Long Tall Sally, Rip it Up, Lucille kag Good Golly Miss Molly.
english: Among the songs of Little Richard or Richard Wayne Penniman in real life, are Tutti Frutti, Long Tall Sally, Rip it Up, Lucille and Good Golly Miss Molly.

text: Ginkabig man ni Richard ang iya kaugalingon nga arkitekto sang ‘rock ‘n’roll’, kun sa diin nagtatak sa isip sang fans ang istilo niya sa musika.
english: Richard also considered himself the architect of rock 'n' roll, where his musical style stamped on the minds of fans.

text: Nahibaluan nga nangin inspirasyon man sang madamo nga singer ang nagtaliwan nga 87 anyos nga American singer.
english: The late 87-year-old American singer was also an inspiration to many singers.

text: Naghimo sang kasaysayan ang isa ka LGBTQIA+ member matapos nga naggradwar ini bilang summa cum laude sang Capiz State University Batch 2025.
english: An LGBTQIA+ member made history after he graduated summa cum laude of Capiz State University Batch 2025.

text: Ini amo si Khaz-JP Padilla nga pinakauna nga transgender nga may highest academic distinction sa maragtas sang unibersidad.
english: This is Khaz-JP Padilla who is the first transgender with the highest academic distinction in the history of the university.

text: Si Padilla ang nagtapos sa degree program nga Bachelor of Science in Social Work sa Capiz State University-Pilar Satellite College.
english: Padilla graduated from the Bachelor of Science in Social Work degree program at Capiz State University-Pilar Satellite College.

text: Suno kay Padilla, ang iya handom indi lamang para sa iya kaugalingon kundi sa bilog nga LGBTQIA+ community nga mabungkag ang tanan nga sahi sang diskriminasyon kag stigma batok sa ila.
english: Padilla said her dream is not only for herself but for the entire LGBTQIA+ community to dismantle all forms of discrimination and stigma against them.

text: Dakop ang mag-asawa sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy-bust operation sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 4 sa Brgy.
english: The couple were arrested in a drug buy-bust operation conducted by the Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 4 in Brgy.

text: South Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: South Baluarte, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang mga subject amo kanday Alyas Libat, manugbaligya sang isda, kag Alyas Sugar, lunsay residente sang nasambit nga barangay.
english: The suspects were identified as Libat, a fish vendor, and Sugar, both residents of the said barangay.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, hepe sang ICPS 4, iya ginpahayag nga utod sang aktibo nga barangay kagawad si Alyas Libat kag yara ang mga ini sa Barangay Drug Abuse Council (BADAC) List.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Ryan Christ Inot, chief of ICPS 4, said Libat is the brother of an active barangay kagawad and they are on the Barangay Drug Abuse Council (BADAC) List.

text: Naglab-ot naman sa duha ka semana ang monitoring sa duha antes natigayon ang operasyon.
english: The two were monitored for two weeks before the operation was performed.

text: Natigayon nga makumpiskar sa ila paghinakop ang 30 ka gramos sang ginapasuni iligal nga droga nga may standard drug price nga P204,000.
english: They were able to confiscate 30 grams of suspected illegal drugs with a standard drug price of P204,000.

text: Sa subong, yara ang mga ini sa paghinakop sang ICPS 4 kag posible magapangatubang sang panumbungon nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Act of 2002.
english: They are currently under the custody of ICPS 4 and may face charges of violating Republic Act 9165 or the Comprehensive Dangerous Act of 2002.

english: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)

text: Nag-upod ang Pilipinas sa World Trade Market nga ginhiwat sa London.
english: The Philippines joined the World Trade Market held in London.

text: Ang World Trade Market London ang leading global event para sa travel industry sa diin nagakit-anay ang industry professionals, naga-explore kag naga-close sang business deals.
english: World Trade Market London is the leading global event for the travel industry where industry professionals meet, explore and close business deals.

text: Sa una nga overseas trip humalin sang nag-umpisa ang pandemya, nagtambong si Department of Tourism Sec.
english: In the first overseas trip since the beginning of the pandemic, Department of Tourism Sec.

text:
Berna Romulo-Puyat sa high-level ministerial meetings kag nagpungko bilang isa sa mga panelists sa ministerial discussion tuhoy sa “Investing in Tourism’s Sustainable Future.”

Ginpakigbahin sang tiglikom nga ang Pilipinas mangin fully open kun safe na ini para sa tanan nga magbaton sang turista.
english:
Berna Romulo-Puyat in high-level ministerial meetings and sat as one of the panelists in the ministerial discussion on “Investing in Tourism’s Sustainable Future.”

The secretary shared that the Philippines will be fully open when it is safe for all to receive tourists.

text: Ginbuyagyag man sini nga ang Pilipinas ang maga-host sa masunod nga tuig sang World Travel and Tourism Council (WTTC) Summit sa Manila.
english: He also revealed that the Philippines will host next year's World Travel and Tourism Council (WTTC) Summit in Manila.

text: Magapadala sang tropa sang militar kag advanced anti-missile system ang Estados Unidos sa Israel.
english: The United States will send military troops and advanced anti-missile systems to Israel.

text: Suno kay US President Joe Biden, tuyo sang deployment sang amo nga system amo nga depensahan ang Israel.
english: According to US President Joe Biden, the purpose of the deployment of the system is to defend Israel.

text: Pahayag naman ni Pentagon spokesperson Pat Ryder, ang Terminal High-Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) battery amo ang maga-augment sa integrated air defense system nga ginagamit sang Tel Aviv.
english: Pentagon spokesperson Pat Ryder said the Terminal High-Altitude Area Defense (THAAD) battery will augment the integrated air defense system used by Tel Aviv.

text: Kabahin ini dugang niya sa US military adjustments para nga suportahan ang Israel kag proteksyunan ang mga Amerikano batok sa pagpang-atake sang Iran kag sang mga militia nga kaalyado sini.
english: He added that this is part of the US military adjustments to support Israel and protect Americans against attacks by Iran and its allied militias.

text: Una naman nga nagpaandam ang foreign minister sang Iran nga ginabutang sang US sa risgo ang kabuhi sang ila tawo sa militar kun ipadala sila agud mag-operate sang US missile systems sa Israel.
english: Earlier, Iran's foreign minister warned that the US is putting the lives of its military personnel at risk if they are sent to operate US missile systems in Israel.

text: Matandaan nga sang Abril, nagpalupad ang Iran sang missiles kag drones sa amo nga Jewish state.
english: In April, Iran fired missiles and drones at the Jewish state.

text: Sang Oktubre 1 naman, masobra sa 200 ka ballistic missiles ang ginpaulan liwat sa Tel Aviv samtang nagalala ang tensyon batok sa Hezbollah militants.
english: On October 1, more than 200 ballistic missiles were again rained on Tel Aviv as tensions against Hezbollah militants escalated.

text: Kadam-an sang amo nga missiles ang na-intercept sang Israel apang may iban gid nga nakalusot sa missile defenses.
english: Most of the missiles were intercepted by Israel but some did break through the missile defenses.

text: MANILA– Plano sang aktres kag youtube sensation nga si Ivana Alawi, nga supton ang iya sweldo sa pagka artista kag bilang youtuber agud makabakal sang regalo para sa iya iloy.
english: MANILA – Actress and youtube sensation Ivana Alawi plans to save her salary as an actress and as a youtuber to buy a gift for her mother.

text: Suno kay Ivana, luyag niya nga baklan sang balay ang iya iloy bilang regalo.
english: Ivana said she wanted to buy her mother a house as a gift.

text: Pahayag pa niya, wala siya sang may ginastos nagikan sa sweldo sini sa youtube bangud para ini sa iloy.
english: He said he did not spend anything from his youtube salary because it was for his mother.

text: Ginklaro man ni Ivana nga wala sang kamatuoran ang mga nagalagaw nga balita nga nagdangat a P1 million pesos ang iya kita sa youtube.
english: Ivana also clarified that there is no truth in the rumors that she earned P1 million pesos on YouTube.

text: Nakaalerto ang Taiwan matapos na-detect ang isa ka Chinese aircraft carrier sa nabagatnan nga bahin sang isla.
english: Taiwan is on alert after a Chinese aircraft carrier was detected in the southern part of the island.

text: Suno sa defense ministry, nagsulod ang Liaoning aircraft carrier group sa dagat nga malapit sa Bashi Channel kag posible nga magpadayon sa western Pacific.
english: According to the defense ministry, the Liaoning aircraft carrier group entered the sea close to the Bashi Channel and is likely to continue into the western Pacific.

text: Pahayag pa sang defense officials, preparado na sila nga maghulag kag magresponde pananglitan kinahanglanon gid.
english: Defense officials said they are ready to act and respond if necessary.

text: Nahibaluan nga pila ka tuig na nga ginapabaskog sang China ang ila military activities sa Taiwan kaangay sang pagpadala sang warplanes kag military aircraft samtang masami naman nga maispatan ang Chinese ships malapit sa katubigan sang amo nga teritoryo.
english: It is known that China has been stepping up its military activities in Taiwan for several years such as sending warplanes and military aircraft while Chinese ships are often spotted near the waters of the territory.

text: Ang pagpakita sang Liaoning aircraft carrier ang natabo kasunod sang paandam ni US State Secretary Antony Blinken sa China kaangot sa “provocative” action sa Taiwan.
english: The appearance of the Liaoning aircraft carrier follows US State Secretary Antony Blinken's warning to China regarding its "provocative" action in Taiwan.

text: Ini ang kasunod naman sa speech ni Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te sa National Day celebrations kun sa diin gintawag sini ang China nga “separatist” kag nagpalabtik man nga indi siya magsugot sa “annexation” nga himuon sang Beijing sa isla.
english: This follows Taiwanese President Lai Ching-te's speech at the National Day celebrations where he called China a "separatist" and said he would not agree to Beijing's annexation of the island.

text: Natigayon liwat ang pag-refer sang Provincial Board sa concurrence of appointment sang bag-o nga Secretary sang Sangguniang Panlalawigan nga si Atty. Henida Genise sa duha ka komitiba: ang Committee on Human Resource Management and General Services kag Committee on Rules.
english: The Provincial Board has again referred the concurrence of appointment of the new Secretary of the Sangguniang Panlalawigan, Atty. Henida Genise on two committees: the Committee on Human Resource Management and General Services and Committee on Rules.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay 4th District Board Member Domingo Oso, Jr., iya ginpahayag ng igatugyan nila ang appointment ni Atty. Genise sa 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan members 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan members.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, 4th District Board Member Domingo Oso, Jr., said they will hand over the appointment of Atty. Genise to the 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan members 15th Sangguniang Panlalawigan members.

text: Suno kay Oso, base sa internal rules sang sanggunian, kinahanglan ang concurrence ukon pag-apruba sang mga myembro sa pag-appoint sang SP Secretary.
english: According to Oso, based on the internal rules of the sanggunian, concurrence or approval of the members is required for the appointment of the SP Secretary.

text: Ginpaathag man ni Oso nga suno sa Omnibus Rules on Appointment and other Human Resource Action sang Civil Service Commission (CSC), Section 113, ginadumilian ang appointment sa mga opisina sang gobyerno pagkatapos sang eleksyon tubtob Hunyo 30, maluwas lang kon natuman ang mga requirements.
english: Oso also explained that according to the Omnibus Rules on Appointment and other Human Resource Action of the Civil Service Commission (CSC), Section 113, appointments in government offices after the election are prohibited until June 30, unless the requirements are met.

text:
Lakip sa mga kinahanglanon amo ang masunod:

Ang appointee dapat nakapasar sa minimum qualification standards sang posisyon nga gina-aplikaran, suno sa special law.
english:
Among the requirements are the following:

The appointee must have passed the minimum qualification standards of the position being applied for, according to special law.

text: Kinahanglan nga ang appointee na-screen sang Human Resource Merit Promotion and Selection Board (HRMPSB) antes ang election ban.
english: The appointee must have been screened by the Human Resource Merit Promotion and Selection Board (HRMPSB) before the election ban.

text: Ang appointment dapat ginakabig nga “urgent” kag dapat nagasunod sa Civil Service Law kag mga special laws.
english: The appointment must be considered “urgent” and must comply with the Civil Service Law and special laws.

text: Gin-athag man sang opisyal nga wala siya sang plano nga punggan ang appointment apang bilang mamalidha sa probinsya nagakinahanglan nga id-idon ang technicalities sa appointment.
english: The official also explained that he has no plans to stop the appointment but as a lawmaker in the province, he needs to check the technicalities of the appointment.

text: Madumduman nga gin-appoint ni Vice Governor Christine Garin si Atty. Genise sang Hunyo 2.
english: It can be recalled that Vice Governor Christine Garin appointed Atty. Genise on June 2nd.

text: Mahimo na nga magpasaka sang presyo ang mga manufacturer sang mga produkto nga pang Noche Buena.
english: Manufacturers of Noche Buena products can now raise prices.

text: Suno kay Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary Ruth Castelo, pahanugutan sang ahensya nga maghulag ang presyo sang Noche Buena products bangud indi man ini kabahin sa basic ukon prime commodities.
english: According to Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) Undersecretary Ruth Castelo, the agency will allow the price of Noche Buena products to move because they are not part of the basic or prime commodities.

text: Tuig 2019 sang ulihe nga nagtaas ang presyo sang mga Noche Buena item.
english: 2019 was the last year that the price of Noche Buena items increased.

text: Pahayag naman ni Philippine Amalgamated Supermarkets Association President Steven Cua, isa sa mga rason kun ngaa kinahanglan magtaas ang presyo amo bangud sa galastuhon man sang mga manufacturer, kaangay sang pagbayad sa 13th month sang mga empleyado.
english: Philippine Amalgamated Supermarkets Association President Steven Cua said one of the reasons why the price needs to increase is because of the expenses of the manufacturers, such as paying the 13th month of employees.

text: Ginbulgar ni Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson nga may kaangtanan si anay Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) secretary Manuel Bonoan sa isa ka “growing family business” sang government flood projects.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson revealed that former Department of Public Works and Highways (DPWH) secretary Manuel Bonoan is linked to a “growing family business” of government flood projects.

text: Base sa research sang opisina ni Lacson nga iya ginpresentar paagi sa privilege speech, naangot si Bonoan sa MBB Global Properties Corporation nga ginapanag-iyahan sang pamilya Maglanque sang Candaba, Pampanga.
english: Based on research by Lacson's office that he presented through a privilege speech, Bonoan is linked to MBB Global Properties Corporation owned by the Maglanque family of Candaba, Pampanga.

text: Ang amo man nga pamilya ang nagapanag-iya sang Globalcrete Builders nga nakakuha sang P2.195 billion nga balor sang flood control projects sa Bulacan halin sang 2018 tubtub sang 2024.
english: The same family owns Globalcrete Builders which won P2.195 billion worth of flood control projects in Bulacan from 2018 to 2024.

text: Sa MBB Global Properties Corporation, ginlista ang anak ni Bonoan bilang isa sa mga tag-iya.
english: At MBB Global Properties Corporation, Bonoan’s son is listed as one of the owners.

text: Ang isa pa ang anak sang mayor, samtang ang isa naman anak ni DPWH Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo.
english: The other is the son of the mayor, while the other is the son of DPWH Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo.

text: Ang MBB suno kay Lacson ang acronym mismo sang tatlo ka mga apelyido nga amo ang Maglanque, Bernardo, kag Bonoan.
english: MBB, according to Lacson, is the acronym of three surnames, namely Maglanque, Bernardo, and Bonoan.

text: “Maglanque, Bernardo, Bonoan — MBB.
english: “Maglanque, Bernardo, Bonoan — MBB.

text: Coincidentally, these are the prominent surnames in today’s flood control saga: Candaba Mayor Rene Maglanque, patriarch of the Maglanques behind Globalcrete Builders, the contractor for multi-billion peso flood control projects,” suno sa senador.
english: Coincidentally, these are the prominent surnames in today’s flood control saga: Candaba Mayor Rene Maglanque, patriarch of the Maglanques behind Globalcrete Builders, the contractor for multi-billion peso flood control projects,” according to the senator.

text: “Kaya naman pala ang palaging depensa ni dating DPWH Sec.
english: “That's why former DPWH Sec.

text: Bonoan — isolated case lang daw ang nakita ni Pangulong Bongbong Marcos na ghost project sa Bulacan,” pahayag pa ni Lacson.
english: Bonoan — President Bongbong Marcos saw only isolated cases of ghost projects in Bulacan,” Lacson said.

text:
“Bonoan probably doesn’t want Globalcrete to be further exposed in the investigation.”

Si Bonoan amo ang public works secretary halin sang July 1, 2022, kag nag-resign lamang sang Septyembre 1, samtang si DPWH Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo naman ang nag-file sang early retirement matapos maangot man sa ma-anomaliya nga flood control project.
english:
“Bonoan probably doesn’t want Globalcrete to be further exposed in the investigation.”

Bonoan has been the public works secretary since July 1, 2022, and resigned on September 1, while DPWH Undersecretary Roberto Bernardo filed his early retirement after being linked to the anomalous flood control project.

text: Patigayunon sa banwa sang Anda sa Bohol Province ang makabig ‘epic’ Spartan Race Philippines sa Abril 2.
english: The epic Spartan Race Philippines will be held in Anda town in Bohol Province on April 2.

text: Ang banwa sang Anda ang 99 ka kilometros ang kalayuon halin sa Tagbilaran City, kag amo ang napili-an nga mangin battleground para sa mga endurance athletes nga maga-compete sa obstacle race.
english: The town of Anda is 99 kilometers away from Tagbilaran City, and was chosen as the battleground for the endurance athletes who will compete in the obstacle race.

text: Suno kay Micca De Joya, race director sang Spartan Philippines, ang terrain sa Anda town ang perfect para patigayunon sang Spartan Race.
english: According to Micca De Joya, race director of Spartan Philippines, the terrain in Anda town is perfect to hold the Spartan Race.

text: Ang mga obstacle courses ang lakipan sang Bohol Sprint 5K, Hurricane Heat, kag Bohol Trail 10K.
english: The obstacle courses will include the Bohol Sprint 5K, Hurricane Heat, and Bohol Trail 10K.

text: Ang Spartan Race ang world’s best obstacle race kag nagapanguna nga sa Extreme Wellness Category.
english: The Spartan Race is the world’s best obstacle race and tops the Extreme Wellness Category.

text: Bukas naman ang registration sini sa ila official website nga spartanrace.ph.
english: Registration is open on their official website spartanrace.ph.

text: Gina-lauman suno kay nga madamo ang magapartisipar sa amo nga event.
english: He said it is expected that many will participate in the event.

text: Sa pinakaulihi nga data, nagdanagat na sa 600 ang mga nakaparehistro.
english: According to the latest data, there are more than 600 registered.

text: Mangin mandatory ang swab test kag strikto nga pagasundon sang mga atleta ang mga protocols nga ginapatuman sang municipal government sang Anda.
english: The swab test will be mandatory and the athletes will strictly follow the protocols implemented by the municipal government of Anda.

text: Nagapati ang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) nga dako ang mabulig sang digital banks agud mabatak ang nagasarurot nga ekonomiya sang pungsod.
english: The Central Bank of the Philippines (BSP) believes that digital banks can help boost the country's slowing economy.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang digital banks amo ang sahi sang financial institutions nga wala sang pisikal nga mga branch kag gindisenyo agud mapahapos ang banking system para sa mga unbanked kag undeserved.
english: It is known that digital banks are the type of financial institutions that do not have physical branches and are designed to ease the banking system for the unbanked and undeserved.

text: Suno kay BSP Gov.
english: According to BSP Gov.

text: Benjamin Diokno, ginaduso sang digital banks ang “tech-savvy” nga sahi sang ekonomiya.
english: Benjamin Diokno, digital banks are promoting a “tech-savvy” type of economy.

text: “We expect the digital banks to help fuel recovery and long-term growth for the Philippines, alongside conventional banks,” pahayag ni Diokno.
english: “We expect the digital banks to help fuel recovery and long-term growth for the Philippines, alongside conventional banks,” Diokno stated.

text: Pahayag niya, wala lang nagatutok ang pungsod nga makarekober sa krisis kundi ang bug-os gobyerno ang nagabubo sang effort padulong sa post-COVID Philippine economy nga mas mabaskog, mas technologically advanced, mas inclusive, kag sustainable.
english: He said the country is not only focused on recovering from the crisis but the entire government is pouring efforts towards a post-COVID Philippine economy that is stronger, more technologically advanced, more inclusive, and sustainable.

text: Una na gin-aprubahan sang BSP ang framework para sa digital banking sa pungsod bag-o ini nag-isyu sang anom ka digital banking licenses.
english: The BSP first approved the framework for digital banking in the country before issuing six digital banking licenses.

text: “Technology aids exponential growth in output.
english: “Technology aids exponential growth in output.

text: In finance, it makes transactions easier and faster which speeds up income generation,” dugang pa ni Diokno.
english: In finance, it makes transactions easier and faster which speeds up income generation,” Diokno added.

text: Daw indi makapati ang filipino ring nurse sang international singer nga si Michael Bublé matapos nga nabaton niya ang isa ka dako nga regalo gikan sa singer.
english: The Filipino ring nurse of international singer Michael Bublé couldn't believe it after he received a big gift from the singer.

text: Bilang pagpasalamat sa pinay nurse nga si Minette ginhatag ni Michael ang iya nga balay bangud sa pag-atipan niya sa iya lolo sa Vancouver.
english: Bilang pagpasalamat sa pinay nurse nga si Minette ginhatag ni Michael ang iya nga balay bangud sa pag-atipan niya sa iya lolo sa Vancouver.
