text: Samtang nagpauli si Minette sa Pilipinas, ginparenovate sang mag utod nga Michael kag Scott ang balay kag sorpresa ini nga ginhatag sa nurse sa iya pagpanumbalik sa Estasos Unidos.
english: While Minette returned to the Philippines, brothers Michael and Scott renovated the house and gave it to the nurse as a surprise on her return to the United States.

text: Suno kay Michael, isa sa mga nangin ‘last wish’ sang iya nga lolo amo ang mabuligan ang iya pinay nurse nga ginkabig na nila nga parte sang ila pamilya.
english: According to Michael, one of his grandfather's last wishes was to help his Filipino nurse whom they considered part of their family.

text: Naghakot sang medalya ang beach volleyball teams sang Pilipinas sa bag-o lang nagtakop nga 2022 Australia Beach Volleyball Tour Championships sa Brisbane, Australia.
english: The Philippine beach volleyball teams won medals at the recently concluded 2022 Australia Beach Volleyball Tour Championships in Brisbane, Australia.

text: Nakuha sang team ang duha ka gold, isa ka silver, kag duha ka bronze medals.Nakumpleto sang national squads ang perfect run sa men’s and women’s Challenger Division 1.
english: The team won two gold, one silver, and two bronze medals. The national squads completed a perfect run in the men’s and women’s Challenger Division 1.

text: Ang volleyball veteran kag Ilongga nga si Jovelyn Gonzaga ang nakakuha sang gold sa iya first partnership kay Dij Rodriguez sa ila hampang sa Women’s Challenger Division matapos ginpierde sanday Alice Zeimann sang New Zealand kag Anna Donlan sang Australia.
english: Volleyball veteran and Ilongga Jovelyn Gonzaga won gold in her first partnership with Dij Rodriguez in their match in the Women's Challenger Division after defeating Alice Zeimann of New Zealand and Anna Donlan of Australia.

text: Daug man sa gold medal match sa Men’s Challenger Division 1 sanday Ranran Abdilla kag Jaron Requinton.
english: Ranran Abdilla and Jaron Requinton also won the gold medal match in the Men’s Challenger Division 1.

text: Ini ang kabahin sang ila isa ka bulan nga training program sa Brisbane para sa 31st Southeast Asian Games sa Hanoi, Vietnam sa Mayo 12-23.
english: This is part of their month-long training program in Brisbane for the 31st Southeast Asian Games in Hanoi, Vietnam on May 12-23.

text: Matandaan nga nakuha sang Pilipinas ang duha ka bronze medals sa beach volleyball sang 2019 SEA Games diri sa Pilipinas.
english: The Philippines won two bronze medals in beach volleyball at the 2019 SEA Games here in the Philippines.

text: Nagmadinalag-on ang ginpatigayon nga operasyon sang mga katapo sang Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) upod ang Regional District Officer sa isa ka warehouse sa syudad sang Iloilo, kun sa diin na-recover ang madamo nga peke kag wala nag-agi sa proseso nga sigarilyo.
english: Members of the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) together with the Regional District Officer conducted a successful operation at a warehouse in Iloilo City, where they recovered a large number of fake and unprocessed cigarettes.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Atty. Nico Benidect Lim, Officer-in-Charge Assistant sang BIR, ginpahayag sini nga ang mga sigarilyo nga nakuha sa nasambit nga bodega wala sang tax stamp halin sa BIR kag indi legal nga ginabaligya.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Atty. Nico Benidect Lim, Officer-in-Charge Assistant of the BIR, said the cigarettes seized from the warehouse did not have a tax stamp from the BIR and were not legally sold.

text: Suno pa kay Atty. Lim, wala man sang official nga tatak kag warning label ang mga pakete sang sigarilyo, isa sa mga importante nga requirement sang layi sa mga produkto nga ginabaligya sa publiko.
english: According to Atty. Lim said the packages of cigarettes do not have official brands and warning labels, one of the important requirements of the law on products sold to the public.

text: Gani, makabig ini nga illicit cigarettes bangud nga wala ini nag-agi sa legal nga proseso kag wala man nakabayad sang excise tax nga ginapahamtang sang gobyerno.
english: Therefore, these cigarettes are considered illicit cigarettes because they did not go through the legal process and did not pay the excise tax imposed by the government.

text: Ginkumpirma man sang abogado nga madugay na nga gina-monitor sang kapulisan ang amo nga warehouse tubtob nga ginpalab-ot ini sa atensyon sang BIR.
english: The lawyer also confirmed that the police had been monitoring the warehouse for a long time until it was brought to the attention of the BIR.

text:
Kapin sa P5 million ang balor sang nakumpiskar nga mga smuggled nga sigarilyo.(BIR)

Sa subong, padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang BIR agud matukiban kun sa diin halin ang mga sigarilyo kag kun sin-o ang responsable sa pagpamuno sang mga iligal nga produkto.
english:
The value of the seized smuggled cigarettes was more than P5 million. (BIR)

At present, the BIR is still investigating to find out where the cigarettes came from and who is responsible for the illegal products.

text: 𝗖𝗔𝗟𝗜𝗙𝗢𝗥𝗡𝗜𝗔, 𝗨𝗦𝗔 – Arestado ang isa ka armado nga lalaki sa California nga amo ang sa likod sang ginapahayag ikatatlo na naman nga assassination attempt batok kay former United States President Donald Trump.
english: January – An armed man behind the alleged third assassination attempt against former United States President Donald Trump was arrested in California.

text: Ini amo si  Vem Miller, 49, residente sang Las Vegas.
english: This is Vem Miller, 49, resident of Las Vegas.

text: Suno sa Riverside Sheriff Office, naaresto si Miller antes ang rally ni Trump sa California sa intersection sang Avenue 52 kag Celebration Drive.
english: According to the Riverside Sheriff's Office, Miller was arrested before a Trump rally in California at the intersection of Avenue 52 and Celebration Drive.

text: Gindala si Miller sa John J. Benoit Detention Center bangud sa pagdala sang armas kag high-capacity magazine.
english: Miller was transported to the John J. Benoit Detention Center for carrying a firearm and high-capacity magazine.

text: Gin-athag naman sang mga otoridad nga wala ini sang anuman nga epekto sa mga nagtambong sa kahiwatan.
english: Authorities clarified that this had no impact on those who attended the event.

text: Dako ang pagpati sang Tubungan Municipal Police Station nga kakilala kag pamilya ang possible suspek sa naghimulos-patay sa 18-anyos nga dalaga sa Brgy.
english: The Tubungan Municipal Police Station believes that the possible suspect in the rape and murder of an 18-year-old girl in Brgy.

text: Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo.
english: Ingay, Tubungan, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Alberto Mangilimotan Jr., hepe sang Tubungan MPS, iya ginpahayag nga ipaidalom na sa autopsy ang biktima subong nga adlaw agud mas madeterminar ang eksakto nga rason sang iya kamatayon.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Alberto Mangilimotan Jr., chief of Tubungan MPS, said the victim will be subjected to an autopsy today to determine the exact cause of his death.

text: Ginpahayag man sang kapulisan nga may yara na sila sang ginakabig nga “person of interest” nga posible may kahilabtanan sa krimen.
english: Police also said they already have a person of interest who may be involved in the crime.

text: Indi magpati ang mga otoridad nga pangayaw ang nagpatay sa biktima bangud wala nagtaghol ang lima ka mga hinuptanan nga ido sang pamilya, kun sa diin posible kilala sang mga ido ang tawo nga naghimo sang krimen.
english: Authorities do not believe that the victim was killed by a stranger because the family's five pet dogs did not bark, where the dogs may have known the perpetrator.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan nga kun maguwa na ang result sang autopsy sang biktima, ginalantaw nga ang suspek ang indi maglayo sa dalaga, kun sa diin ginalantaw man nga possible kilala sang dalaga ang suspek nga naghimulos-patay sa iya.
english: He added that when the result of the autopsy of the victim comes out, it is expected that the suspect will not be far from the girl, where it is also believed that the girl may know the suspect who raped her.

text: Madumduman nga nasapwan-patay lang ang lawas sang biktima nga ginkilala kay alyas Jeje sa sulod sang iya kwarto, kun sa diin may hanog sa mata kag wala sang pang-idalom nga panapton.
english: The victim, identified as Jeje, was found dead inside his room, with a burn in his eye and no underwear.

text: Padayon ang koordinasyon sang Tubungan PNP sa mga himata, abyan, kag kilala sang biktima agud makuha ang dugang nga impormasyon nga makabulig sa imbestigasyon.
english: Tubungan PNP continues to coordinate with the victim's relatives, friends, and acquaintances to obtain additional information that will assist in the investigation.

text: Nag-propose si House Committee on Ways and Means chairperson kag Albay Representative Joey Salceda sang hagna nga buhinan ang excise tax sa produktong petrolyo sa sulod sang anum ka bulan.
english: House Committee on Ways and Means chairperson and Albay Representative Joey Salceda proposed a bill to reduce the excise tax on petroleum products for six months.

text: Sa iya pag-file sang House Bill 10438, ginpahayag sang mamalidha nga ang pagbuhin sa excise tax sa fuel products ang dapat nga ipatuman umpisa sa December 1, 2021 tubtub sa June 1, 2022.
english: In his filing of House Bill 10438, the lawmaker said the reduction in excise tax on fuel products should be implemented from December 1, 2021 to June 1, 2022.

text: Suno kay Salceda, ang padayon nga pagsaka sa presyo sang fuel products amo ang seryoso nga makapugong sa pagbangon sang ekonomiya kag sa price stabilization.
english: According to Salceda, the continuous increase in the price of fuel products is a serious obstacle to economic recovery and price stabilization.

text: Ginpahayag man sini nga ang diesel kag kerosene ang dapat nga ma-exempt sa excise tax sa sulod sang anum ka bulan.
english: He also said that diesel and kerosene should be exempt from excise tax for six months.

text: Ang excise tax sa gasolina ang dapat man nga buhinan halin sa P10 per liter panubo sa P7 per liter.
english: The excise tax on gasoline should also be reduced from P10 per liter to P7 per liter.

text: Ginpahayag sang Bicolano lawmaker nga ang iya nga recommendation amo ang most fiscally sustainable ipaanggid sa iban nga mga proposals.
english: The Bicolano lawmaker said his recommendation is the most fiscally sustainable compared to other proposals.

text: Kadungan sini, naghingyo man si Salceda sa Department of Energy (DOE) nga istriktuhan pa gid ang monitoring sa presyo sang petroleum products.
english: Meanwhile, Salceda also urged the Department of Energy (DOE) to tighten monitoring of the price of petroleum products.

text: Dakop sa ginpatigayon nga drug buy-bust operation sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 4 ang isa ka iloy kag 21-anyos niya nga anak sa Zone 2, Barangay San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.
english: A mother and her 21-year-old son were arrested in a drug buy-bust operation conducted by the Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 4 in Zone 2, Barangay San Juan, Molo, Iloilo City.

text: Ang subject amo sanday Alyas Madam Inday, 41, kasado, kag caretaker sa sa guwa sang Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) sa Ungka, Jaro, kag iya bata nga si Alyas Nene, college student.
english: The subjects were identified as Madam Inday, 41, married, and caretaker outside the Bureau of Jail Management and Penology (BJMP) in Ungka, Jaro, and her daughter, Alias ​​Nene, college student.

text: Sila nga duha ang lunsay High-Value Individuals (HVI) kag residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: They are both High-Value Individuals (HVI) and residents of the said area.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Lt.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo, Police Lt.

text: Lloyd Pagulayan, deputy station commander sang ICPS 4, iya ginpahayag nga naglab-ot sa masobra duha ka semana ang monitoring sa mga subject matapos nakabaton sang impormasyon ang mga pulis nga nagkalain-lain nga mga tawo ang nagakadto sa balay sang alleged drug suspects.
english: Lloyd Pagulayan, deputy station commander of ICPS 4, said the monitoring of the subjects lasted for more than two weeks after the police received information that various people were going to the house of the alleged drug suspects.

text: Sang ginpatigayon ang operasyon, natigayon nga makuha ang 100 ka gramos sang ginapasuni nga ilegal nga droga nga may standard drug price nga P680,000.
english: During the operation, 100 grams of suspected illegal drugs with a standard drug price of P680,000 were recovered.

text: Nahibaluan nga preso man ang bana ni Madam Inday sa BJMP, Ungka, Jaro sa kapareho man nga kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 9165 ukon Comprehensive Dangerous Act of 2002.
english: It was learned that Madam Inday's husband is also detained at the BJMP, Ungka, Jaro for the same case of violation of Republic Act 9165 or Comprehensive Dangerous Act of 2002.

text: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)
english: (Article: Bombo Phauline Pillora)

text: Gintawag ni Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto nga habitual liars ang mag-asawa nga Discaya nga tag-iya sang mga construction firm nga involved sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects.
english: Pasig City Mayor Vico Sotto called the Discaya couple, owners of construction firms involved in anomalous flood control projects, habitual liars.

text: Suno kay Mayor Vico, kilala na ang mga Discaya sa lokal nga politika kag construction circles sang siya ang una nga nagpungko bilang mayor.
english: According to Mayor Vico, the Discayas were already known in local politics and construction circles when he first took office as mayor.

text: Ginsiling niya nga madamo na sang huring-huring tuhoy sa mga transaksyon sang mga Discaya apang ginlimitahan niya ang iya nga testimonya sa mga butang nga personal niya nga naobserbahan.
english: He said there were many rumors about the transactions of the Discaya but he limited his testimony to things he personally observed.

text: Gintumod man niya nga ang mga imbestigasyon kag report sang damlag lang ang nagbuyagyag kun ano kadalom ang pagpang-ugat sang construction empire sang mga Discaya.
english: He also pointed out that recent investigations and reports have revealed how deeply rooted the construction empire of the Discayas is.

text: Dugang niya, halos tanan nga kompaniya ang may mga pending deficiency sa tax sa Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) kag mangin sa local government.
english: He added that almost all companies have pending tax deficiencies with the Bureau of Internal Revenue (BIR) and even with the local government.

text: May mga tawo nga nakulbaan gid sa pagsakay sa eroplano.
english: Some people get really nervous about getting on a plane.

text: Ano pa gid ayhan kun ikaw na ang mapalupad sini, tapos wala pa ikaw sang ihibalo kun paano ini imanehar?
english: What if you're the one who flies it, and you don't know how to manage it?

text: Amo ini ang natabo sa mag-asawa didto sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika sang naabtan sila sang emerhensya samtang yara sa kahawaan.
english: This is what happened to a couple in the United States of America when they had an emergency while in space.

text: Ang piloto amo si Eliot Alper, 78, samtang kaupod sini sa gamay nga eroplano ang iya asawa nga si Yvonne Kinane-Wells, 69.
english: The pilot was Eliot Alper, 78, while with him in the small plane was his wife Yvonne Kinane-Wells, 69.

text: Halin sila sa Henderson Executive Airport sa Las Vegas kag pakadto na kuntani sa Monterey, California.
english: They were coming from Henderson Executive Airport in Las Vegas and were on their way to Monterey, California.

text: Samtang nagalupad ang eroplano, gulpi lang nga gin-atake sa korason ang piloto.
english: While the plane was flying, the pilot suddenly had a heart attack.

text: Sa una, grabe ang panic sang asawa bangud magluwas nga malain ang kondisyon sang iya bana, indi pa siya makahibalo magmanehar sa eroplano kag wala gid siya nakaagi training.
english: At first, the wife panicked because besides her husband's poor condition, he did not know how to fly a plane and had never received training.

text: Apang mind over matter, nangisog ini sa flight deck, ginkontak ang air traffic controller, kag ginsunod ang tanan nga ginahambal sini sa radio.
english: But mind over matter, he braved the flight deck, contacted the air traffic controller, and followed everything he said on the radio.

text: Pila ka minutos ang nagligad, natigayon ang emergency landing sa Bakersfield, California kun sa diin nagahulat ang emergency vehicles tubtub dalayon nga napa-untat sang asawa ang eroplano.
english: A few minutes later, an emergency landing was achieved in Bakersfield, California where emergency vehicles were waiting until the wife immediately stopped the plane.

text: Gindala gilayon ang bana sa ospital, apang amo na lang ang paghilibion sang asawa bangud ginbawian gihapon ini sang kabuhi.
english: The husband was rushed to the hospital, but the wife was left crying as she died.

text: Madamo gid ang nagdayaw sa pagka-kalmado sang babaye kag mangin ang director sang airport ang nagbilib kag nagsiling nga wala pa siya nakaagi-kita sang amo nga insidente sa iya bilog nga karera.
english: Many people praised the woman's calmness and even the airport director was impressed and said that he had never seen such an incident in his entire career.

text: Bilang pagsunod sa proseso, may imbestigasyon sa gihapon nga patigayunon ang Federal Aviation Administration kag National Transportation Safety Board kaangot sa amo nga insidente.
english: In compliance with the process, the Federal Aviation Administration and the National Transportation Safety Board are still conducting an investigation into the incident.

text: MANILA, PHILIPPINES- Ginpanginwala sang aktres kag philanthropist Angel Locsin ang mga espekulasyon nga magapadalagan ini sa public office.
english: MANILA, PHILIPPINES- Actress and philanthropist Angel Locsin has denied speculation that she will run for public office.

text: Ini bangud man sa indi matago nga pagbulig ni Angel, nga naghatag sang bulig sa hospitals bangud sa coronavirus disease 2019.
english: This is also due to the unhidden help of Angel, who provided assistance to hospitals due to the coronavirus disease 2019.

text: Suno kay Locsin, bilang artista, makonsidera na sila nga public servant, bangud para sa iya, tuman na kapubliko ang ila kabuhi.
english: According to Locsin, as artists, they can be considered public servants, because for him, their lives are too public.

text: Pahayag pa ni Angel, tanan ang ila ginahimo , indi lang para sa ila kaugalingon, kundi maghatag man sang kalingawan sa tao.
english: Angel said everything they do is not only for themselves, but also to entertain people.

text: Dugang pani Locsin, pag-abot sa pulitika, wala niya ini naisip kag wala gid ini nagsulod sa iya paminsaron.
english: Locsin added that when it came to politics, he did not think about it and it never entered his mind.

text: Nagsaka sa 5.3 percent ang inflation rate ukon ang pagmahal sang mga balaklon sini nga bulan sang Oktubre.
english: The inflation rate rose to 5.3 percent in October.

text: Suno kay Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno, mas mataas ini ipaanggid sa 4.8 percent nga inflation rate sang tinalikdan nga Septyembre.
english: According to Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas Governor Benjamin Diokno, this is higher compared to the 4.8 percent inflation rate last September.

text: Pahayag ni Diokno, kadam-an sa mga produkto nga may pagtaas sa presyo para sa bulan sang Oktubre amo ang gatong, kag key food items kaangay sang karne kag bugas.
english: Diokno said most of the products with price increases for the month of October are fuel, and key food items such as meat and rice.

text: Suno sa Department of Energy, sini lamang nga Oktubre, apat ka beses nga ginpataas sang pila ka mga local oil companies ang presyo sang gatong.
english: According to the Department of Energy, this October alone, some local oil companies raised fuel prices four times.

text: Natalana naman nga magpaggwa ang Philippine Statistics Authority sang opisyal nga inflation figures para sa bulan sang Oktubre sini nga Nobyembre 5, 2021.
english: The Philippine Statistics Authority is scheduled to release the official inflation figures for the month of October on November 5, 2021.

text: “Inflation will be driven largely by the upward adjustments in domestic oil prices.
english: “Inflation will be driven largely by the upward adjustments in domestic oil prices.

text: Higher Meralco (Manila Electric Co.) electricity rates, increased fish and fruits prices, and the peso depreciation will provide additional upside pressures,” pahayag ni Diokno.
english: Higher Meralco (Manila Electric Co.) electricity rates, increased fish and fruits prices, and the peso depreciation will provide additional upside pressures,” Diokno said.

text: Ginhingyo sang kampo ni anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kay Presidente Ferdinand Marcos nga tugutan ini nga makabalik sa Pilipinas kun naaprubahan ang interim release nila sa International Criminal Court (ICC).
english: Former President Rodrigo Duterte's camp has asked President Ferdinand Marcos to allow him to return to the Philippines if their interim release is approved by the International Criminal Court (ICC).

text: Suno kay Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, padayon ang pagluya sang ikaayong lawas sang anay presidente nga naapektuhan ang abilidad sini para mahangpan sang madalom ang mga ebidensiya.
english: According to Atty. Nicholas Kaufman, the former president's health continues to deteriorate, affecting his ability to deeply understand the evidence.

text: Dugang pa ni Kaufman nga tugutan ni Marcos ang pagbalik sa pungsod ni Duterte para sa patas nga hearing tubtob sa pagtakop sang proceedings.
english: Kaufman added that Marcos will allow Duterte to return to the country for a fair hearing until the end of the proceedings.

text: Matandaan nga humalin pa sang Marso, yara na sa kustodiya sang ICC ang 80-anyos nga anay presidente kag sang Agosto, naghingyo sila sang interim release sa wala ginpangalanan nga pungsod.
english: The 80-year-old former president has been in ICC custody since March and in August, they requested interim release from an unnamed country.

text: Lauman nga makahampang na si Kyrie Irving sa home games sang Brooklyn Nets.
english: Kyrie Irving is expected to play in the Brooklyn Nets' home games.

text: Ini kasunod sang lihok sang alkalde sang New York nga pag-exempt sa New York-based performers kag mga atleta sa vaccination mandate sa amo nga lugar.
english: This follows the New York mayor's move to exempt New York-based performers and athletes from the vaccination mandate in the area.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa si Irving sa mga basketball players nga wala nabakunahan.
english: Irving is one of the basketball players who is not vaccinated.

text: Ang Nets ang nagapang-walo subong sa Eastern Conference kag subject sa play-in tournament nga magaumpisa sa Abril 12.
english: The Nets are currently eighth in the Eastern Conference and subject to a play-in tournament starting April 12.

text: Excited naman ang mga fans bangud wala sang Irving nga nakit-an sa nagligad nga 35 ka home games sang Nets subong nga season.
english: Fans are excited because Irving has not been seen in the past 35 home games of the Nets this season.

text: Ipakakas ni Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Police General Nicolas Torre III sa serbisyo ang mga overweight nga police officers kun indi sila makabuhin sang bug-at sa sulod sang isa ka tuig.
english: Philippine National Police (PNP) chief Police General Nicolas Torre III will dismiss overweight police officers from service if they fail to lose weight within one year.

text: Suno kay Torre, nasaad sa Section 30 sang Republic Act No.
english: According to Torre, Section 30 of Republic Act No.

text: 6975 ukon ang Department of the Interior and Local Government Act of 1990 nga pila sa general qualifications para sa appointment bilang PNP officer ukon member amo nga ang pulis ang dapat magbug-at sang indi maglapaw ukon mas manubo sang lima ka kilo sa standard weight nga naga-correspond sa iya height, age, kag sex.
english: 6975 or the Department of the Interior and Local Government Act of 1990 which states that some of the general qualifications for appointment as a PNP officer or member are that a policeman must weigh not more than or less than five kilograms in standard weight corresponding to his height, age, and sex.

text: Ginpaathag ni Torre nga sa idalom sang pagsulundan sang PNP, ang mga pulis nga wala sa ila standard weight ang hatagan sang anom ka bulan tubtob isa ka tuig agud mapahimo nga normal ang ila bug-at.
english: Torre explained that under the PNP guidelines, policemen who are not at their standard weight will be given six months to one year to normalize their weight.

text: Suno sa iya, kun mapaslawan, kakason sa serbisyo ang mga pulis.
english: He said if they fail, the policemen will be removed from service.

text: Para sa mga pulis nga may medical nga kondisyons mahimo sila mangatubang sang “complete disability discharge” ukon sayluhon sa trabaho sa opisina.
english: For police officers with medical conditions they may face a “complete disability discharge” or transfer to office work.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Wala ginadula sang kapulisan ang posibilidad nga isa lang ang pusil nga ginhalinan sang duha ka stray bullet incident sa Villa San Lorenzo Subdivision, Barangay Loboc, Lapuz, Iloilo City kadungan sang New Year.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Police are not ruling out the possibility that the same gun was the cause of the two stray bullet incidents in Villa San Lorenzo Subdivision, Barangay Loboc, Lapuz, Iloilo City during the New Year.

text: Ang una nga bala ang nakit-an sa sulod sang kwarto sang isa ka balay, samtang ang isa naman ka bala ang nakit-an sa kilid sang dalan.
english: The first bullet was found inside the bedroom of a house, while the other bullet was found on the side of the road.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Lester Oliveros, hepe sang Iloilo City Police Station 8, iya ginpahayag nga wala pa na natumod ang sa likod sang nasambit nga insidente.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Lester Oliveros, chief of Iloilo City Police Station 8, said the motive behind the incident has not yet been identified.

text: Suno kay Oliveros, ginpadala naman nila ang bala sa Crime Laboratory agud matumod kun sa diin ini nga pusil naghalin.
english: Oliveros said they sent the bullet to the Crime Laboratory to determine where the gun came from.

text: Nagapanawagan man si Oliveros sa mga residente mga magpadulong sa kapulisan kun may idea ang mga ini nga nagpalupok sang pusil sang New Year.
english: Oliveros also appealed to residents to come to the police if they have any idea that they fired guns during the New Year.

text: Tuman nga ginakasubo sang aktres nga si Heart Evangelista ang pagtaliwan sang iya ido nga si Linda.
english: Actress Heart Evangelista is deeply saddened by the passing of her dog Linda.

text: Suno sa aktres, ginakabig niya nga isa sa pinaka paborito niya nga foster pet si Linda humalin sang nagsugod siya nga magrescue sang mga sapat sang 13-anyos palang sya.
english: According to the actress, she considers Linda one of her favorite foster pets since she started rescuing animals when she was 13 years old.

text: Nahibaluan nga kilala si Heart bilang isa ka nagasakdag sang animal rescue kag adoption.
english: Heart is known as an advocate for animal rescue and adoption.

text: May yara man sya sang pila ka ido kaangay nalang sang mga “Aspin” ukon Asong Pinoy.
english: He also has some dogs like the “Aspin” or Asong Pinoy.

text: Si Heart man ang madugay na nga ambassador sang Philippine Animal Welfare Society kag sang 2019, ginlunsayr niya ang iya animal welfare facility sa Sorsogon sa diin gobernador ang iya bana nga si Chiz Escudero.
english: Heart is also a long-time ambassador of the Philippine Animal Welfare Society and in 2019, she launched her animal welfare facility in Sorsogon where her husband, Chiz Escudero, is governor.

text: Dugang sang aktres, sa pihak sang iya pagkasubo malipayon sa gihapon ang iya tagipusuon bangud pat-ud niya nga nabatyagan sang iya ido nga si Linda ang iya paghigugma sang ini ang buhi pa.
english: The actress added that despite her sadness, her heart is still happy because she is sure that her dog Linda felt her love when she was still alive.

text: Posible nga sa masunod nga mga semana, indi na kinahanglan magprensenta sang negative swab test result ang mga turista nga magasulod sa Isla sang Boracay kun fully vaccinated na ang mga ini batok sa COVID-19.
english: It is possible that in the coming weeks, tourists entering Boracay Island will no longer need to present a negative swab test result if they are fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

text: Suno kay Tourism Secretary Berna Romulo-Puyat, ini ang nadesisyunan mismo ni Aklan Governor Florencio Miraflores.
english: According to Tourism Secretary Berna Romulo-Puyat, this was decided by Aklan Governor Florencio Miraflores himself.

text: “According to him, in a month’s time or maybe in three weeks’ time, he will already be accepting fully vaccinated in lieu of negative RT-PCR,” pahayag ni Puyat.
english: “According to him, in a month’s time or maybe in three weeks’ time, he will already be accepting fully vaccinated in lieu of negative RT-PCR,” stated Puyat.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga posible sini bulan sang Disyembre, pahanugutan na nga makasulod sa Boracay ang tanan nga fully vaccinated nga mga turista bisan wala sang negative COVID-19 test result.
english: He said that it is possible that this December, all fully vaccinated tourists will be allowed to enter Boracay even if they do not have a negative COVID-19 test result.

text: Dugang pa ni Puyat, ginahulat nalang ni Governor Miraflores nga malab-ot sang Boracay ang 100% nga vaccination rate sang tourism workers kag mga residente sang Isla.
english: Puyat added that Governor Miraflores is waiting for Boracay to reach 100% vaccination rate of tourism workers and residents of the island.

text: Wala na nakibot si Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. was not surprised.

text: sa pag-ilis sang liderato sa Senado.
english: to change leadership in the Senate.

text: Ginpahayag niya nga sang nagliligad pa nga binulan, matunog na ang isyu sang bayluhanay sang liderato.
english: He said that months ago, the issue of leadership change was already raised.

text: Suno sa iya, nangin mabaskog na ang pangalan ni Senator Vicente “Tito” Sotto III nga handa nga kuhaon ang posisyon bilang Senate President bulos kay Sen.
english: He said Senator Vicente “Tito” Sotto III has become a strong name and is ready to take the position as Senate President to replace Sen.

text: Chiz Escudero.
english: Chiz Escudero.

text: Bilang anay senador, ginpahayag ni Marcos ang pag-ilis sang liderato sa Senado ang isa ka internal issue kun sa diin ginapakita lamang sang mga senador ang ila nga kumpiyansa sa kada isa.
english: As a former senator, Marcos said the change of leadership in the Senate is an internal issue where senators are only showing their confidence in each other.

text: Wala untat ang pagpakamalaut nga ginahaboy sa transgender athlete nga si Lia Thomas matapos nga ini ang nangin maragtasan sang nagdaug sa NCAA swimming championship.
english: There is no stopping the condemnation being thrown at transgender athlete Lia Thomas after she made history when she won the NCAA swimming championship.

text: Si Thomas ang isa ka transgender swimmer nga nakakuha sang titulo sang nagdaug sa 500 meter freestyle.
english: Thomas is a transgender swimmer who won the title of winner in the 500 meter freestyle.

text: Isa sa nag-protesta amo ang anay Olympic swimmer nga si Reka Gyorgy nga nagpadala sang sulat sa US college sports governing body agud nga kwestyunon ang pagdaug ni Thomas.
english: One of the protesters was former Olympic swimmer Reka Gyorgy who sent a letter to the US college sports governing body to question Thomas’ win.

text: Nakasaad sa pagsulundan sang USA Swimming nga ang transgender atlethes ang kinahanglan nga magpaidalom sa tatlo ka tuig nga hormone replacement therapy bag-o ini makaintra sa ano man nga kompetisyon.
english: USA Swimming's rules state that transgender athletes must undergo three years of hormone replacement therapy before they can participate in any competition.

text: Sa sitwasyon ni Thomas, kulang pa ini sang anom ka bulan apang nagdesisyon ang NCAA nga indi na pagsundon ang ginapatuman nga pagsulundan sang Swimming organization.
english: In Thomas' situation, it was less than six months but the NCAA decided not to follow the Swimming organization's rules.

text: Gikaakig naman sang iban pa nga mga atleta ang amo nga desisyon sang NCAA.
english: Other athletes were angry with the NCAA's decision.

text: Nalakip man ang Save Women’s Sport, ang grupo nga nagakontra sa transgender athletes sa mga nagpatigayon sang protesta.
english: Save Women's Sport, a group that opposes transgender athletes, was also among those who held the protest.

text: Nagalibog ang ulo sang mga jeepney driver sa Iloilo City kun ano na lang ang ila dal-on pauli nga kuwarta sa ila tagsa ka pamilya ilabi na nga halos ibakal na lang sang krudo ang makit-an nila sa isa ka adlaw nga byahe.
english: Jeepney drivers in Iloilo City are confused about what to bring home with their families especially since they can only buy fuel in a day's journey.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Russel Zamora, iya ginpahayag nga P450 pa ang iya ginabayaran sa gina-arkila sini nga traditional jeep.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Russel Zamora said he still pays P450 for his traditional jeep rental.

text: “Ano na lang ang para sa amon nga pamilya?
english: “What about our family?

text: Amo pa lang natabo ni.
english: This just happened.

text: First time pa lang ni.
english: This is the first time.

text: Pangabay man namon sa gobyerno nga ila man depensahan ang pagsinaka sang presyo sang krudo.
english: We also ask the government to defend the rise in crude oil prices.

text: Kaluluoy kami tanan nga nagapangabuhi sa dalanon bilang driver,” suno sa iya.
english: Pity all of us who make a living on the road as drivers,” he said.

text: Sa P850 sini nga limpyo, P500 ang ginatabon sini sa krudo gani P350 na lang gid ang madala sini pauli.
english: Of the P850 clean, P500 is covered by the crude oil so it only takes P350 home.

text: Suno kay Zamora, ginaantisipar na sini nga mas maga-gamay pa gid ang iya limpyo bangud madugangan pa gid sang P14 ang presyo sang kada litro sang krudo sa masunod nga semana.
english: Zamora said he anticipates that his cleanliness will be even smaller because the price of crude oil will increase by P14 per liter next week.

text: Tubtub subong suno sa iya, wala pa ini sang nabatian nga may nakabaton na sang ayuda.
english: So far, he said, he has not heard of anyone who has received the aid.

text: 2018 sang nag-umpisa siya sa pagbyahe sang jeep diri sa syudad kag ini ang una nga bes suno sa iya nga na-eksperyensya nila ang kapuraot sang byahe nga resulta sang nagatimbuok nga presyo sang gatong.
english: 2018 when he started driving a jeep here in the city and this is the first time he said they experienced the difficulty of driving as a result of the rising price of fuel.

text: “Kun gapamati ang tagdumalahan sang gobyerno, tani batyagon man nila kami nga mga driver, kay kaluluoy ang amon pamilya sini,” suno sa driver.
english: “If the government officials are listening, I hope they feel for us drivers, because our family is poor,” said the driver.

text:
“Waay pa kami kabati nga may ayuda diri sa Iloilo nga may nakakuha kay ipaagi pa kuno sa coop.”

Kun basehan ang oil industry estimates, posible nga magdangat na sa P130 ang presyo sang diesel sa masunod nga semana, samtang magalapaw naman sa P100 ang kada litro sang gasolina bangud sang panibag-o nga oil price hike nga resulta sang kinagamo sa Middle East.#
english:
“We have not heard of any aid here in Iloilo that anyone has received because it is supposed to be sent through the coop.”

Based on oil industry estimates, the price of diesel is likely to reach P130 next week, while the price of gasoline will exceed P100 per liter due to the new oil price hike resulting from the unrest in the Middle East.

text: Ginsapubliko ang written explanation kag ang resignation letter nga ginpasa sang former actress nga si Nadia Montenegro sa Chief of Staff ni Sen.
english: The written explanation and resignation letter submitted by former actress Nadia Montenegro to the Chief of Staff of Sen.

text: Robin Padilla nga si Atty. Rudolf Jurado.
english: Robin Padilla that Atty. Rudolph Jurado.

text: Sa iya sulat, ginpahayag sini nga matapos nabutang ang iya pangalan sa incident report sang ginaalegar paggamit sang marijuana sa Senate building sa Pasay City, nabutang siya sa “publicity trial” kag gin-ulan siya sang mga pagpakamalaot lakip na ang pagtawag sa iya nga adik.
english: In his letter, he said that after his name was included in the incident report of alleged marijuana use in the Senate building in Pasay City, he was put on a “publicity trial” and was showered with insults including calling him an addict.

text: “I was unfairly subjected to publicity trial, misjudgments, bashings and grave humiliation.
english: “I was unfairly subjected to publicity trial, misjudgments, bashings and grave humiliation.

text: My children were unjustly became the subject of ridicule, calling them the children of a ‘drug addict’.
english: My children were unjustly became the subject of ridicule, calling them the children of a ‘drug addict’.

text: One comment even said maybe my children are drug addicts as well,” pahayag ni Montenegro.
english: One comment even said maybe my children are drug addicts as well,” Montenegro said.

text: Dugang sini, indi siya guilty, apang nag-resign siya bangud demonstrasyon ini sang iya nga pagtahod kay Padilla kag sa Senado.
english: He added that he is not guilty, but he resigned because it is a demonstration of his respect for Padilla and the Senate.

text: “My decision to resign should not be misconstrued as an admission of guilt—it is not.
english: “My decision to resign should not be misconstrued as an admission of guilt—it is not.

text: Rather, it is a demonstration of my deep respect for the Senate and Senator Padilla’s office, so that this issue does not cause further distraction or harm.
english: Rather, it is a demonstration of my deep respect for the Senate and Senator Padilla’s office, so that this issue does not cause further distraction or harm.

text: To prevent this baseless issue from growing any further, I would rather remove myself from the spotlight and allow the Senate to focus on its important work,” pahayag pa sini.
english: To prevent this baseless issue from growing any further, I would rather remove myself from the spotlight and allow the Senate to focus on its important work,” it said.

text: Antes ang resignation, matandaan nga ginpa-leave anay ni Padilla si Montenegro samtang padayon ang internal investigation.
english: Before the resignation, Padilla had placed Montenegro on leave while the internal investigation was ongoing.

text: Nahibaluan nga base sa incident report nga napetsahan sang Agusto 13, ginplastar sang security personnel nga si Victor Patelo nga may duha ka insidente nga may napanimahuan nga indi kinaandan sa isa ka area sa Senate building.
english: Based on the incident report dated August 13, security personnel Victor Patelo said there were two incidents involving unusual smells in an area of ​​the Senate building.

text: Una amo ang sa ikaduha nga semana sang Hulyo 2025 kun sa diin may nag-report nga isa ka male staff member nga maisog nga baho, apang wala man sang nakit-an nga nagpanigarilyo.
english: The first was in the second week of July 2025 when a male staff member reported a strong smell, but no one was found smoking.

text: Ikaduha amo ang Agusto 12 kun sa diin nagpalapit ang staff ni Senator Panfilo Lacson sa amo gihapon nga security personnel sa 5th floor, kag nagpanugid nga may indi kinaandan nga baho nga halin sa comfort room sang mga babaye malapit sa extension offices sang mga senador.
english: The second was on August 12 when Senator Panfilo Lacson's staff approached the same security personnel on the 5th floor, and reported an unusual smell coming from the women's comfort room near the senators' extension offices.

text: Ginpahayag nga daw marijuana ang baho kag ang tawo lamang sa area sa amo nga tion amo si Nadia.
english: It reportedly smelled like marijuana and the only person in the area at the time was Nadia.

text: Suno sa security personnel, ginmunuhan sini si Nadia sang naglabay ini sa iya pwesto, apang nagpanginwala ang former actress nga nagpanigarilyo ini ukon naggamit sang marijuana.
english: According to security personnel, he led Nadia as she passed his place, but the former actress denied smoking or using marijuana.

text: Gin-ako sini nga may dala siya nga vape sa iya bag nga amo ang posible ang ginhalinan sang baho.
english: He admitted to having a vape in his bag, which may have been the source of the smell.

text: May ginpasa naman nga investigation report sa Office of the Senate President (OSP) kasunod sang amo nga insidente.#
english: An investigation report was submitted to the Office of the Senate President (OSP) following the incident.

text: Nalutos ang Pinay tennis star nga si Alex Eala sa kamot sang isa ka unseeded player sa iya imbukada nga hampang sa WTA 250 Guangzhou Open sa China.
english: Pinay tennis star Alex Eala lost to an unseeded player in her opening match at the WTA 250 Guangzhou Open in China.

text: 2-6, 6-4, 6-4 ang resulta sang hampang pabor sa 25-anyos nga world No.
english: The result was 2-6, 6-4, 6-4 in favor of the 25-year-old world No.

text: 305 nga si Claire Liu nga nagatiglawas sang Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: 305 Claire Liu representing the United States of America.

text: Apisar sang temprano nga exit sa singles match, may oportunidad pa nga makabawi ang world No.
english: Despite the early exit in the singles match, the world No. 1 still has an opportunity to recover.

text: 53 nga si Eala paagi sa doubles match sini 2:10 karon sa hapon.
english: 53 Eala through its doubles match at 2:10 pm today.

text: Maka-pares ni Eala ang Ukrainian player nga si Nadiia Kichenok.
english: Eala will be paired with Ukrainian player Nadiia Kichenok.

text: Atubangon nila ang Chinese-British pair nanday Tang Qianhui kag Emily Appleton.
english: They will face the Chinese-British pair of Tang Qianhui and Emily Appleton.

text: Kasunod sini nga Guangzhou Open, magapasakop ang Pinay tennis player sa Hong Kong Open sa October 25 tubtub November 2.
english: Following the Guangzhou Open, the Filipina tennis player will participate in the Hong Kong Open from October 25 to November 2.

text: Ini ang iya pang-apat nga tour sa China sa nagligad nga duha ka bulan kasunod sang iya partisipasyon sa Jingshan, Wuhan, kag Suzhou.
english: This is his fourth tour of China in the past two months following his participation in Jingshan, Wuhan, and Suzhou.

text: KINAHANGLAN ma-update na ang Local Climate Change Action Plan sang siyudad sang Iloilo nga gin-aprubahan sadtong 2013.
english: The Local Climate Change Action Plan of Iloilo City approved in 2013 needs to be updated.

text: Syempre, tungod kay pabag-o bag-o man ang panahon kag ang siyam (9) ka tuig nga nagligad nagpakita na gid man sang bastante nga pagbag-o. In fact, for worse!
english: Of course, because the times are changing and the past nine (9) years have shown enough change. In fact, for worse!

text: Nagpirma na gani si Mayor Trenas sadtong Enero 10, 2023 sa isa ka commitment signing para sa Climate Change Competency Assessment Framework upod sa National Resiliency Council.
english: Mayor Trenas even signed on January 10, 2023 a commitment signing for the Climate Change Competency Assessment Framework with the National Resiliency Council.

text: Sa madumduman naton, si Councilor Dave Jamora ang nanguna sa pagpatigayon sang First Iloilo City Environmental Summit sadtong Enero 6-7 2011, bilang tsirman sang Committee on Environment, agud mag-develop sang Strategic Environmental Action Plan for 2011-2013.
english: As we recall, Councilor Dave Jamora led the conduct of the First Iloilo City Environmental Summit on January 6-7 2011, as chairman of the Committee on Environment, to develop the Strategic Environmental Action Plan for 2011-2013.

text: Gintambungan ini sang mga 120 ka mga stakeholders nga ginpangunahan sang kilala nga mga experto sa Climate Change.
english: It was attended by about 120 stakeholders led by well-known Climate Change experts.

text: Gin-take up nila diri ang mga issues & concerns nga partikular nagatumod sa Climate Change kag mga problema nga dala sini sa kadutaan, kahanginan kag katubigan sa siyudad.
english: They took up issues & concerns specifically related to Climate Change and the problems it brings to the land, air and water in the city.

text: Nauna na diri ang isyu sang nagalala nga pagbaha-baha sa siyudad.
english: The issue of worsening flooding in the city has already been raised.

text: Kon madumduman pa gani sang mga pumuluyo, gin-igu sang Typhoon Frank ang siyudad sadtong Abril 8, 2008.
english: If residents remember, Typhoon Frank hit the city on April 8, 2008.

text: Nagdala ini sing malaparon nga pagbaha, nga wala pa natabo sa siyudad.
english: It brought widespread flooding, unprecedented in the city.

text: Sobra katunga sang 180 ka mga barangay sang siyudad ang gin-sul-ob sang storm rain nga nagtener pa sing senemana sa pila ka lugar.
english: More than half of the city's 180 barangays were washed away by the storm rain that lasted for a week in some areas.

text: Bag-o pa ang Typhoon Frank sang 2008 ginhingyo na ni anay Mayor Mansueto Malabor (1992-2001) sa gobyerno nasyonal ang isa ka floodway sa Iloilo tungod gani sa problema sang pagbinaha-baha sa siyudad.
english: Before Typhoon Frank in 2008, former Mayor Mansueto Malabor (1992-2001) asked the national government for a floodway in Iloilo because of the flooding problem in the city.

text: Salamat kay nasuguran na gid man ang pagpatindug sang 8-km.
english: Thankfully, the construction of the 8-km has finally begun.

text: Iloilo Floodway sa idalom ni Presidente Gloria Arroyo (2001-2010) pagkatapos sang Typhoon Frank mismo sang 2008.
english: Iloilo Floodway under President Gloria Arroyo (2001-2010) after Typhoon Frank itself in 2008.

text: Natapos ini sadtong 2011.
english: It was completed in 2011.

text: Isa ini ka escape channel sang floodwaters halin sa ginsang-an sang mga suba sang Aganan kag Tigum sa Pavia, Iloilo nga patayon direkta sa Iloilo Strait.
english: It is an escape channel of floodwaters from the confluence of the Aganan and Tigum rivers in Pavia, Iloilo that will flow directly into the Iloilo Strait.

text:
***

Sa pagpungko ni Mayor Jerry Trenas bilang mayor (2001-2010) yara na sa iya abaga ang pagpatuman sang floodway nga ginsuguran sadtong 2008.
english:
***

With Mayor Jerry Trenas as mayor (2001-2010) he is now responsible for the implementation of the floodway that began in 2008.

text: Tubtub sa iya pagbalik mayor sadtong 2019, pagkatapos ni Mayor Jed Mabilog, madamo pa ang nadugang niya nga mga proyekto kag programa batok sa sige paglala sang Climate Change diri sa siyudad.
english: Until his return as mayor in 2019, after Mayor Jed Mabilog, he added many more projects and programs against the worsening Climate Change here in the city.

text: Mayor diri ang iya pag-ulikid sa mga kubos sang siyudad sa ila handom nga makaangkon sang ila kaugalingon nga puluy-an nga mabakod batok sa bagyo kag malayo sa peligro batok sa storm surge sa baybayon kag pag-awas sang suba kon diin madamo dira ang nagapuyo.
english: The mayor expressed his concern for the city's poor in their desire to have their own homes that are strong against typhoons and safe from storm surges on the coast and river floods where many live.

text: Ginsuporta man sini ang pagpasanyog sang mga renewable energy projects kag ang pagpatuman sang Clean Air Act sa padayon nga away sa Climate Change.
english: He also supported the promotion of renewable energy projects and the implementation of the Clean Air Act in the ongoing fight against Climate Change.

text: Apang madamo gihapon ang hilimuon kag kinahanglan nga mapasanyog (enhance) pa gid ang pagpatuman sang 2013 action plan.
english: However, there is still much to be done and the implementation of the 2013 action plan needs to be enhanced.

text:
***

Naham-ut kita sa aton coastguard.
english:
***

We are proud of our coastguard.

text: Aton legally ang West Philippine Sea kag illegal inang claim sang China sa South China Sea nga ginsakop pa ang WPS.
english: The West Philippine Sea is legally ours and China's claim to the South China Sea, which includes the WPS, is illegal.

text: Pero daw idu kita nga indi makataghol man lang batok sa pang-bully sang China sa WPS.
english: But we are like bears that can't even bark against China's bullying of WPS.

text: Kita pa gani ang ginataghol kag asta salakayon!
english: We are even being barked at and even attacked!

text: Sakop ang WPS sang aton 200-nautical mile nga  Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) nga gintalana sang UN Convention of the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) sa sobra 100 ka mga myembro sini, nga nagalakip sang Filipinas kag sang China pa gani.
english: The WPS is part of our 200-nautical mile Exclusive Economic Zone (EEZ) set by the UN Convention of the Law of the Sea (UNCLOS) to its more than 100 members, which includes the Philippines and even China.

text: Gindaug naton ang problema sa WPS sa kaso sang Filipinas batok sa China sa Hague Tribunal sadtong 2016.
english: We won the WPS problem in the case of the Philippines against China in the Hague Tribunal in 2016.

text: Pero wala ini ginkilala sang China.
english: But China did not recognize it.

text: Upod sa legal pero kontra sa legal!
english: With legal but against legal!

text: Haslo!
english: Haslo!

text: Pero ano ang ginahimo naton?
english: But what do we do?

text: Sang makuha sang coastguard naton ang nagtupa nga tinipik sang test missile sang China sa sulod sang WPS, aba!, ginpabay-an lang sini nga agawon sang Chinese  coastguard.
english: When our coastguard found the fragment of the Chinese test missile inside the WPS, aba!, it just let the Chinese coastguard snatch it.

text: Pirme man gani ginatabug sini ang aton mga mangingisda samtang nagapanagat sa WPS nga daw ila.
english: It even drives our fishermen away while fishing in the WPS as if it were theirs.

text: Lain na subong ang panahon sangsa sadtong anyos tiempos nga pakusug nga pag-solbar sang problema sang mga pungsod.
english: The times are different now than in those years when nations were forced to solve their problems.

text: Panahon na ini sang international law nga ginapatuman sang United Nations sa malapit 200 sini nga mga myembro nga dapat respetuhon sang tanan.
english: It is time for international law enforced by the United Nations in its nearly 200 members that must be respected by all.

text: Gani, kon ako, pabungol-bungolan ko lang sila.
english: So, if it were me, I would just mute them.

text: Kag indi naton kinahanglan mang-bully sa ila kasubong sang ginahimo sang China sa iya fake nga claim.
english: And we don't have to bully them like China does with its fake claim.

text: Aksyon legal kag diplomasya lang.
english: Legal action and diplomacy only.

text: Pero kon magpabuang-buang sila, kag atakihon pa nila ang aton mga mangingisda kag coastguard dira, natural lang nga depensahan naton ang aton poder dira sa WPS, indi bala?/PN
english: But if they go crazy, and they attack our fishermen and coastguard there, it's natural for us to defend our power here in WPS, right?/PN

text: Kun ikaw ang ginbugayan sang talento sa pagkanta, pat-od nga nalipay ka gid nga i-share ini iban.
english: If you are blessed with the talent of singing, you must be happy to share it with others.

text: Amo ina abi ang maayo nga himuon kun ikaw may yara sang special talent halin sa Diyos — ang ipakigbahin ini sa iban nga mga tawo para nga sila ang ma-inspire, ma-happy, kag ma-share man nila ang ila gift kaangay abi sang pagsaot, pagpinta, pagsulat, kag madamo nga iban pa.
english: That's the best thing to do if you have a special talent from God — to share it with other people so that they can be inspired, happy, and share their gifts such as dancing, painting, writing, and many others.

text: Sa Britanya, may yara sang 17 ka mga tawo nga nagabug-os sang isa ka choir nga amo ang ginhingadlan sang Guinness World Records bilang world’s oldest choir.
english: In Britain, there are 17 people who make up a choir that has been named by Guinness World Records as the world’s oldest choir.

text: Ginatawag sila nga Prime Timers.
english: They are called Prime Timers.

text: Ang mga miyembro sini ang nagaedad sang 87 tubtub sa 99 years old, buot silingon, ang average age amo ang 94.
english: Its members range in age from 87 to 99 years old, that is, the average age is 94.

text: Sang tinalikdan nga bulan, may yara sila sang Christmas concert kun sa diin nalakip sa nagtambong amo ang Guinness World Records adjudicator.
english: Last month, they had a Christmas concert where the Guinness World Records adjudicator was among those in attendance.

text: Ini amo ang nagkumpirma nga ang amo nga performance sang grupo ang nagguba sang record sang performance sang nauna nga oldest choir.
english: This confirmed that the group's performance broke the performance record of the previous oldest choir.

text: Ini nga singers ang lunsay halin sa mga care homes didto sa Stratford-upon-Avon sa England.
english: These singers are all from care homes in Stratford-upon-Avon in England.

text: Sang tion nga nag-perform sila sang Disyembre, kaupod nila ang English musician nga si Tony Christie nga nag-perform sang bantog nga “Amarillo” kag “Silent Night.”
english: By the time they performed in December, they were with English musician Tony Christie who performed the famous “Amarillo” and “Silent Night.”

text: Ginpaidalom sa mandatory drug testing ang 110 ka mga hepe sang pulis sa Western Visayas.
english: 110 police chiefs in Western Visayas have been subjected to mandatory drug testing.

text: Suno kay PRO6 Regional Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan, kabahin ini sang mas ginpabaskog nga integrity monitoring kag nagapadayon nga commitment sa internal cleansing.
english: According to PRO6 Regional Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan, this is part of the strengthened integrity monitoring and ongoing commitment to internal cleansing.

text: Pahayag ni Ligan, ini nga tikang ang nagapakita sang prinsipyo nga kinahanglan nga ang mga hepe sang kapulisan ang dapat magserbe nga maayo nga ehemplo.
english: Ligan said the move reflects the principle that police chiefs should serve as good examples.

text: Ini santo man sa prayoridad ni Philippine National Police Chief Police General Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.
english: This is also in line with the priority of Philippine National Police Chief Police General Jose Melencio Nartatez Jr.

text: nga pagtib-ong sang propsyonalismo kag ipabilin ang pagsalig sang publiko sa organisasyon sa diin man nga lebel.
english: to promote professionalism and maintain public confidence in the organization at all levels.

text: Ang mandatory drug test ginpatigayon kahapon, Pebrero 2, 2026 sa PRO6 Multi-Purpose Hall.
english: The mandatory drug test was conducted yesterday, February 2, 2026 at the PRO6 Multi-Purpose Hall.

text: Nakumpleto sang National Board of Canvassers (NBOC) ang tally sang election results tatlo ka adlaw matapos ang May 12 midterm elections.
english: The National Board of Canvassers (NBOC) completed the tally of election results three days after the May 12 midterm elections.

text: Suno kay Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairman George Garcia, natalana na nga iproklamar ang mga nagdaog nga senador buwas sa hapon, Mayo 17.
english: According to Commission on Elections (Comelec) Chairman George Garcia, the winning senators are scheduled to be proclaimed tomorrow afternoon, May 17.

text: Base sa national canvass report, yari ang pinal nga resulta sa senatorial race.
english: Based on the national canvass report, here are the final results of the senatorial race.

text:
Ang sulod sa Magic 12 amo sanday:

Nagapang-13 naman si Ben Tulfo nga may 12,090,090; nagasunod si Bong Revilla nga may 12,027,845; kag si Abby Binay nga may 11,808,645.
english:
The contents of Magic 12 are:

Ben Tulfo came in 13th with 12,090,090; followed by Bong Revilla with 12,027,845; and Abby Binay with 11,808,645.

text: Apisar gin-release na ang boto kag rankings, ginklaro nga indi pa ini pinal kag subject pa sa auditing nga natalana nga himuon subong nga adlaw, Mayo 16.
english: Although the votes and rankings have been released, it was clarified that they are not final and are still subject to auditing scheduled for today, May 16.

text: Nagnegatibo sa Coronavirus Disease 2019 ang aktres nga si Angel Locsin kag iya nobyo kag producer nga si Neil Arce.
english: Actress Angel Locsin and her boyfriend and producer Neil Arce tested negative for Coronavirus Disease 2019.

text: Ini ang ginpakigbahin ni Angel paagi sa iya social media account sa diin makita ang picture sang duha ka test kits nga nakapangalan sa iya kay kay Neil.
english: Angel shared this through her social media account where you can see a picture of two test kits named after her and Neil.

text: Nahibaluan nga humalin sang nagsugod ang pagpatuman sang lockdown sa pila ka lugar sa Luzon, padayon ang pagpanagtag ni Angel sang bulig sa mga apektado sang pandemic kaupod man ang pila niya ka mga abyan sa showbiz.
english: Since the lockdown began in some parts of Luzon, Angel has been distributing relief goods to those affected by the pandemic along with some of his showbiz friends.

text: Bag-o pa man ang pagsugod sang 97th season sang National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) sa Marso 26, nagpagwa na ang league sang lineup sa men’s basket ball teams.
english: Even before the start of the 97th season of the National Collegiate Athletic Association (NCAA) on March 26, the league has released the lineup of the men’s basketball teams.

text: Ang defending champion nga Letran Knights ang kabahin sang lineup.
english: The defending champion Letran Knights are part of the lineup.

text: Napabilin man sa ila team ang ila top players sang season 95 nga sanday MVP Fran Yu, Jeo Ambohot, kag Christian Fajarito.
english: They also retained their top players from season 95, MVP Fran Yu, Jeo Ambohot, and Christian Fajarito.

text:
Yari ang lineups sang mga teams:

Arellano University, Colegio de San Juan de Letran, De La Salle-College of Saint Benilde, Emilio Aguinaldo College, Jose Rizal University, Lyceum of the Philippines University, Mapua University, San Beda University, San Sebastian College-Recoletos, University of Perpetual Help System DALTA
english:
Here are the teams’ lineups:

Arellano University, Colegio de San Juan de Letran, De La Salle-College of Saint Benilde, Emilio Aguinaldo College, Jose Rizal University, Lyceum of the Philippines University, Mapua University, San Beda University, San Sebastian College-Recoletos, University of Perpetual Help System DALTA

text: Ginbuyagyag ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr nga ginsipa sa puwesto si General Nicholas Torre bilang PNP Chief bangud sa pagsupak sini sa direktiba halin sa National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM).
english: President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. revealed that General Nicholas Torre was removed from his post as PNP Chief for violating the directive from the National Police Commission (NAPOLCOM).

text: Ginpahayag ni Marcos nga wala ginasunod ni Torre ang NAPOLCOM kun sa diin indi ini kumporme sa pila ka direktiba.
english: Marcos said Torre does not follow NAPOLCOM where he does not comply with some directives.

text: Dugang pa sang Presidente nga sang maistorya sini si Torre, ginpahayag niya nga may chain of command nga indi basta-basta mabalewala.
english: The President added that when he spoke to Torre, he said there is a chain of command that cannot be ignored.

text: Diri ginsiling niya kay Torre nga kakason niya ini sa puwesto kun sa diin ang sabat sang anay PNP chief amo nga wala na siya sang mahimo.
english: He told Torre that he would remove him from office to which the former PNP chief replied that he had no choice.

text: Nagapati ang presidente nga maayo nga pulis si Torre bangud ginaprotektahan niya ang iya nga mga tinawo.
english: The president believes that Torre is a good policeman because he protects his men.

text: Ginpanginwala man sang president ang isyu nga nadulaan ini sang pagsalig kay Torre rason nga ginsipa niya ini sa pwesto.
english: The president also denied the issue that he lost confidence in Torre and kicked him out of office.

text: Indi lang subong nga adlaw kundi sa sulod sang anom ka adlaw, may yara sang liwat nga pagtaas sa presyo sang produkto petrolyo.
english: Not only today but for the past six days, there has been a renewed increase in the price of petroleum products.

text: Ini na ang ika-siyam nga sunod-sunod nga semana sang price hike.
english: This is the ninth consecutive week of price hikes.

text: P1.15 centavos ang magadugang sa presyo sang gasolina kada litro; P0.45 sa diesel kag P0.55 sa kerosene.
english: P1.15 centavos to increase the price of gasoline per liter; P0.45 for diesel and P0.55 for kerosene.

text: Ang price adjustment ang nag-epekto na las 6 kaina sang aga.
english: The price adjustment took effect at 6 am yesterday.

text: Sa latest data gikan sa Department of Energy (DOE), ang year-to-date adjustments ang may kabug-usan nga net increase nga P19.65 sa kada litro sang gasolina, P18.00 sa kada litro sang diesel kag P15.49 sa kada litro sang kerosene.
english: According to the latest data from the Department of Energy (DOE), the year-to-date adjustments have a total net increase of P19.65 per liter of gasoline, P18.00 per liter of diesel and P15.49 per liter of kerosene.

text: Nagdangat sa P690.26 billion ang pondo nga ginpaggwa sang Department of Budget and Management (DBM) as of September 30, 2021.
english: The funds released by the Department of Budget and Management (DBM) amounted to P690.26 billion as of September 30, 2021.

text: Ang nasambit nga pondo ang para sa COVID-19 response programs sang gobyerno.
english: The said fund is for the government's COVID-19 response programs.

text: Santo sa DBM, sandig sa financial accountability reports sang pila ka ahensya sang gobyerno, 89.4 percent ukon P570.04 billion na sa kabug-usan nga gin-release nga budget ang na disbursed ukon naggasto.
english: According to the DBM, based on the financial accountability reports of several government agencies, 89.4 percent or P570.04 billion of the total released budget has been disbursed or spent.

text: Ang dugang nga pondo nga ginpaggwa sa ika-tatlo nga quarter sini nga tuig, ang gin-charge sa 2021 General Appropriations Act (GAA) kasunod sang expiration sang validity sang pondo sa idalom sang Bayanihan 1 kag 2 laws.
english: The additional funds released in the third quarter of this year, were charged to the 2021 General Appropriations Act (GAA) following the expiration of the validity of the funds under the Bayanihan 1 and 2 laws.

text: “These include the payment for the Covid-19 special risk allowance of public and private health workers, purchase of Covid-19 vaccine ancillaries, procurement of RT-PCR testing kits and renewal of contracts for hiring of healthcare professionals, among others,” pahayag sang DBM.
english: “These include the payment for the Covid-19 special risk allowance of public and private health workers, purchase of Covid-19 vaccine ancillaries, procurement of RT-PCR testing kits and renewal of contracts for hiring of healthcare professionals, among others,” the DBM said.

text: Napasaka na ang kaso batok sa pulis nga amo ang driver sang ambulansya sang Regional Medical and Dental Unit sang Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 nga nakabunggo sa isa ka 18-anyos nga estudyante sa Brgy.
english: A case has been filed against the policeman who is the driver of the ambulance of the Regional Medical and Dental Unit of the Police Regional Office (PRO) 6 that hit an 18-year-old student in Brgy.

text: Dungon B, Jaro, Iloilo City.
english: Dungon B, Jaro, Iloilo City.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson sang Iloilo City Police Office, iya ginpahayag nga kahapon, natigayon na nga mapasaka ang kaso nga reckless imprudence resulting in homicide batok sa driver nga may ranggo nga Police Corporal.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Major Shella Mae Sangrines, spokesperson of the Iloilo City Police Office, said that yesterday, a case of reckless imprudence resulting in homicide was filed against the driver with the rank of Police Corporal.

text: Suno kay Sangrines, sang Hunyo 4 natabo ang insidente samtang nagalakat ang biktima kag nagatabok pakadto sa Westwoods sa Brgy.
english: According to Sangrines, the incident occurred on June 4 while the victim was walking and crossing to Westwoods in Brgy.

text: Dungon B kun sa diin base sa resulta sang imbestigasyon, na-alang-alang ang ambulansya nga padulong kuntani sa Iloilo Police Provincial Office kag aksidente nga nabungguan ang biktima.
english: Dungon B where based on the results of the investigation, the ambulance that was heading to the Iloilo Police Provincial Office hesitated and accidentally hit the victim.

text: Bangud sa mabaskug nga impact, natabog ang biktima sang pila ka metros, nga rason sang pilas sa iya ulo kag pagkalipong.
english: Due to the strong impact, the victim was thrown several meters, causing head injuries and dizziness.

text: Natigayon pa nga madala ini sa ospital kun sa diin nagpaidalom pa sa pila ka operasyon, apang sang Hunyo 12, gindeklarar siya nga napatay.
english: He was rushed to the hospital where he underwent several operations, but on June 12, he was declared dead.

text: Suno sa ginikanan sang biktima, wala pa sila sang nabaton nga pinansyal nga bulig halin sa PRO 6 para sa bill sa ospital.
english: According to the victim's parents, they have not yet received any financial assistance from PRO 6 for the hospital bill.

text: Apang gin-athag man sang iloy sang biktima nga naka-contact na sa ila ang asawa sang nasambit nga pulis kag nagpalab-ot sang bulig pinansyal.
english: However, the victim's mother explained that the policeman's wife had already contacted them and offered financial assistance.

text: Padayon pa ang imbestigasyon sang mga otoridad may kaangtanan sa insidente kag sa kaso nga ginpasaka batok sa pulis nga driver sang ambulansya.
english: Authorities are still investigating the incident and the case filed against the police ambulance driver.

text: Uso gid subong amo ang crop tops ilabi na sa kababainhan.
english: Crop tops are very trendy right now especially for women.

text: Mahapos abi ini suksukon, mabugnaw, kag komportable kaayo.
english: I think it's easy to wear, cool, and very comfortable.

text: Bisan gani sa lalaki, napa-crop top man pati ang two-time Olympic gold medalist nga si Carlos Yulo nga gin-istoryahan gid sang halos bilog nga Pilipinas nga mahilig sa fashion trend.
english: Even the men, two-time Olympic gold medalist Carlos Yulo, who was talked about by almost the entire Philippines who love the fashion trend, also wore a crop top.

text: Apang paano kun bangud sa imo crop top, papanaugon ikaw sa salakyan?
english: But what if your crop top gets you out of the car?

text: Natabo ini sa tatlo ka babaye nga interesado gid subong nga mag-file sang reklamo batok sa isa ka kumpaniya sang eroplano matapos sila ginpapanaog bangud lang sa ila ginasuksok.
english: It happened to three women who are now keenly interested in filing a complaint against an airline after they were downgraded simply because of what they were wearing.

text: Nagsugod ang insidente sang nagsakay ang mag-abyan nga sanday Tara Kehidi kag Teresa Araujo nga halin sa Los Angeles, California kag pakadto kuntani sa New Orleans, Louisiana.
english: The incident began when friends Tara Kehidi and Teresa Araujo were traveling from Los Angeles, California to New Orleans, Louisiana.

text: Sang nagsaka pa lang ang duha, may sweater pa sila, apang gin-uba man nila ini bangud wala pa ginapaandar ang air conditioning system sang cabin samtang wala pa naka-take off.
english: When the two first boarded, they were still wearing sweaters, but they also took them off because the cabin's air conditioning system was not yet turned on while they had not yet taken off.

text: Pagkadugay-dugay, suno sa istorya sang duha, nagpalapit na ang lalaki nga flight attendant kag agresibo sila nga ginsilingan nga magsuksok sang bayo.
english: After a while, according to the two, the male flight attendant approached them and aggressively told them to get dressed.

text: Nabatian ini sang isa pa ka babaye nga pasahero nga si Carla Hager nga sang amo nga tion may upod nga bata nga lalaki.
english: This was overheard by another female passenger, Carla Hager who at the time had a young boy with her.

text: Ginsuportahan sini ang mag-abyan bangud magin-ot gid man sang amo nga tion, kag timing man nga naka-crop top siya kag naka-sweater.
english: He supported the couple because it was very cold at the time, and the timing was that he was wearing a crop top and a sweater.

text: Bangud sa komosyon, gin-uba man sini ang iya sweater bangud gusto gani sini ipakita ang iya suporta sa mag-abyan bisan indi man sila kilalahay.
english: Due to the commotion, he also took off his sweater because he wanted to show his support to the couple even though they did not know each other.

text: Sang ulihi, baw… tatlo gid sila ang ginpapanaog sa flight kag wala ginhatagan sang refunds!
english: Finally, three of them were taken off the flight and not given refunds!

text: Bisan ang ikatatlo nga babaye, wala nakaluwas gani amo man ang bitbit sini sa iya bata samtang ginpaguwa sa aircraft.
english: Even the third woman, did not survive so she was carrying her child while being evacuated from the aircraft.

text:
Suno kanday Tara kag Teresa, ginsilingan pa nila ang attendant kun pwede nga masuksok lang sila liwat sang sweater, apang wala na ginpasugtan kag “ulihi na ang tanan.”

Naggasto naman ang duha sang 1,000 USD ukon P57,000 para sa last-minute flight pakadto sa New Orleans bangud didto sila maga-selebrar sang birthday ni Tara.
english:
According to Tara and Teresa, they even asked the attendant if they could wear the sweater again, but they were not allowed and “it was too late.”

The two spent 1,000 USD or P57,000 for a last-minute flight to New Orleans because they were going to celebrate Tara's birthday there.

text: Tuman ang kalain sang ila buot sa natabo bangud daw kaangay suno sa ila nga ginkabig sila nga mga criminal bangud lamang sa ila crop top.
english: They were very upset about the incident because they said it was like they were considered criminals just because of their crop top.

text: Base sa Contract of Carriage sang airline company, mahimo nila balabagan ang customer ukon pasahero kun sila ang naga-tiniil lang ukon indi nagakaigu ang bayo.
english: Based on the airline company's Contract of Carriage, they can block a customer or passenger if they are barefoot or inappropriately dressed.

text: Wala man sini ginpahangop kun ang buot-silingon nila sa “lewd, obscene, or offensive in nature” nga mga bayo ang nagalakip pati sa mga crop-top.#
english: It also did not specify whether they meant by “lewd, obscene, or offensive in nature” clothes including crop-tops.#

text: Nakuha liwat ni Serbian tennis superstar Novak Djokovic ang World No.1 rank sa men’s singles rankings sang Association of Tennis Professionals ukon ATP.
english: Serbian tennis superstar Novak Djokovic has regained the World No.1 rank in the men's singles rankings of the Association of Tennis Professionals or ATP.

text: Ini apisar wala siya nakahampang sa BNP Paribas Open tournament sa Indian Wells.
english: This is despite not playing in the BNP Paribas Open tournament in Indian Wells.

text: Matandaan nga nadula sa nasambit nga 20-time Grand Slam champion ang no.
english: The 20-time Grand Slam champion lost the no.

text: 1 place sa ATP men’s singles world rankings kag nagkadto ini kay Russian contender Daniil Medvedev sang Pebrero.
english: 1 place in the ATP men’s singles world rankings and it went to Russian contender Daniil Medvedev in February.

text: Sang amo nga tion, first time ni Medvedev nga mapangalanan bilang World No.
english: At the time, it was Medvedev's first time to be named World No.

text: 1 kag siya man ang una nga player nga nakakuha sang amo nga rank magluwas kanday Djokovic, Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, kag Andy Murray.
english: 1 and is also the first player to achieve that rank aside from Djokovic, Roger Federer, Rafael Nadal, and Andy Murray.

text: Apang bangud napierde si Medvedev sa Round of 32 sa Indian Wells Masters, nabuhinan man ang iya nga puntos kag na-retain ni Djokovic ang No.
english: But because Medvedev lost in the Round of 32 at the Indian Wells Masters, his points were also reduced and Djokovic retained the No.

text: 1 ranking.
english: 1 ranking.

text: Nadakpan sa ginpatigayon nga entrapment operation ang isa ka empleyado sang City Planning and Development Office matapos ginreklamo sang robbery-extortion.
english: An employee of the City Planning and Development Office was arrested in an entrapment operation after he was complained of robbery-extortion.

text: Natabo ini sa Olongapo City.
english: It happened in Olongapo City.

text: Suno sa National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), magabukas sang dental clinic ang babaye nga biktima kag nagpadulong sa amo nga opisina kun sa diin ginpangayuan ini sang duwa ka mga empleyado sang P98,100 para sa zoning, locational, kag occupancy permits.
english: According to the National Bureau of Investigation (NBI), the female victim was about to open a dental clinic and went to the office where two employees asked her for P98,100 for zoning, locational, and occupancy permits.

text: Sa entrapment operation, naaktuhan nga nagabaton sang kwarta ang nadakpan nga suspek samtang ang ikaduwa nga suspek ang wala sa lugar sang natabo ang operasyon.
english: In the entrapment operation, the arrested suspect was caught receiving money while the second suspect was not at the scene when the operation took place.

text: Nagdepensa ang nadakpan nga suspek nga ginbuligan lang niya ang biktima kag ang amo nga kantidad ang “quotation” lamang para sa tanan nga balayran.
english: The arrested suspect defended that he only helped the victim and that the amount was only a quotation for all the bills.

text: Gin-athag naman sang otoridad nga wala sang gahum ang amo nga empleyado nga magbaton sang bayad para sa mga amo nga sahi sang transakasyon.
english: The authorities clarified that the employee has no authority to accept payment for such transactions.

text: Pasakaan ang mga suspek sang kaso nga paglapas sa Republic Act 3019 (Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act) kag Republic Act 6713 (Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and ­Employees).
english: The suspects will be charged with violations of Republic Act 3019 (Anti-Graft and Corrupt Practices Act) and Republic Act 6713 (Code of Conduct and Ethical Standards for Public Officials and Employees).

text: Nagakulumuron na ang mga barangay officials kag pumuluyo sang Barangay Dulonan, Arevalo bangud sa ginpa-untat nga contruction sang ila multi-purpose hall nga ginsuguran sang 2015, apang wala pa gihapon matapos tubtob subong nga tuig.
english: Barangay officials and residents of Barangay Dulonan, Arevalo are already complaining about the suspended construction of their multi-purpose hall which began in 2015, but has not been completed until this year.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Rodolfo Villegas, kapitan sang nasambit nga Barangay, iya ginpahayag nga 50% pa lang ang natapos antes ini ginpa-untat sang tuig 2022.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Rodolfo Villegas, barangay captain, said that only 50% of the work was completed before it was stopped in 2022.

text: Suno kay Villegas, nagatinulo na ang babaw nga porsyon sang atop sang nasambit nga hall, nga nagapadugang pa gid sang problema.
english: According to Villegas, the upper portion of the roof of the hall is already leaking, which adds to the problem.

text: Apektado na subong ang mga kabataan nga naga-eskwela, bangud ang idalum sang building ginhimo bilang daycare center.
english: School children are now affected, as the basement of the building has been converted into a daycare center.

text: Ang multi-purpose building kuntani ang maga-serbe bilang barangay hall, daycare center, kag venue sang mga aktibidad sa komunidad.
english: The multi-purpose building was supposed to serve as a barangay hall, daycare center, and venue for community activities.

text: Apang tungod sang pag-untat sang construction, limitado ang gamit sang pasilidad kag nabudlayan ang barangay sa pagpatigayon sang mga serbisyo.
english: However, due to the cessation of construction, the use of the facility is limited and the barangay has difficulty in providing services.

text: Sa subong, ginahulat pa sang mga barangay officials ang desisyon ni Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Jamjam Baronda kun san-o liwat mapadayon ang pagpaobra sang nasambit nga building.
english: At present, barangay officials are still waiting for the decision of Iloilo City Lone District Representative Julienne Jamjam Baronda on when to resume the construction of the said building.

text: Ginadayaw sang mga fans sang aktres nga si Nadine Lustre ang pagsunod niya sa physical distancing samtang nagapamalaklon sa isa ka supermarket.
english: Fans of actress Nadine Luster are praising her for following physical distancing while shopping in a supermarket.

text: Ini matapos nga gin-upload sang isa ka fan sang aktres ang picture niya samtang nagapila sa supermarket.
english: This was after a fan of the actress uploaded a picture of her while queuing at the supermarket.

text: Makita man sa picture nga nakasuksok si Nadine sang mask nga isa sa mga protocol antes makasulod sa mga merkado kag iban pa nga establisyemento komersyal.
english: The picture also shows Nadine wearing a mask as one of the protocols before entering markets and other commercial establishments.

text: Suno pa sa fan nga nakakita, naga-isahanon lang nga nagpadulong sa supermarket ang aktres nga base man sa pagsulundan sang gobyerno sa diin isa lang ka tawo kada household ang mahimo nga makagwa kag makapamakal sang mga essential goods kaangay nalang sang pagkaon kag bulong.
english: According to a fan who saw it, the actress went to the supermarket alone, which is also based on the government's rules where only one person per household can go out and buy essential goods such as food and medicine.
