text: Madumduman nga humalin sang nagsugod ang pandemic, isa si Nadine sa mga nagpalab-ot na sang bulig sa mga frontliners kag iban pa nga apektado sang krisis.
english: Since the beginning of the pandemic, Nadine has been one of those who have already provided assistance to frontliners and others affected by the crisis.

text: Maga-import sang isda ang gobyerno agud nga masolusyonan ang kakulang sa suplay bangud sa off-fishing season.
english: The government will import fish to solve the supply shortage due to the off-fishing season.

text: Suno kay Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) Director Dr. Eduardo Gongona, pila sa mga major fishing areas sa Pilipinas ang indi pa mapangisdaan bangud kinahanglan sang mga isda nga mangitlog.
english: According to Bureau of Fisheries and Aquatic Resources (BFAR) Director Dr. Eduardo Gongona, some of the major fishing areas in the Philippines are not yet fished because the fish need to lay eggs.

text: Apektado sang off-fishing season pahayag niya ang mga local producer gani sa ini man nga tion nga naga-harvest na sa aquaculture.
english: He said local producers are affected by the off-fishing season and are already harvesting in aquaculture.

text: Apang dugang ni Dr. Gongona, kulang pa man ini sa gihapon gani ang rekomendasyon sang Department of Agriculture amo nga mag-import sang inug-dugang sa suplay sang isda.
english: But Dr. Gongona, it is still not enough so the recommendation of the Department of Agriculture is to import to supplement the supply of fish.

text: Kinahanglan ini suno sa iya bilang balancing act agud nga indi magtaas ang presyo sang isda kag indi makaapekto sa inflation.
english: He said this is necessary as a balancing act so that the price of fish does not rise and does not affect inflation.

text: Nagdala sang mga buhawi, baha, kag storm surges ang paglaslas ni hurricane Milton sa Florida, USA.
english: Hurricane Milton brought tornadoes, floods, and storm surges to Florida, USA.

text: Masobra sa duha ka milyon ka mga puluy-an ang nadulaan sang kuryente kag may narekord man nga patay.
english: More than two million homes lost power and deaths were also recorded.

text: Sa St.
english: In St.

text: Petersburg, sa west coast sang estado,nakakas gid ang atop sang Major League Baseball stadium.
english: Petersburg, on the west coast of the state, the roof of the Major League Baseball stadium was completely torn off.

text: Ang Milton isa ka category five hurricane nga gin-downgrade na subong sa category one apang padayon ang paglaslas kag pagpanghalit sini.
english: Milton is a category five hurricane that has now been downgraded to category one but continues to wreak havoc.

text: Si Milton ang naglaslas duha ka semana matapos ang paghalit man ni Hurricane Helene nga nagpatay sa kapin 225 ka tawo sa Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia kag North Carolina.
english: Milton struck two weeks after Hurricane Helene also struck and killed more than 225 people in Florida, Georgia, South Carolina, Tennessee, Virginia and North Carolina.

text: Indi mahapos ang kabuhi sang pila ka mga estudyante sa Batad, Iloilo sa una nga adlaw pa lang sang pagsugod sang klase para sa school year 2025-2026.
english: Life is not easy for some students in Batad, Iloilo on the first day of classes for the school year 2025-2026.

text: Ini bangud kinahanglan pa nila nga magsakay sa baroto para mag-eskwela.
english: This is because they still have to take a boat to go to school.

text: Didto ini sa Sitio Magalumbi Island, Tanao, Batad.
english: It is located in Sitio Magalumbi Island, Tanao, Batad.

text: Ini nga baroto ang gindonar sang Global Literacy Organization.
english: This boat was donated by the Global Literacy Organization.

text: Kapin 20 ka kabataan ang nagasakay diri para makakadto sa ila eskwelahan.
english: More than 20 children ride it to get to school.

text: Balida Ernesto, Vice Mayor of Batad
english: Balida Ernesto, Vice Mayor of Batad

text: Mas masolusyunan ang impact sang nagataas nga presyo sang produktong petrolyo kun buligan na lang ang transportation sector sa baylo nga dulaon ang fuel excise tax.
english: The impact of the rising price of petroleum products can be better solved if the transportation sector is helped instead of the fuel excise tax.

text: Suno kay Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) Deputy Governor Francisco Dakila Jr., nagakadapat nga tutukan sang national government ang assistance nga ihatag para sa vulnerable sectors sang ekonomiya ilabi na sa public transport sector.
english: Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas (BSP) Deputy Governor Francisco Dakila Jr. said the national government should focus on assistance to be provided to vulnerable sectors of the economy especially the public transport sector.

text: “Having more targeted intervention would be actually more effective.
english: “Having more targeted intervention would be actually more effective.

text:
And that assistance can be directed to the most vulnerable sectors of the economy including on public transport.”

Ini nga pahayag ang sabat sang BSP sa panawagan sang Department of Energy nga i-suspende ang excise tax sa produktong petrolyo agud nga mapanubuan ang presyo sang gatong.
english:
And that assistance can be directed to the most vulnerable sectors of the economy including on public transport.”

The BSP's statement was in response to the Department of Energy's call to suspend the excise tax on petroleum products in order to reduce fuel prices.

text: “Although there’s no official stance on this, I’ll just note that cutting excise taxes will have an impact on the fiscal position.
english: “Although there’s no official stance on this, I’ll just note that cutting excise taxes will have an impact on the fiscal position.

text: So that’s one big consideration.
english: So that’s a big consideration.

text: But the benefit will accrue both to the poor and also to the wealthy,” dugang pa ni Dakila.
english: But the benefit will accrue both to the poor and also to the wealthy,” Dakila added.

text: Nahibaluan nga santo sa Department of Finance, mahimo maglab-ot sa P131.4 billion ang kapyerdehan sang gobyerno sa revenue sa masunod nga tuig kun indi ma-implementar ang fuel excise tax.
english: According to the Department of Finance, the government could lose P131.4 billion in revenue next year if the fuel excise tax is not implemented.

text: Wala sang pagbag-o sa kahimtangan sang impeachment case batok kay Vice President Sara Duterte samtang ginahulat pa ang desisyon sang Supreme Court (SC) sa mga gin-file nga motion for reconsideration (MR).
english: There is no change in the status of the impeachment case against Vice President Sara Duterte while the decision of the Supreme Court (SC) on the filed motions for reconsideration (MR) is still awaited.

text: Ini ang suno kay Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III.
english: This is according to Senate President Vicente “Tito” Sotto III.

text: Sa bulan sang Agosto, ginbotohan sang Senado sa idalom sang liderato ni anay Senate President Chiz Escudero nga i-archive ukon ibutang sa records ang articles of impeachment batok kay Duterte, kasunod sang desisyon sang Supreme Court nga nagdeklarar nga unconstitutional ang impeachment process.
english: In August, the Senate under the leadership of former Senate President Chiz Escudero voted to archive or put on record the articles of impeachment against Duterte, following the Supreme Court's decision that declared the impeachment process unconstitutional.

text: Apang ginpahayag ni Sotto nga dapat pa hulaton ang desisyon sang SC sa motion for reconsideration nga gin-file sang Office of the Solicitor General (OSG), bilang representante sang House of Representatives.
english: However, Sotto said the SC's decision on the motion for reconsideration filed by the Office of the Solicitor General (OSG), as a representative of the House of Representatives, should be awaited.

text: Nagapabilin nga naka-archive ang impeachment case samtang nagapadayon ang legal nga proseso.
english: The impeachment case remains archived while the legal process continues.

text: Ginpasalamatan sang aktres nga si Iza Calzado ang tanan nga nagpalab-ot sa iya sang suporta sa iya nangin away batok sa COVID-19.
english: Actress Iza Calzado thanked everyone who extended their support to her in her fight against COVID-19.

text: Suno kay Iza, bangud sa pangamuyo kag suporta nga iya nabaton gikan sa iya mga fans kag pamilya madasig siya nga nakarecover sa pinaka mabudlay nga tion sang iya nga kabuhi.
english: According to Iza, thanks to the prayers and support she received from her fans and family, she quickly recovered from the most difficult time of her life.

text: Ginpanugyanan man sang aktres ang publiko nga padayon nga maghalad sang pangamuyo agud matapos na ang krisis nga gintuga sang COVID-19.
english: The actress also advised the public to continue to offer prayers for an end to the crisis caused by COVID-19.

text: Madumduman nga sang Marso 30, ginkumpirma sang manager sang aktres nga nagnegatibo na sya sa nasambit nga balatian.
english: On March 30, the actress' manager confirmed that she had tested negative for the disease.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Iza ang ika duha nga showbiz personality nga natapikan sang COVID-19 sa diin una na diri ang beterano nga aktor nga si Christopher de Leon.
english: Iza is the second showbiz personality to be infected with COVID-19, followed by veteran actor Christopher de Leon.

text: Wala sang sudlan ang kalipay sang isa ka Ukrainian high jumper matapos nagdaug sang gold medal sa World Indoor Championships sa Belgrade, Serbia.
english: A Ukrainian high jumper was overjoyed after winning a gold medal at the World Indoor Championships in Belgrade, Serbia.

text: Ang atleta nga si Yaroslava Mahuchikh ang una nga nakakuha sang bulawan nga medalya para sa iya pungsod sa sulod sang 20 ka tuig.
english: Athlete Yaroslava Mahuchikh won the first gold medal for her country in 20 years.

text: Suno sa atleta, sobra-sobra man ang iya nga naagyan antes maka-compete sa Serbia bangud man sang pagpang-atake sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: According to the athlete, he went through a lot before competing in Serbia because of Russia's attack on Ukraine.

text: Nagtinir pa ang 20-anyos nga atleta sa basement sang balay antes nagbyahe pa-Serbia.
english: The 20-year-old athlete stayed in the basement of the house before traveling to Serbia.

text: Tatlo ka adlaw ang iya byahe sa amo nga tion.
english: He was three days away at the time.

text: Siya man ang reigning European Indoor high jump champion kag nagdaug sang bronze medal sa Tokyo Olympics.
english: She is also the reigning European Indoor high jump champion and won a bronze medal at the Tokyo Olympics.

text: Nalakip sa top 7 finalists ang tiglawas sang Iloilo City nga si Denver Tajanlangit sa Miss Trans Global pageant 2025.
english: Iloilo City representative Denver Tajanlangit is among the top 7 finalists in the Miss Trans Global pageant 2025.

text: Ginpatigayon ang finals night sa Baguio City, kagab-i, Hunyo 15.
english: The finals night was held in Baguio City, last night, June 15.

text: Si Tajanlangit ang nakoronahan bilang SOGIESC Ambassador 2024.
english: Tajanlangit was crowned SOGIESC Ambassador 2024.

text: Magluwas sa iya adbokasiya natuhoy sa LGBTQIA+ visibility kag SOGIE Education, isa man ini ka fast rising host sa syudad.
english: Aside from her advocacy on LGBTQIA+ visibility and SOGIE Education, she is also a fast rising host in the city.

text: Napatay ang isa ka piloto samtang yara sa tunga-tunga sang flight halin sa Seattle, Washington, USA kag pakadto kuntani sa Istanbul, Turkey.
english: A pilot died while mid-flight from Seattle, Washington, USA and bound for Istanbul, Turkey.

text: Suno sa Turkish Airlines, nalipong ang 59-anyos nga pilot nga si Ilçehin Pehlivan samtang yara sa flight 204.
english: According to Turkish Airlines, 59-year-old pilot Ilçehin Pehlivan fainted while on flight 204.

text: Apisar sang medical intervention, wala naumpawan ang piloto rason nga nag-desisyon ang co-pilot sini nga magpatigayon sang emergency landing, apang ginbawian gid sang kabuhi si Pehlivan antes pa man makahugpa ang eroplano.
english: Despite medical intervention, the pilot was not comforted and his co-pilot decided to conduct an emergency landing, but Pehlivan died before the plane could land.

text: Base sa data sang tracking site nga FlightAware, ang Airbus A350 ang nakahugpa sa John F. Kennedy International Airport sa New York City antes ang alas sais sa aga.
english: Based on data from tracking site FlightAware, the Airbus A350 landed at John F. Kennedy International Airport in New York City shortly before 6am.

text: Hilway man sa katalagman ang tanan nga pasahero kag may ginhimo nga arrangements ang kumpaniya agud makalab-ot sila sa ila destinasyon.
english: All passengers are safe and the company has made arrangements for them to reach their destination.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Pehlivan ang naga-trabaho sa Turkish Airlines halin sang 2007 kag base sa health check sang Marso, wala man ini sang problema sa ikaayong lawas nga sarang makabalabag sa iya trabaho.
english: Pehlivan has been working for Turkish Airlines since 2007 and based on a health check in March, he has no health problems that could interfere with his work.

text: “As Turkish Airlines, we deeply feel the loss of our captain and extend our sincerest condolences to his bereaved family, colleagues, and all his loved ones,” kabahin sang statement sang airlines.
english: “As Turkish Airlines, we deeply feel the loss of our captain and extend our sincerest condolences to his bereaved family, colleagues, and all his loved ones,” part of the airlines statement.

text: Nagkit-anay na kag naka-istoryahanay sanday Pope Francis kag Cardinal-designate Pablo Virgilio David sa Synod Hall sa Vatican City.
english: Pope Francis and Cardinal-designate Pablo Virgilio David met and spoke at the Synod Hall in Vatican City.

text: Base sa video sang Roman Catholic Bishop of Kalookan, gintamyaw ni Bishop Ambo si Pope Francis gamit ang lenggwahe nga Espanyol, nagpasalamat ini, kag nagsiling nga daku gid ang impact sang Santo Papa sa iya kabuhi.
english: Based on the video of the Roman Catholic Bishop of Kalookan, Bishop Ambo greeted Pope Francis in Spanish, thanked him, and said that the Pope had a great impact on his life.

text:
Ginsugid pa sini sa Santo Papa nga wala siya nagpati sang una niya nabatian ang appointment sa iya bilang cardinal bangud nagpinsar siya nga isa lang ini ka “joke.”

Sa malip-ot nga meeting, nabatian man si Bishop David nga nagapasalig kay Pope nga yara lang siya kun kinahanglanon siya sini.
english:
He told the Pope that he did not believe it when he first heard about his appointment as cardinal because he thought it was just a “joke.”

During the brief meeting, Bishop David was also heard assuring Pope that he would be there if he needed him.

text: Nagpangayo man ini nga i-bless siya kag nakit-an man nga gin-bless ini ni Pope Francis kag ginhakos.
english: He also asked to be blessed and was seen blessed by Pope Francis and hugged.

text: Matandaan nga si Bishop David kag 20 ka iban pa halin sa lain-lain nga parte sang kalibutan ang gin-anunsyo ni Pope Francis nga mangin cardinal.
english: It can be recalled that Bishop David and 20 others from different parts of the world were announced by Pope Francis to become cardinals.

text: Ginpatigayon ang anunsyo pagkatapos sangAngelus prayer sa Vatican sang Domingo.
english: The announcement was made after the Angelus prayer at the Vatican on Sunday.

text: Si Bishop David naman nga presidente man sang Catholic Bishops’ Conference of the Philippines (CBCP) ang yara subong sa Roma agud magtambong sa General Ordinary Assembly sang Synod of Bishops.
english: Bishop David, who is also president of the Catholic Bishops' Conference of the Philippines (CBCP), is currently in Rome to attend the General Ordinary Assembly of the Synod of Bishops.

text: Ang 65-anyos nga obispo ang natalana nga mangin ika-napulo nga FIlipino cardinal sa maragtas sang Pilipinas.#
english: The 65-year-old bishop is set to become the tenth Filipino cardinal in Philippine history.

text: Madulom pa sa gihapon subong kun aprubahan gid man ang petition sang transport groups sa pungsod nga pasakaan ang plete sang mga pasahero sa mga jeep.
english: It is still unclear whether the petition of transport groups in the country to increase the fare of passengers in jeeps will be approved.

text: Ang hingyo sang transport sector ang kasunod sang binulan na nga pagtaas sa presyo sang gatong.
english: The transport sector's request follows months of increases in fuel prices.

text: Gin-quote ni Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Chairman Martin Delgra ang “guidance” ni Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Arthur Tugade nga kun pwede, indi lang pagpataasan ang bayad sa public utility jeepneys (PUJs) bangud madamo ang maapektuhan.
english: Land Transportation Franchising and Regulatory Board (LTFRB) Chairman Martin Delgra quoted the “guidance” of Department of Transportation (DOTr) Secretary Arthur Tugade that if possible, not only increase the fare for public utility jeepneys (PUJs) because many will be affected.

text: “Ang guidance po ni [Transportation] Secretary [Arthur Tugade], kung puwede hindi magtataas ng pamasahe.
english: “The guidance of [Transportation] Secretary [Arthur Tugade], if possible not to increase the fare.

text: On one hand we understand very much the concern and basis for the petition pero kung papayagan po natin ang petition na ‘yan, may matatamaan naman na mas nakakarami,” suno kay Delgra.
english: On one hand we understand very much the concern and basis for the petition but if we allow that petition, there will be more people who will be affected,” Delgra said.

text: Irekomenda na sang DOTr suno kay Delgra nga i-increase lang ang seating capacity ukon ang pwede nga makasakay sa mga public transportation.
english: Delgra said the DOTr will recommend increasing the seating capacity of public transportation.

text: Pwede man dugang niya nga buhion ang fuel subsidy ukon damuon ang diskuwento sang mga gasolinahan sa mga public jeepneys.May patigayunon man nga pagsinapol sa House transportation committee agud istoryahan ang diskarte kun paano mabuligan ang transport sector.
english: He added that the fuel subsidy could be extended or the discount of gas stations on public jeepneys could be increased. There will also be a meeting with the House transportation committee to discuss the strategy on how to help the transport sector.

text: Nagpirmahanay sang Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) ang Iloilo City Government kag Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) subong nga adlaw natuhoy sa pag-enroll sang ginabulubanta 4,000 ka mga job hire sa Group Enrollment Program sang National Health Insurance Program (NHIP).
english: The Iloilo City Government and Philippine Health Insurance Corporation (PhilHealth) signed a Memorandum of Agreement (MOA) today regarding the enrollment of an estimated 4,000 job hires in the Group Enrollment Program of the National Health Insurance Program (NHIP).

text: Ang MOA signing gintambungan nanday Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, City Administrator Melchor Tan, PhilHealth Regional Office 6 Acting Vice President Lazaro Tabsing, Field Operations Division Chief Junie Sabusap kag pila pa ka mga representative sang PhilHealth.
english: The MOA signing was attended by Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas, City Administrator Melchor Tan, PhilHealth Regional Office 6 Acting Vice President Lazaro Tabsing, Field Operations Division Chief Junie Sabusap and several other representatives of PhilHealth.

text: Ang kasugtanan sa tunga sang duha ang may tinutuyo nga mahatagan sang mga health benefits ang mga job hire kag maka-conduct sang regular nga Information and Education Campaign (IEC) agud ma-familiarize sang mga enrollees ang polisa sang PhilHealth, benepisyo, availment procedures, kinamatarong kag obligasyon sa idalom sang program.
english: The agreement between the two aims to provide health benefits to job hires and conduct regular Information and Education Campaign (IEC) to familiarize enrollees with PhilHealth policies, benefits, availment procedures, rights and obligations under the program.

text: Matigdas nga ginpanginwala ni Quezon City 1st District Rep.
english: Quezon City 1st District Rep.

text: Arjo Atayde ang alegasyon ni Curlee Discaya nga nalakip siya sa government officials nga involved sa flood control kickbacks.
english: Arjo Atayde rejected Curlee Discaya's allegation that he was among the government officials involved in flood control kickbacks.

text: Pahayag sini, wala siya naga-benepisyo sa bisan sin-o man nga konktraktor, kag wala sang kamatuoran sa akusasyon ni Discaya nga ginbulgar kadungan sang Senate hearing, Septyembre 8.
english: He said he is not benefiting from any contractor, and there is no truth in Discaya's accusation that was exposed during the Senate hearing, September 8.

text: Nagpahayag ang actor-turned-politician nga tinluan sini ang iya pangalan kag pasabton sa layi ang nagapalapta sang sala nga mga istorya.
english: The actor-turned-politician said he will clear his name and hold those who spread false stories accountable.

text: Samtang, gindepensahan sang TV host-actress nga si Maine Mendoza ang iya bana nga si Quezon City Rep.
english: Meanwhile, TV host-actress Maine Mendoza defended her husband, Quezon City Rep.

text: Arjo Atayde matapos gindalahig ini sang contractor nga si Curlee Discaya kag gin-akusaran nga isa ini sa nagabaton sang porsiyento sa ila nga mga proyekto.
english: Arjo Atayde after he was involved by contractor Curlee Discaya and accused of being one of the recipients of percentages in their projects.

text: Gintawag ini sang aktres nga “baseless allegations”.
english: The actress called them “baseless allegations”.

text: Pahayag sini, nagalaum siya kag nagapangamuyo nga mapasabat ang mga tawo nga amo ang matuod nga responsable sa kurapsyon kag mahilway naman sa sini nga eskandalo ang mga inosente nga indibidwal.
english: He said he hopes and prays that the people who are truly responsible for corruption will be held accountable and that innocent individuals will be freed from this scandal.

text: Ginpanubo na sa Category 3 ang anay Category 5 Hurricane Milton samtang labi ini nga nagapalapit sa state sang Florida sa Estados Unidos sang Amerika.
english: Former Category 5 Hurricane Milton has been downgraded to Category 3 as it approaches the state of Florida in the United States of America.

text: Apisar nagnubo ang kategorya, nagpaandam ang weather forecasters sang daku gihapon nga mga halit nga posible dal-on sini sa mga residente.
english: Despite the decline in the category, weather forecasters warned of still serious damage that it could bring to residents.

text: Suno sa National Hurricane Center, posible nga mag-landfall ini Myerkules sang gab-i (US time).
english: According to the National Hurricane Center, it is likely to make landfall Wednesday night (US time).

text: Padayon ang pagpangabay sa mga residente nga magbakwit bangud possible mapatay sila kun magpakatig-a pa nga magtinir sa delikado nga lugar.
english: Residents are still being asked to evacuate because they may die if they insist on staying in the dangerous area.

text: Gintawag man ini ni US President Joe Biden nga “storm of the century” sa isa ka White House press briefing.
english: US President Joe Biden also called it the “storm of the century” in a White House press briefing.

text: Una na ini gindeklarar nga national emergency antes pa man ang ginalauman nga pag-landfall sini sa west coast sang Florida malapit sa Manatee county.#
english: It was previously declared a national emergency ahead of its expected landfall on the west coast of Florida near Manatee county.#

text: Isahanon ang pambato sang Pilipinas sa World Athletics Indoor Championships sa Serbia nga maga-umpisa na buwas nga adlaw.
english: The Philippines will compete alone at the World Athletics Indoor Championships in Serbia starting tomorrow.

text: Dal-on sang Filipina-American sprinter nga si Kristina Knott ang hayahay sang Pilipinas matapos nga nag-qualify ini sa amo nga hinampang.
english: Filipino-American sprinter Kristina Knott will carry the Philippines title after qualifying for the games.

text: Kaupod kuntani ni Knott si star pole vaulter EJ Obiena kun nahatagan ini sang endorsement halin sa Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA).
english: Knott would have been accompanied by star pole vaulter EJ Obiena if he had been given an endorsement from the Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA).

text: May yara sang 49 ka mga sprinters nga magapasakop sa event nga nagikan sa 38 ka mga pungsod.
english: There will be 49 sprinters participating in the event from 38 countries.

text: Sa subong, yara sa number 150 ang rank ni Knott sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Knott is currently ranked number 150 in the world.

text:
Kritikal sa ospital ang isa ka lalaki matapos mabun-an sang iya upod nga nagahampang sang pusoy sa isa ka namatyan sa Project 5, Barangay Sooc, Arevalo, Iloilo City subong nga gab-i.

Ang biktima amo si Alyas Rocky, legal ang edad residente sang nasambit nga barangay kag ang suspek amo si Alyas Dodong, legal ang edad kag residente sang probinsya sang Iloilo.
english:
A man is in critical condition after being stabbed by his companion while playing pusoy with a deceased in Project 5, Barangay Sooc, Arevalo, Iloilo City tonight.

The victim was identified as Rocky, legal age, resident of the said barangay and the suspect was identified as Dodong, legal age, resident of Iloilo province.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Staff Sergeant Vergel Deatras, imbestigador sang Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 6, iya ginpahayag nga samtang nagahampang sang pusoy ukon baraha ang duha sa namatyan, may natabo nga pagbinaisay sa tunga nila kag didto na nga nagdesisyon ang suspek nga magpauli sa ginatiniran niya nga balay malapit sa namatyan, apang ginlagas ini kag sang masulod na kuntani ang suspek sa ila nga kudal, ginbutong ini sang biktima kag nagpukotay apang bangud nga may dala na nga kutsilyo ang suspek, gilayon nga ginbuno niya ang biktima.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Staff Sergeant Vergel Deatras, investigator of Iloilo City Police Station (ICPS) 6, said that while the two were playing cards with the deceased, there was an argument between them and the suspect decided to go home to his house. in their fence, the victim threw it and started fighting but since the suspect was already carrying a knife, he immediately stabbed the victim.

text: Suno kay Deatras, pilas sa nawala nga bahin sang tiyan ang naangkon sang biktima kag suno sa ma residente nga nakakita, nagguluwa gid ang tinae sini bangud sa pilas nga naangkon.
english: According to Deatras, the victim sustained injuries to the left side of his stomach and according to residents who saw him, his intestines came out due to the injuries sustained.

text: Gilayon man nga ginhingagaw dala sa malapit nga ospital ang biktima agud madapatan sang nagakaigo nga pagbulong.Narecover man sa crime scene ang kitchen knife nga gingamit sa krimen.
english: The victim was rushed to a nearby hospital for treatment. A kitchen knife used in the crime was also recovered from the crime scene.

text: Sa subong, padayon pa ang hot pursuit operation sang ICPS 6 sa suspek nga nakapalagyo.
english: ICPS 6 is still conducting a hot pursuit operation against the suspect.

text: Text by: Bombo Hanna Andasa
english: Text by: Bombo Hanna Andasa

text: May yara na naman sang big-time increase sa presyo sang produkto petrolyo subong nga adlaw.
english: There was another big-time increase in the price of petroleum products today.

text: Ini na ang ika-walo nga sunod-sunod nga semana sang price hike.
english: This is the eighth consecutive week of price hikes.

text: P1.90 centavos ang magadugang sa presyo sang gasolina kada litro; P1.50 sa diesel kag P1.40 sa kerosene.
english: P1.90 centavos to increase the price of gasoline per liter; P1.50 for diesel and P1.40 for kerosene.

text: Ang price adjustment ang nag-epekto na kaina las 6 sang aga.
english: The price adjustment took effect yesterday at 6 am.

text: Sa latest data gikan sa Department of Energy (DOE), ang year-to-date adjustments ang may net increase nga P17.85 kada litro sang gasolina, kag P16.50 kada litro sang diesel.
english: According to the latest data from the Department of Energy (DOE), the year-to-date adjustments have a net increase of P17.85 per liter for gasoline, and P16.50 per liter for diesel.

text: Pagapangunahan ni Senate President Pro Tempore Ping Lacson ang imbestigasyon sang Senate Blue Ribbon Committee sa maanomaliya nga flood control projects sa pungsod.
english: Senate President Pro Tempore Ping Lacson will lead the Senate Blue Ribbon Committee's investigation into anomalous flood control projects in the country.

text: Ini matapos ginkumpirmar ni Senate President Vicente Sotto III nga magabulos si Lacson kay Senador Rodante Marcoleta bilang chairman sang komitiba.
english: This comes after Senate President Vicente Sotto III confirmed that Lacson will replace Senator Rodante Marcoleta as chairman of the committee.

text: Gin-athag ni Sotto nga indi miyembro sang majority bloc si Marcoleta kag ang Blue Ribbon Committee ang para lamang sa mayoriya.
english: Sotto clarified that Marcoleta is not a member of the majority bloc and the Blue Ribbon Committee is only for the majority.

text: Suno sa iya, wala sang nagaluntad nga mga pagsulundan, bisan sa Blue Ribbon Committee Charter ukon sa pangkabilugan nga Senate Rules, ang nagasiling nga ang chairman sang Blue Ribbon Committee dapat isa ka abogado.
english: He said none of the existing rules, either in the Blue Ribbon Committee Charter or the general Senate Rules, say the chairman of the Blue Ribbon Committee must be a lawyer.

text: Pahayag pa sini, bastante lamang nga mga katapo sang mayoriya ang kinahanglanon nga kwalipikasyon sa pagpamuno sa nasambit nga gamhanan nga komitiba.
english: He said only enough members of the majority are qualified to head the powerful committee.

text: Samtang, naghatag sang halimbawa si Sotto nga sadtong 9th Congress, ginpili nila si Senador Sonny Alvarez bilang chairman sang Blue Ribbon Committee bisan indi ini abogado.
english: Meanwhile, Sotto gave an example that during the 9th Congress, they elected Senator Sonny Alvarez as chairman of the Blue Ribbon Committee even though he is not a lawyer.

text: Dugang pa sang Senate President, ang mangin isa ka abogado ang indi garantiya nga mangin isa ka maayo nga imbestigador.
english: The Senate President added that being a lawyer is no guarantee of being a good investigator.

text: Suno sa iya, mas maayo si Lacson kon imbestigasyon ang pagahambalan.
english: He said Lacson is better when it comes to investigation.

text: Apang, suno kay Sotto, magapabilin si Senador Sherwin Gatchalian bilang chairman sang Committee on Finance nga amo ang magapanguna sa imbestigasyon sa ginaduso nga national fund para sa tuig 2026.
english: However, Sotto said Senator Sherwin Gatchalian will remain as chairman of the Committee on Finance which will lead the investigation into the proposed national fund for 2026.

text: Nakagwa na sa ospital ang aktor nga si Christopher De leon matapos nga nagpositibo sa Coronavirus Disease 2019.
english: Actor Christopher De Leon has been discharged from the hospital after testing positive for Coronavirus Disease 2019.

text: Suno sa talent manager sang aktor nga si Lolit Solis, gintugutan na sang iya nga doktor nga makagwa si Christopher bangud amat-amat na nga naga ayo ang iya nga kondisyon.
english: According to the actor's talent manager, Lolit Solis, his doctor has allowed Christopher to leave because his condition is slowly improving.

text: Madumduman nga sang Marso 17 sang ginkumpirma sang aktor nga nagpositibo sya sa nasambit nga balatian kag kinahanglan niya nga iconfine sa ospital.
english: It can be recalled that on March 17, the actor confirmed that he tested positive for the disease and had to be confined to the hospital.

text: Sa subong kinahanglan sa gihapon nga magpaidalom sa 14 ka adlaw nga quarantine sang aktor agud masiguro nga mangin hilway na siya sa virus.
english: The actor is still required to undergo a 14-day quarantine to ensure that he is free of the virus.

text: Nagsaka sa 44.6 percent ukon kapin P570.4 billion ang balor nga nagasto sang gobyerno para sa imprastraktura sa una nga walo ka bulan sang 2021.
english: Government spending on infrastructure rose by 44.6 percent or more than P570.4 billion in the first eight months of 2021.

text: Ang nasambit nga balor ang gingamit sang gobyerno para sa big-ticket projects apisar sang malawig nga pagpatuman sang quarantine restrictions.
english: The said value was used by the government for big-ticket projects despite the long implementation of quarantine restrictions.

text: Santo sa latest nga data sang Department of Budget and Management (DBM), nagsaka ang expenditures sa infrastructure kag iban pa nga capital outlays halin sa P394.5 billion nga gasto sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: According to the latest data of the Department of Budget and Management (DBM), expenditures on infrastructure and other capital outlays increased from P394.5 billion last year.

text: Kun isipon ang subsidies kag equity sa state-run corporations amo man ang transfers sa lokal nga mga gobyerno sa idalom sang infrastructure components, ang kabug-usan nga infra disbursements humalin sang Enero tubtob Agusto tuig 2021 ang yara sa kapin P717.6 billion, mas mataas sa 37.7 percent halin sa P521 billion sang una man nga walo ka bulan sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: Including subsidies and equity to state-run corporations as well as transfers to local governments under infrastructure components, total infra disbursements from January to August 2021 stood at more than P717.6 billion, up 37.7 percent from P521 billion in the first eight months of last year.

text: Ginpaiway sang Pre-Trial Chamber I sang International Criminal Court (ICC) ang natalana nga hearing para confirmation of charges batuk kay anay Presidente Rodrigo Duterte nga una nga gintalana sa Setyembre 23, 2025.
english: The Pre-Trial Chamber I of the International Criminal Court (ICC) has postponed the scheduled hearing for confirmation of charges against former President Rodrigo Duterte that was initially scheduled for September 23, 2025.

text: Ang nasambit nga desisyon ang nagtulod sa hingyo sang kampo ni Duterte nga i-postpone ang hearing bangud sa ila pahayag nga indi siya “fit to stand trial” ukon indi na makatambong sa trial bangud sa kondisyon sang iya ikaayong lawas.
english: The decision prompted Duterte's camp to request a postponement of the hearing because of their statement that he was not “fit to stand trial” or could not attend the trial due to his health condition.

text: Suno sa ICC, ginpatuman ang limitado nga postponement agud hatagan sang kahigayunan nga masolbar ang nasambit nga request kag iban pa nga may kaangtanan nga mga butang.
english: According to the ICC, a limited postponement was imposed to allow the request and other related matters to be resolved.

text: Samtang, nagpaguwa naman si Judge María del Socorro Flores Liera sang isa ka dissenting opinion, nga nagapamatok sa pag-isol sang hearing.
english: Meanwhile, Judge María del Socorro Flores Liera issued a dissenting opinion, opposing the postponement of the hearing.

text: Madumduman nga gindakop si Duterte sang Marso 11, 2025, may kaangtanan sa mga kaso sang krimen batok sa katawhan, lakip na ang pagpatay, pagpaantos, kag pagpanglugos, nga ginaalegar natabo sa idalom sang iya pagpanguna sa Davao City kag sa tion sang iya administrasyon bilang Presidente sang Pilipinas.
english: It can be recalled that Duterte was arrested on March 11, 2025, in connection with cases of crimes against humanity, including murder, torture, and rape, which allegedly occurred under his leadership in Davao City and during his administration as President of the Philippines.

text: Ang katuyuan sang pagbista sa kumpirmasyon sang mga panumbungon amo ang pagdeterminar kon bala may bastante nga ebidensya sa pagpadayon sang kaso sa hugna sang pagbista.
english: The purpose of a confirmation of charges hearing is to determine whether there is sufficient evidence to proceed with the case to the trial phase.

text: Sa tion nga makumpirmar ang mga panumbungon, ang kaso igasaylo sa Trial Chamber para sa pormal nga pagbista.
english: Once the charges are confirmed, the case will be transferred to the Trial Chamber for a formal hearing.

text: Ginklaro ni President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr.
english: President Ferdinand Marcos, Jr. clarified that

text: nga napaidalom gihapon sa Alert Level 3 ang status sang Lebanon apisar sang nagasingki nga krisis sa Middle East bangud sa away sang pwersa sang Israel batok sa pwersa sang militante nga grupo nga Hezbollah.
english: that Lebanon's status is still under Alert Level 3 despite the escalating crisis in the Middle East due to the fighting between Israeli forces and the forces of the militant group Hezbollah.

text: Sa idalom sang sini nga alert level, may yara sang repatriation sa mga Pilipino apang boluntaryo lamang.
english: Under this alert level, there will be repatriation of Filipinos but only voluntarily.

text: Kun ipasaka naman ini sa Level 4, buot silingon, magapanawagan na ang gobyerno sang mandatory repatriation para nga mapasulabi ang mga Pinoy kag mahilway sa anuman nga katalagman.
english: If it is raised to Level 4, it means that the government will call for mandatory repatriation so that Filipinos will be given priority and free from any danger.

text: Suno kay Marcos, nakadepende pa ini sa sitwasyon kag padayon man subong ang assessment sang Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) kag embahada sang Pilipinas.
english: Marcos said it depends on the situation and the assessment of the Department of Foreign Affairs (DFA) and the Philippine embassy is ongoing.

text: Kahapon, Oktubre 9, samtang yara sa ASEAN summit sa Laos, nagpatawag si Marcos sang online meeting kaupod ang Gabinete agud nga istoryahan ang mga pagbag-o sa sitwasyon sa Lebanon kun sa diin nagsugod na ang Israel sang ground operations.
english: Yesterday, October 9, while at the ASEAN summit in Laos, Marcos called an online meeting with the Cabinet to discuss changes in the situation in Lebanon where Israel has begun ground operations.

text: Ginsugo man sang presidente ang tanan nga concerned government agencies nga hulagon na ang tanan nga available assets para nga mapat-od nga safe kag husto ang tiyempo sang repatriation sa mga Pilipino nga apektado sang krisis.#
english: The president also instructed all concerned government agencies to mobilize all available assets to ensure the safe and timely repatriation of Filipinos affected by the crisis.

text: Naghatag sang $5 milyon ukon masobra sa P254 milyon nga donasyon ang non-profit organization sang singer nga si Rihanna para sa pagbato sa Coronavirus Disease 2019 sa bilog nga kalibutan.
english: Singer Rihanna's non-profit organization has donated $5 million or more than P254 million to the fight against Coronavirus Disease 2019 worldwide.

text: Kabulig man nila ang pila ka mga grupo kaangay nalang sang Solidarity Response Fund sang World Health Organization, International Rescue Committee, Partners in Health, Direct Relief and Feeding America para sa relief operations.
english: They are also assisting several groups such as the Solidarity Response Fund of the World Health Organization, International Rescue Committee, Partners in Health, Direct Relief and Feeding America for relief operations.

text: Pagagamiton ang pondo para sa pagsuporta sa mga food banks nga nagabulig sa mga tigulang lakip man ang pagbakal sang mga personal protective equipment sang mga health workers.
english: The funds will be used to support food banks that help the elderly as well as the purchase of personal protective equipment for health workers.

text: Nagpasalig si weightlifting gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz nga siya liwat ang makakuha sang bulawan nga medalya sa iya ginapreparahan nga apat ka major competitions subong nga tuig.
english: Weightlifting gold medalist Hidilyn Diaz has assured that she will again win a gold medal in her four major competitions this year.

text: Suno kay Hidilyn, iya ginapreparahan nga magpasakop sa Southeast Asian ((SEA) Games sa Mayo, ang Asian Games sa Septyembre, Weightlifting World Championships sa Oktubre, kag ang Asian Weightlifting Championships sa Disyembre sa Manila.
english: Hidilyn said she is preparing to participate in the Southeast Asian ((SEA) Games in May, the Asian Games in September, Weightlifting World Championships in October, and the Asian Weightlifting Championships in December in Manila.

text: Tuyo ni Hidilyn nga mapasaka ang iya body weight sa 59-kg event ang para sa World Championships bangud ini ang magaserbe bilang iya qualifiers para sa 2024 Paris Olympics.
english: Hidilyn aims to increase her body weight in the 59-kg event for the World Championships as it will serve as her qualifiers for the 2024 Paris Olympics.

text: Ang amo nga olympiada ang wala sang 55-kg event weight class nga amo ang gindag-an niya.
english: That Olympics did not have the 55-kg event weight class which he won.

text: Nagpasalamat man si Hidilyn bilang three-time Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA) Athlete of the Year awardee.
english: Hidilyn also expressed her gratitude as a three-time Philippine Sportswriters Association (PSA) Athlete of the Year awardee.

text: Gin-engganyo man sang first ever gold medalist sang Pilipinas ang iban pa nga mga atleta nga padayunon ang ila mga handom tubtob nga ila malab-ot ang kadalag-an.
english: The first ever gold medalist of the Philippines also encouraged other athletes to continue their dreams until they achieve victory.

text: SADTONG anom ka tuig nga nagligad na-ospital ako tungod sa mild stroke.
english: SIX years ago I was hospitalized with a mild stroke.

text: Naggwa ako pagkatapos sang anom ka adlaw agud padayunon lang ang akon pagpaayo sa balay.
english: I came out after six days to just continue my recovery at home.

text: Tungod sa mga pribelihiyo sang isa ka senior citizen – katulad sang 12% VAT removed, PhilHealth coverage, 20% discount sa bulong – wala ako kag ang akon pamilya nagkabalaka bisan pa sa pribado nga ospital ako nagpa-confine.
english: Because of the privileges of a senior citizen – such as 12% VAT removed, PhilHealth coverage, 20% discount on medicines – my family and I did not worry even though I was confined to a private hospital.

text: Sa sige ugaling pagbakal sang bulong kag kadamo sang ginatiid sang mga doctor sa sulod sang akon lawas, didto ko natantya nga basi kulangon ako sing inugbayad kag ma-stranded sa ospital.
english: However, with the constant purchase of medicine and the many doctors checking inside my body, I realized that I might run out of money and be stranded in the hospital.

text: Gani, gin-kumbinse ko ang akon pamilya nga kinahanglan ko magpauli na kag sa balay padayunon ang akon pagpaayo.
english: So I convinced my family that I needed to go home and continue my recovery at home.

text: Luyag pa sadto ako punggan sang doktor.
english: The doctor wanted to stop me.

text: So nag-pirma ako sang waiver agud wala sing salabton ang ospital kon matabo ako sa paggwa ko.
english: So I signed a waiver so the hospital wouldn't be held responsible if I happened to be on my way out.

text: Ang ginbayran sang amon pamilya sadto mga P11,000 (neto) para sa hospital charges plus ang mga P10,000 nga ginpabakal nga mga bulong sa gwa sang ospital.
english: Our family paid about P11,000 (net) for hospital charges plus about P10,000 for medicines purchased outside the hospital.

text:
***

Sining ulihi lang, mga anom ka tuig nga nagligad,  na-ospital naman ako.
english:
***

More recently, about six years ago, I was hospitalized again.

text: Nagtupa naman ako sa pribado gihapon nga ospital tungod medyo nag-improve man ang earnings sang pamilya.
english: I went to a private hospital because the family's earnings improved a bit.

text: Pagkatapos sang pila ka adlaw, ugaling, nadiskubrihan ko ang sobra nga kamahal sang mga bulong sa pharmacy sang ospital kag sa gwa.
english: After a few days, however, I discovered the exorbitant price of medicines in the hospital pharmacy and outside.

text: Mataas man ang  visiting rate sang akon visiting doktor kag ang daily rate sang akon kwarto.
english: My visiting doctor's visiting rate and my room's daily rate are also high.

text: Dugang pa ang mataas man nga rate sang nagakalain-lain nga paglili sa sulod sang akon lawas agud mahibal-an gid ang kabangdanan sang akon ginabatyag.
english: In addition, the high rate of various tests inside my body to determine the cause of my symptoms.

text: Kinulbaan ako kay sobra ini kaayo kataas nga galastuhon sa ginpaabot ko ikumparar sa nagligad ko nga pagpa-ospital sa halos pareho man nga ginhimo sa akon.
english: I was nervous because it was so much higher than I expected compared to my previous hospitalization for almost the same treatment.

text: Gani naghingyo ako sa akon pamilya pagkatapos sang tatlo ka adlaw nga maggwa na lang kay basi ma-stranded ako kon magpabilin pa ako sa ospital.
english: So I asked my family after three days to just leave because I might get stranded if I stayed in the hospital any longer.

text: Nagpasugot ang akon doktor, kag nag-prescribe na gid lang sang isa ka semana nga pagbulong sa balay kag pagkatapos sina mabalik ako sa iya.
english: My doctor agreed, and prescribed a week of home treatment after which I would return to him.

text: Naggwa ako sa ospital sang ikaapat nga adlaw.
english: I left the hospital on the fourth day.

text: Sa ina nga hugada, naglab-ut ang amon balayran sa neto nga P40,000 kag mga P15,000 nga bulong sa gwa.
english: At that time, our bill reached a net of P40,000 and about P15,000 for outside medicine.

text: Naglab-ut ini tanan sa P55,000.
english: It all amounted to P55,000.

text: Atong P21,000 nga gingasto namon sadto malayo kaayo, obviously, sa gingasto namon sining ulihi nga P55,000!
english: That P21,000 we spent then is a far cry, obviously, from the last P55,000 we spent!

text: Salamat kay nabayran gid namon ini paagi sa pag-inamutay sang mga myembro sang amon pamilya.
english: Thankfully, we were able to pay for it through the generosity of our family members.

text: Kahibalo ang akon fraternity, kag naghatag man sing bulig nga P5,000 ang Iloilo Alumni Council sang Sigma Rho Fraternity kag Sorority, Iloilo Chapter sa pagpanguna ni Brod Roger Lopez.
english: My fraternity knew, and the Iloilo Alumni Council of Sigma Rho Fraternity and Sorority, Iloilo Chapter led by Brod Roger Lopez also donated P5,000.

text: Nagpaaman pa amot gani si Sis Rose Rivera sing P1,000.
english: Sis Rose Rivera even donated P1,000.

text: Thanks gid sa inyo tanan, brods kag sis!
english: Thank you all, brods and sis!

text: By the way, katapo ang SR Iloilo Chapter sa Samahan ng mga Sigma Rho sa PIlipinas, Inc.
english: By the way, SR Iloilo Chapter is a member of the Association of Sigma Rho in the Philippines, Inc.

text: Nangin Grand Archon man ako sang Iloilo Chapter sang Sigma Rho sadto sa University of Iloilo.
english: I was also the Grand Archon of the Iloilo Chapter of Sigma Rho at the University of Iloilo.

text:
***

Wala kita nagabasol sa pribado nga ospital sa pagtaas sang ila sulokton.
english:
***

We do not blame private hospitals for increasing their fees.

text: Basta nagakaigu lang, okey sa akon.
english: As long as it fits, it's okay with me.

text: Ina tungod ginpili naton diri sa Filipinas ang mangabuhi sing Hilway, nga ang isa ka ginapatuman diri amo ang Free Enterprise nga sistima sang ekonomiya.
english: That's because we here in the Philippines have chosen to live Freely, with one of the principles being implemented here is the Free Enterprise economic system.

text: Mayor nga prinsipyo diri amo ang Law of Supply and Demand.
english: Major principle here is the Law of Supply and Demand.

text: Bunga man sini ang natural nga competition sang mga negosyo nga lakip diri ang mga ospital.
english: This also results in natural competition from businesses including hospitals.

text: Indi man ugaling buot silingon sini nga pwede mo na abusuhon ang imo pareho labi na gid ang mga kubos.
english: However, this does not mean that you can abuse your fellowmen, especially the poor.

text: May mga kasuguan man nga naga-protejer sang ila kinamatarong batok, por ejemplo,  sa sobra nga presyo sang basic goods.
english: There are also laws that protect their rights against, for example, excessive prices of basic goods.

text: “Unusual” ugaling ang mga hitabo sa pungsod sa pag-abot sang Covid-19 sadtong Pebrero 2020.
english: However, the events in the country with the arrival of Covid-19 in February 2020 were “unusual”.

text: Tungod sa mga restriction madamo ang nawad-an sing palangabuhian, samtang ang wala swerte nga madamo nalab-ut gid sang kawit ni Kamatayan.
english: Because of the restrictions, many have lost their livelihoods, while the unfortunate many have been caught in the hook of Death.

text: Sang magkalma ang Covid-19 tungod sa bakuna, amat-amat nga nagbangon ang ekonomiya sang pungsod, lakip na sa siyudad sang Iloilo.
english: When Covid-19 subsided due to the vaccine, the country's economy gradually recovered, including in Iloilo City.

text: Natukod man diri ang Iloilo City Hospital kag madamo nga mga health centers.
english: The Iloilo City Hospital and many health centers were also established here.

text: Daku nga bagay ini para sa mga pumuluyo sang Iloilo City sa pagsabat sang kinahanglan nga pagtatap sa ila ikaayong lawas.
english: This is a big deal for the people of Iloilo City to meet the needs of their health care.

text: Diri na lang gani ako seguro mapa-confine sa Iloilo City Hospital kon liwat ma-ospital ako kag indi na didto sa mga pribado nga mga ospital.
english: I'll probably be confined here at Iloilo City Hospital if I'm hospitalized again and not in private hospitals.

text: Of course, tani indi man matabo ina sa akon.
english: Of course, I hope that doesn’t happen to me.

text: Kon matabo gid man, pwede lang tani ako matatap sa balay  tubtub “Baybay Life!”/PN
english: If it happens, I could have been taken care of at home until “Baybay Life!”/PN

text: Ka-Bombo ano ang masarangan nga himuon sang imo hita?
english: Ka-Bombo what can your thighs do?

text: Samtang nagapaminsar ka pa, istoryahan ko na lang ikaw sang isa ka babaye nga nakahimo sang world record bangud sa iya hita.
english: While you’re still thinking, I’m going to tell you about a woman who broke a world record for her thighs.

text: Didto ini sa Turkey kun sa diin ginbuka sang isa ka babaye ang dalagko nga mga sandiya gamit ang iya mga hita.
english: It was in Turkey where a woman opened large watermelons with her thighs.

text: Ini amo si Gozde Dogan nga naghimo sang world record attempt paagi sa pagbutang sang sandiya sa tunga sang iya duha ka hita kag ginbuka ini.
english: This is Gozde Dogan who made a world record attempt by placing a watermelon between his two thighs and cracking it open.

text: Sa sulod sang isa ka minuto, lima ka sandiya ang iya nabuka nga naghimo sa iya bilang record- holder sang pinakamadamo nga sandiya nga nabuka gamit ang hita sang isa ka babaye.
english: Within a minute, she broke five watermelons making her the record- holder for the most watermelons broken using a woman’s thigh.

text: Lauman ang pagtaas sang presyo sang Liquefied Petroleum Gas ukon (LPG) sa imbukada nga adlaw sang Enero, 2026.
english: Liquefied Petroleum Gas (LPG) prices are expected to rise on the opening day of January, 2026.

text: Base sa advisory, yara sa P2.18 kada kilo ang ginalauman nga pagtaas sang kada LPG, epektibo alas 12:01 kaina sang kaagahon sang Enero 1, 2026.
english: Based on the advisory, the expected increase in the price of LPG is P2.18 per kilo, effective at 12:01 am on January 1, 2026.

text: Ini bangud sa P23.98 nga pagtaas sa presyo sang isa ka tipikal nga 11-kilogram nga LPG tank.
english: This is due to the P23.98 increase in the price of a typical 11-kilogram LPG tank.

text: Dugang pa nga ang amo nga pagtaas ang nagabase sa international contract price sang LPG para sa bulan sang Enero.
english: He added that the increase is based on the international contract price of LPG for the month of January.

text: Nakaaresto ang Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) sang 250 ka mga wanted persons sa bilog nga Enero 2026.
english: The Police Regional Office 6 (PRO6) has arrested 250 wanted persons throughout January 2026.

text: Nalakip sa mga nadakpan amo ang tanan nga yara sa Top 10 Most Wanted Persons sa Western Visayas.
english: Among those arrested are all those in the Top 10 Most Wanted Persons in Western Visayas.

text: Sa nadakpan nga mga indibidwal, 81 ang Most Wanted Persons, samtang 169 ang Other Wanted Persons.
english: Of the arrested individuals, 81 are Most Wanted Persons, while 169 are Other Wanted Persons.

text: Resulta ini sang 247 ka mga law enforcement operations sa bug-os nga rehiyon.
english: This is the result of 247 law enforcement operations across the region.

text: Ang Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) ang may pinakadamo nga naaresto nga 128 ka wanted persons, ginasundan sang Capiz PPO kag Antique PPO nga pareho nga may 30 ka mga naaresto, kag Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) nga may 25 ka mga naaresto.
english: The Iloilo Police Provincial Office (IPPO) had the highest number of arrests with 128 wanted persons, followed by the Capiz PPO and Antique PPO with 30 arrests each, and the Iloilo City Police Office (ICPO) with 25 arrests.

text: Nagpasalamat kag nagdayaw naman si PRO6 Regional Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan sa pagtinguha sang tanan nga operating units agud malab-ot ini nga kadalag-an sa bahin sang kapulisan.
english: PRO6 Regional Director Police Brigadier General Josefino Ligan thanked and praised the efforts of all operating units to achieve this victory on the part of the police.

text: Maga-umpisa na ang 2025-26 season sang National Basketball Association (NBA) subong nga adlaw.
english: The 2025-26 season of the National Basketball Association (NBA) will begin today.

text: Matabo ini matapos ang 120 ka adlaw kasunod sang kadalag-an sang Oklahoma City Thunder sa finals batok sa Indiana Pacers.
english: It will occur 120 days after the Oklahoma City Thunder’s finals victory over the Indiana Pacers.

text: 7:30 subong nga aga (oras sa Pilipinas), magaatubangay sa Paycom Center sa Oklahoma ang team sang Thunder kag ang Houston Rockets.
english: 7:30 this morning (Philippine time), the Thunder team and the Houston Rockets will face each other at the Paycom Center in Oklahoma.

text: Magapanguna sa defending champions ang reigning Most Valuable Player (MVP) nga si Shai Gilgeous-Alexander samtang debut naman sang superstar nga si Kevin Durant sa Rockets.
english: Reigning Most Valuable Player (MVP) Shai Gilgeous-Alexander will lead the defending champions while superstar Kevin Durant will make his Rockets debut.

text: 10:00 naman subong gihapon nga aga, magasambuwa ang Los Angeles Lakers kag ang Golden State Warriors sa Crypto.com Arena sa Los Angeles, California.
english: At 10:00 this morning, the Los Angeles Lakers and Golden State Warriors will face each other at the Crypto.com Arena in Los Angeles, California.

text: Indi maka-upod ang 40-anyos nga superstar nga si LeBron James sa imbukada nga hampang bangud sa iya nga injury.
english: 40-year-old superstar LeBron James will miss the opening game due to an injury.

text: Ini na ang iya record-breaking nga 23rd season sa liga.
english: This is his record-breaking 23rd season in the league.

text: Manguna sa Lakers si Luka Doncic nga amo ang iya una nga full season sa Los Angeles matapos ang blockbuster trade nagikan sa Dallas Mavericks sang Pebrero.
english: The Lakers will be led by Luka Doncic, who is in his first full season in Los Angeles after the blockbuster trade from the Dallas Mavericks in February.

text: Sa Warriors, yara ang 37-anyos nga si Stephen Curry nga maga-umpisa sang iya ika-17 nga season sa NBA, kun sa diin makaupod man sini ang 36-anyos nga si Jimmy Butler kag 35-anyos nga si Draymond Green.
english: The Warriors have 37-year-old Stephen Curry, who will begin his 17th season in the NBA, along with 36-year-old Jimmy Butler and 35-year-old Draymond Green.

text: Gindesisyunan sang mayorya sang transport cooperatives sa syudad sang Iloilo nga mag-updanay sa pagpatigayon sang transport holiday sa Lunes, Marso 23.
english: The majority of transport cooperatives in Iloilo City decided to join hands in celebrating the transport holiday on Monday, March 23.

text: Ginkumpirma ini ni Mr. Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, chairman sang Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC), kasunod sang ila pagpatigayon sang pagsinapol subong nga adlaw.
english: This was confirmed by Mr. Raymundo “Boyet” Parcon, chairman of the Western Visayas Transport Cooperative (WVTC), following their meeting today.

text: “Majority gid, kag basi tanan nga ruta, by Monday, wala sang may ma-byahe, upod sa aton nga traditional nga mga jeep nga mauntat man sa byahe, kay subong kawsa na ni namon tanan,” suno kay Parcon.
english: “The majority, and maybe all routes, by Monday, no one will be able to travel, including our traditional jeeps that will also stop traveling, because now it's our fault,” Parcon said.

text: Sa bahin sang WVTC, nagabyahe ang modernized units sini sa apat ka mga ruta sa syudad nga amo ang Tagbak Terminal, Mohon Terminal, Diversion Highway, kag Jaro CPU.
english: On the part of the WVTC, its modernized units operate on four routes in the city namely Tagbak Terminal, Mohon Terminal, Diversion Highway, and Jaro CPU.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Parcon, iya ginpahayag nga padayon pa ang ila pagpanawag sa dugang nga mga grupo agud mag-upod sa sini nga kawsa.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Parcon said they are still calling on more groups to join the cause.

text: Pahayag sini, pila ka semana na sila nga nagahipos apang wala man sang gihapon sang mehura bangud wala gihapon sang suporta nga nagatupa kag gin-suspende man ang ila ginahingyo nga saka sa plete.
english: He said they have been silent for several weeks but there is still no improvement because there is still no support and their request for a fare increase has been suspended.

text: Nauna na nga ginpahayag ni Parcon nga lab-ot na sa P100,000 ang ginapamyerdehan sang WVTC kada adlaw bangud sang pagtimbuok sa presyo sang gatong.
english: Earlier, Parcon said the WVTC is losing up to P100,000 per day due to the increase in fuel prices.

text: Kun basehan ang oil industry estimates, posible nga magdangat na sa P130 ang presyo sang diesel sa masunod nga semana, samtang magalapaw naman sa P100 ang kada litro sang gasolina bangud sang panibag-o nga oil price hike.
english: Based on oil industry estimates, the price of diesel is likely to reach P130 next week, while the price of gasoline will exceed P100 per liter due to the new oil price hike.

text:
MGA GINAHINGYO SANG TRANSPORT COOPERATIVES

Ipanawagan sang transport cooperatives ang pagpasaka sang plete kadungan sang transport holiday.
english:
TRANSPORT COOPERATIVES DEMAND

Transport cooperatives will call for a fare hike during the transport holiday.

text: Suno kay Parcon, ang fare increase amo ang makabulig sa ila bilang “pang-sapin-sapin” lang samtang tuman ka taas ang presyo sang diesel.
english: According to Parcon, the fare increase will help them as a “cover-up” while the price of diesel is very high.

text: “Ang number one nga ginapangayo naton amo ni ang pagpasaka sang plete.
english: “The number one thing we are asking for is a fare increase.

text: Kuntani pasakaan ini sang seven pesos [provisional fare increase].
english: It should have been increased by seven pesos [provisional fare increase].

text: Temporary lang ini.
english: It’s only temporary.

text: Kun mag-normal na, ibalik man naton sa normal ang pletehan.
english: When it gets back to normal, we will also return the fare to normal.

text: Sa subong, importante lang sa tanan nga may suporta lang o kapital o pang-sapin-sapin man sa amon nga para man sa pagserbisyo sa mga pumuluyo kag commuters para nga maka-sustain man kami sa sige-sige nga saka sang diesel,” suno kay Parcon.
english: At the moment, it is important for everyone to have support or capital or cover for us to serve the residents and commuters so that we can sustain the continuous increase in diesel prices,” said Parcon.

text: Ginpahayag sini nga gintawtawan lang sila sang pasalig nga may subsidiya, apang tubtub subong, bisan tatlo ka semana na ang gyera sa Middle East, wala gihapon sang ayuda nga nabaton halin sa gobyerno.
english: He said they were only given promises of subsidies, but until now, even after three weeks of war in the Middle East, no aid has been received from the government.

text: “Indi gid namon kaya kag bisan ang pagbakal sang diesel kay tama gid ka mahal,” pahayag sini.
english: “We can't afford it and even buying diesel is very expensive,” he said.

text: Nakahibalo man ini nga madamo ang maapektuhan kun indi sila magbyahe, apang nagapanindugan siya nga paagi ini agud nga pamatian sila sang gobyerno.
english: He also knows that many will be affected if they do not travel, but he insists that this is a way for the government to listen to them.

text: “[Kami sa WVTC], nagapamyerdehan kami sang P100,000 a day.
english: “[We at WVTC], we lose P100,000 a day.

text: Diin kami makuha sina kun indi kami mag-pressure sa gobyerno nga dapat pamatian kami?
english: Where do we get that if we don't put pressure on the government to listen to us?

text: Kun transport kami, once mag-untat kami byahe, kadamo sang maapektuhan nga mga pasahero,” pahayag pa ni Parcon.
english: If we are transport, once we stop flying, many passengers will be affected,” Parcon said.

text: Nagdugang man ini nga preparado man sila sa posible nga show cause order ukon kun ano ang mangin akto sang gobyerno sa ila himuon nga transport holiday.
english: He added that they are also prepared for the possible show cause order or what the government will do in their transport holiday.

text: “Ini nga kawsa indi lang ni basta-basta.
english: “This cause is not just a joke.

text: Gutom na ang mga operators kag drivers subong.
english: Operators and drivers are hungry now.

text: Updan namon ini nga kawsa subong, wala na kami subong nakulbaan bisan i-cancel ukon i-revoke ang amon prangkisa,” dugang niya.
english: We will join this cause now, we are now not nervous even if our franchise is canceled or revoked,” he added.

text: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – Patay ang isa ka babaye matapos gin hit and run sang driver nga nagamaneho sang Toyota Vios nga Sedan sa Barangay Kirayan Norte, Miagao, Iloilo.
english: 𝗜𝗟𝗢𝗜𝗟𝗢 – A woman was killed after being hit and run by a driver driving a Toyota Vios sedan in Barangay Kirayan Norte, Miagao, Iloilo.

text: Ang biktima amo si Jenery Neirves Naldoza, 40, kasado, residente sang nasambit nga lugar.
english: The victim was identified as Jenery Neirves Naldoza, 40, married, resident of the said place.

text: Samtang ang driver naman sang kotse amo si John Perez, residente sang Barangay Damilisan, Miagao, Iloilo.
english: The driver of the car was identified as John Perez, resident of Barangay Damilisan, Miagao, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Major Richard Lao, hepe sang Miagao Municipal Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga nagasaot ang biktima sa higad sang dalan sang ginbungguan sang kotse nga naghalin sa Guimbal, Iloilo.
english: Police Major Richard Lao, chief of Miagao Municipal Police Station, said the victim was dancing on the side of the road when he was hit by a car coming from Guimbal, Iloilo.

text: Suno kay Lao, madasig ang pagpadalagan sang driver sang kotse rason nga wala niya natalupangdan ang biktima nga ara sa dalan.
english: According to Lao, the driver of the car was driving fast and did not notice the victim on the road.

text: Nag-angkon naman ang biktima sang pilas sa ulo kag sa nagkalain-lain nga bahin sang iya lawas nga amo ang gintunaan sang iya kamatayon.
english: The victim sustained injuries to his head and various parts of his body which led to his death.

text: Nagpalagyo pa ang driver, apang nagsungka sa pulis matapos nga natumod ang iya identity.
english: The driver fled the scene, but surrendered to police after his identity was established.

text: Sa subong, ginahibalo pa kun magpasaka sang kaso ang pamilya sang biktima batok sa driver sang kotse.
english: It is still unknown whether the victim's family will file a case against the driver of the car.

text: – 𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗮 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗔𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘀𝗮
english: – 𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝗮𝗮𝗮 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗔𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘀𝗮

text: MANILA-Nagtaliwan na ang iloy sang aktor nga sanday  Bernard kag Mico Palanca nga si  Pita Revilla sa edad nga 62.
english: MANILA-The mother of actors Bernard and Mico Palanca, Pita Revilla, has passed away at the age of 62.

text: Suno sa kampo ni Pita, may cancer ang iloy sang aktor kag ginpawian sang kabuhi sa  San Francisco California.
Sa social media post sang pakaisa  Pita nga si Ditas Santos, ulihi lang nahibaluan nga may sakit nga cancer si Pita sang nagpacheck ini sa doktor.
Nahibaluan nga tatlo  ka bulan palang ang nakaligad sang napatay si Mico bangud nagsuicide.

Ginaduso sang isa ka mamalidha nga kuhaan sang pondo sang Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA) kasunod sang indi sini pag-endorso kay Pinoy Olympian kag world number 5 EJ Obiena nga makahampang sa World Indoor Championships (WIC).
english: A lawmaker is proposing to defund the Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA) following its refusal to endorse Pinoy Olympian and world number 5 EJ Obiena to compete in the World Indoor Championships (WIC).

text: Suno kay Puwersa ng Bayaning Atleta (PBA) party-list Representative Jericho Nograles, dapat nga utdon sang Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) ang suporta sini sa PATAFA bangud ginapahayag nga ginauyangan sini ang buwis nga ginabayad sang tawo.
english: According to Puwersa ng Bayaning Atleta (PBA) party-list Representative Jericho Nograles, the Philippine Sports Commission (PSC) should cut off its support to PATAFA because it allegedly wastes taxes paid by the people.

text: Pahayag pa sang mamalidha, dapat nga i-direkta na lang sang foundations kag private institutions ang ila suporta nga ginahatag sa mismo track and field athletes sa baylo nga i-fund pa ini ukon ihapit sa PATAFA.
english: The lawmaker said foundations and private institutions should direct their support to the track and field athletes themselves instead of funding it or passing it on to PATAFA.

text: Ginpahayag pa ni Nograles nga ang indi pag-endorso sang PATAFA kay Obiena sa isa ka daku nga sahi sang hinampang ang nagapakita lang nga wala ini sang labot sa best interest sang Philippine sports.
english: Nograles said PATAFA's failure to endorse Obiena in a major sports event shows that it has nothing to do with the best interest of Philippine sports.

text: Ginhingyo man sang mamalidha sa government institutions kaangay sang Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) kag sa Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PSCO) nga untaton na ang pagsuporta sa PATAFA.
english: The lawmaker also urged government institutions such as the Philippine Amusement and Gaming Corporation (PAGCOR) and the Philippine Charity Sweepstakes Office (PSCO) to stop supporting PATAFA.

text: Ginkumpirma ni newly-elected Senate President Tito Sotto nga si Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson na ang bag-o nga chairperson sang gamhanan nga Blue Ribbon Committee.
english: Newly-elected Senate President Tito Sotto confirmed Senate President Pro Tempore Panfilo “Ping” Lacson as the new chairperson of the powerful Blue Ribbon Committee.

text: Buslan sini si Sen.
Rodante Marcoleta sa amo nga posisyon sa kasagsagan sang imbestigasyon sang upper chamber sa flood control scandal.
english: Rodante Marcoleta in the position amid the upper chamber's investigation into the flood control scandal.

text: Sa inisyal nga pamangkot kay Sotto kaina, nagrason ini nga indi makatinir si Marcoleta bilang head sang Blue Ribbon panel bangud indi ini miyembro sang majority kasunod sang pag-ilis sang liderato sa Senado subong nga adlaw, Septyembre 8.
english: In an initial question to Sotto yesterday, he argued that Marcoleta cannot remain as head of the Blue Ribbon panel because he is not a member of the majority following the change of leadership in the Senate today, September 8.

text: “He is not a member of the majority.
The Blue Ribbon is reserved for the majority,” pahayag sang Senate leader.
english: The Blue Ribbon is reserved for the majority,” the Senate leader said.

text: Kaina, si Marcoleta pa ang nag-preside sa hearing sang panel sang ginpangbulgar sang mag-asawa nga sanday Pacifico “Curlee” Discaya kag Cezarah “Sarah” Discaya ang pangalan sang mga kongresista kag government officials nga involved sa kurapsyon sa mga proyekto sa flood control.#
english: Yesterday, Marcoleta presided over the hearing of the panel when Pacifico “Curlee” Discaya and Cezarah “Sarah” Discaya revealed the names of congressmen and government officials involved in corruption in flood control projects.

text: Nagapaninguha ang industriya sang turismo nga mapasanyog ang domestic market samtang amat-amat nga naga-recover gikan sa epekto sang coronavirus pandemic.
english: The tourism industry is trying to boost the domestic market as it slowly recovers from the impact of the coronavirus pandemic.

text: Suno kay Loleth So, Vice President sang Hotel Sales and Marketing Association, ginlantaw nila nga mapasangkad pa ang ila regional kag international tourism markets kag nagalaum nga makapasulod liwat sang mga Korean, Japanese kag Chinese tourists sa pungsod.
english: Loleth So, Vice President of the Hotel Sales and Marketing Association, said they are looking to expand their regional and international tourism markets and hope to bring back Korean, Japanese and Chinese tourists to the country.

text: Dugang pa niya, 15,000 nga mga hospitality kag tourism workers ang fully vaccinated na batuk sa COVID-19.
english: He added that 15,000 hospitality and tourism workers are fully vaccinated against COVID-19.

text: Samtang , gina-istoryahan pa ang ginaduso para sa “bakuna bubble” sa travel industry.
english: Meanwhile, the proposal for a “vaccine bubble” in the travel industry is still being discussed.

text: Nag-umpisa na kahapon nga adlaw, Oktubre 8 ang commercial operations sang Bicol International Airport.
english: The commercial operations of the Bicol International Airport started yesterday, October 8.

text: Ang inagurasyon ang ginpangunahan ni Presidente Rodrigo Duterte kag ni Transport Secretary Art Tugade.
english: The inauguration was presided over by President Rodrigo Duterte and Transport Secretary Art Tugade.

text: Una na ginpahayag sang Department of Tourism nga ang nasambit nga aiport ang maka-akomodar sang 2 million ka mga pasahero kada tuig.
english: Earlier, the Department of Tourism said the airport can accommodate 2 million passengers annually.

text: Kadungan sang groundbreaking ceremony, ginpahayag man ni Duterte nga sa pihak sang mga kalamidad kag COVID-19 pandemic, ang pagtapos sang amo nga proyekto ang isa lang sa key milestone sang Build, Build, Build program.
english: During the groundbreaking ceremony, Duterte also said that despite the disasters and COVID-19 pandemic, the completion of the project is one of the key milestones of the Build, Build, Build program.

text: “This airport, dubbed as the ‘Most Scenic Gateway’ in the country, promises to provide unforgettable travel experience, not only of visitors but many Bicolanos,” pahayag ni Presidente Duterte.
english: “This airport, dubbed as the ‘Most Scenic Gateway’ in the country, promises to provide unforgettable travel experience, not only of visitors but many Bicolanos,” President Duterte said.

text: “I am confident that once fully operational, this airport will be able to serve the needs of those which is expected—two million passengers annually and provide efficiency, reliability and safety standards to ensure the modern airport,” dugang pa niya.
english: “I am confident that once fully operational, this airport will be able to serve the needs of those which is expected—two million passengers annually and provide efficiency, reliability and safety standards to ensure the modern airport,” he added.

text: Suno naman kay Secretary Tugade, ang night operations sang airport ang pagabuksan sini nga Nobyembre, 2021.
english: According to Secretary Tugade, the night operations of the airport will be opened this November, 2021.

text: Gin-aprobahan na sang Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) ang proposal nga paghatag sang insentibo sa mga manufacturers sang mga electric vehicles.
english: The Department of Trade and Industry (DTI) has approved the proposal to provide incentives to manufacturers of electric vehicles.

text: Suno kay Trade Secretary Cristina Roque, naaprubahan na niya ang draft sang EV Incentives Strategy (EVIS) nga ginpasa sang Board of Investments (BOI).
english: Trade Secretary Cristina Roque said she has already approved the draft EV Incentives Strategy (EVIS) submitted by the Board of Investments (BOI).

text: Igasumiter ini sa Fiscal Incentives Review Board (FIRB) para sa hiwaton nga meeting.
english: It will be submitted to the Fiscal Incentives Review Board (FIRB) for a meeting.

text: Ang nasambit nga tikang ang ginahimo agud magdamo pa ang mga Pilipino nga magabakal sang mga electric vehicle.
english: The move is aimed at attracting more Filipinos to buy electric vehicles.

text: Ginlunsyar sang aktres nga si Maine Mendoza ang isa ka fundraising drive para sa mga empleyado nga apektado sang ginpatuman nga community quarantine sa Luzon.
english: Actress Maine Mendoza launched a fundraising drive for employees affected by the community quarantine in Luzon.

text: Ang nasambit nga proyekto sang aktres ang gintawag niya nga DoNation Drive.
english: The actress' project is called DoNation Drive.

text: Ginpakigbahin man ni Maine ang link sang iya blog nga isa ka information source para sa mga luyag mag donar kag mga empleyado nga luyag mag avail sang donasyon.
english: Maine also shared a link to her blog which is an information source for those who want to donate and employees who want to avail of donations.

text: Gindetalye man sang aktes kun pila ang ginaplano niya nga ihatag sa mga beneficiaries.
english: The actress also detailed how much she plans to give to the beneficiaries.

text: Suno kay Maine, plano niuya nga hatagan sang P1,000 ang kada household nga mahimo nila magamit para sa pagkaon, kag iban pa nga essentials.
english: According to Maine, he plans to give P1,000 to each household that they can use for food, and other essentials.

text: Masobra na sa 43,000 ka pribado kag pampubliko nga establisyemento sa bilog nga pungsod ang nahatagan sang safety seal certifications.
english: More than 43,000 private and public establishments nationwide have been given safety seal certifications.

text: Ang safety seal ang nagapamatuod nga ang isa ka establisyemento ang nagatuman sa minimum public health standards batok sa COVID-19.
english: The safety seal proves that an establishment meets minimum public health standards against COVID-19.

text: Sandig sa data sang Safety Seal Technical Working Group, may yara sang kabug-usan nga 85,731 ka applications, kun sa diin 43,332 applications ang approved samtang 9,858 applications ang wala naaprubahan ukon gin-refer sa nagakaigu nga ahensya.
english: According to the data of the Safety Seal Technical Working Group, there were a total of 85,731 applications, of which 43,332 applications were approved while 9,858 applications were not approved or referred to the appropriate agency.

text: Under inspection pa ang nabilin nga applications.
english: The remaining applications are still under inspection.

text: Naglunsar sang strikes ang Israel batok sa Iran kag gin-target ang nuclear program kag ang long-range missile capabilities sini.
english: Israel has launched strikes against Iran and targeted its nuclear program and long-range missile capabilities.

text: Suno sa Israeli military official, ini indi one-day attack kag ang strikes ang “preemptive, precise, combined offensive” nga nagalakip sang “dozens of targets” sa bilog nga Iran.
english: The Israeli military official said this was not a one-day attack and the strikes were a “preemptive, precise, combined offensive” involving “dozens of targets” across Iran.

text: Ginkumpirma naman ni Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu nga gin-igo nila ang nuclear facility kag gin-target ang mga scientists.
english: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu confirmed that they hit the nuclear facility and targeted scientists.

text: Pahayag ni Netanyahu, ang strikes sang Israel ang kabahin sang Operation Rising Lion.
english: Netanyahu said the Israeli strikes were part of Operation Rising Lion.

text: Suno pa sa iya, ang Iran ginakabig nga pamahog sa “very survival” sang Israel.
english: He said Iran is considered a threat to Israel's “very survival”.

text:
Nagdeklarar naman sang state of emergency ang Israel sa possible pagbalos sang Iran saying the country expected retaliation

Gin-athag naman ni Secretary of State Marco Rubio nga wala sang US involvement ukon US assistance sa strikes.
english:
Israel has declared a state of emergency over possible Iranian retaliation, saying the country expected retaliation

Secretary of State Marco Rubio clarified that there was no US involvement or US assistance in the strikes.

text: 𝗣𝗔𝗦𝗦𝗜 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – Patay ang isa ka amay nga nagasakay sa tricycle matapos nabungguan sang van sa Barangay Punong, Passi City.
english: 𝗣𝗔𝗦𝗦𝗜 𝗖𝗜𝗧𝗬 – A father was killed after being hit by a van in Barangay Punong, Passi City.

text: Ang biktima amo si Edmar Pareñas, residente sang Barangay Rumbang, Pototan, Iloilo samtang ang driver naman sang van amo si Noriel Simba sang Barangay Namocon, Leon, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as Edmar Pareñas, resident of Barangay Rumbang, Pototan, Iloilo while the driver of the van was identified as Noriel Simba of Barangay Namocon, Leon, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Police Captain Maria Rosario Miranda, Deputy Chief of Police sang Passi City Police Station, iya ginpahayag nga padulong kuntani ang biktima sakay sang iya 10 ka tuig nga anak sa Estancia, Iloilo samtang padulong naman ang van sa Caticlan sa Malay, Aklan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Police Captain Maria Rosario Miranda, Deputy Chief of Police of Passi City Police Station, said the victim was heading with her 10-year-old son to Estancia, Iloilo while the van was heading to Caticlan in Malay, Aklan.

text: Nagpondo ang biktima sa kilid sang dalan agud kuntani magkuha sang iya sunglasses, apang wala ini nakit-an sang van rason nga nabungguan ini.
english: The victim stopped on the side of the road to get his sunglasses, but the van did not see him and hit him.
