text: Suno kay Miranda, madasig ang pagmaneho sang van sa diin wala sini nakit-an ang tricycle rason nga nabungguan niya ini.
english: According to Miranda, the van was driving fast when he did not see the tricycle and hit it.

text: Sa subong, ginahibalo pa kun mapasaka sang kaso ang pamilya sang biktima sa driver sang van.
english: It is still unknown whether the victim's family will file a case against the driver of the van.

text: – 𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝗻𝗻𝗮 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗔𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘀𝗮
english: – 𝗪𝗶𝘁𝗵 𝗮 𝗿𝗲𝗽𝗼𝗿𝘁 𝗳𝗿𝗼𝗺 𝗕𝗼𝗺𝗯𝗼 𝗛𝗮𝗮𝗮𝗮 𝗝𝗼𝘆 𝗔𝗻𝗱𝗮𝘀𝗮

text: Linibo ka mga tawo sa nagkalain-lain nga parte sang kalibutan ang nagmartsa sa mga dalanon agud ipanawagan nga untaton na ang gyera sa Gaza kag indi na pagdayunon ang pagpasangkad pa gid sang away sa Middle East.
english: Thousands of people in different parts of the world marched in the streets to call for an end to the war in Gaza and not to continue the further expansion of the fighting in the Middle East.

text: Ginabanta nga 40,000 ka pro-Palestinian demonstrators ang nagguwa sa pagprotesta sa central London, samtang may mga nagtilipon man sa Paris, Rome, Manila, Cape Town kag sa New York City.
english: An estimated 40,000 pro-Palestinian demonstrators took to the streets in central London, while others gathered in Paris, Rome, Manila, Cape Town and New York City.

text: Mangin sa atubang sang White House sa Washington sa Amerika, may mga nagaprotesta man batok sa suporta sang Estados Unidos sa military campaigns sang Israel sa Gaza kag sa Lebanon.
english: Even in front of the White House in Washington in America, there were also protests against the US support for Israel's military campaigns in Gaza and Lebanon.

text: Subong nga adlaw amo ang anibersaryo sang una nga sorpresa nga gin-atake sang Hamas militants ang southern Israel.
english: Today marks the anniversary of the first surprise attack by Hamas militants on southern Israel.

text: Kaagahon sang Oktubre 7 sa Israel sang nakasulod ng Hamas fighters, nagpangpatay sang 1,205 ka mga tawo nga kadam-an mga sibilyan, kag nagdala man sang ginatos ka mga bihag sa Gaza.
english: On the morning of October 7, Hamas fighters entered Israel, killing 1,205 people, mostly civilians, and taking hundreds of prisoners to Gaza.

text: Apat ka mga Pilipino ang nalakip sa napatay lakip naman ang isa ka Ilongga caregiver nga tumandok sang Maasin.
english: Four Filipinos were among the dead including an Ilongga caregiver from Maasin.

text: Sa 251 ka mga bihag, 64 pa ang na-detain subong samtang 117 naman ang nahilway kag 70 ang kumpirmado nga nagkalamatay.
english: Of the 251 hostages, 64 are still detained while 117 have been released and 70 are confirmed dead.

text: Sang amo nga tion, nagdeklarar na sang gyera ang akig nga prime minister sang Israel nga si Benjamin Netanyahu batok sa Hamas nga blacklisted bilang “terrorist” organization sa European Union kag sa United States.
english: By then, angry Israeli prime minister Benjamin Netanyahu had already declared war on Hamas, which is blacklisted as a “terrorist” organization in the European Union and the United States.

text: Pagkatapos sang amo nga atake, wala na ginpadugay sang Israel kag gin-umpisahan na ang pagbomba sa Gaza.
english: After that attack, Israel did not delay and started bombing Gaza.

text: Sang Oktubre 13, gin-abisuhan na ang mga sibilyan sa northern Gaza nga magkadto sa nabagatnan nga bahin sang Gaza strip.
english: By October 13, civilians in northern Gaza had been warned to go to the southern part of the Gaza strip.

text: Ginbanta sang United Nations nga 2.4-million ka mga tawo ang nagtal-as sang amo nga tion.
english: The United Nations estimates that 2.4-million people were displaced at the time.

text: Oktubre 27 sang naglunsar na ang Israel sang ground offensive.
english: On October 27, Israel launched a ground offensive.

text: Abril subong nga tuig sang nagsingki man ang away sang Iran kag Israel sang nagpaulan sang drones kag missiles ang Iran, samtang sang Hulyo naman sang nag-atake naman ang Israel sa Yemen bilang balos sa makamamatay nga strike sang Houthi rebels sa Tel Aviv.
english: In April this year, the fighting between Iran and Israel intensified when Iran rained drones and missiles, while in July, Israel attacked Yemen in retaliation for a deadly strike by Houthi rebels in Tel Aviv.

text: Ang Houthi rebels amo ang responsable sa pagpang-atake naman sa mga barko sa Red Sea kag sa Gulf of Aden kun sa diin may nagkalamatay pa nga mga Pilipino.
english: Houthi rebels are responsible for attacks on ships in the Red Sea and the Gulf of Aden, which have killed Filipinos.

text: Halin sang nag-ibwal ang gyera sa Gaza, naga-intra man ang Hezbollah militants nga nakabase naman sa Lebanon.
english: Since the outbreak of the war in Gaza, Hezbollah militants based in Lebanon have also been involved.

text: Bangud sa pagsingki man sang away kag kamatayon sang mga lider sang Hezbollah, ini naman subong ang ginatutukan sang Israel kag gina-intrahan man sang Iran bangud suportado sini ang amo nga militant group pati na ang Hamas kag ang Houthis.
english: Due to the intensification of fighting and deaths of Hezbollah leaders, it is now the focus of Israel and Iran is also involved because it supports the militant group as well as Hamas and the Houthis.

text: Mangin ang mga Western countries ang nagapanawagan na kay Netanyahu nga untaton na ang gyera sa Gaza.
english: Even Western countries are calling on Netanyahu to end the war in Gaza.

text: Naakig prime minister sang nagpahayag ang France nga dapat nga untaton na ang pagdul-ong sang mga armas sa Israel.
english: The prime minister was outraged when France announced that arms deliveries to Israel should be stopped.

text: Sabat sini, bisan buligan sila ukon indi sang iban nga mga pungsod, magadaog sa gihapon ang Israel.
english: The answer is that whether other nations help them or not, Israel will win.

text: “Israel is seeking to defend itself against those who fight against civilization, Israel is fighting against fanatism.
english: “Israel is seeking to defend itself against those who fight against civilization, Israel is fighting against fanaticism.

text: Rest assured, we will fight until the battle is won, for our sake and for the peace and sake of the entire world,” kabahin sang statement ni Netanyahu.
english: Rest assured, we will fight until the battle is won, for our sake and for the peace and sake of the entire world,” Netanyahu said in a statement.

text:
As of press time, base sa record sang Gaza health ministry, masobra na sa 41,000 ka Palestinians ang nagkalamatay sa sulod sang isa ka tuig bangud sang pagtimalos sang Israel sa Hamas.#

RONALDO SCHEMIDT/AFP via Getty Images
english:
As of press time, based on the records of the Gaza health ministry, more than 41,000 Palestinians have died in the past year as a result of Israel's retaliation against Hamas.

RONALDO SCHEMIDT/AFP via Getty Images

text: Gintawag ni House Speaker Martin Romualdez nga “false” kag “malicious” ang sworn statement ni Curlee Discaya sa Senado kun sa diin gin-angot sini ang mamalidha sa anomaliya sa flood control.
english: House Speaker Martin Romualdez called Curlee Discaya's sworn statement in the Senate "false" and "malicious" where he linked the lawmaker to anomalies in flood control.

text: Suno kay Romualdez, wala siya sang kahilabtanan kag wala siya sang basbas diri.
english: According to Romualdez, he has nothing to do with it and he has no blessing here.

text:
Yari ang pahayag sang house speaker:

“𝙄 𝙘𝙖𝙣𝙣𝙤𝙩 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙬𝙞𝙡𝙡 𝙣𝙤𝙩 𝙖𝙡𝙡𝙤𝙬 𝙡𝙞𝙚𝙨 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙣𝙖𝙢𝙚-𝙙𝙧𝙤𝙥𝙥𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙩𝙤 𝙥𝙖𝙨𝙨 𝙪𝙣𝙘𝙝𝙚𝙘𝙠𝙚𝙙.
english:
Here is the house speaker’s statement:

“A 𝙘𝙖𝙣𝙣𝙤𝙩 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙬𝙞𝙡𝙡 𝙣𝙤𝙩 𝙖𝙡𝙡𝙤𝙬 𝙚𝙡𝙡 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙣𝙖𝙢𝙚-𝙙𝙧𝙤𝙥𝙥𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙩𝙤 𝙥𝙖𝙨𝙨 𝙪𝙣𝙘𝙝𝙚𝙘𝙠𝙚𝙙.

text: 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙘𝙡𝙖𝙞𝙢 𝙞𝙣 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝘿𝙞𝙨𝙘𝙖𝙮𝙖 𝙘𝙤𝙪𝙥𝙡𝙚’𝙨 𝙖𝙛𝙛𝙞𝙙𝙖𝙫𝙞𝙩 𝙩𝙝𝙖𝙩 𝙢𝙮 𝙣𝙖𝙢𝙚 𝙬𝙖𝙨 𝙪𝙨𝙚𝙙 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙘𝙤𝙢𝙢𝙞𝙨𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙨 𝙞𝙨 𝙛𝙖𝙡𝙨𝙚, 𝙢𝙖𝙡𝙞𝙘𝙞𝙤𝙪𝙨, 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙣𝙤𝙩𝙝𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙢𝙤𝙧𝙚 𝙩𝙝𝙖𝙣 𝙣𝙖𝙢𝙚-𝙙𝙧𝙤𝙥𝙥𝙞𝙣𝙜.
english: 𝙏𝙝𝙚 𝙘𝙡𝙖𝙞𝙢 𝙞𝙣 𝙩𝙝𝙚 𝘿𝙞𝙨𝙘𝙖𝙮𝙖 𝙘𝙤 𝙖𝙛𝙛𝙞𝙙𝙖𝙫𝙞𝙩 𝙩𝙝𝙖𝙩 𝙢𝙮 𝙣𝙖𝙢𝙚 𝙬𝙖𝙖 𝙪𝙙 𝙛𝙤𝙧 𝙘𝙤𝙢𝙢𝙞𝙨𝙨𝙞𝙤𝙣𝙨 𝙞𝙨 𝙛𝙖𝙡𝙨𝙚, 𝙢𝙖𝙡𝙞𝙘𝙞𝙤𝙪𝙨, 𝙖𝙣𝙙 𝙣𝙤𝙩𝙝𝙞𝙣𝙜 𝙢𝙤𝙧𝙚𝙣 𝙣𝙖𝙢𝙚-𝙙𝙧𝙤𝙥𝙥𝙞𝙣𝙜.

text: 𝙇𝙚𝙩 𝙢𝙚 𝙗𝙚 𝙘𝙡𝙚𝙖𝙧: 𝙒𝙖𝙡𝙖 𝙖𝙠𝙤𝙣𝙜 𝙠𝙞𝙣𝙖𝙡𝙖𝙢𝙖𝙣, 𝙬𝙖𝙡𝙖 𝙖𝙠𝙤𝙣𝙜 𝙥𝙖𝙝𝙞𝙣𝙩𝙪𝙡𝙤𝙩, 𝙖𝙩 𝙬𝙖𝙡𝙖 𝙖𝙠𝙤𝙣𝙜 𝙗𝙖𝙨𝙗𝙖𝙨 𝙨𝙖 𝙢𝙜𝙖 𝙜𝙖𝙣𝙮𝙖𝙣𝙜 𝙜𝙖𝙬𝙖𝙞𝙣.”
english: 𝙇𝙚𝙩 𝙢𝙚 𝙗𝙚 𝙘𝙡𝙚𝙖𝙧: 𝙒𝙖𝙡𝙖 𝙖𝙠𝙤𝙣𝙜 𝙠𝙞𝙣𝙖𝙡𝙖𝙢𝙖𝙣, 𝙬𝙖𝙡𝙖 𝙖𝙠𝙤𝙣𝙜 𝙥𝙖𝙝𝙞 𝙖𝙩 𝙬𝙖𝙡𝙖 𝙖𝙠𝙤𝙣𝙜 𝙗𝙖𝙨𝙗𝙖𝙨 𝙨𝙖 𝙢𝙜𝙖 𝙜𝙖𝙣𝙮𝙖𝙣𝙜 𝙜𝙖𝙬𝙖𝙞𝙣.”

text: Ginbida sang mga Ilonggo ang ila pinasahi nga talento kadungan sang ginpatigayon nga 1st ever Grand Finals sang International Ballet Grand Prix 2024 nga ginpatigayon sa National University of Singapore.
english: Ilonggos showcased their unique talents during the 1st ever Grand Finals of the International Ballet Grand Prix 2024 held at the National University of Singapore.

text: Ini amo sanday Ayanna Fuerte kag Bianca Pia Isabel De La Cruz.
english: They are Ayanna Fuerte and Bianca Pia Isabel De La Cruz.

text: Gindala pauli ni Fuerte ang duha ka Bronze medals— isa para sa Classical Ballet Variation kag ang isa naman ang para sa Contemporary Category.
english: Fuerte took home two Bronze medals— one for the Classical Ballet Variation and the other for the Contemporary Category.

text: Samtang si De La Cruz naman ang nakakuha sang Bronze para sa Classical Ballet Variation.
english: Meanwhile, De La Cruz won Bronze for Classical Ballet Variation.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Pauline Cordero – Dingcong, Ballet Teacher, Mentor, kag Coach sang duha ka mga ballerina, iya ginpahayag nga ang nasambit nga kadalag-an ang nagapakita sang dedikasyon kag pagtinguha agud makakuha sang prestiyoso nga pasidungog kag pagpakita sang world-class talent.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Pauline Cordero-Dingcong, Ballet Teacher, Mentor, and Coach of the two ballerinas, said the victory shows dedication and effort to win the prestigious award and showcase world-class talent.

text: Ginpasalamatan man ni Dingcong, ang suporta nga ginahatag sang mga ginikanan indi lang nanday Fuerte kag De La Cruz kundi sa ila man kaangay nga mga talented nga mga ballet dancers.
english: Dingcong also thanked the parents for their support not only to Fuerte and De La Cruz but also to their fellow talented ballet dancers.

text: Ginlakip sang Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) si world No.
english: The Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) included world No.

text: 5 pole vaulter EJ Obiena kag ang iya nga Ukrainian coach nga si Vitaliy Petrov sa team sang Pilipinas para sa SEA Games sa Vietnam.
english: 5 pole vaulter EJ Obiena and his Ukrainian coach Vitaliy Petrov in the Philippine team for the SEA Games in Vietnam.

text: Una diri, nagpamalibad ang presidente sang Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA) nga i-endorso sanday Obiena kag Petrov nga dal-on sa delegasyon sang pungsod.
english: Earlier, the president of the Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA) refused to endorse Obiena and Petrov to be included in the country's delegation.

text: Apang suno kay POC President Bambol Tolentino, ang POC ang may yara sang final say sa pag-accredit sa mga myembro sang national delegation.
english: However, according to POC President Bambol Tolentino, the POC has the final say in accrediting the members of the national delegation.

text: Ang 31st Southeast Asian Games ang patigayunon na sa bulan sang Mayo.Mangin ang Kamara ang nagapanawagan na kanday Obiena kag sa PATAFA nga ipaiway anay ang away kag magtutok sa pagdala dungog sa pungsod paagi sa pag-compete sa SEA Games.
english: The 31st Southeast Asian Games will be held in May. Even the House of Representatives is calling on Obiena and PATAFA to postpone the fight and focus on bringing honor to the country by competing in the SEA Games.

text: Ang away nanday Obiena kag sang PATAFA ang nagdangat na sa Court of Arbitration for Sport matapos nga nag-file si PATAFA president Philip Juico sang complaint batok sa nasambit nga Tokyo Olympian kag amo man pati sa POC.
english: The fight between Obiena and PATAFA has reached the Court of Arbitration for Sport after PATAFA president Philip Juico filed a complaint against the Tokyo Olympian as well as the POC.

text: Nadalahig diri ang liquidation ni Obiena sa sweldo sang iya coach nga sang ulihi naglab-ot pa gid sa akusasyon ni EJ nga gina-harass siya sang iya nga national sports association.
english: This included Obiena's liquidation of his coach's salary which later led to EJ's accusation that he was being harassed by his national sports association.

text: Nakatipon sang season-high 50 points si Brooklyn Nets basketball player Kyrie Irving sa ila hampang kontra sa Charlotte Hornets.
english: Brooklyn Nets basketball player Kyrie Irving scored a season-high 50 points in their game against the Charlotte Hornets.

text: Si Irving ang ginpahanugutan lang sa limitado nga hampang subong nga NBA season bangud sa iya unvaccinated status nga amu ang nagdumili sa iya maghampang sa home games.
english: Irving was allowed only limited games this NBA season due to his unvaccinated status which prevented him from playing in home games.

text: Samtang, sanday Brooklyn Nets basketball player Andre Drummond ang nakatipon sang 20 points kag 14 rebounds, Bruce Brown kag Kevin Durant ang parehas nakatipon sang 14 points kag si Patty Mills ang nagdugang sang 12 points nga amo naka-produce sang second-highest point total sa subong nga season.
english: Meanwhile, Brooklyn Nets basketball player Andre Drummond collected 20 points and 14 rebounds, Bruce Brown and Kevin Durant each collected 14 points and Patty Mills added 12 points to produce the second-highest point total this season.

text: Ginsuguran sang duha ka team ang hampang sa score nga 32-33 records.
english: Both teams started the game with 32-33 records.

text: Nakatipon sang 20 points si Irving sa tunga-tunga sang hampang sa diin nagpanguna ang Nets sa 69-43 advantage.
english: Irving scored 20 points midway through the game as the Nets led to a 69-43 advantage.

text: Napyerde sa hampang ang Charlotte Hornets sa 13-point gap sa 120-107.
english: The Charlotte Hornets lost the game by a 13-point margin at 120-107.

text: Ginsaysay ni Punong Barangay Rodrigo “Boy” Dellomes sang Don Esteban, Lapuz, ang natabo nga pagkomprontahanay nila ni Punong Barangay Felix Ventura sang Sinikway, Lapuz.
english: Punong Barangay Rodrigo “Boy” Dellomes of Don Esteban, Lapuz, narrated the confrontation between him and Punong Barangay Felix Ventura of Sinikway, Lapuz.

text: Sa amo nga insidente nga natabo sa Don Esteban, ginpahayag nga nakit-an si Ventura nga nagkuha sang iya pusil.
english: In the incident in Don Esteban, Ventura was reportedly seen taking out his gun.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay former Punong Barangay Rodrigo “Boy” Dellomes sang Don Esteban, Lapuz, iya ginpahayag nga nagsumalangay ang ginamaneho nila nga mga salakyan kun sa diin makitid lang ang dalan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, former Punong Barangay Rodrigo “Boy” Dellomes of Don Esteban, Lapuz, said the vehicles they were driving collided where the road was narrow.

text: Suno kay Dellomes, nauna ini nga nagsulod sa dalan kag kapin 30 metros na ang distansya nga nasulod sini sang nagsugata man ang salakyan nga ginamaneho ni Ventura.
english: According to Dellomes, he entered the road first and was more than 30 meters away when he met the vehicle driven by Ventura.

text: Pahayag ni Dellomes, sang nagtabuay na ang ila mga salakyan, didto na nagtaas ang tingog ni Ventura kag may ginbuy-an ini nga indi manami nga tinaga.
english: Dellomes said that when their vehicles collided, Ventura raised his voice and let out a bad word.

text: Suno pa kay Dellomes, sang naglampas na ang salakyan ni Ventura, nakit-an nga may ginkuha ini nga pusil kag ginsiling pa nga kun wala lang ini sang kaupod, gintiro na niya ang anay punong barangay.
english: According to Dellomes, when Ventura's vehicle passed by, he was seen taking out a gun and said that if he had not been with him, he would have shot the former barangay captain.

text: Gin-ako naman ni Dellomes nga may yara gid man sila sang nauna na nga indi paghangpanay bangud sa boundary dispute sa ila barangay.
english: Dellomes acknowledged that they had a previous disagreement over the boundary dispute in their barangay.

text: Sa pihak sang isyu, gin-athag niya nga wala man ini sang kaugot ukon dumot kay Ventura apang suno sa iya, nahibaluan niya nga akig ang amo nga opisyal sa iya.
english: Despite the issue, he clarified that he has no grudge against Ventura but he said he knows that the officer is angry with him.

text: Sa subong, wala pa nakaatubangay ang duha para istoryahan ang natabo.
english: So far, the two have not met face to face to discuss the incident.

text: Kadungan sang selebrasyon sang 127th Philippine Independence Day Anniversary, agaw atensyon ang isa ka hayahay sa Guimbal, Iloilo.
english: In conjunction with the celebration of the 127th Philippine Independence Day Anniversary, a celebration in Guimbal, Iloilo, caught the attention.

text: Ang nasambit nga flag, human sa kutsinta.
english: The flag is made of kutsinta.

text: Ini ang ginbutang sa sulod sang gym sang banwa kadungan sang ginpatigayon nga programa subong nga adlaw.
english: It was placed inside the town gym during the program held today.

text: Nagbalik kag nagpatigayon sang daku nga rally si anay United States President Donald Trump sa Butler, Pennsylvania nga amo man ang lugar kun sa diin nakaluwas siya sa isa ka tuyo nga asasinasyon sang Hulyo 2024.
english: Former United States President Donald Trump returned and held a large rally in Butler, Pennsylvania, the same place where he survived an assassination attempt in July 2024.

text: Ang pagbalik sini sa amo nga lugar ang natabo man eksakto isa ka bulan antes ang November 5 presidential elections kun sa diin makasumpong sini si Vice President Kamala Harris.
english: His return to the area also comes exactly one month before the November 5 presidential elections where he will be challenged by Vice President Kamala Harris.

text: Sang natabo ang assassination attempt tatlo ka bulan na ang nagligad, pabor sa former president ang dalagan sang eleksyon sa Amerika kun sa diin nangin matunog ang iya pangalan bilang “political martyr” kag nakaluwas sa kamatayon.
english: When the assassination attempt occurred three months ago, the former president was in favor of the elections in the United States where he became famous as a "political martyr" and survived death.

text: Gindugangan pa ini sang pigado nga performance ni President Joe Biden sa debate nga sang amo nga tion amo ang presumptive nominee sang Democrats.
english: This was compounded by a poor performance in the debate by President Joe Biden who at the time was the Democrats’ presumptive nominee.

text: Halos isa ka semana matapos ang amo nga development, nagbalikad ang mga hitabo sa presidential race, nag-atras si Biden sa presidential race, kag nagbulos si Harris nga gintib-ong sang Democratic Party.
english: Nearly a week after that development, events in the presidential race turned around, Biden withdrew from the presidential race, and Harris, who was promoted by the Democratic Party, took over.

text: Kadungan sang pagbalik sang Trump campaign sa Pennsylvania, nagpadulong naman si Harris sa North Carolina agud makigkita sa emergency responders kag mga residente nga nabiktima ni Hurricane Helene.
english: Along with the Trump campaign's return to Pennsylvania, Harris traveled to North Carolina to meet with emergency responders and residents affected by Hurricane Helene.

text: Anum ka states ang nalaslasan ang hurricane kag yara sa 200 ang nagkalamatay.
english: Six states were hit by the hurricane and about 200 people died.

text: Magalab-ot pa sa masobra isa ka dekada bag-o mabalik ang pre-pandemic growth sang ekonomiya sang Pilipinas.
english: It will take more than a decade for the Philippine economy to return to its pre-pandemic growth.

text: Suno kay National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) Planning Secretary Karl Chua, ang long run total cost sang quarantine tuga sang COVID-19, ang posible magsaka sa $810 billion ukon P41.4 trillion.
english: According to National Economic and Development Authority (NEDA) Planning Secretary Karl Chua, the long run total cost of the quarantine caused by COVID-19, is likely to rise to $810 billion or P41.4 trillion.

text: Ini nga losses sa ekonomiya suno sa iya ang mabatyagan sa masunod nga 10 tubtob 40 ka tuig.
english: These economic losses, he said, will be felt for the next 10 to 40 years.

text: Posible man suno kay Chua nga mangin permanente ang pagnubo sang economic productivity tuga sang death, illness kag lack of schooling sa tunga sang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: Chua said it is also possible that the decline in economic productivity due to death, illness and lack of schooling in the midst of the COVID-19 pandemic will be permanent.

text: Pahayag ni Chua, nagresulta man sa pagkadula sang minilyon nga trabaho kag pagkagutom ang asud-asud nga pagpatuman sang lockdown kag restrictions.
english: Chua said the lockdown and restrictions have also resulted in the loss of millions of jobs and starvation.

text: Ginalauman nga mag-expand ang ekonomiya sang pungsod sa apat tubtob lima ka porsyento sini nga tuig ipaanggid sa record contraction nga 9.6 percent sang 2020.
english: The country's economy is expected to expand by four to five percent this year compared to a record contraction of 9.6 percent in 2020.

text: Apang suno kay Chua, ginalantaw nga 10 pa ka tuig antes makabalik ang pungsod sa pre-pandemic growth, nga naga-average sa 6.4 percent, bag-o nag-igo ang COVID-19 pandemic.
english: However, Chua said it is expected that it will take another 10 years for the country to return to pre-pandemic growth, which averaged 6.4 percent, before the COVID-19 pandemic hit.

text: Ginapaaligmat ang mga Pilipino sa Middle East bangud sa ginalantaw nga mga risgo sa seguridad kadungan sang una nga anibersaryo sang pagpang-atake sang Hamas militants sa southern Israel.
english: Filipinos in the Middle East are being warned of perceived security risks on the first anniversary of the attack by Hamas militants in southern Israel.

text: Natabo ini nga sorpresa nga pagpang-atake sang Oktubre 7, 2023 kun sa diin 1,200 ka mga tawo ang nagkalamatay nga kalabanan sibilyan kag 250 naman ang ginbihag sa Gaza nga kadam-an ang nahilway na.
english: This surprise attack took place on October 7, 2023 where 1,200 people were killed, mostly civilians, and 250 were taken prisoner in Gaza, most of whom have been released.

text: Sa mga napatay, apat ang mga Pilipino kun sa diin isa ang Ilongga caregiver nga tumandok sang Maasin.
english: Of the dead, four were Filipinos, one being an Ilongga caregiver from Maasin.

text: Ini nga atake ang nagpa-ibwal sang kaakig sang Israel rason nga naglunsar ini sang giyera sa Gaza agud mapapas ang Hamas.
english: This attack angered Israel, which led it to launch a war on Gaza to wipe out Hamas.

text: Nagapadayon ini subong kun sa diin 41,000 na ang nagkamatay lakip na ang mga sibilyan, kag mas nagasangkad ang tension sa Middle East bangud sang mga development sang nag-intra man ang iban nga militant groups lakip ang Houthis kag ang Hezbollah.
english: It continues today with 41,000 deaths including civilians, and tensions in the Middle East are escalating due to developments involving other militant groups including the Houthis and Hezbollah.

text: Suno sa Department of Foreign Affairs, posible nga ang Israel ukon ang pihak nga kampo ang may himuon kadungan sang anibersaryo.
english: According to the Department of Foreign Affairs, it is possible that Israel or the other camp will do something in conjunction with the anniversary.

text: Ginapanugyan sang ahensya sa mga Pinoy sa rehiyon nga magpabilin nga vigilante kag mag-check gid kun may mga abiso halin sa embahada.
english: The agency advises Filipinos in the region to remain vigilant and check for notices from the embassy.

text: Nagapati man ang ahensya nga mas nabatygan sang 30,000 ka mga Pilipino sa Israel nga safe sila sa posible nga mga pagpang-atake bangud sa mabakod nga depensa sang pungsod nga sagangon ang missile attacks.
english: The agency also believes that the 30,000 Filipinos in Israel feel safer from possible attacks because of the country's strong defense against missile attacks.

text: Indi na madepensahan ni Olympian pole-vaulter EJ Obiena ang iya titulo sa patigayunon nga Southeast Asian (SEA) Games sa Vietnam sa Mayo.
english: Olympian pole-vaulter EJ Obiena will not be able to defend his title at the Southeast Asian (SEA) Games in Vietnam in May.

text: Ini ang kasunod sang desisyon sang Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA) nga indi pag-ilakip sa mga magapasakop nga atleta si Obiena.
english: This follows the decision of the Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (PATAFA) not to include Obiena among the participating athletes.

text: Nahibaluan nga si Obiena ang reigning gold medalist sa SEA Games sang 2019.
english: Obiena was the reigning gold medalist at the SEA Games in 2019.

text: Ang amo nga desisyon ang ginkasubo ni Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) President Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino bangud nakita sini ang development ni Obiena nga subong nagapang-lima sa kalibutan sa patag sang pole-vaulter.
english: The decision was regretted by Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) President Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino because he saw the development of Obiena who is now ranked fifth in the world in the field of pole-vaulter.

text: Nagasalig kuntani si Tolentino nga sa liwat makakuha sang medalya para sa Pilipinas si Obiena.
english: Tolentino hoped that Obiena would once again win a medal for the Philippines.

text: Bilang wala nalakip sa listahan sang mga atleta nga magapadulong sa SEA Games, indi man mangin kabahin sang World Indoor Championships si Obiena nga patigayunon sa Marso 18-20 sa Belgrade, Serbia.
english: As not included in the list of athletes heading to the SEA Games, Obiena will also not be part of the World Indoor Championships to be held on March 18-20 in Belgrade, Serbia.

text: Nabungguan ang isa ka 22-anyos nga lalaki samtang nagatabok sa pedestrian lane sa porsyon sang General Luna St.
english: A 22-year-old man was struck while crossing the pedestrian lane on the portion of General Luna St.

text: Ang biktima amo si John Paul Chiva, residente sang Ipil, Calinog, Iloilo.
english: The victim was identified as John Paul Chiva, resident of Ipil, Calinog, Iloilo.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Arnel Precioso, isa ka vendor, iya ginpahayag nga pakadto kuntani sa Iloilo Provincial Capitol ang biktima sang nagtabok ini kag hinali lang nabungguan sang Toyota Veloz.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Arnel Precioso, a vendor, said the victim was on his way to the Iloilo Provincial Capitol when he crossed the road and was suddenly hit by a Toyota Veloz.

text: Dugang pa sang natungdan, gulpi man nag-minar ang salakyan sang nakalab-ot sa pedestrian lane, apang nalab-ot sini ang bitkima rason nga natumba ini kag nakaagum sang pilas sa kilid sang iya nawong kag tiil.
english: He added that the vehicle suddenly mined when it reached the pedestrian lane, but it hit the victim causing him to fall and sustain injuries to the side of his face and leg.

text: Gilayon nga gindala ang biktima sa ospital, samtang, nag-untat man ang driver sang salakyan kag padayon nga gina-imbestigaran sang katapo sang Traffic Enforcement Unit.
english: The victim was immediately brought to the hospital, while the driver of the vehicle stopped and is being investigated by members of the Traffic Enforcement Unit.

text: Apisar sang kontrobersiya sa tunga ni Filipino Olympian pole vaulter Ernest John “EJ” Obiena kag sa iya mother national sports association nga Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (Patafa), wala ini nangin upang agud magtaas pa ang iya nga tumbo kag makahatag dungog sa pungsod.
english: Despite the controversy between Filipino Olympian pole vaulter Ernest John “EJ” Obiena and his mother national sports association, the Philippine Athletics Track and Field Association (Patafa), it did not stop him from rising to the top and bringing honor to the country.

text: Sa Perche Elite Tour sa France, nag-set si Obiena sang bag-o nga national record ukon ang iya season-best nga 5.91 meters.
english: At the Perche Elite Tour in France, Obiena set a new national record or his season-best of 5.91 meters.

text: Silver medalist si EJ sa amo nga kumpetisyon.
english: EJ was a silver medalist in that competition.

text: Mas mataas ini sa iya anay nga season-best nga 5.81 meters nga nakuha niya sang nagdaog siya sang gold medal sa Orlen Cup kag Orlen Copernicus Cup sa Poland sang February.
english: That’s up from his previous season-best of 5.81 meters that he managed when winning gold medals at the Orlen Cup and Orlen Copernicus Cup in Poland in February.

text: Apang mas manubo naman ini sang duha lang ka sentimetro sa iya nga Asian record nga 5.93 meters nga gin-set niya sang nag-compete siya sa Golden Roof Challenge sa Austria sang Septyembre sang nagligad nga tuig.
english: But it is only two centimeters lower than his Asian record of 5.93 meters that he set when he competed in the Golden Roof Challenge in Austria in September last year.

text: Isa man sa nangin talalupangdon kay EJ sa iya kumpetisyon sa France amo ang pagsuksok sini sang baller band nga may duag nga yellow kag blue nga nagasimbolo sang flag sang Ukraine.
english: One of the things that also stood out about EJ during his competition in France was that he was wearing a baller band with yellow and blue colors symbolizing the Ukrainian flag.

text: Antes ang paglukso, ginbayaw ni EJ ang iya nga kamot kag ginpakita ang ballers, kag pagkatapos sang iya nga lukso, gintudlo sini ang ballers kag ginhalukan.
english: Before the jump, EJ raised his hand and showed the ballers, and after his jump, he pointed to the ballers and kissed them.

text: Nahibaluan nga isa ka Ukrainian citizen ang coach ni EJ nga si Vitaly Petrov.
english: It turns out that EJ’s coach Vitaly Petrov is a Ukrainian citizen.

text: Ginathag sang aktres nga si Heart Evangelista nga siya ang nag design sang face mask nga iya ginagamit.
english: Actress Heart Evangelista explains that she designed the face mask she uses.

text: Madumduman nga nag trending ang ginpost nga picture ni Heart sa iya nga social media sa diin nakasuksok siya sang mask nga daw kaangay nga naghalin sa isa ka malahalon nga brand.
english: It can be recalled that Heart posted a picture on her social media where she was wearing a mask that looked like it came from an expensive brand.

text: Suno kay heart, ginhimo lang niya nga ‘stylish’ ang iya nga mask paagi sa pagbutang niya sang daan nga ribbon nagikan sa mga paper bag.
english: According to heart, he just made his mask 'stylish' by putting old ribbon from paper bags.

text: Ini bangud natalupangdan sang mga netizens nga kalabanan sa mga mask ni heart ang may yara sang ribbong sang mga malahalon nga boutique.
english: This is because netizens noticed that most of heart's masks have the ribbon of expensive boutiques.

text: Dugang pa sang aktres luyag lang niya nga mangin ‘fashionably safe’.
english: The actress added that she just wanted to be ‘fashionably safe’.

text: Duha ka mga lider sang simbahan ang nag-upod sa senado sa panawagan nga padayunon ang impeachment trial kay Vice President Sara Duterte.
english: Two church leaders joined the Senate in calling for the impeachment trial of Vice President Sara Duterte to continue.

text: Suno kay Lingayen-Dagupan Archbishop Socrates Villegas, daw kaangay nga nagaupang sa kamatuoran ang delay sa hearing.
english: According to Lingayen-Dagupan Archbishop Socrates Villegas, the delay in the hearing seems to be hindering the truth.

text: May kinamatarong ang pumuluyo nga mahibaluan ang kamatuoran suno sa kasuguan kag ebidensya.
english: The people have the right to know the truth according to the law and evidence.

text: Ginakabig sini nga isa ka pagpangawat ang indi pagpahibalo sa mga pumuluyo kun ano ang kamatuoran.
english: He considers it a theft not to let the people know what the truth is.

text: Samtang, ginpahayag man ni Bishop Jose Colin Bagaforo, presidente sang Caritas Philippines nga dapat gilayon nga sabton sang Senado ang panawagan nga sugdan ang hearing nga may integridad kag pagsunod sa kasuguan.
english: Meanwhile, Bishop Jose Colin Bagaforo, president of Caritas Philippines, said the Senate should immediately respond to the call to start the hearing with integrity and compliance with the law.

text: Nag-guwa sa isa ka pagtuon nga yara gid sa pinakamanubo nga pwesto ang Pilipinas pag-abot sa resilience sang ekonomiya kag response sa COVID-19 crisis.
english: A study found that the Philippines ranks lowest in terms of economic resilience and response to the COVID-19 crisis.

text: Sa latest Covid Resilience Ranking sang international news agency nga Bloomberg, nakasaad nga 40.2 ang score ang Pilipinas — ang lowest out of 53 ka mga pungsod nga gin-rank sang pagtuon.
english: In the latest Covid Resilience Ranking by the international news agency Bloomberg, the Philippines scored 40.2 — the lowest out of 53 countries ranked by the study.

text: Sa nagligad nga report sa amo man nga pagtuon, nagapang-52 ang Pilipinas.
english: In the previous report of the same study, the Philippines ranked 52nd.

text: Ang iban nga mga Southeast Asian Countries nga yara man sa bottom five amo ang: Indonesia (52.4 ang score), Thailand (47.6), Malaysia (44.1), kag Vietnam (43.7).
english: Other Southeast Asian Countries also in the bottom five are: Indonesia (52.4 score), Thailand (47.6), Malaysia (44.1), and Vietnam (43.7).

text: Ang monthly ranking sang Bloomberg ang nagabase sa kaso sang coronavirus sa mga pungsod, quality of life, kag “reopening progress,” nga nagalakip man sang estado sang vaccination kag lockdown, amo man ang flight capacity sang mga airline companies.
english: Bloomberg’s monthly ranking is based on coronavirus cases in countries, quality of life, and “reopening progress,” which also includes the status of vaccination and lockdown, as well as the flight capacity of airline companies.

text: Nagapangibabaw sa listahan amo ang mga pungsod halin sa Europa: Ireland, Spain, the Netherlands, Finland, kag Denmark.
english: Topping the list are countries from Europe: Ireland, Spain, the Netherlands, Finland, and Denmark.

text: Natalana nga ilunsyar sang Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG) ang 911 emergency hotline sa Setyembre 11.
english: The DILG is scheduled to launch the 911 emergency hotline on September 11.

text: Suno sa DILG, paga-islan sini ang masobra 30 ka local numbers agud mapadasig ang pagresponde sang kapulisan, bombero, medical kag disaster response.
english: According to the DILG, it will replace more than 30 local numbers to speed up the response of the police, fire, medical and disaster response.

text: Ang sistema nga “Unified 911” magakonektar sa mga nagatawag sa serbisyo sa emerhensya sa isa ka network.
english: The “Unified 911” system will connect emergency service callers on a single network.

text: Ginpahayag ni DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla nga ang hotline isa ka “lifeline” kag ang mga operator ginahanas sa pagpasalig sa mga nagatawag nga ang bulig yara sa dalan.
english: DILG Secretary Jonvic Remulla said the hotline is a “lifeline” and operators are trained to reassure callers that help is on the way.

text: Ang nasambit nga panawaga, libre sa bug-os nga pungsod sa anuman nga oras kag sarang makasabat sang nagkalain-lain nga mga lenguahe sa pungsod lakip na ang Cebuano, Ilocano, Waray, Tausug kag Tagalog.
english: The call is free nationwide at any time and can be answered in various languages ​​in the country including Cebuano, Ilocano, Waray, Tausug and Tagalog.

text: Ang 911 ang una nga ginpatuman sa pungsod bilang national emergency number sang 2016 sa panahon ni sadto nga Presidente Rodrigo Duterte, nga nagbulos sa daan nga Patrol 117 hotline.
english: 911 was first implemented in the country as a national emergency number in 2016 during the time of then President Rodrigo Duterte, replacing the old Patrol 117 hotline.

text: Makaligad ang duha ka tuig, ginpirmahan ni Duterte ang Executive Order 56 nga naga-institutionalize sang 911 sa bug-os nga pungsod.
english: Two years later, Duterte signed Executive Order 56 institutionalizing 911 nationwide.

text:
Suno kay Eigenmann sa iya Instagram Stories, mas gusto niya nga ang iya mga kabataan mangin messy from living fully” sang sa “clean from sitting still.”

Ginhatagan niya pagtamod nga ang mga nagapakamalaut sa masami amo ang sahi sang mga ginikanan nga ginapabay-an lang ang ila kabataan sa bug-os nga adlaw nga mag-focus sa gadgets kag magkaon sang fast food.
english:
Eigenmann said on his Instagram Stories that he prefers his kids to be messy from living fully” rather than “clean from sitting still.”

He noted that the detractors are usually the kind of parents who just let their kids go all day focusing on gadgets and eating fast food.

text: Nakaagi ka na bala nga nagdabok sang basura, apang sang naglapta ang kalayo, nagsala-sala ka na kun paano mo ini mapatay sa kahadlok nga basi kun masunog pati ang inyo balay?
english: Have you ever burned garbage, but when the fire spread, you wondered how to put it out for fear that your house might burn down?

text: Ano pa gid abi ang imo palak kun halimbawa ikaw ang gintunaan sang isa ka wildfire?
english: What else would you do if you were the cause of a wildfire?

text:
Natabo ini sa isa ka lalaki sa western Colorado, U.S.A.

Isa ka adlaw, nagguwa ang lalaki kag ginsunog ang bangkay sang iya nga ido.
english:
This happened to a man in western Colorado, U.S.A.

One day, the man went out and burned the body of his dog.

text: Base sa record sang korte, sang ginhaboy na sang lalaki ang spray can sa kalayo, naglupok ini, naglapta ang kalayo sa kahoy nga ingod sini, nagdaku ang sunog, naglapta kag nahimo nga wildfire!
english: According to court records, when the man threw the spray can into the fire, it exploded, the fire spread to the tree where it was located, the fire grew, spread and became a wildfire!

text: Ang nasunog amo ang 28-square-kilometer private property, isa ka balay, kag ang halit nga natuga sini ang nagdangat sa $200,000 ukon ginabanta nga P11 million.
english: The fire was a 28-square-kilometer private property, a house, and the damage caused by it amounted to $200,000 or an estimated P11 million.

text: Nakilala ang lalaki bangud sang gin-report sa pulis ang wildfire, nakit-an pa ini nga naghalin sa lugar sang sunog kag nagagamit ini sang salakyan.
english: The man was identified because when the wildfire was reported to the police, he was seen leaving the scene of the fire and using a vehicle.

text: Nagapuyo man ang amo nga lalaki sa isa ka camper van nga malapit lang sa gintabuan sang sunog.
english: The man also lives in a camper van near the scene of the fire.

text: Nakit-an man sang mga imbestigador nga may mga tul-an sang ido sa lugar kag may yara sang nakasulat sa bato nga “Oct.
english: Investigators also found dog bones at the site and an inscription on the stone that read “Oct.

text:
2017 – July 2024, Rocket Dog, Rest In Peace Buddy.”

Ini amo ang ginatudlo nga lulubngan kuntani sang ido nga si Rocket.
english:
2017 – July 2024, Rocket Dog, Rest In Peace Buddy.”

This is where it is pointed out that the dog Rocket would have been buried.

text: Arestado na subong ang amo nga lalaki kag natalana nga kasuhan sang arson kag trespassing kasunod sang resulta sang pagpangusida sang wildfire investigators.#
english: The man has now been arrested and is scheduled to be charged with arson and trespassing following the results of the wildfire investigators' investigation.

text: Ginkalipay ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas ang nabaton nga sulat nga ginpadala ni Vice Mayor-elect “Love-Love” Baronda nga nagahingyo sang reconciliation meeting kay Mayor-elect Raisa Treñas-Chu.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas welcomed the letter sent by Vice Mayor-elect “Love-Love” Baronda requesting a reconciliation meeting with Mayor-elect Raisa Treñas-Chu.

text: Suno kay Mayor Treñas, mapadala man ini sang sulat bilang balos kag pahibaluon si Baronda nga naka-out-of-town si Raisa Chu kag wala pa ini naga-opisina sa Iloilo City Hall.
english: Mayor Treñas said he will also send a letter in return and inform Baronda that Raisa Chu is out-of-town and is not yet working at Iloilo City Hall.

text: Ginpasalig man sang alkalde nga makalab-ot gid sa iya anak ang sulat ni Baronda.
english: The mayor also assured that Baronda's letter will reach his son.

text: Madumduman nga nagpaguwa sang pahayag ang utod ni Love-Love nga si Congresswoman Jam-Jam Baronda nga bukas gid ang ila kampo kun maghingyo ang kampo ni Treñas sang reconciliation.
english: Love-Love's sister, Congresswoman Jam-Jam Baronda, said their camp is open if Treñas' camp requests reconciliation.

text: Pahayag sang alkalde, ini ang isa ka sinsero nga tikang padulong sa pag-ayo kag pagpadayon nagikan sa pagbinahin-bahinay nga nakit-an sa politika sa syudad.
english: The mayor said this is a sincere step towards healing and continuity from the divisions found in politics in the city.

text: Naapresyar gid niya ang “spirit of unity and collaboration” sa pagpadala ni Baronda sang amo nga sulat para sa masunod nga alkalde nga nagatuyo sang sinsero nga pagp\akig-istorya para sa siyudad kag mga Ilonggos.
english: He appreciated the “spirit of unity and collaboration” in Baronda's sending of the letter to the next mayor which aims at sincere dialogue for the city and the Ilonggos.

text: Bukas ang mga alkalde kag gobernador sa kada probinsya sa bilog nga pungsod sa paghalog sang mga pagsulundan sa domestic air travel para sa mga fully vaccinated nga mga indibidwal agud mapasanyog ang mga aktibidad sa turismo.
english: Mayors and governors in each province nationwide are open to relaxing domestic air travel rules for fully vaccinated individuals to promote tourism activities.

text: Suno kay Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion, ginsapol nila ang local chief executives sang mga top tourist destinations sa Pilipinas agud maghingyo nga dulaon na lang ang pagrequire sang Reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) test para sa mga fully vaccinated nga mga turista.
english: According to Presidential Adviser for Entrepreneurship Joey Concepcion, they met with local chief executives of top tourist destinations in the Philippines to request that the requirement of reverse transcription-polymerase chain reaction (RT-PCR) test for fully vaccinated tourists be abolished.

text: ”We have to start allowing mobility for our tourism site, we met with our governors, mayors of the top tourists’ destinations.
english: ”We have to start allowing mobility for our tourism site, we met with our governors, mayors of the top tourists’ destinations.

text: We’re asking them to waive the PCR tests that’s a very expensive test.
english: We’re asking them to waive the PCR tests that’s a very expensive test.

text:
They’re open to the idea of allowing airlines to fly passengers without PCR tests anymore.”

Apang required sa gihapon ang RT-PCR test sa mga indibidwal nga indi bakunado.
english:
They’re open to the idea of ​​allowing airlines to fly passengers without PCR tests anymore.”

However, the RT-PCR test is still required for unvaccinated individuals.

text: Ginhingyo man ni Concepcion ang coronavirus task force nga buhinan ang quarantine days para sa international travelers halin North America kalakip na ang vaccinated nga mga overseas workers.
english: Concepcion also urged the coronavirus task force to reduce the quarantine days for international travelers from North America including vaccinated overseas workers.

text: Magaumpisa na subong nga adlaw, Marso 4, ang Winter Paralympics sa Beijing, China.
english: The Winter Paralympics begin today, March 4, in Beijing, China.

text: Milagro naman para sa mga atleta sang Ukraine nga nakaabot sila nga buhi sa amo nga hinampang kag makatiglawas sa ila pungsod sa isa ka prestihiyoso nga kumpetisyon apisar sang pagpamomba kag kakugmat nga nagakatabo subong sa Ukraine.
english: It is a miracle for the Ukrainian athletes that they arrived alive at the Games and represented their country in a prestigious competition despite the bombing and terror that is currently taking place in Ukraine.

text: Sandig sa una nga anunsyo sang International Paralympic Committee (IPC), 20 ang atleta nga halin sa Ukraine nga magapasakop sa biathlon kag cross-country skiing.
english: According to the initial announcement of the International Paralympic Committee (IPC), 20 athletes from Ukraine will compete in biathlon and cross-country skiing.

text: Daku ang pangalan sang amo nga pungsod sa Paralympics bangud sang 2018, nakuha nila ang 22 ka mga medalya, lakip na ang pito kag gold — kag nagpang-anum sa world tally.
english: The country has a big name in the Paralympics because in 2018, they won 22 medals, including seven and gold — and finished sixth in the world tally.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, gindumilian naman ang mga atleta sang Russia kag ang kaalyado sini nga pungsod nga Belarus nga magpasakop sa paralympics.
english: Meanwhile, athletes from Russia and its ally Belarus have been banned from participating in the Paralympics.

text: Buwas na, Septyembre 7, ang una nga adlaw sang 2025 Philippine Bar Examinations, nga magapadayon sa Septyembre 10 kag 14, 2025.
english: Tomorrow, September 7, is the first day of the 2025 Philippine Bar Examinations, which will continue on September 10 and 14, 2025.

text: Isa sa gin-designar sang Korte Suprema nga testing centers amo ang Central Philippine University (CPU) sa Iloilo City.
english: One of the testing centers designated by the Supreme Court is the Central Philippine University (CPU) in Iloilo City.

text: Kaangot diri, nag-isyu si Mayor Raisa Treñas sang tatlo ka executive orders sa tuyo nga mahagan-hagan ang distractions kag mapasiguro ang kalinong para sa linibo ka law graduates nga magakuha sang national examinations.
english: In this regard, Mayor Raisa Treñas issued three executive orders in order to alleviate distractions and ensure peace for thousands of law graduates who will take the national examinations.

text: Sa idalom sang EO No.
english: Under EO No.

text: 57, ginadumilian ang pagbaligya kag ang pag-inom sang makahulubog nga ilimnon sa sulod sang 500-meter radius sang CPU halin sa tungang gab-i sang Sept.
english: 57, prohibits the sale and consumption of alcoholic beverages within a 500-meter radius of the CPU from midnight on Sept.

text: 6, 9, kag 13 tubtub sa 11:59 p.m. sang Sept.
english: 6, 9, and 13 through 11:59 p.m. on Sept.

text: Sa EO No.
english: In EO No.

text: 58, ginamanduan ang mga negosyo nga maglikaw sa paghimo sang mga gahod.
english: 58, orders businesses to refrain from making noises.

text: Ginhatagan man sang mandu ang mga kontraktor nga suspendiron ang mga construction kag ang maintenance malapit sa unibersidad samtang nga padayon ang pagkuha sang test.
english: Contractors were also ordered to suspend construction and maintenance near the university while testing continues.

text: Temporaryo man nga ginadumilian ang mga makatuga sang gahod kaangay sang videoke machines.
english: Noise makers such as videoke machines are also temporarily prohibited.

text: Sa pihak nga bahin, may coordinating committee naman nga gintukod pagai sa EO No.
english: On the other hand, a coordinating committee was established under EO No.

text: 59 kun sa diin siguraduhon ang security, traffic, health, disaster risk management, kag public information.
english: 59 which will ensure security, traffic, health, disaster risk management, and public information.

text: Ang Chairperson sang 2025 Bar Examinations Committee amo si SC Associate Justice Amy C. Lazaro-Javier.
english: The Chairperson of the 2025 Bar Examinations Committee is SC Associate Justice Amy C. Lazaro-Javier.

text: Anum ka core subjects ang igalakip sa exams.
english: Six core subjects will be included in the exams.

text: Sa una nga adlaw, magatutok ang test sa Political and Public International Law kag Commercial and Taxation Laws; Civil Law, Labor Law kag Social Legislation sa Septyembre 10; samtang Criminal Law, Remedial Law, kag Legal and Judicial Ethics with Practical Exercises naman sa katapusan nga adlaw sang pasinawan.#
english: On the first day, the test will focus on Political and Public International Law and Commercial and Taxation Laws; Civil Law, Labor Law and Social Legislation on September 10; while Criminal Law, Remedial Law, and Legal and Judicial Ethics with Practical Exercises will be on the last day of the examination.

text: Magauntat sa pag-operate ang 30% sang mga backyard hog raisers bangud nagadagsa ang mga imported pork products nga amo ang nagapanubo sang farm-gate prices.
english: Thirty percent of backyard hog raisers will stop operating because of the influx of imported pork products, which is driving down farm-gate prices.

text: Suno kay ProPork chairman Nicanor Briones, nagakahangawa ang local hog industry bangud ang presyo sang live hogs ang yara na lang sa P150 kada kilo.
english: According to ProPork chairman Nicanor Briones, the local hog industry is worried because the price of live hogs is only P150 per kilo.

text: Pahayag pa niya, ang pork products nga gina-import ang tuman ka barato kag manubo pa ang taripa rason nga nagakaputo ang mga manugbaboy sa bilog nga pungsod.
english: He said the pork products imported are very cheap and the tariff is low, which is why pig farmers across the country are starving.

text: Bangud sini, indi malayo nga madamo ang magauntat sang operasyon kag indi na sila magsagod pa sang baboy.
english: As a result, many will soon stop operating and no longer raise pigs.

text: Padayon ang pagpaninguha ni Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas sa pagpangita sang epektibo nga solusyon sa problema sang pagbaha sa pila ka mga parte sang syudad.
english: Iloilo City Mayor Jerry Treñas continues his efforts to find an effective solution to the problem of flooding in some parts of the city.

text: Sa interview sang Bombo Radyo kay Treñas, iya ginpahayag nga nagpatigayon siya sang meeting upod ang pila ka mga ahensya sang lokal nga gobyerno agud istoryahan kag usisaon ang mga rason sang pagbaha, labi na kun magbubo ang mamunog nga ulan.
english: In an interview with Bombo Radyo Koronadal, Treñas said he held a meeting with several local government agencies to discuss and investigate the causes of flooding, especially when heavy rains fall.

text: Una na nga gintutukan ang La Paz area matapos makabaton sang madamo nga reklamo halin sa mga residente, partikular sa isyu sang drainage system.
english: The La Paz area was initially targeted after receiving many complaints from residents, particularly on the issue of the drainage system.

text: Suno kay Mayor Treñas, nabuksan na ang pila ka mga ginpangsiraduhan nga drainage sa Divinagracia, La Paz, bangud may yara na sang nahamtang nga pumping station sa Libertad area nga magbulig suyop sang tubig.
english: According to Mayor Treñas, some of the closed drainages in Divinagracia, La Paz have been opened, because there is already a pumping station in the Libertad area to help absorb water.

text: Ginalantaw man sang alkalde nga isa sa mga rason sang pagbaha amo ang madamo nga mga pamalay kag taytay sa palibot sang Rizal Creek sa La Paz, kun sa diin mabudlay magguwa ang tubig.
english: The mayor also believes that one of the reasons for the flooding is the many houses and bridges around the Rizal Creek in La Paz, where it is difficult to get out of the water.

text: Gin-athag man sang alkalde nga may yara na sila sang mga plano nga paga-islan ang mga daan nga drain inlets kag magdugang sang mga pumping station nga konektado na sa kuryente.
english: The mayor also explained that they already have plans to replace the old drain inlets and add pumping stations that are already connected to electricity.

text: Sa subong, padayon ang koordinasyon sang lokal nga gobyerno sang Iloilo sa pagresolbar sang problema nga nagaapekto sa seguridad kag kahilwayan sang mga pumuluyo.
english: Meanwhile, the local government of Iloilo continues to coordinate to resolve the problem that affects the security and freedom of the people.

text: Excited si Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach sa iya pagpanumbalik sa Indonesia.
english: Miss Universe 2015 Pia Wurtzbach is excited about her return to Indonesia.

text: Suno kay Pia, may yara sang ‘special place’ ang Indonesia sa iya nga tagipusu-on bangud nadumduman niya ang iya una nga trip bilang Miss Universe sa Jakarta kag Bali.
english: According to Pia, Indonesia has a special place in her heart because she remembers her first trip as Miss Universe to Jakarta and Bali.

text: Dugang sang natungdan, kaangay sa Pilipinas nabatyagan niya ang pagpalangga sa mga pageant lovers sa Indonesia.
english: She added that like in the Philippines, she felt the love of pageant lovers in Indonesia.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagpadulong si Pia sa Indonesia agud magjudge sa Puteri Indonesia nga isa ka pageant sa diin ginapili ang mangin tiglawas nila sa Miss Universe.
english: It is known that Pia went to Indonesia to judge in Puteri Indonesia, a pageant where they choose their representative in Miss Universe.

text: Kaupod man ni Pia sa Indonesia si reigning Miss Universe Zozibini Tunzi sang South Africa.
english: Also with Pia in Indonesia is reigning Miss Universe Zozibini Tunzi of South Africa.

text: Dugang pa nga mga sports governing bodies ang nagsugud naman sa pag-ban sang mga Russian teams kag athletes sa pagparticipar sa mga kompetisyon kasunod sang pagsalakay sang Russia sa Ukraine.
english: More sports governing bodies have begun banning Russian teams and athletes from participating in competitions following Russia's invasion of Ukraine.

text: Gin-ban sang International Basketball Federation (FIBA) kag sang International Skating Unions (ISU) ang Russian athletes.
english: The International Basketball Federation (FIBA) and the International Skating Unions (ISU) banned Russian athletes.

text: Nauna na nga ginkakas sang International Volleyball Federation ang Russia nga amu kuntani ang host sa men’s world championships subong nga summer.
english: The International Volleyball Federation has already removed Russia from hosting the men's world championships this summer.

text: Samtang, nagpagwa naman sang pahayag ang ang governing bodies sa pro tennis (ATP kag WTA) nga ang mga atleta halin sa Russia kag Belarus ang sa gihapon tugutan nga magparticipar sa kondisyon nga sila ang maga-compete nga indi sa idalom sang ila nasyon.
english: Meanwhile, the governing bodies of pro tennis (ATP and WTA) issued a statement that athletes from Russia and Belarus will still be allowed to participate on condition that they compete outside their country.

text: Nahibaluan nga nagpalab-ot sang supporta ang FIBA kag ang ISU sa Ukraine.
english: FIBA and the ISU have extended their support to Ukraine.

text: Kun matandaan ang Women’s Russian figure skaters ang ginakabig ‘best in the world’ nga amu ang indi na maka-compete sa world figure skating championships subong nga bulan sa Montpellier, France.
english: The Women's Russian figure skaters, considered the best in the world, will not be able to compete in the World Figure Skating Championships this month in Montpellier, France.

text: Nahibaluan nga nadesisyonan naman sang FIFA nga dumilian nga mag-compete sa World Cup soccer qualifiers ang Russian.
english: FIFA has decided to ban the Russian from competing in the World Cup soccer qualifiers.

text: Indi magsuporta si United States President Joe Biden pananglitan gusto sang Israel nga atakehon ang nuclear program sang Iran.
english: United States President Joe Biden will not support if Israel wants to attack Iran's nuclear program.

text: Ini ang lakip lang sa mga gina-bati-bati nga posible kabahin sang pagtimalos nanday Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu matapos nagpaulan ang Iran sang ginabanta 200 ka missiles sa Israel sang nagligad nga gab-i nga ang iban nakalusot pa depensa sang amo nga Jewish state.
english: This is just one of the rumors that may be part of Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's revenge after Iran rained about 200 missiles on Israel last night, some of which escaped the defenses of the Jewish state.

text: Ang pahayag ni Biden nga indi ini magsuporta sa pagtimalos sang Tel Aviv ang kasunod sang iya diskusyon sa iban nga lider sang Group of Seven ukon G7 nga amo ang Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan kag United Kingdom.
english: Biden's statement that he would not support Tel Aviv's retaliation followed discussions with other leaders of the Group of Seven or G7, namely Canada, France, Germany, Italy, Japan and the United Kingdom.

text: Sa amo nga diskusyun na-istoryahan ang posible nga bag-o nga sanctions batok sa Iran.
english: During the discussion, possible new sanctions against Iran were discussed.

text: Nahibaluan nga ang Estados Unidos kag ang mga kaalyado sini ang nagatulod sa Israel nga magpugong kag dapat gid nga balansehon sang maayo ang plano sini nga magtimalos batok sa Iran.
english: It is well known that the United States and its allies are pushing Israel to exercise restraint and must carefully balance its retaliation plan against Iran.

text: Ang pag-intra sang G7 ang sa tuyo man nga punggan ang paglapta pa gid sang gyera sa Middle East nga una natabo sa tunga sang Israel kag Hamas kag gin-intrahan sang iban pa gid nga militant groups nga amo ang Hezbollah kag mangin ang Houthis nga lunsay proxies sang Iran.
english: The G7's involvement is also aimed at preventing the further spread of the war in the Middle East, which first occurred between Israel and Hamas and involved other militant groups such as Hezbollah and the Houthis, both proxies of Iran.

text: Kun tandugon sang Israel ang controversial nuclear program sang Tehran, amo ini ang makabig nga pinakadaku nga lihok nga maga-garit-garit gid sa amo nga pungsod kag magapaibwal pa sang gyera sa rehiyon sang Middle East.
english: If Israel were to touch Tehran's controversial nuclear program, it would be considered the biggest move that would deeply destabilize the country and spark war in the Middle East region.

text:
Negatibo ang panan-awan sang mga negosyo sa ekonomiya sang Pilipinas santo sa pinakaulihe nga ”business and consumer expectation surveys” sang Bangko Sentral ng Pilipinas

Suno kay Redentor Paolo Alegre Jr., senior director sang Department of Economic Statistics sang BSP, nagnubo sa negative 5.6 ka porsyento sa ika-tatlo nga quarter halin sa 1.4 percent sang ika-duha nga quarter sang 2021 ang overall confidence index sang mga negosyo sa pungsod.
english:
Businesses have a negative outlook on the Philippine economy according to the latest "business and consumer expectation surveys" of the Central Bank of the Philippines

According to Redentor Paolo Alegre Jr., senior director of the Department of Economic Statistics of the BSP, the overall confidence index of businesses in the country fell to negative 5.6 percent in the third quarter from 1.4 percent in the second quarter of 2021.

text: Ini bangud man sa epekto sang nagapadayon nga pandemya.
english: This is also due to the impact of the ongoing pandemic.

text: Ang business expectation survey ang ginpatigayon sang Hulyo 22 tubtob Septyembre 15 samtang Hulyo 1 tubtob 14 naman ang Consumer Expectation Survey.
english: The business expectation survey was conducted from July 22 to September 15 while the Consumer Expectation Survey was conducted from July 1 to 14.

text: Santo sa naggwa nga resulta, natumod nga ang enhanced community quarantine (ECQ), manubo nga sales kag inflation ang mga rason sang negative outlook sang businesses ukon mga negosyo.
english: According to the results, the enhanced community quarantine (ECQ), low sales and inflation are the reasons for the negative outlook of businesses.

text: Ginabantayan sang fans ang natalana nga kasal sang celebrity couple nga sanday Sarah Lahbati kag Richard Gutierrez.
english: Fans are keeping an eye on the scheduled wedding of celebrity couple Sarah Lahbati and Richard Gutierrez.

text: Nag shoot na sang ila pre-nup photos ang celebrity couple sa El Nido, Palawan nga may tema nga underwater.
english: The celebrity couple shot their pre-nup photos in El Nido, Palawan with an underwater theme.

text: Nangin topiko man sa social media ang bigatin nga principal sponsors ukon maninoy kag maninay sa kasal kaangay na lang nanday Presidente Rodrigo Duterte, anay presidente Gloria Macapagal Arroyo kag Joseph Estrada, mag-asawa nga Sen.
english: The main sponsors of the wedding, such as President Rodrigo Duterte, former President Gloria Macapagal Arroyo and Joseph Estrada, Sen.

text: Manny kag Jinkee Pacquiao kag iban pa nga kilala nga personalidad sa pungsod.
english: Manny and Jinkee Pacquiao and other well-known personalities in the country.

text: Nahibaluan nga hiwaton ang kasal sang duha sa Marso 14, 2020.
english: The couple will be married on March 14, 2020.

text: Magapanubo ang Department of Agriculture (DA) sang suggested retail price (SRP) sang imported nga bugas sa P43 kada kilo umpisa Hulyo 1, halin sa P45.
english: The Department of Agriculture (DA) will reduce the suggested retail price (SRP) of imported rice to P43 per kilo starting July 1, from P45.

text: Santo ini sa mando ni Presidente Ferdinand Marcos Jr.
english: This is in accordance with the order of President Ferdinand Marcos Jr.

text: nga padayunon niya ang pagpangita sang paagi agud mapamag-an ang gasto sang mga Pilipino ilabi na sa bugas.
english: that he will continue to find ways to ease the cost of Filipinos especially on rice.

text: Suno kay DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., ang tikang sabat sa pagpanubo sang presyo sang bugas sa global market kag gin-umpisahan na ini sang Enero, agud magpabatyag sang epekto sang plano nga pagpanaug sang rice tariff halin 35% pakadto 15% sa Hulyo.
english: According to DA Secretary Francisco Tiu Laurel Jr., the move is a response to the reduction of rice prices in the global market and was initiated in January, to make the impact of the planned reduction of rice tariff from 35% to 15% in July felt.

text: Ang inisyatibo nga ini kabahin sang kampanya nga “Benteng Bigas, Meron Na!” nga nagatuman sa promisa ni Presidente Marcos nga maghatag bugas sa presyo nga P20 kada kilo.
english: This initiative is part of the campaign “Benteng Bigas, Meron Na!” fulfilling President Marcos' promise to provide rice at P20 per kilo.

text: Ang pilot run sang P20 rice program magalawig tubtob Disyembre kag target nga maghatag sang benepisyo sa 14 milyones nga low-income kag at-risk nga mga Pilipino kag minimum wage earners.
english: The pilot run of the P20 rice program will last until December and is targeted to benefit 14 million low-income and at-risk Filipinos and minimum wage earners.

text: Nagmandu man si Presidente Marcos sa DA nga ipadayon ang P20 kada kilo nga bugas nga programa tubtob matapos ang iya termino sa Hunyo 2028.
english: President Marcos also ordered the DA to continue the P20 per kilo rice program until the end of his term in June 2028.

text: Samtang, ginmando ni Speaker Ferdinand Martin G. Romualdez ang mga policy kag budget experts sang House of Representatives nga himuon ang maid-id nga pag-review sang posibilidad nga himuon nga national policy ang P20 kada kilo nga bugas nga programa.
english: Meanwhile, Speaker Ferdinand Martin G. Romualdez directed the policy and budget experts of the House of Representatives to conduct a thorough review of the possibility of making the P20 per kilo rice program a national policy.

text: Ginpahayag man ni Romualdez nga pagahandaan sang Kamara nga mag-draft sang hagna agud ma-institutionalize ang programa, nga ginlantaw niya nga isa ka importante nga tikang sa long-term food security kag economic relief para sa minilyon nga Pilipino.
english: Romualdez also said the House will prepare to draft a bill to institutionalize the program, which he viewed as an important step in long-term food security and economic relief for millions of Filipinos.

text: Ginpadayaw sang Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) ang makabig “fighting team” sang Pilipinas nga amu ang ipadala saVietnam para sa Southeast Asian (SEA) games sa Mayo.
english: The Philippine Olympic Committee (POC) has praised the Philippines' fighting team that will be sent to Vietnam for the Southeast Asian (SEA) games in May.

text: Gin-ako naman sang POC nga mas naggamay ang numero sang mga atleta nga ipadala sang Pilipinas subong nga tuig kun ipaanggid sang 2019.
english: The POC acknowledged that the number of athletes sent by the Philippines this year has decreased compared to 2019.

text: May kabug-usan nga 656 ka mga atleta ang ipadala sa Vietnam mas manubo sa 1,115 sang 2019.
english: A total of 656 athletes will be sent to Vietnam down from 1,115 in 2019.

text: Suno kay POC president Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino, nagasalig ini nga madepensahan sang Pilipinas ang titulo nga ila nakuha sang 2019.
english: POC president Abraham “Bambol” Tolentino said he is confident that the Philippines will defend the title they won in 2019.

text: Ang Pilipinas ang maga-compete sa 39 out of 40 sports.
english: The Philippines will compete in 39 out of 40 sports.
